tei:div.tei:p: rmordobyerdzorka/ ༄ri byene+eṣ+pe 4d+nghawar+shalko swā ciX/༷3ṭ+wāṃXskre/byeshād+nghaXlge+o/ snyehūṃsdeX—wawa wa ྾ —4—/lnguk+to byelartewawa—mo wawa9shā4
da sproraju

da༅༅/ / sngags mang dpe tshogs rtsom sgrig khongs mi lhan rgyas/blo 'dri sa/mkhan dkon mchog rin chen/ dkar brjid sku lo bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma/gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/ rdo grub sprul sku klong yangs/ grub dbang namamakha'/ka ring rta mgrin/ mag gsar snangasrid rdo rje/ mibaskyod mkhasagrub rgya mtsho/ rtse gzhung lhaspyon rol ba rtsal/ sngags 'chang rta mgrin rgyal/spyikhrab rtsom sgrigaspu/hūṃ chen he ru ka nyi zla he ru kasbyikhrab rtsomaz-ig gzhon pa/yon tan rgya mtsho/ yeshesa'od zer sgrol ma/ rig 'dzin 'od gsal rdo rje/rtsom sgrigaspu/ka rong 'jigasamed rang grol/ rong skyesasnang mdzad rdo rje/ dbang chen pad+ma rig 'dzin/ 'jigs med 'gro phan/ smin gling 'gyur med rab rgyas/ thub bstan sgrol ma/

dpe skrun gsal bshad/de yang 'phrin las rdo rje phur pa 'di spyir na sngatshomo'i dus su bod spyi'i yi dam du bkur ba zhig yin la/ sgos su o rgyan rin po che'i rjes 'jug pa dag gis lhag pa'i lha mchog tu 'bral med 'dzin pa dang yi dam kun gyi rgyal por bsngags pas na/ snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i bstan pa'i nyi zer phog pa'i yul gru kun du dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i byin rlabs kyi me+e tog tshar du dngar ba ni smos med red/ de bzhin du reb kong rig 'dzin sngags kyi grong khyer chen po ru yang/ grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma rang grol dang 'gro mgon dkon mchog chos 'phel/ drag po mngon spyod kyi las la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i mag gsar kun bzang stobs ldan dbang po/ rigatsho'adzin chen po dgu rong sna tshogs rang grol sogs phur pa'i rnal 'byor pa zam ma chad par byon zhing phur pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bsgrubs/ deng gi char yang reb kong sngags mang phur thogs stong dang dgu brgya'i rjes 'jug pa dag gis ni lhag lha phur pa la byed pa shas che/ 'on te bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis gnas 'di ru phur pa'i dbang lung khrid gsum nyams shing phur par bsnyen bsgrub gnad smin byed mkhan kyang dkon por snang la/ lhag par du phur pa'i chos skor gyi phyag dpe gal chen rigs kyang mi mang ba sogs la gzhigs nas/ rig 'dzin 'dus sde 'di ga'i mkhas dbang lha smyon rol ba rtsal nas nged sngags mang zhib 'jug khang gi mngag bcol ltar〈〈phur pa'i chos 'byung〉〉zer ba zhig rtsom pa'i ngal ba khur du bzhes nas dus yun ring bo ma phyin pa na/ khong sku snyun lci mos btab nas las 'di'i mjug mi bsdu rang bsdur song bas/ nged zhib 'jug khang gis reb kong sngags mang gtso byas mdo smad rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshom bu'i dgos mkhor dmigs te/ da lam 'di phyogs sngags mang la dkon zhing gsar skyes sngags 'chang rnams la phan du re ba'i rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor gyi dpe rnying gal chen 'ga' phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs par〈〈phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs〉〉zhes pa'i mtshan gyis dbu rnam par brgyan pa lags/sngags mang zhib 'jug khang gis/2 kya 0 5lo'i zla2par zi ling du/

༄7/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/༄7/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byang tshal lo rgyas ngo mtshar /9tshorgyar rwari rami ra ba reshārmorgya mcha' rba rlabs zhas bya ba bzhugs sa/ /༄7/ / dpal rdo rje phur pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig 'dzin bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la/ /bdag yid gus pas rtag par phyag bgyis te/ /yang gsang chos kyi gtam brgyus(rgyud)bsgrags par bya/ /de la ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang pos dus phun sum tshogs pa dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi dus/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams su/ skye med mtha' bral chen po'i dgongs pa las ma g.yos bzhin du/'gag med cho 'phrul bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum du skur bzhengs te thabs shes rab gnyis su med par sbyor ba las/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa phyogs bcu'i khro bo phra thabs dang / phur pa sras kyi dkyil 'khor mngon par sprul nas/ chos phun sum tshogs pa byi to ta ma la 'bum sde la sogs pa 'phrin las phur pa'i rgyud mtha' dag gsungs so/ /rgyud de dag kyang / ston pa nyid dang / rdo rje sems dpa' dang / phyag na rdo rje/mkha' 'gro ma dang / bram ze mi'i thod pa can la sogs pas yang dag par bsdus so/ / ci 'khor gyis bsdus pa nyid rigs kyi/ ston pa nyid kyis bsdus pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ de ni 'di skad bdag gis bshad pa'i dus cig na/ ces pa dang gsang 'dus kyi 'grel(slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gsang ba grub pa las)pa las/ slob dpon kha cig 'di skad du/dpal ldan 'dus pa mdangs can gyi/ /rgyud kyi sdud par byed pa po/ /dpa' bo 'jig rten dbang phyug zer/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i sdud pa po/ /gzhan dag yod pa ma yin zhes/ /bdag nyid 'ba' zhig smra bar byed/ /rgyud mdzad pa po ni thugs rdo rje/ /zhes rgya 'grel las 'byung bas gsal ba yin no/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma dang mi'i yul du rim gyis dar ba yin te/ ston pa kun tu bzang pos/ rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / rdo rje gzhon nu dang / lag na rdo rje dang / de dag ni rgyal rigs bzhi/1 de dag

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/la slon dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis gsan no/ /yang rdo rje sems dpa'/ des dga' rab rdo rje la bshad/ des sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi sprul pa bzhad pa'i rdo rje la bshad/des rgyal po u ru sha ne la/ des klu'i bu mo rgya mtsho la/ des rgyal po in+t+ra bhu ti la/ des slob dpon dha na sang tri ta/ dha na u pa ya/ blo ldan mchog sred gsum la bshad/ dha na sang tri tas slon dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / bi ma la mi tra/ bal po shī la maspru gsum la bshad do/ /yang rdo rje sems dpas/ rgyal po dza la glegs bam gyi char dngos grub du phab pa las brgyud pa yang yod de/ ji skad du/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ /thugs rje mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /spo ti glegs bam snang bar byed/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal po dza lha lcam go ma de wī/ rgyal bu sha kra pu ri nas rim par brgyud de rgya bal bod du dar ro/ / yang kun tu bzang pos rdo rje gzhon nu la/ des bram ze mi thod can/ des mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che la gtad/ des mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par gter du sbas/ de shrī sing has thon/ des za hor gyi mkhan po pra bha ha ste/ des lha lam a pa dā na/ des slon dpon pad+ma 'byang gnas la brgyud/gi//5 sa ri niri byeces grags so/ / brgyud tshul gzhan yang mang du yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni bdag cag lta bu mthong ba chung ba dag gis ji ltar thos pa nyid bris pa tsam mo/ / da ni sangs rgyas gnyis pa mi yul du byon pa slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di'i sku che ba'i tshul mdo tsam smos na/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ / kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod 'dzin pa/ / rgyal po sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs 'chang / / che ba sangs rgyas rigs sngags rgyal/ / zhes gsungs pas/ brjod bya bshad thabs phyogs gcig gis chos dang gang zag gnyis ka lung bstan pa ltar du spyir slob dpon chen po 'di pad+ma la rdzus te skyes pa yin na yang / phrin las phur pa'i chos 'di spel ba'i slad du mngal du skye ba bzung bar mdzad pa yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan mngal skyes kyi sems can rnams rdzus skyes kyis mi thul bas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyang mngal 'dzin pa'i tshul ston dgos pa'i phyir/ slob dpon gyis kyang mngal du zhugs pa'i tshul bstan pas/ rgya bod gnyis su slob dpon gyi chos gzhan pas phur pa dar che zhing 'di'i sgo nas grol ba thob pa dang / grub pa brnyes pa byon pa'i rnam grangs brjod kyis mi langs pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/ / de yang o rgyan gyi yul na srid skyong pa'i rgyal po ma nu si ta bya ba'i bu dā na rak+shi ta zhes kyang bya/ shān+ta rak+shi ta bya ba ༵ dob dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs ldan pas pad+ma'i rigs kyi mtshan dang ldan zhing /

༄/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byu༄ tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/sgyu rtsal thams cad rdzogs pa mgo dang sked pa rgya mdud ro stod cums bzhogs/ ro smad zur gsum/ kha dang mig zla gam skra kham pa ste/ mi sdug phur pa'i mtshan nyid can zhig skyes so/ /de cher skyes pa na/ yul de'i rgyal po sras kyis phongs pa zhig la/ nam 'i/ga na sras gcig byung nas/ de skyed mos tshal du bza' shing gi bsil grib la bsnyal ba'i mgo la sha sbrang zhig gis za bzhin 'dug pa la/ dā na rak+shi tas rgyal bu shi yi dogs/ sor rdo 'phangs pas rde'u dang sha sbrang sbrags te klad pa la song nas rgyal bu shi'o/ / 'di la kha cig blon po'i bu tri shu la phog nas bsad zer te/ rdzus skyes kyi lo rgyus su de ltar yin gyi/ 'dir mi 'thad do/ /de nas mi rnams kyis/ khyod kyis rgyal bu bsad do byas pas/ bdag gis ngan sems kyis ma brgyab ste/ rgyal bu'i mgo la sha sbrang cig za zhing mchis pas/ sha sbrang la 'phangs pas sor rdo dang bcas pa klad par song nas bkums so zhes smras pa/ mi rnams kyis bltas pas/de ltar 'dug pa dang / rgyal khrims gnyan pas nyes pa rab gsod/ 'bring sgyugs/ tha ma lo gsar lhags sgang la nangs ma re la bag phye khal brgya pa re 'jal du 'jug pa las/ 'di da res rgyal po'i sras bsad pa yin pas nyes pa rab tu 'ong ste ngan sems kyis ma brgyab pas/spyugs par rigs/ zhes gros 'chams te spyugs so/ /der mda' lnga dang gzhu thogs nas rgya gar gyi dur khrod so sa gling du byon/ yo byad gzhan ci yang med pas/ ro zas 'bras chan zas su bza' zhing ro ras gos su gyon/ pho byung tshad btags shing btang / mo byung tshad spyad cing btang pas dur khrod na srin po shān+ta rak+ṣi ta bya ba snang ngo / / zhes grong khyer kun tu gleng ngo / / de'i tshe yul de'i rgyal po 'thab par dga' ba zhes bya ba khros te/ 'di ma bsad na yul khams phung ste 'gro bas sod cig ces bsgos nas dmag bcas te/ rgyal po'i bu in+t+ra rā dza dpa' zhing brtul bas lung pa'i ngogs dur khrod mdo 'gag dam par dgag tu bcugargyal po dmag dang bcas pas ri rongs dur khrod kun bshus pas/ shān+ta rak+ṣi ta bros pa dang /dur khrod kyi mdo 'gag na rgyal bu in+t+ra rā dzas dgug(sgug) pa dang 'phrad de der shān+ta rak+ṣi tas mda' 'phangs pas/ in+t+ra rā dza'i snying la phog ste bsad do/ /de nas bros te song pa na/re zhig na lam du mi gnyis dang phrad nas/ khyed gnyis gar 'gro dris pas/ za hor gyi mkhan po la chos nyan par 'gro brer/ der sngar gyi rang gi spyod pa la skyo ste grogs dang bsdongs te chos la phyin pas/ lam du slob dpon shākya bo dhi dang mjal nas gsum ka rab tu byung /dge tshul gyi khrims mnos te/ ming yang shākya pra bha/ shākya mi tra/ shākya seng ge zhes btags/ de nas za hor du byon pas/ slob dpon pra bha ha ti dang mjal/ grogs gnyis — 3 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/kyis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas chos zhus pas gsum ga la yo ga'i dbang rdzogs par bskur/gsang mtshan las kyi rdo rje/ chos rab rdo rje/ shākya seng ge'i mtshan sems dpa' rdo rje zhes btags so/ / ta thā sam gra ha'i rgyud mtshan nyid sde gsum ltar bshad nas tshim mam gsungs pas/ shākya pra bha tshim zer nas song / gnyis pos ma tshim byas pas sngags phyi pa sde gsum ltar tshar gcig bshad nas tshim mam gsungs/ shākya mi tra tshim zer nas song / shākya seṅges mi bsad pas yul du 'gro sa med pas ma tshim byas pas/ slob dpon gyis lag mthil du yo gi'i lha rnams gsal bar bstan nas/ dbang 'di la zhu 'am/ nga la zhu gsungs/ der slob dpon la zhu byas pas/ slob dpon na re/ rig dbang rig pa'i sras yin pas/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nga las sprul/ / nga ni thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yin/ / nga las thams cad byung bas na/ /nga yis bstan pa bzhin du nyon/ /zhes gsungs nas yo gi'i chos thams cad rdzogs par bslabs/ de nas gsang ba bla na med pa sgyu 'phrul gyi dbang rdzogs par bskur/ de nas phur pa 'bum sde'i chos thams cad rdzogs par bshad pa yin no/ / de nas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rtogs/ tshe la dbang pa'i rig 'dzin thob/ za hor rgyal po'i bu mo me tog man dā ra bya ba sgrub byar bkugs nas/ nub phyogs kyi ri bo go ma ha ti sha ga'i brag phug mā ra ti ka ru bsgrubs pas rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin thob po/ / de nas bsad pas mi 'jigs snyam ste/ rgya gar du byon pas/ sngon rgyal bu in+t+ra rā dza bsad pa'i mi thong po yin pa ngo shes nas/ rgyal po 'bangs dang bcas pas/ slob dpon lha lcam dang bcas pa tsan+dan gyi me la bsregs te/ zhag bdun nas du ba chad pa dang bltas pas/ mtshe'u'i dbus na pad+ma'i sdong po skyes pa la slob dpon lha lcam gnyis bzhugs pa mthong nas ngo mtshar te/ nyes pa bshags/ mchod gnas su bzhugs par zhus pas gnang ste/ rgya gar du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par gyis shig de ltar ma byas na khyed cag nyams par 'gyur ro gsungs nas o rgyan du byon no/ / der yang sngon gyi mi thong po byung ngo zer nas yul gyi mi res shing khu(khur) re bsdus nas me dpung chen po'i dbus su bsregs pas ma tshig ste/ sngar bzhin mtshe'u'i dkyil na pad+ma'i sdong po skyes pa'i lte bar bzhugs pa mthong nas thams cad ngo mtshar zhing dad pa skyes/ sngar gyi nyes pa bshags nas/ o rgyan gyi yul du chos kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad do/ / de nas slob dpon gyi dgongs pa la/ skye shi 'khor ba'i chos dang ni bral/mi brjed pa'i gzung ni thob/ tshe la dbang ba dang / rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin ni brnyes/ da phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin cig sgrub dgos par dgongs nas/ bal yul du — 4 ge

༄7/ /dpal rdo je phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/byon te/ yang le shod kyi brag phug tu yang dag mar me dgu pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pas/ yul de'i klu gyong po zhes bya ba dang / lha 'dre yongs kyis bar chad byas te/ lo gsum du gnam las char ma babs/ sa la rtsi shing nags tshal dang lo tog thams cad bskams/ chu bo dang chu phran kun kyang rgyun chad de dus ngan byung ba'i tshe slob dpon gyi dgongs pa la/ 'di ni cis kyang ma lan te/ bdag byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa zhig go snyam nas/ mchod pa bshams te/ lha la gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkha' las sgra byung ste bar chad 'di gzhan gyis 'dul ba'i thabs med kyi/ rgya gar shī(na)len+t+ra'i gtsug lag khang nas rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud sde spyan drongs shig ces sgra byung ngo / / de nas bal po'i mi gnyis la gser bre gang bskur nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya la phul/ lo rgyus gsol bas rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor 'bum sde tsam zhig bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ po ti mi khur gnyis paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis brdzangs so/ / de yang le shod du slebs pa tsam gyis lha 'dre'i bar chad rang sar zhi ste dus kyi 'brug grags/glog 'gyus/ char babs te rtsi shing nags tshal lo tog thams cad phun sum tshogs par gyur to/ /de tsa na phur pa'i chos 'di bkra shis shing byin rlabs myur bas phyogs thams cad du rgyas par bya snyam du dgongs nas/ rgyud sde rnams kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos/ lta ba byi to/ sgom pa phun sum tshogs pa/ 'phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu bdab pa las kha tshar dang bzhi ru phye ste mdzad/ dus der slob dpon pad+ma dang / bi ma la mu tra dang/ bal po shī la mdzi gsum gyis yang le shod du bsgrubs pas rtags thon te/ de'i tshul 'og tu 'chad do/ /dus der lung tshad du phyin nam ma phyin dgongs pa mdzad pas/ rtags mngon sum du gzigs pa dang / phur smad nyi shu ru bsdus te/ rgyud lnga la lung gī la ya bcu gnyis kyi tan+t+ra/lcags gzer nag po'i tan+t+ra/ 'bum bskos chen po'i tan+t+ra/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi tan+t+ra/rig pa mchog gi tan+t+ra/ lta ba lnga la/ lta ba byi to/ bla ma chen po/ mya ngan las 'da' ka ma/ ye shes nyi zer nam mkha' rol pa'i rgyal po'o/ / phrin las lnga la/ rdo rje gzhon nu/las brgya rtsa brgyad pa sras mchog skad tre/ las kha tshar/ las gsang ba'o/ /sgrub pa lnga la/phun sum tshogs pa/ thugs gsang ba/ gze ma nag po/ thugs kyi brnags pa/ las kyi bkol byang ngo / / de tsa na lha bdud du sprul nas drod nyul ba ni/ lcags kyi sdig pa nag po 'jigs su rung ba cig thog babs su tho mtshams su byung pa la slob dpon nyid phag tu brdzus nas zos par chas pas/ sdig pa de bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu ri rab brjid pa'i skur mthong / drag shul gyi las la thogs pa med pa'i dbang thob ste/ de'i dus su bsnyen phur — 5 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/bsgril zhing nga btsan gyi mgur bzhes(bzhengs)pa ni/ dip+ta tsakra phur pa'i lha/ / mthing nag gcer bu ral ka can/ /sku stod khro bo chen po la/ /zhal gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste/ /lte ba man chad phur pa'i dbal/ / drag por gyur pa'i phur pa ste/ / ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra ba/ /'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /btab na lha yang brlag 'gyur na/ /gnod byed rnams la smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bstan bcos rnams paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya la gzigs 'bul bar chas te/ rgya bal gnyis kyi so mtshams/ chu mig byang chub ris su gzims pa na mnal lam du sku bkrongs pa snyams byung ba dang / phyag gis nyul bas/thugs ka nas sems can gyi dngos po zhig zin te spar bur bcug phyag mtshan rdo rjes rgyas btab nas bzhag nangs par gzigs pas/ bu mo mtshar sdug dang ldan pa bzhi 'dug ste/khyed su yin dris pas/ de rnams na re/ sngon bcom ldan 'das dpal chen pos dregs pa pho bsgral mo sbyar ba'i dus na dam la btags te/ 'gro ba'i srog la dbang bskur ba'i ma mo bzhi lags te/ de'i thugs dam gyi dbang gis 'dir 'ongs pa lags kyi/ slob dpon gyis kyang bdag cag la dbang bskur cig zer/ slob dpon gyi dgongs pa la/ sngon dbang thob pas/ nga tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin 'di yang 'chi ba snyam byed na/ ngas kyang dbang bskur na 'gro ba thams cad gsod snyams nas/ rdo rje phur pa nyan pa'i/ bshad pa'i/bsgom sgrub byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i srog la dbang gyis shig gsungs nas/ bse mo bzhi dang bka' bgros nas/ bse lung tsha ba'i yang gter mdzad do/ / de ltar snga 'gyur gyi phur smad nyi shu co gcig bsnams te/ shī(na) len+t+ra'i gtsug lag khang du byon nas paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya'i spyan sngar bkrams pas/ chos shin tu legs pas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags/paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis kyang slob dpon la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas mkhas pa rnam pa gsum gyis bka' bgros te/ byi to ta ma la 'bum sde thams cad gzigs te/ rdo rje phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud la sogs pa rgyud sde sum cu rtsa gnyis la 'grel pa sgrub thabs ṭik+ka la sogs pa phye nas rgyas par mdzad do/ / de'i dus su srod la shwa na ma mched bzhis srog snying phul lo/ nam gong la bdag nyid ma mched bzhis srog snying phul lo/ / de nas ji ltar dar ba ni bye ma(bi ma)las/gzung ma dag pa(dam pa) la bshad/ gnyis kas rgya gar gyi rgyal po in+t+ra bhu ti la bshad/de nas rgya gar gyi yul na dar zhing rgyas par spyod do/ /slob dpon pad+mas/ bal po shākya de ba la bshad/ de gnyis kas o rgyan rgyal po dharma ko ṣa la bshad/ de nas o rgyan gyi yul na dar zhing rgyas par spyod do/ / bal po shi la mdzis smad mtshong ma shin+ti la bshad/ des bal po'i — 6 —

༄7/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/rgyal po gu na ta la la bshad/ de nas bal po'i yul na dar zhing rgyas par spyod do/ /da ni bod yul du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul ba/bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bod yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzugs par dgongs nas thugs dam gyi lha khang bsam yas bzhengs pa'i sa 'dul ba slob dpon bo dhi sa twa spyan drangs nas sa 'dul mdzad pas/ bod kyi lha 'dre rnams zing langs te/ nyin mo mis brtsigs pa nub mo lha 'dres bshigs te ri rdo ri la bskyal/ klungs rdo klungs su bskyal nas brtsigs su ma ster ba dang / rgyal po thugs mug ste/ e sha slob dpon byin rlabs chung ngam/bdag sgrib pa che 'am/ bod 'bangs bsod nams chung ngam/ 'di rgyu rkyen ci las gyur zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ bdag ting nge 'dzin rtsal shugs chung pa ma yin te/byams pa shas che bas mi ma yin ma thul pa yin/ o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rdo rje phur pa'i dngos grub thob pa zhig bzhugs/ de spyan drangs na bar chad zhi bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ spyan mi 'drongs bsams zhus pas/ slon dpon gyi zhal nas/ rang re rnams tshe sngon ma'i spun yin pas las dang smon lam gyi dbang gis byon yong gsungs/ de ji ltar yin zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ spyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sems can gyi don mdzad tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin/ khyad par du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis sems can thams cad 'khor ba nas drangs te lan gsum du sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag ste/da sems can 'khor ba na med dam snyam gzigs pas/ sngar bas kyang sems can mang zhing nyon mongs pa rags su song 'dug pas/ slar snying rje skyes te bshums pas/ mchi ma thigs pa gnyis gtor nas 'di gnyis kyi sgo nas kyang sems can gyi don chen po ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung bar gyur cig ces gsungs pas/ mchi ma thigs pa gnyis sum cu rtsa gsum du song ba las/ lha'i bu mo gaṅgā ma dang / gaṅgā ma chung ngu zhes pa gnyis su skyes/ de gnyis cher skyes nas skabs su lha'i khrims bsrang ba zhig gi tshe/ gaṅgā ma chang ngus gaṅgā ma'i ldum ra nas me tog rtsar 05 ra mi ceXrdo re(1 ther ༷༷rgya yig spyoraritshor spyodagari sna ngarabarkus pas/ lha' khroms nyams pas 'a sa ta/ skya ba phya ma la ma' yul du bya rdza ma bad mchog bya bar skyes/ bya btsos pa'i slo dang rgyag lhag bsags te/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor bya ba bzhengs/ bum pa'i srog shing btsugs tsam la mo shi nas/ dam tshig gi lha mo pra mo ha zhes bya bar sangs rgyas so/ /de la bu bzhi yod de dge slong a ba kha du/ rta rdzi/ phag rdzi/khyi rdzi dang bzhi'o/ / bu de bzhis mchod rten gyi 'phro rdzogs par 'byongs te grub/ rab gnas byas tshar ba dang / bu so sos smon lam 'di ltar btab po/ / bu che nga/sa/7 bdag

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/cag tshos dge ba 'di la brten nas skye ba phyi ma la sa bdag gi rgyal po chen po zhig tu skye bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab po/ / de'i 'og mas bstan pa bsrung ba'i sngags 'chang mthu stobs can zhig tu skye bar gyur cig de'i 'og mas mkhan po byang chub sems dpa' zhig tu skye bar gyur cig de'i 'og mas/ phu bo gsum po'i bya ba sgrub pa zhig tu skye bar gyur cigaces smon lam btab po/ /de dus che ba rgyal po nyid yin/ de'i 'og ma slob dpon pad+ma yin/de'i 'og ma nga yin/ de'i 'og ma yar klungs kyi sba mi khri bzher yin gsungs/ de nas rgyal pos sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ mchims shākya bha dra/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge gsum chibs dang bcas nas gser phye mang po bskur nas slob dpon spyan 'dren du brdzangs so/ /de dus slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas rgya gar dā hu la'i gtsug lag khang na (sprukhor paṇ+ḍi ta stong lnga brgya la rgyud lung man ngag gsum gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing bzhugs pa las/mngon par mkhyen pas mkhyen te/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnams la zla ba gsum na bod kyi rgyal po'i bla mchod la 'gro bar 'dug chos rnams myur du tshar bar bya'o gsungs nas/ chos rdzogs pa dang zla ba gsum song ba'i nyin der bod kyi bang chen btang mi gsum gyis slebs/ gser gyi spa tra bco brgyad dang / gser phye mang po phul/ mnga' bdag rgyal po'i zhu ba rnams gsol bas/sngon gyi smon lam gyi 'brel ba yod pas bod la 'dengs gsungs nas gnang ngo / /de nas slob dpon dang / bod kyi mi gsum gyis dā hu la'i gtsug lag khang nas bteg ste rim gyis bal yul du phebs so/ / lang lab kyi lo rgyus su ni/ slob dpon spyan 'dren ba'i bang chen pa/stag tshal gyi lo tsā pa brang ti dza ya rak+ṣi dang / mang yul gyi lce ku ku ra tsa gnyis la gser phye bskur nas brdzangs/ zhes 'byung ngo / / de nas rim gyis mang yul gyi grong khyer ze bya bar phebs/ de dus mang yul na khyim bdun las med/ rgan mo gsum la gdams pa btab pas skad cig la grol/ de dus bod kyi lha 'dre rnams kyis nyi ma nam baspos su bcug pas/lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas skad cig la nyi ma bkug nas zhag bdun nyi ma ma btang bar lha 'dre'i kha gnon du khrong bre'i gong kha der lha khang brtsigs/ de la de dus mun pa lha khang zer ro/ / de rtsa na chu mig gnyan po sus kyang reg mi nus pa gcig yod pa de'i klu btul nas chu zhing la drangs/ lha khang du thugs rje chen po bzhugs su gsol/ ri gong zhig tu bal po'i lha 'dre phyir 'brangs pa rnams kyi kha gnon du rdo'i mchod rten bzhengs phur pa gsum rdo la nub par btab nas bzhag de nas ya tshad na khung bu nas rlung 'ong ba'i sa de bod la gnod par gzigs nas lha khang brtsigs/ de mang yul byams sprin yin no/ / de nas yar byon te ma da 8 da

༄7/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/chung gi bar du gro gsol/ der slob dpon la lha 'dres ma tshugs so/ / 'khor rnams smyos pas smyon thang du grags so/ / de 'dul ba'i don du mchod rten brgya dang rtsa brgyad mdzad do/ /yang zhang zhung yul de gu ge la byon/ der gzhi bdag dgra lha mu tsa med kyis ma bzod nas/ ri phan tshun 'thab pa'i bar du slob dpon dpon g.yog bcar bar brtsams pas dpon g.yog ni nam mkha' la gshegs/ dgra lha mu tsa med skrag ste bros pa las/ phyag mtshan rdo rje gsor bas/ mo drung du lhags te srog snying phul/ bran du khas blangs te dam la btags so/ / de nas lha yul gung thang du byon/ dge bsnyen snya shu rtsa gcig gis cho 'phrul bstan/ thog phab pas/ thog me tog gi char du song nas/ der dge bsnyen rnams dbang du bsdus nas chos kyi srung mar bskos so/ / de nas mang yul kha la'i rong sgo nu/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis thog mda' bcu gnyis dus gcig la phabs pas/ sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la blangs te klad la bskor bas/ sol dum bcu gnyis su nag hrul gyis song bas bstan ma skug ste srog snying phul dam la btags/ de dus gtso mo gangs dkar ma she'u bza' bros te dpal mo lha mtsho'i nang du bros pas/ slob dpon gyis dpal mtsho nas chu spar bu gang blangs nas dgongs pa gtad pas skad cig la spar ba'i chu la rlangs pa chil gyis byung ba dang mtsho yang rlangs phyur gyis byung / spar ba'i chu de khol ba dang mtsho khol bas mos ma bzod de mtsho las bsnyengs thon pa dang rus pa dang sha so sor bral nas keng rus su song ba dang / phyag mtshan rdo rje 'phangs pas mig ya gcig bcar/ de nas mo skrag nas srog snying phul sgrub thabs brtsams te/ dkar mo cig sgrub/ stag mo nu 'jag gnam sman mched lnga'i sgrub skor gsum du phye/ sngar bstan ma'i gtso mo yin pa la phyis rang mnyam du bzhag de nas rtsangs lhas lha phug tu bsnyen bkur nas bka' 'bangs su byas te/ 'di ni chos la ma dad pas slob dpon la tho mtshams so/ /phug der stag gsum byung ba la rdo rje gsor bas stag gsum po phug gcig tu bros song ba la/ shul bsnyegs te byon pas rlung 'tshub gcig tu song ba la phur pa btab pas/ gas btsan gyis rang tshugs bstan nas srog snying phul lo/ / phug pa de la stag phug ces da ltar yang grags so/ /de rnams su lha 'dre thams cad bstar la brgyus pa ltar dam la btags pas chu'i ming yang star chu zhes grags/ de nas lha 'dre'i khrom tshogs pas yul gyi ming la khrom pa zer/ de nas bcu gnyis pa spugs nas mar byon/ phug bdag mo gcig dge bsnyen du btsud/ de nas byang lam tshu tha nas byon/ stag po sdings kyi kha nas grom pa lha khang gi rab gnas mdzad pas/ grom pa rgyang du gnas grags zer/ de nas rim gyis byang — 9 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/phyi khol na mar la byon/ 'od yug gro mo 'phrod kyi la kha ru lha srin gyi cho 'phrul byung ba btul/de nas 'dam snying drung ngos la byon/ gnam mtsho dang thang lha'i bar du sbra dkar phub nas bzhugs pas/ thang lhas thog char ba ltar phab/ slob dpon gyi sbra dkar rdo rje'i khang par bsgoms pas/ thog dred de mtsho la song bas/ mtsho khol te chu nang gi srog chags rnams shi/der ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga mdzad de sems can shi ba rnams byang chub la bkod/ de nas sbra dkar btab ste/ thang lha'i gangs la zhal gzigs nas/ gangs kyi mgor ram̐ gcig bsgoms pas gangs zhu nas rud chad de g.ya' brag tu zangs te song ba dang / kho skrag ste rang gzugs bstan nas srog snying phul/ dam la btags/ kho'i sgrub thabs mdzad/ der kho na re/ bdag ni lha 'dre kun gyi sde dpon yin zer/ 'o na khyed kyis lha 'dre thams cad khrid shog gsungs pas der khos lha 'dre phal che ba bkug byung pa la/ srog snying phrogs dam la btags so/ / de nas gnam gyi shug sdong du dregs pa gnad 'bebs kyi sgrub pa zhag gsum mdzad/ nam srod la ri rab nyil ba lta ba'i sgra drag po byung pa dang / thang lha dmag dpon bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa lhags so/ / der slob dpon gyis khyed la de tsam gyi sgra skad dang cho 'phrul yod na bzang gi khyod kyi khrod na pho bdud nyi khri chig stong dang / de'i khrod na mthu che rtsal drag nyi shu rtsa gcig yod kyi/ de dag khrid la da lta nga'i drung du shog mi 'ong na khyed thams cad kyi srog snying nga la yod pas/ ngas thams cad kyi snying 'byin no gsungs pas thams cad skrag ste 'dar phril phril 'dug de nas dar cig na bdud la dbang che ba bzhi/dmag dpon rnam rol dang lnga/ shar nas dbang che ba bzhi/ dmag dpon khyab 'jug dang lnga/ gnyan la dbang che ba bzhi/ klu rje thod dkar dang lnga/ btsan la dbang che ba bzhi/yam shud dmar po dang lnga/ de dag gi las mkhan ḍāk+ki nag po dang / nyer gcig po dbang du bsdus/ dam nyams sgrol ba'i ging du bskos/ lha'i dge bsnyen du ming btags/ phur pa sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dgongs pa sgrub pa dang dpal 'byor dang tshe spel bar khas blangs dam bcas so/ / de nas 'phan yul gong gi la kha nas/ stod lung la log byon te/stod lung gzhong par chos ston gsol ba la chu med nas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bye ma la brgyab pas chu rko mog bdun byung / da lta gzhong pa lha chu bya bar grags/ gzhan yang stod lung gi yul rnams su btsan dang / bdud dang / the'u brang rnams dam la btags/ de nas lha sa gram thang du byon nas zhag gcig bzhugs/ der chibs la rtswa med pa la/ lha sa'i bye ma skad cig la ne'u gsing du bsgyur nas chibs kyi rtswa byung ste/ ding sang yang ni'u gsing du yod pa 'di yin/— 10 —

༄khya/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/de nas skyid chu brgal te ba lam klags kyi la la byon pa dang / phyi byon rnams kyis mnga' bdag la/ slob dpon byon no zhes sbran/ der mnga' bdag gis/ nga bod kyi btsan po yin yang / slob dpon o rgyan gyi rgyal po'i sras yin/ sangs rgyas rnams dang mi lab pa bzhin du gsung gleng mdzad pa/ lha ma srin bran du 'khol ba sogs yon tan mtha' yas pa yin pas gsungs pa la 'gro dgos dgongs nas/ dbu la zhwa dang / zhabs la lham gsol/na bza' steng g.yogs ber sked rags ma bcing par g.yangs klubs su gsol nas byon tsa na/slob dpon gyi zhal nas la nye mi bzang / dus nam zhig na stod na rgyal khrims zhwa tsam zhig chags pa 'dug smad na rgyal khrims lham tsam zhig lus par 'dug bar 'dir rang kha sil bu sil bur 'gro bar 'dug kye hud/ sems can snying re rje/ zhes gsungs/dus der phan tshun phyag bsnyeg res byung pas/ slob dpon gyis rgyal po la dbu dun mdzad pas/ rgyal po'i na bza'i phyed mes gzhob tu rog par song/ phyag mkhar dum bu gsum du chag der rgyal po'i thugs la rdzu 'phrul dang yon tan slob dpon lhag mod/ nga bod nu bzhi'i rje yin pas phyag la lan 'ong ngam dgongs pa la/ slob dpon gyis srin lag gi sen mo la gling bzhi gling phran thams cad khongs su bcug nas bstan/ nga che nga btsan gyi mgur gsungs pas rgyal pos phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas bsam yas kyi sa 'dul mdzad de brtsigs/nyin par mi dang / mtshan mo lha 'dres brtsigs pas legs par 'byongs te rab gnas mnga' gsol mdzad/ rgyal po rje 'bang rnams kyis dga' ston lo bcu gsum du byas so/ /bsam yas 'byongs nas/ rgyal po dang / jo mo mkhar chen bza' dang / spyan 'dren pa mi gsum gyis rdo rje phur pa'i dbang nos/ rgyud dang sgrub thabs mnyan te/ phur pa rgyal po lags su grags pa dang / sna snam lags/ shud ba lags/ 'chims lags/ jo mo raX 0ri char05 65 zir raX rabyeraX zipa zipa raX ziralugs bzha ru byung / da' rjas rang ban la gnang bas/ rang zang lugs dang 'khan la gnang ba las 'khon gyi lugs ding sang sa phur du grags pa 'di byung ba yin la/ cog ro bzas slob dpon dngos la thug kyang dbang yi dam la zhus pas yi dam slob dpon gyi thugs kar bsdus pas dbang skal chad/ phyis jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis thugs brtse bas/ man ngag zab dgu gnang bas phur pa lcam lugs zhes 'byung ba de yin no/ /de'i nang nas 'byung pa'i drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag ces grags pa/ gnubs pa dang rje btsun mi la'i mthu chen po de yang phur pa lcam lugs kyi gdam skor yin te deng sang gi bar du lung rgyun yod do/ / de nas brag dmar bsam yas su slob dpon gyis phyi nang gi chos rgya chen po gsungaḍi 1pa'i dus/

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/jo mo mkhar chen bza' lha mo la su ma'i sprul pa yin par gabrigs/ rgyal pos kyang gzungs mar phul/ der slob dpon gyis jo mo la/ khyod la 'og min gyi zhing khams bstan gyi gsungs nas slob dpon dang gnyis 'ja' ltar du yal nas song / zhag gsum song pa'i nangs par log nas byung / rgyal pos mtsho rgyal la/ khyed kyis 'og min gyi zhing khams mthong ngam gsungs pas bdag gis kun tu bzang po'i zhing khams dang / rdo rje sems dpa' dang / shākya thub pa dang / 'jam dpal dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / de rnams kyi zhing khams mi bzad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan te mthong zhus pas/ mnga' bdag gi zhal nas de mi bden/ slob dpon gyis 'og min gyi zhing khams spyod mi nus/ de nus pa yin na gzugs kyi phung po la mi chags pa yin te/slob dpon da dung gzugs kyi phung po la chags 'dug pa gsungs pas/ mtsho rgyal na re/bdag gis mthong ba'i zhing khams de rnams kyi bkod pa 'di dang 'di lta bu gda'/ rdzun ma lags zhus pas/ 'o na de dag bden na/ sngon bdag gi ma gyim shang kong jo ma bde spyod rgyal po la gtod pa'i dus su/ ge sar rgyal po'i lag tu bdag gi ma'i 'phrul gyi me long bse'i phub chung tsam zhig shor nas yod kyi/ de slob dpon len du chug cig gsungs/ jo mos slob dpon la de brjod ma thag tu slob dpon 'od du yal/ rjes shel phreng brgya rtsa brgyad bgrang ma zin pa la slob dpon gyis ge sar rgyal po'i bang mdzod nas blangs nas byung ste/ de jo mos rje la phul/ yang rje'i zhal nas/ 'o na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas na bya khyung gi sgo nga yod kyi de len du chug gsungs/ jo mos zhus pas/ de ma thag slob dpon gyis blangs pa/jo mos rje la phul/ yang rje'i zhal nas rgya mtsho'i gting na klu'i rgyal po gtsug na rin chen gyi bu mo mdzes ldan ma'i lag na yid bzhin gyi nor bu yod kyi/ de slob dpon len du chug gsungs/ jo mos de skad brjod ma thag slob dpon gyis blangs nas jo mos rje la phul/yang rje'i zhal nas bar snang khams na sbrang khams pa'i rnga ma yod kyi/ de slob dpon len du chug gsungs/ sngar ltar skad cig la blangs byung / yang rje'i zhal nas/ zhang po rgya'i yul na sngon bskal pa bzang po'i nas tshad dang / tshe lo brgya ba'i bre tshad yod kyi gsungs/ de yang skad cig la blang byung / yang rje'i zhal nas/ rdo rje gdan na sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / dri ma med pa'i sku'i gdan khri'i bar gyi sa 'og na gnam chags pa'i dum bu bya ba dang sa ral pa'i ras ma bya ba'i dum bu rin po che yod kyi de slob dpon len chugs gsungs/ jo mos slob dpon la brjod ma thag tu blangs byung ba rje la phul bas/ rje'i zhal nas/ slob ge 12 —

༄7/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/dpon gyi rdzu 'phrul gyi khungs brtags pa yin te/ zad mi shes pa 'dug slob dpon 'di 'byung pa dang rang sems la dbang thob pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas las lhag pa zhig 'dug gsungs/ thugs ches zhabs spyi bor blangs so/ / de'i dus su rgyal po rje 'bangs rnams kyis tshe snga ma'i skye ba ji ltar blangs pa'i tshul dang / de'i rgyu mtshan/ blon po khri bzang yab lhag khyod/ / skye ba 'di yi snga ma la/ / nya yi lus ni blangs pa'i rtags/ / da lta mchan khung g.yon na nya gshogs yod/ / ces sogs gsungs pas kun yid ches/ da lta rang rang so so'i bsam pa 'di ltar 'gyu tshul dang / ma 'ongs dus kyi 'gyur ldog la sogs pa dus gsum sa ler gzigs pas chags thogs med par lung bstan/ dus 'dir lo tsā pa brang ti dza ya rak+ṣi ta dang / lce ku ku rā tsas byas nas chos mang du bsgyur/ mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug la phur pa gnang bas/ des rgyud kyi don khong du chud/ gdan 'dren pa mi gsum gyis kyang rgyud kyi bshad pa rgya cher spel te/ sna snam gyis gtsang du spel/ shud bus lho brag tu bshad/ mchims kyis kong yul mchims kyi steng du spel lo/ / de tsam gyis bsam yas 'chims phur slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / de'i lo tsā ba gnyags dzñā na ku ma ras byas te rje 'bangs nyer lngas sgrub chen byas pa la/ dar za byang chub kyis sgrub pa la ya ga bsgrags nas chab gsol dgos zer/ de blon po rnams kyis btsad po la zhus/ khyad par ngan lam stag ra klu kong gis slob dpon la ngan smras mang du byas pas kho kha lkugs/ dar za byang chub ni sa'i lha mo bstan ma phag ser khra la zhon/ lag na lcags kyu thogs pas darī za'i lce nas btab ste gson por sa 'og tu khrid pa kun gyis mthong bas blon po rnams kyis slob dpon la chab gsol ma nus/ bstan pa ma nub tsam du byung / der slob dpon rdzu 'phrul dang mthu stobs che bas/ bod kyi blon po chos la mi dga' ba rnams yid rab tu skrag ste slob dpon slar rgya gar du byon pa'i zhu ba rgyal po la phul/ sdig blon rnams dbang che bas rgyal po yang gsan dgos pa byung nas zhal gyis bzhes/ slob dpon la zhus pas/ nga rgya gar du 'gro ba rung mod kyi/ 'on kyang gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs spel ma thub pas glo ba ma dga'/ bod kyi ri thams cad nags kyis khyab pa/ gtsang po sbubs su 'jug pa/ bye ma thams cad ne'u gsing du bsgyur ba/ 'brog dgon pa dang / byang thang thams cad zhing la gtang ba sogs bya rgyu mang po yod pa la/ sems can gyi bsod nams la ma shong ba yin/ bod 'bangs snying re rje gsungs/ bsam yas kyi mtha' bskor bye ma la bsnyen phur pasgril bas sing mar sngo zhungs kyis song / gtsug lag khang dang lcags ri'i mtha' la bskor — 13 ge

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/ba mdzad pas/ zhabs bzhag pa'i sar lcang ma re skyes so/ /de nas rgyal po la/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i drag sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang phan bya brgya nyi shu gnang / 'dzam bu'i gling gi nor kun bsdus nas rgyal po dpe dkar la gtad de bsam yas kyi bsrung mar bskos/ de nas slob dpon gshegs khar jo mos zhus pa/ bdag bud med blo dman pas nyung la bslab pa'i chos gcig zhu/ nyon mongs pa rags pas nyon mongs 'joms pa'i chos gcig zhu/ tshe thung bas grub thag nye ba'i chos gcig zhu/ dgra mang bas mthu che ba'i chos gcig zhu/ zhes zhu don bzhi phul bas/ nyung la bsdus pa phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu stod las byang chub sgrub pa/smad las dmod pa lam du khyer ba man ngag mchog tu gyur pa 'di gnang ngo / / de nas slob dpon gyis/ mnga' bdag la gsungs pa/ da ni bdag srin po'i kha gnon la 'gro ba'i dus la bab pa 'dra'o/ / bdag ni tshe'i rig 'dzin thob pa yin/ mnga' bdag nyid kyang tshe'i dngos grub 'dod na tshe chu 'di 'thung mdzod gsungs nas bdud rtsi bum pa gang gnang /der rgyal po'i dgongs pa la/ slob dpon gshegs par chas pa 'dis ma dges nas/ lho bal gyi zhad kyis dug btang ba 'dra'ang srid snyam/ spyang thul gyi 'dabs nas mar pho bas de ma thag pa la chu mig brdol bas/ ding sang chu rjes ni'u gsing du grags so/ / de nas slob dpon gshegs pa mnga' bdag gis ma bzod de/ rgyal khrims zhig na'ang zhig rgyal po bdag nyid ma gum bar du bzhugs par zhu/ zhus pas/ bsam yas su rgyun du bzhugs par ma gnang / ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba skal ldan rnams kyi don du bod kyi sgrub gnas rnams su rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/ sgrub pa mdzad de byin gyis brlob pa dang / bod khams gling dgu'i sa gzhi thams cad zhabs kyis bcags te bkra shis shing byin chags par bya ba dang / da dung bod kyi gdul bya ma rdzogs pas/ de dag gi don gyi phyir dben gnas gangs dang ri brag mtsho gling rnams su gnas bcas te/ rgyal po rje 'bangs kyi don du skabs skabs su 'ong gi/ nga'i chos kyi 'phro lus pa rnams rgya gar nas slob dpon bi ma la mi tra spyan drongs nas zhus shig gsungs nas/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis nye gnas byas te gshegs so/ / de nas sgrub gnas rnams su byon nas sgrub pa mdzad/ brag la sku dang zhabs kyi rjes bzhagakhyad par du mtsho chen po bzhi la phyag rjes bzhag pa ni chu ma bskams kyi bar du gnas par byin gyis brlabs/ bsam yas kyi rab gnas dang / skabs su rgyal po rje 'bangs la chos gsungs pa dang / btsun mo dmar rgyan bza'i mdze nad bsal ba rnams la byon/ mnga' bdag grongs nas/ sras mu ne+e btsan po yum gyi dug gis bkrongs/ mu khri btsan po na — 14 —

༄khya/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/gzhon/ mtha'i dmag rgya dang / hor dang / ge sar dang / khrom la sogs pas bod phung la nye ba na/ rgyal khrims lo gsum bskyangs te bod 'bangs kyi don mdzad/ mthar rgyal bu la rgyal sa gtad do/ / de nas su yis bshol btab kyang ma gsan te/ lho nub rnga yab kyi gling du srin po'i kha gnon la gshegs te/ de ltar bod yul 'dir ji tsam bzhugs snyam na/rba bzhed du bshad pa ltar bsam yas kyi sa 'dul ba la sogs pa'i bar du zla ba gsum bzhugs/de nas rgya gar la gshegs pa ltar du sdig blon rnams kyi ngor mdzad nas bod dben rtsa rnams su bzhugs te/ zla ba drug gis bgrod pa re la lo dang zhag bco lnga la zla ba rer rtsi ba/ rgyal po lo chos la sogs pa rgya gar gyi brtsi lugs shig gis dbang du byas pa'i lo brgya dang bcu gcigalo hril po lnga bcu rtsa lnga dang zla ba drug bzhugs pa yin no/ / don 'di nyid thugs su ma chud cing / lo rgyus la go ba ma longs pa dag gis/ myang gi gter dpe bai ro'i phyag bris ma las/slob dpon pad+ma bod yul du lo brgya dang bcu gcig bzhugs te/ zhes pas rgyal po'i bla mchod du lo brgya dang / sgrub gnas rnams su lo bcu gcig bzhugs so/ / zhes zer/rgyal po dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad bzhugs par khas len mod kyi/ de ltar na lugs de'i lo bcu dgu po de la gong gi mdzad pa de rnams rdzogs pa'i yul med la/ mdzad pa de dag ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni ding sang gi bar du phal che ba rnams mngon sum du gsal bas shes so/ /spyir slob dpon 'di'i yon tan dang 'phrin las dang / gdul bya btul tshul ni 'phags pa sa bcu pa la gnas pa rnams kyis kyang bsam par mi nus shing sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskal pa brgya'i bar du gsungs kyang rdzogs mtha' mngon pa ma yin par rgya bod kyi paṇa grub bzhed do/ /slob dpon de la phur pa'i slob ma mang yang / mchog tu bka' babs pa ni jo mo mtsho rgyal yin te/ des mon kha sna ring seng ge rdzong gi brag phug tu phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye ste sgrub pas zhag nyer gcig na phur pa thams cad bzhad cing 'od 'phro ba dang bro 'khrab pa byung / der jo mo'i dgongs pa la/ ma mo grub na khrag zor 'phang / / gshin rje grub na 'khor lo bskor/ /ging pho grub na las la rbad/ /phur pa grub na gdab las bya/ /zhes pa la/ bdag la bdo ba'i dgra ni med/ su la brdeg gi snyam ste bsnyen phur pasgril ba las/ bdag la dgra med kyang pha mes kyi srog gcod pa'i za 'dre la gdab snyam du dgongs pa dang / bsnyen phur phyag nas shor te nam mkha' la 'phur nas/ pha yul gyi khang pa'i ltag na 'dre de gnas pa'i skyer phung zhig yod pa la babs te/ skyer phung de rtsa ba nas bsregs cing za 'dre de nyid bsgral/ phur pa de dbon brgyud rnams kyis bcings te/ gdengs pa tsam gyis ge 15 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/lha 'dre mang po btul bas/ mkhar chen bza' 'dre 'dul gyi brgyud pa zhes zam ma chad par byung ngo / / jo mo 'di ni sgrol ba tshad du phyin pas/ mtshon gyis bsad pa'i mi ro yang gson por slong nus pa yin no/ / de nas ji ltar brgyud pa ni/ jo mos rang gi ming po mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug la bshad/ des la byid ye shes brtsegs/ des lce ston yon tan rgya mtsho/ des lce me dpal sgron/ des ngam 'bre klu'i rgyal mtshan/ des ngam 'bre gsal le/des rma chu rab kyi pha rol/ skye chu rab kyi tshur rol/ dbye ma yug mo sgang du lang lab byang chub rdo rje la bshad do/ / de yan chig brgyud kho na yin la/ phur pa man ngag drug pa zhes bya ba'i brgyud pa yin/ de nas lang lab kyis bka' bo ba sna snam shes rab tshul khrims/bka' rkus pa myang nag dbang gi shes rab zhes grags kyang / de'i dus kyi slob dpon so so'i chags sdang gi gtam yin gyi/ myang nag la bka' bo ba'i lo rgyus 'og tu 'chad do/ /de nas sna snam gyis rgya ston sangs rgyas la bshad/ des bshangs gur zhogs khams pa lung du rgya thung shes rab rgyal mtshan la bshad/ des nag po rmu'i brag phug tu dgon ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan la bshad de/ 'dis ni sna nam shud bu mchims gsum gyi gdung rgyud la yang thug nas zhus so/ /phur pa la 'di bas mkhas pa ma byung zhes grags/ des myang dar ma seng ge la bshad/ des gnubs shes rab ye shes la/ des rang gi sras gnubs bdud rtsi 'od la/ des sras phur grags la bshad/ des sras jo lcam la bshad/ des jo btsun grub ye/ se mig pa/ phu ri jo ston/ shes rab rdo rje/ tshe brtan dpal bzang / sngags 'chang shes rin pa/bsod nams rdo rje/ gcung dkon mchog bzang po/ mkhan chen shes rab rje/ sngags 'chang kun dga' dar po/ 'jam dbyangs kun bzang / grags pa dpal 'byor/ rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / bla chen chos kyi rgyal po/ de la bdag gis man ngag drug pa'i dbang dang gdams skor rnams kyi lung mnos/yang lang lab kyi slob ma skyi ban byang chub rin chen bya ba zhig byung / de la pha spun rnams kyis khang zhing dang nor 'phrogs pa la bsten nas/ lang lab la phur pa zhus bsgrubs nas/ pha spun gyi mi grongs tshe dgu'i mi phyugs sgo khyi tshun chad tshar bcad de/ mthar dgra 'di tsho shi pas mi chog khang pa'i gyang 'di mthong pa dang yang nga snying na gsungs nas/phur pa bsgril bas/ gyang kun yang rmang nas 'gyel te/ de nas mtshan yang skyi gyang 'gyel du grags/ de'i slob ma khams pa stong gsum gyi sgom chen mu ni dang / thag gdong dkar gyi btsun pa shes rab 'od gnyis las mched de shin tu mthu che ba skyi phur du grags pa byung nas/— 16 bhe

༄7/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/ding sang ni gdams skor thor bu las/ yongs su rdzogs pa bzhugs pa'i bka' lung yod pa ma rnyed do/ /yi ge rnying ma las/ thag btsun sher 'od kyi slob ma lha rje gnubs chung yin par bshad pa ltar na/ gza' gdong dmar nag gi skor yang skyi'i lugs la yod dam snyam mo/ /spyir na/ rlangs/ rngog 'khon/ rog gnubs/ se/ zur/ 'gos/dpang / rgyus/ 'o bran la sogs pa'i rus chen rnams kyi gdung rigs las/ rdo rje phur pa'i grub pa thob pa ni bod yul 'dir shin tu mang zhing brjod kyis mi lang la gsar ma'i sngags rnams ma dar gyi bar du yi dam dang bstan srung gi srog rtsa yang phur gyis bzung pa yin pas/brgyud pa byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags 'chang de rnams gdung rigs shas che ba las gsar ma ba'i skyes chen rnams kyang byon pa yin te/ bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa dang / khro phu ba dang /phag mo grub pa la sogs pa lta bu ste/ de ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ so so'i gdung rabs rnam thar rnams su gzigs par mdzod kyi/ bdag cag shes rab chung ba dag gis brjod par mi nus so/ /da ni rang lugs la grags pa rong zom lugs kyi lo rgyus cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de la phur pa'i chos 'di rong zom la ji ltar brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon pad+ma/ sna snam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug don ā tsar+ya dpal gyi me tog sgro rdo rje gzhon nu/ zhang zhung yon tan grags/ rong ban yon tan rin chenak+to/ rong ban rin chen tshul khrims kyi bar du brgyud pa las 'ong pa yin la/ kha cig ni/ rong ban yon tan rin chen gyis/ slob dpon pad+ma dngos la thug des mi yul du lo sum brgya bzhugs te mthar sku ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs/ de'i sras rong ban rin chen tshul khrims kyis kyang lo phyed dang nyis brgya bzhugs/ de'i sras rong zom yin la/ 'dis lo brgya dang bcu dgu mi yul du bzhugs te sku bgres rgud mi mnga' ba'i ngang nas sku gshegs pa yin zer/gang ltar yang grub thob bar ma chad pa'i brgyud pa yin la/ 'di 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/bod ru bzhi'i nang nas ru lag gtsang smad kyi sa'i cha/ rong gi snar lung par 'khrungs/ sku gzhon nu nas sgra tshad la sogs pa shes bya thams cad la mkhas shing / gzhan dag dngos po stobs kyi rigs pas tshar bcad pas/ kha cig paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti'i skye ba yin brer/ kha cig paṇ+ḍi ta 'phra la ring mo'i skye ba yin zer/ phyis jo bo rje dang rong yul lhar mjal te rtsod pa byas pas jo bos rong zom ma thub/ der jo bo'i zhal nas/ khyod rgya gar gyi a tsar+ya nag po spyod pa ba de'i skye ba yin te/ kho bos khyod dang chos kyi gtam bya ba ga la thub ces gsungs/ ngo — 17 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/mtshar ba'i mdzad pa dang cho 'phrul la thogs pa med pas/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i sprul bar yang grags la/ phal cher 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul ba yin zhes bsngags pa brjod do/ /'dis dgung lo bcu gcig mtshan nyid gsan/ bcu gsum yan chad la gsan pa rdzogs te mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ ma bslab pa'i shes bya thams cad la yang ma rmongs/dka' ba'i gnas rnams kyang lan re nyan pas mkhyen pa yin te/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/bdag thos pa chung ba yang ma yin te/ chos thams cadajil ma thos pa med do/ /bdag thos pa che ba yang ma yin/ chos thams cad la tshar re las ma dgos so/ /zhes gsungs/ spyir na dam pa 'di shes rab zab la rgya che ba dri ma med pa dang ldan pas/ rgya gar gyi chos su gtogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos sngar ma gzigs pa dag la yang tshar re re gnyis gzigs pas mkhyen nas/ tshig don ma lus pa thugs su chud cing mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa yin no/ /gzhan yang tsa na ka la sogs pa 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos dang / tshad ma dang sgra dang / snyan ngag dang / rig byed kyi bstan bcos gzhan gsum dang / sa brtags pa la sogs pa'i shes bya phra mo mtha' dag la yang mkhas shing / thugs rje chen po mnga' bas chos la mos pa'i mi rnams dang / chos kyi gang zag dang / rdo rje theg pa la zhugs pa dag gis las dang dngos grub sgrub par 'dod pa rnams la phyin ci ma log pa'i gdams pas nan tan du phan thogs par mdzad/ mngon par shes pa'i cha dang ldan zhing sems can ni 'dul ba'i dus dang tshod la mkhas/ 'gro ba phal ba dang chos kyis blo bsgyur ba rnams tshe 'di dang phyi ma gnyis ka bde ba la 'god pa'i phyir bstan bcos mang du brtsams shing / de lta bus phan 'dogs pa la dus rtag du skyo ba mi mnga'/ chos kyis blo ma bsgyur ba'i skye bo phal ba la yang ser sna dang gnod sems spangs nas thugs rje'i yul du mdzad de zhi bde la 'god/ sdom pa dang thugs dam la srog ltar gces spras su mdzad cing / gzhan pa dag kyang de la sbyor/ chos brtsom pa na glegs bam bsdu zhing gzigs pa la sogs pa'i rtsol ba ma mdzad kyang / chos phyogs med la thogs rdugs med pa'i spobs pa spro bar nus/ bstan bcos mdzad pa de dag kyang lung dang rigs pa dang mi 'gal zhing sgra skyon dang don skyon dang rnam par bral bas gzhan mkhas pa sus kyang rtsod mi nus/ sgra'i tshul dang saṃ skṛ ta'i skad ma bslab par mkhyen/ byis pa'i dus su a tsa ra byung tshad la dgyes shing de dag gi skad la mkhas/ bi bsta'i po ti gzigs pas skad dod kyi bag chags sad pa ltar gyur/ tha na dud 'gro'i skad dang brda' yang mkhyen/ 'khrul ba mi mnga' zhing byin rlabs che bas des mdzad pa'i gsang sngags kyi yig cha rnams la slob ma'i da 18 da

༄7/ /dpal rdo je phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/brgyud du byung ba'i gang zag rnams kyis lung ma thob par yi ge las byung ba bzhin du bsgrubs pa la byin rlabs dang dngos grub ma byung ba med/ lo tsā ba chen po de la dus de tshe bod ru bzhi'i mkhas pa mang pos btud par gyur te/ go rub lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab ces bya ba chos phyogs med la mkhas pa zhig gis/ thog mar bod du skyes pa'i gang zag gis chos mang po rtsom pa zhes skur ba btab po/ / phyis bla ma rong zom gyis mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po'i tshul la 'jug pa'i po ti mthong bas/ gus pa chen po skyes te/ zang zing mang pos mnyes par byas te nyes pa bshags nas bdag rjes su bzung du gsol/ zhes zhus pas gnang ste/ 'jam dpal gsang rgyud la sogs pa chos mang du zhus pas gnang / gzhan yang mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug la sogs pa'i lo tsā ba dang / mkhas par grags pa'i blo rtsal can mang pos btud cing gsan par gyur te/ gsan pa po de bdag gi slob brgyud thams cad kyang shin tu dad nas bla ma dam par 'dzin no/ /gsang rgyud kyi skabs su nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'o skol la da ltar rgya dpe yod na 'di ltar 'gro ba yin te/ rgya dpe med pas da ltar bcos su med gsungs pa la/ go rub kyi dpe bzung nas/ phyis jo bo kriṇi pa zhes bya ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta las rgya dpe byung nas de la gsan pas rong pa chen po gsungs pa bzhin byung nas shin tu mos te/ kriṇi pa las byung pa'i dpe zhig rong pa nyid la phul nas yang gsan skad/ gzhan yang rong pa 'dis/ paṇ+ḍi ta mdzi shrī ṭhan+ma dang / mdzi shrī dzñā na dang / u pā ya shrī mi tra dang / bud+dhā ā ka ra bha dra dang /de nā ka ri tsan+t+ra dang / pa ra me sho ra dang / a mo gha badz+ra la sogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta mang por bstan nas/ de dag gi lo tsā ba mdzad de/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / gshin rje dgra rgyud dang /'jam dpal sngags don dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud la sogs pa mang du bsgyur/ 'gyur shin tu bzang bas phan che bar btags/ paṇ+ḍi ta kun gyi gsung nas kyang / dharma bha tra khyod kyis chos mang po rtsom la 'gro ba rnams skyobs shig khyod kyi yon tan gzhan lta zhog gi/ sgra tshad kyi lugs 'di'i sum cha tsam las mi shes pas kyang rgya gar na chos mang po rtsom pa yin khyod ci'i phyir chos mi brtsom zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan yang /bdag bstod la sogs pa'i dri ma dang bral zhing / gzhan gyi chos lugs dang spyod pa dman yang don du 'gyur na ma gtogs pha rol khyad du gsod pa'i gtam ye mi gsungs/ brag bzang po'i ngos la gshegs pa dang / nam mkha' la 'phur pa dang / brag la phur pa 'debs pa la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang grub rtags la thogs pa mi mnga'/ myang smad du mgar ston tshul khrims bzang po la sngags rnying ma gsan te/ 'di dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i — 19 ge

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/dus yin/ lo bcu gsum pa la mkhas pa mdo ston seng ge rgyal mtshan la yang gsan/mnal lam du gsang ba snying pos zan byas/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyis tshod ma byas gsol ba rmis pa slob dpon la zhus pas/ de shin tu bzang chos de khongs su chud pa'i rtags yin/de gnyis la khyod kyis 'grel pa re gyis gsungs pas/ 'grel pa mdzad de/ bod du yig cha byung pa la bzang / dus phyis bstan bcos mdzad pa ni/ bslab pa rin po che gsum la bsten pa'i ched du/ gal che ba'i man ngag gsum mjod de/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rgyud la skye ba'i phyir dam tshig mdo rgyas mdzad/ lhag pa ting 'dzin gyi bslab pa bskyed pa'i phyir 'grel pa tshul bzhi yan lag bco lnga pa mdzad/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa rgyud la bskyed pa'i phyir rdzogs pa chen po lta bsgom man ngag mdzad/ gzhan yang ngan song sbyong rgyud dang / 'jigs byed dang / smra sgo la sogs par yang 'grel pa mdzad cing / bstan bcos gzhan yang mang du mdzad/ de'i dus su shab kyi yang khye bla ma/ mar pa do pa/ 'o yugs pa mda' bsam gtan/ mdo'i khyung po hūṃ snying / se khrom rgya mtsho 'bar mtshams ston go cha/ dpang ka dar chung / 'gos lhas btsas/ rgya rgyal tshul la sogs pa bod ru bzhi'i mkhas pa rnams kyis rtsod par brtsams te/ bod du skyes pa'i gang zag gis bstan bcos 'di tsam brtsams par mi rigs so zhes zer zhing sun 'byin du sku drung du 'ong bas/gsung gleng mdzad pa tsam gyis rtsod pa'i spobs pa bcoms/ bstan bcos re mthong bas shin tu mos te/ thams cad kyis chos zhus/ zhabs tog mdzad de gtan gyi skyabs gnas su 'dzin par gyur to/ / de ltar rong zom 'di ni 'khrungs pa tsam nyid nas ngang gis dge ba'i kun spyod can lhun gyis grub pa'i shes rab che/ 'jig rten lugs kyi thugs dkyel yang shin tu che zhing rang dang dus mtshungs kyi mkhas pa thams cad kyis mngon par bstod do/ /phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas/ khyad par sgra tshad la ma rmongs pas/ bod kyi skad la yang / 'di ni don 'di tsam zhig la 'jug go zhes tshig don gyi khyad par phra mo dag kyang gzhan las ches lhag par ston nus/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ro cog gi tshig don ma lus pa thugs su chud cing mkhas/ tha na 'jig rten pa'i 'tsho tshis zhing las/phyugs skyong ba/ dkar she sgrub pa sogs la'ang mkhas pas/ dge ba ji ltar bsgrub pa'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ bod kyi lha 'odre thams cad kyis kyang chos zhu zhing bsnyen bkur bka' bsgrub/ lta ba mchog tu gyur/ chos thams cad dam/ bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa yin te/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi chos thams cad kyang mnga'/ be+e ro tsa na'i da 20 da

༄khya/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/chos rnams kyang / be+e ros g.yu sgra snying po/ des bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/ des grum shing slag can nas/ gnubs dpal ldan/ ya zi bon ston/ des rong zom la bshad de/ sems kyis brgyud pa lugs shig kyang mnga' ste bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ ldan klong thang sgron mar sku 'khrungs pa'i sprul pa'i sku a ro ye shes 'byung gnas kyi gdams pa'i bdag po yang yin te/ 'di la rgya gar bdun brgyud dang / rgya'i hwa shang bdun brgyud kyi gdams pa yod pa las/ a ro'i dngos slob cog ro zangs dkar mdzod khur dang khams pa ya zi bon ston gnyis ka la rong zom gyis gsan no/ /de nas brgyud pa tsho la rdzogs chen khams lugs su grags/ bi ma la las brgyud pa rnams kyang / myang ting 'dzin bzang po dang / rma rin chen mchog dang / gnyags dzha na ku mā ra nas brgyud pa dag kyang / gnyags dang rma gnyis kas khu byang chub 'od dang / khyung po dbyig 'od las rim par 'ong ste rong zom la mnga'/mdor na 'di'i mkhyen pa dang yon tan ni sus kyang brjod du mi nus shing / bod gangs can gyi rgyud 'dir 'di dang mnyam pa'i mkhas pa ni su yang ma byung la/ spyir 'di sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin mod kyi/ grub pa thob pa ni rdo rje phur pa'i sgo nas yin pas/ phur pa'i bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad do/ /brgyud pa rnams kyang grub thob zam ma chad par byon pa yin la/des sras rgyud dang / slob brgyud gnyis las/ gdung rabs ni/ dang por rong ban dpal gyi rin po che/ de'i sras rong ban rin chen tshul khrims/ de'i sras rong zom chos kyi bzang po dang / sgomarichen chos 'phags gnyis/ chos bzang gi sras gzi brjid 'bar ba dang 'bum 'bar gnyis/ gzi brjid 'bar gyi sras ston dar dang ston skyabs gnyis/ston dar la sras ston song / ston song gi sras jo sras ra spe/ 'di'i sras 'bum dpal/ston skyabs kyi sras jo sras 'od zer/ de'i sras slob dpon 'bum bstan/ chos bzang gi sras gnyis pa 'bum 'bar la sras chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ jo rtsegs/ jo bzang sogs kha yar byung / chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sras ru ā nan ta badz+ra ste/ rong pa kun dga' zer/ de'i slob dpon me dpung / de yi sras chos kyi bshes gnyen dang / chos bzhad gnyis/ rong pa jo bzang gi sras slob dpon jo bkra/ de'i sras dar bzang / rdo rje bstan gnyis/dar bzang gi sras slob dpon ser 'od/ jo bstan gyi sras nyi ma seng ge/ de'i sras 'od zer 'bum dang 'bum rgod gnyis/ rong sgom chos 'phags kyi sras slob dpon ston g.yung /de'i sras jo sras lha srung / des slob dpon byams chos pa chen po dar ma bsten/ de'i srasu slob dpon sra brtan rdo rje yin no/ / ding sang ni rong zom gyi gdung brgyud chad nas med ge 21 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/kyang / 'bum rgod kyi dus su rin spungs pa'i zhal ngo nam mkha' rgyal pos sbyin bdag mdzad de/ slob ma mang du thon/ de'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa thang khrom bka' bzhi pa yin te/'dis 'bum rgod gshegs rjes/ rong zom chos bzang gi gdung 'bum dgon dkar por spyan drangs/ phur pa'i chos skor gnyags kyi gdung brgyud sngags 'chang slob ma ba rnams la gsungs so/ / gnyis pa slob brgyud ni/ spyir dam pa 'di de dus kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi zhabs la gtugs pas bsam gyis mi khyab cing / khyad par du go ru lo tsā ba/ mar pa do pa/ rje 'gos la sogs pa lo tsā ba chen po bcu bdun/ g.yag rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa grub thob chen po sum cu rtsa lnga/ ma cig zha ma'i ming po rje mkhon phu ba la sogs pa sgom chen grub pa thob pa brgya brgyad cu/ yol dge bsnyen rdo rje dbang phyug dang / yang khyer bla ma la sogs pa ston pa gdugs thogs pa lnga brgya la sogs pa mtha' yas te brjod kyis mi lang ba lta bu las phur pa'i chos skor ji ltar brgyud pa ni/ rong zom gyis yol dge bsnyen rdo rje dbang phyug yol lcags grub thob/ rgya ston stong 'bar/ rnal 'byor gzhungs pa/ pho rog mdo sde mgon/ yol lcags sangs rgyas nyi 'bum/ don grub gzhon nu/ dpyal 'phags dpal/ dpyal kun dga' nyi ma/ dpyal kun mkhyen chos rgyal/ mkhan po rgyal mchog pa/gu ge paṇa chen/ grub chen dpal 'byor ba/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chag rin chen chos rgyal/ bla ma dam pa rdo rje seng ge/ de la bdag gis rong zom lugs kyi dbang lung rdzogs par zhus so/ /de yang phur pa lha nag tu grags pa ni/ slob dpon pad+ma yab yum yan chad spyi dang 'dra la de nas/ 'bre a tsa ra nu ru/ 'di ni phur pa'i sgo nas grub pa thob ste tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pas ding sang gi bar du 'das grongs med par bzhugs pa yin la/ lang lab byang chub rdo rjes grub pa thob tshar ba'i rjes su'ang 'di dang mjal nas/ sngar thos pa'i phur pa'i skor la zhus dag byas/ tshar cig zhus pa yin cing / lo rgyus la lar/ ngam 'bre a tsa ra sa le yin par byas 'dug pa ni ma nges pa chen po ste/ mtsho rgyal dang lang lab kyi bar na mi rabs lnga yod pa ma go ba yin la/ gter ma'i lo rgyus shig na/ lang lab lo bdun 'gro ba'i byis pa zhig gis/ slob dpon lho nub du byon khar zhabs la gtugs zer ba snang ste/ ma nges pa'i rang bzo kho na'o/ / phyis 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pas/ smad las drag po sgrol ba'i dbang 'di gsan par bzhod nas btsal bas ma rnyed de/ 'khor rnams la 'di lta bu'i dbang thob pa 'dug na sprang po zhig la 'dug kyang khrid shog de la kho bos zhu'o — 22 —

༄7/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/gsungs nas btsal kyang ma rnyed/ phyis bal po nas tshong pa'i skad cha las/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi slob ma a tsa ra nu ru(lo rgyus gzhan las bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrī yin zer)bya ba tshe'i rig 'dzin thob pa zhig la phur pa'i chos rdzogs par bzhugs/ bal po na gsung gi 'dug zer/ der bstan pa'i khur chen por dgongs pas/ 'o na de bal por yod dam gsungs pas/ med/bsil ba tshal la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi don mdzad pa yin zer/skabs skabs su byon nas/ gdul bya skal ba can rnams la chos bag re gsung par gda' zer ba la/ 'o na de bal por byon na nga la skad thong pa gyis gsungs te gnang sbyin mang po gnang / de nas lo 'ga' song pa dang / bal po nas lon byung / der 'phags pa rin po che chos dang 'jig rten gyi thugs brel gyis g.yengs nas 'byon ma thub nas/ glo bod lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen la gser la sogs pa'i dngos po mang po bskur nas brdzangs/ de nas lo tsā ba bod du byon pa dang 'phags pa rin chen drag po'i sgrol dbang gsan te/ deng sang gi bar du ma nub pa 'di yang / ā tsā ra nu ru dang / 'phags pa rin po che'i drin yin no/ /lha nag gi brgyud pa ni/ yar 'brog pa gu rub yang dag gis rgyud mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba 'di la brten nas lha thams cad nag por mdzad pa las byung ba yin mod kyang / de'i gong gi brgyud pa ni/ a tsa ra nu ru/ lang lab/ sna snam tshul khrims shes rab/ khyung po 'chal chen/ 'chal chung / blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gu rub yang dag 'gos ston byang 'bar/ khyung po seng ge/ khyung po khro bo/ gnyal ston grags/ skyi chos kyi seng ge/ rgya ye shes kyi mgon po/ dpal ldan rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ 'dis bshad 'bum rdo rje don gsal dang / dbang chog sgrub skor la sogs pa yig sna mang du mdzad/ des bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ri gdongs pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams bzang po/ slob dpon bkra shis rgya mtsho/ mnyam med gzhon nu dpal/ sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i mtshan can/bla ma chen po rdo rje rgyal po/ bla ma rdo rje seng ge/ de la bdag gis zhus so/ / yang gu rub nas brgyud nas phur pa lha nag ni/ rtse ba sgang pa dang / snye mdo ba la babs te 'phrin las che bar byung ngo / /deng sang gi bar du bstan pa'i bdag po dpal ldan sa skya pa rnams phyag len du mdzad pa'i sa phur du grags pa ni/ dang por 'khon klu dbang bsrung pas slob dpon pad+ma dngos la zhus nas bsgrubs pas grub pa thob ste/ 'di'i gcung 'khon rdo rje rin chen ni phur pa la brten nas grub pa thob cing de'i sras shes rab yon tan/ de nas sras rim bzhin/ gtsug — 23 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/tor shes rab/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong / bal po/ shākya blo gros/ 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims/ 'di ni lha srin bran du 'khol zhing yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ rnga la zhon te nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul thogs med du ston nus pa yin la 'di yan chad du phur pa'i grub pa thob pa sha stag byon no/ / 'khon rog 'di'i gcung po 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po yin te/ 'dis 'gro'i lung ston chen po zhig la ltad mo la byon pas/ sngags pa 'gas/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyi mcham byas pas khrom thog chod/ de'i lo rgyus gcen la bsnyad pas/ da gsang sngags 'chol ba bya ba'i dus byung pas grub thob mi 'ong / rang re la yod pa'i dpe cha lha rten sngags kyi lag cha kun gter du sba/ nga ni rgas/ khyod gzhon pa yin pas/ mang kar du 'brog mi lo tsā ba la gsang sngags gsar ma nyon shog gsungs nas rnying ma kun gter du sbas/ der chos skyong gi cho 'phrul che bas/ phur pa'i mngon rtogs skor bsdus pa gcig yang dag gi dpe mtshan gcig bsrung ma'i gtor chog seng ldeng phur pa skor cha gnyis / dkar mo nyi zlas 'khon rog la dngos su bstan pa'i bsgrub skor rnams 'don dgos pa byung ste gcung la gnang / 'di'i sras sa skya pa chen po yin la/ de nas rje btsun sku mched/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che nas rim par brgyud nas deng sang gi bar du dar rgyas che la/ bla chen chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du bdag gis kyang ldong ston gyi yig cha'i steng nas sa phur gyi dbang dang / chos skor sna 'ga' re thos so/ /yang gsang ba'i rgyud phur pa la bsten pa mtha' dag nas btus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / gsang ba'i rgyud drug dang / gī lā ya'i tan+t+ra bcu gnyis nas btus pa bshams sngon gyi skor du grags pa/ stod las yang dag la brten nas byang chub bsgrub pa'i tshul dang /smad las sras mchog phur pa la brten nas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i rim pa dang por bal yul yang le shod du slob dpon rnam pa gsum du mdzad/ bod yul du slob dpon pad+mas bsnams byon pa dus der spel ba'i dus la ma bab nas/ byang gi bya mang po sa'i cha la gter du sbas/dus phyis gter ston byang chub gling pa5dpal rgyal mtshan gyis gter nas thon te deng sang lung rgyun yod la paṇa chen bi ma mi tra nas brgyud de dar ba'i tshul ni/ bod chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan sku gshegs rjes/ btsun mo dmar rgyan bza' me tog sgron dbang che zhing spyod pa ngan pas/ sngags kyi lo tsā ba kun la sdang zhing gtses pa dang / ska cog zhang gsum dang / be+e ro tsā na dang / gnyags la sogs pa bsam yas su ma bzhugs par/ bas mtha' dang / yul gyi mtha'i dben pa rnams na bzhugs la/ khyad par du gnyags rnye ku mā ge 24 —

༄tsho/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/ra yar 'brog sgang du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rang gi pha spun po gnyags dge la ston gyi 'dis mu stegs ngan sngags mkhan sdig po che yin no zhes yul mi kun la bsgrags/ ban da zung gcig bse zhos byugs nas dmar por yod pa de gnyis brkus nas/ ban da gri rtses 'drud cing mi rnams la ston/ 'dis zog 'di 'dra byed do zer ya ga bsgrags/ slob dpon bkrongs/dben pa bshig pa'i gros bshams pa dang / slob dpon gyis do dgong nas/ gang du dgongs pa mdzad pa'i sar rin po che gtor zhing bzhag pas/ mi kun na re/ slob dpon gang na dgongs pa mdzad pa'i shul kyang rin po cher 'khrul lo/ / khyod kyi de mi bden no zer ba la/ kho na re/ mi bden na 'di red zer zhing yang ban da gri rtses 'drud cing ston no/ /der slob dpon yul der ma chags nas g.yog po glal mi da 'og btsan bya ba zhig khrid nas/kong po mchim yul gyi steng du byon pas/ lung stong gi phu na/ ra ma bdun 'dug pas/slob dpon gyis/ ra 'di kun ded 'gro gsungs pas/ g.yog po na re/ ri 'di kun gyis ci btsal/ ra la bdag po mchis/ byas pas/ slob dpon na re/ lung stong gi ra la bdag po ga la mchis/ ded gsungs nas phyin pas/ ra mchims bya rog gi yin pas/khos mthong nas/ rkun khag btsugs/ bdun 'jal 'dod zer/ ra la bdun 'jal sprad tsa na/ ma nyan par dben pa bshig lcags kyi tho ba thogs nas ded pas slob dpon bros te/ gtsug lag khang du chud/ btsun chung gi mgo la lcags tho de'u de thebs brer ro/ /der yang bzhugs su ma chags nas/ bod yul dbus su byon pas/ slob dpon rta gcig chibs nas mas nas byon pa dang / 'bro sras chung shwa ba cig ded nas yas nas byung pa dang thug phrad pas/ kho'i rta 'drogs/ shwa ba yang shor bas/ kho slar byung ste/ nyams ban 'dis nga'i shwa ba yang shor/ rta 'drogs/ rta brdabs kyang btsal zer nas ded de gsod par chas pa la/ bros pas thar tsam byung / dus de tsa na mnga' bdag gi sras che ba mu ni btsan po la/ yum mar rgyan bzas dug btang ste bkrongs/ de'i lhad kyi tshogs dpon la slob dpon bi ma la rgya nag nas spyan drangs 'dug der bi mi'i spyan sngar phyin nas/ gser phye long mo gang phul/ bi ma la'i zhal nas/ lo tsā ba dpon g.yog skyid dam gsungs pa la/yar 'brog sgang du skyid bgyi ru/ / dge la ston gyi mar ster ro/ / mchims yul steng du skyid bgyi ru/ /bya rog smyal bas ma ster ro/ /bod yul dbus su skyid bgyi ru/ /'bro sras chung gis ma ster ro/ / zhes gnyags kyis glu phul bas/ bi ma las bstan pa nub kyi dogs nas/phur pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / bshams sngon ma bu gnyis thugs nas phyung ste gnang / lho — 25 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/brag g.yar chu sna'i brag phug tu seng ldeng phur pa nyi shu rtsa gcig la bsten te bi ma la dang /gnyags lo tsā ba gnyis kas bsgrubs pas phur bu khrol ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma bzang po byung nas/ der gnyags kyis thog mar bya rog la'o byas nas phur pa bsgril bas/ stong khams kyi bya rog thams cad 'ub 'ub 'dus byung / ma yin te/ mchims bya rog la'o byas pas/mchims yul steng gi bya rog zung cig byung / der gnyags khros nas bya rog gcig la btab par brtsam pa dang / bya rog tshul ling gis shi'o/ / de nas bi ma las/ da slong la thongs byas pas bslong ma thub/ der bi ma las bye ma zhig btab nas bslangs te btang / da phyin chad de tsug ma byed sdig che'o gsungs nas/ gnas lung gi cho ga yang der gnang ngo / / de nas mchims lha than tsho g.yag dkar po gcig tu byas nas byung pa la yang phur pa btab nas bsgral/ mchims bya rog kyang der bsgral/ bsla bcang rab la btab pas rab bskams/'bring la btab pas 'bring bskams/ tha ma la btab pas tha ma bskams/ bran bkol dang /'og rta dang / sgo khyi dang / gnag gi gnyen mtshams yan chad la btab pas/ rabs bcad de/ dam sri 'am sku dgra rnams sa gcig der btul lo/ /dam sri rnams sa gcig ni/pha spun po gnyags dge la ston la btab pas/ slob dpon gnyags nyid snying rje skyes shing chos nyid kyi klongs su gyur pas ye ma thebs te/ phur pa mtshan dang ldan pa zhig rnyed na thebs 'ongs gsungs/ der tshol du phyin pas dus de tsa na 'khar ba la sog po zer pas/ sog po chen po cig gis sha gcig dang shing khur gcig khur/ ra gcig khrid pa dang phrad/ khyod su yin byas pas/ bdag gi rus ni khang lags/ ming ni stag sbyin lags zer/ phyi bzhin du 'brangs phyin pas/ kho mgar byed de/ de khab nag brdung gnyis mid pas/ kho dad pa skyes/ khyod kyi chos nus sam gsungs pas/ bka' bstsal na rngo thogs lags zer ro/ /nangs par ban+de gzhan zhig mgar tshang du byung ba la skam pas khab tsag brgyab pas a tsha zer/mdang dgong gi ban+de de ni khab mid nas kyang btang ngo / / khyod a tsha zer ba ci nyes zer rgod do/ / bar der chung ma la brngan pa sbyin nas khyo la gros thob cig byas/ de nas kho la chos bya 'am bgyis pas/ chung ma la dri'o zer dris pas/ chung ma na re/ chos mi bya ba'i gtsug ga na yod/ chos ni mar srang khri tshor res kyang mi khugs zer/ der chos skor bzhugs pa la yo byad med zer ba la/ yo byad slob dpon gyis chungs nas chos sbyin pas/ kho dad pa mchog tu skyes te rab tu byung / ming lha dpal gyi ye shes su btags/ 'di phur bu'i mtshan dang ldan pa ni/ mig 'bur gyen du 'khyil ba/ sna gru gsum/ mgo bo brgya mdud 'dril ba/— 26 —

༄7/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/lce zla gam/ ro stod zur brgyad du 'dug pa/ ro smad zur gsum du yod pa/ ci la yang thogs pa med pa cig rnyed/ de dang mthun pa 'o bran dpal gyi gzhon nu la yang 'dug pas/sngar gyi slob ma yang yin pas gnyis ka khrid de 'ongs/ de nas dpon slob gsum gyis bsgrub pa byas nas bsgral/ slar yang sog po dpal yes gnyags dge la ston gyi gam du song nas/kho shi 'dug pa'i snying bton nas slob dpon la phul te/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ / dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ / rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ / sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / kun kyang gnod pa rnams dang bral/ / zhes ched du brjod de gnas spar/gnyags lha bya mings lcags kyi bya khra gcig tu byas byung ba yang bsgral/ bla spyang rab 'bring tha ma gsum ga la btab ste bskams/ bran dang 'og rta sgo khyi gnag gi gnyen tshan tshun chad bsgral/ dam sri rnams sa gcig der btul lo/ / de nas 'bro sras chung ne+e'u thang na rta khyu 'tsho ba las/ rnam shes liṅka la bkug nas phur pa btab ste bsgral/ 'bro'i lha spyang ki sngon po zhig tu byas byung pa yang bsgral/ bla spyang rab 'bring tha ma gsum la btab pa bskams/bran dang 'og rta sgo khyi gnag gi gnyen mtshams yan chad la btab nas bsgral te/ dam sri rnams sa gcig der btul lo/ / tshul 'di la lo rgyus la lar/ gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra la sku dgra gsum langs pa'i dus su/ 'o bran dpal gyi gzhon nus dkor nor dang zhing yul la sogs pa phul/ brtul zhugs dang dpa' rtsal gyis slob dpon gyi thugs bzung / yab mched po gnyags dge la ston dang / gnyags 'phags pa smyug zhu can gnyis kyis gcen bshes gnyen lha mtsho btson du bzung nas/ btson bsrung mi gnyis bzhag pa la/ 'o bran gyis brkus nas slob dpon la phul bas mnyes te phur pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / bsham sngon can gnyis gnang ba yin zer ro/ / yin pa srid mod/ lo rgyus 'thad ldan ltar na/btson du bzung ba ni yul nya 'khor gyis mda' ngam ra zhes par/ ngam ra dang pha spun mi sha chags pa la/ chos rgyal bzhugs dus gnyags la rtsod ma nus pa las/ phyis btsun mos sras dang lo tsā ba rnams dbu 'phangs dmad dus/ gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra nyid btson du bzung ba/sog po dpal yes srog la ma bltas par btson srung mi gnyis bkums nas/ slob dpon rkebatson nas bton pa yin pas/ gcen lha mtsho btson du bcug pa dang / 'don pa po 'o bran dpal gzhon yin zhes pa nor ba yin la/ phur pa phun sum tshogs pa bshams sngon dang bcas pa'i chos skor kyang / 'o bran kho na la yod pa las gzhan la ma grags pa ma yin te/gnyags la dpal gyi slob ma brgyad byung pa'i brgyad ka la yod par phur pa'i lo rgyus kyi ye ge — 27 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/rnying ma dag la gsal lo/ / dpal gyi slob ma brgyad ni/ snyan ā tsar+ya dpal dbyangs/'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes/ mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug thags bzang dpal gyi rdo rje/gra dpal gyi snying po/ zla lcogs dpal gyi seng ge/ dar rje dpal gyi grags pa/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje rnams yin no/ / 'di rnams las khams dang / lho brag dang / mnga' ris su mched pa grangs las 'das pa byung par bshad/ de tsho'i nang nas 'brog mi ral pa can gyis sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che rten dge slong la brgyud pas phrin las che bar grags shing /'di dag ni slob rgyud shas che'o/ / gdung brgyud kyi dar rgyas byung pa la yang mang ngo de dag tu ma 'dus pa'i mchog gi slob ma ni/ 'o bran dang sog po dpal ye dang / gnyags kyi dbon rgyud rnams yin te 'phrin las rgya che zhing rgyun mi chad pa byung zhing / khyad par grub thob zam ma chad par byon no/ / de dag la lung rgyun dbang dang 'brel ba ma chad tsam bdag gis rnyed pa ni/ 'o bran dpal gyi gzhon nu sku 'das nas zla ba lnga drug nas/ sras 'o bran pad 'byung 'khrungs/ sku nar son pa na/ yab mes kyi phyag dpe rnams gzigs pas dad de/lung rgyun rtsad bcad pas ring mo zhig lon pa na/ gye re gnyen rtse'i ri khrod na gnubs ston pad+ma dbang rgyal la bzhugs zer/ de ma thag byon nas/ gser srang bco brgyad kyis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba mang po byas nas lo gnyis la rdzogs par zhus/ chig brgyud bka' rgya dang gser gyi 'bul ba med par mi ster bas/ 'o bran gyi phur pa gser mgo can du grags shing / gzhan yang gshin rje gshed 'thob rgya can gyi skor dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum la sogs pa gnubs pa la brgyud par 'ded do/ /de nas blo gros dbang phyug gis rang gi yab 'o bran pad 'byung la yang gsan/ chos 'phro cung zad ma rdzogs pa la yab gshegs pas gnubs kyi slob mar/ gnyags pad 'byung ba'i sras/ gnyags pad+ma rgyal po la rdzogs par gsan te brgyud pa gnyis ldan du byas so/ / de nas sprul sku ri rab dam pa'i bar du 'o bran gyis gdung brgyud rnams la brgyud cing / ri rab dam pas rin po che don grub dpal 'byor la gnang / de nas rim par brgyud de/ yongs 'dzin dam pa rdo rje seng ges bdag la phur pa phun sum tshogs pa shams sngon dang bcas pa thugs brtse bas gnang ngo / /da ni phur pa gzhan la ma grags pa jo bo lang lab kyi khyad chos ji ltar byung ba ni/ lang lab kyi bla ma ngam 'bre sa le yan chad ni gong du bstan zin la/ jo bo lang lab ni sku gzhon nu nas pha ma grongs/ pha spun rnams kyi pha ma'i kha chems la ma nyan te/ lang lab ma bu la khang pa rmig gu gang dang / zhing chung zhig las ma byin pas/ ngam 'bre sa les thugs kyis ma bhe 28 —

༄khya/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/bzod nas/ khyad par 'phags pa phur pa'i gdams pa 'di gnang ste/ lang lab kyis sgrub pa byas te dgra thams cad tshar bcad/ snyan grags kyis phyogs kun tu khyab kyang sbyin 'bras chung pas phongs te/ 'khor re na lug rdzi byed cing yod tsa na/ de dus dge bshes rā lo tsā ba rdo rje grags sku bsod dang / mthu che bas bod kyi mi che dgu dang / bla ma slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyis phyag dang zhe sa bkur bsti 'bul dgos pa yin la/ gal te ma byas na gshin rje'i gshed kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis skad cig la bsgrol ba yin te/ khong la zhe sa ma byas pas/ mar pa'i sras dar ma mdo sde la sogs pa sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu gsum bsgral/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags la sogs pa rang mnyam gyi lo tsā ba bcu gsum la sogs pa mang po bsgral ba yin zhing / khong de rtsa ba grwa pa khri tshos bskor te 'khor re ru chos 'khor la byon/ 'khor re btsad po la sogs pas chos bzhi zla ba bzhir btegs/ de dus rā lo tsā ba la lang lab kyis phyag ma btsal ba la/ mi blun po zhig yin 'ong dgongs pa la/ slar mi rnams kyis khong sku mthu che zhing phur pa la mkhas pa yin kyang / sku bsod chung bas da lta gzhan gyi lug rdzi byed dgos pa lags byas pas/ 'o na kho nga rgyal gyis khong sbos nas nga la phyag mi byed pa yin 'ong ste/ kho la do nub kyi tshe las med kyi bsgugs sdod cig gsungs/ chos thun grol ba dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsad pa'i sbyor ba bzhi'i bca' gzhi mdzad de/ khyad par sbyin sreg gi skabs su rā lo nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos kyi skur gyur nas/ ling ga la lang lab dgug gzhugs kyi bden bdar lan gsum byas te/dus der lang lab ni lug 'tsho ba nyid las gzhan ci yang mi byed mod kyi/ dgug 'dren dang po'i dus der dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor na gnas pa'i rtsangs phur rnams byung ste/ char du babs nas tho phyi'i grwa pa rnams rmas/ bar pa la za gsod dang khro bo bcu'i lcags phur gyi char babs nas 'khor rnams khyim gyi phug tu 'bro dgos pa byung / tha ma'i tshe nam mkha'i khams me dpung dang 'ur sgras gang ste/ der steng du bltas pa na/ rdo rje gzhon nu ri rdo chad tsam lcags bsregs las grub pa/ stod khro bo smad phur pa/ thugs ka nas phur pa drag tu bsgril zhing / hūṃ phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa zhig rwa lo tsā ba'i thog tu babs ma khad/ za za rngam rngam mcha' mcha' ltar du 'dug pas rab tu skrag ste/ de nyid du bzod par gsol/ lang lab la gus 'dud byed par dam bcas pa dang cho 'phrul rnams yal song ngo / / de nas de'i nub lang lab spyan drangs te/ phyag dang zhe sa bsnyen bkur ba dang / brgya 'bul bzang po mdzad do/ / dus der mi rnams na re/ gshin rje mkhan po phur la rdugs/ / zhes pa'i da 29 da

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/gtam yang rgya cher grags skad/ de lta bu'i slob dpon lang lab 'di bas lhag pa'i phur pa'i grub thob ni bod yul 'dir su yang ma byung la/ slob ma yang kha yar byung zhing / mchog tu gyur pa ni bzhi yin te/ 'khor re rgyal thang gi sna snam shes rab tshul khrims/ mong rgu'i skyi nag gyang 'gyel/ rong gi sprangs phu ru mgo/ 'od yug rol po'i nyang nag dbang gi shes rab dang bzhi'o/ / nyang nag gi bka' rkus/ dbang dang gdams ngag med zer ba yang chags sdang gi gtam yin gyi/ lo rgyus 'og tu 'chad do/ /de ltar byin rlabs dang cho 'phrul phun sum tshogs pa phur pa'i chos 'di la dang po nyid nas/ bdag cag gi bla ma'i bar du byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan zam ma chad par byung pa yin te/ de yang slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ rgya gar du tsan+dan gyi nags la me shor te zhag mang por me ma shi nas nags tshal kun zad du nye/ sems can mang po shi zhing la la shi la khad pa la/ seng ldeng gi phur pa sor brgyad pa zhig btab pas/ me shi ste nags tshal sngar las phun sum tshogs pa skyes/ sems can shi ba dang shi la khad pa rnams gsos/ tsan+dan nags la thebs zer kyang / 'byung ba me la thebs pa yin/ slob dpon 'di'i dben sa ni bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug slob dpon gyi gsang mtshan ni bde ba'i myu gu'o/ / slob dpon bi ma la mi tras chu bo gaṅgā la thebs te/ slob dpon gyi chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du sgrub pa mdzad pas/ de'i sngags kyi zer phyogs de'i klu chen po gcig gis ma bzod nas phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po gnam du bcol/ slob dpon la skyin thang drag po phab/ chu bo gaṅgā lud de lung par mi shong par byas byung ba la/ slob dpon gyis phur pa sor brgyad pa gcig btab pas/ gaṅgā yar mar du chad de bar du lam dod de phyin chog pa byung / 'di ni gaṅgā la btab zer yang / chu la ma yin te/ klu la thebs pa'o/ /bal po shī la mdzis maṇ+ḍa la'i mkhar gong la thebs te/ maṇ+ḍa la'i mkhar gong la brag srin mo gdug pa can cig gnas pa des slob dpon gyi dgongs pa la bar chod brtsams pa dang /phur pa bsgril bas maṇ+ḍa la'i mkhar gong gi brag nas sran tsam du nyil lo/ /'di ni brag mkhar gong la thebs zer te/ brag srin mo la thebs pa'o/ /lo rgyus gzhan dag na ni/ rgya gar du phyi nang gnyis ma 'cham pa na rgyal pos zhag gsum na rtsod pa gyis shig su rgyal ba dang rdzu 'phrul su che ba de'i zhabs nas 'degs so zer/ der rtsod pa'i dus su/ slob dpon gyis/brjod rgyu thams cad tha snyad mtha' la gnas/ /don ma mthong bar grol ba ga la 'gyur/ /mu stegs 'chal ba'i gtams gyis ci zhig bya/ / chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen po 'dzugs par bya/ /zhes gsungs nas phur pa bsgril pas/ maṇ+ḍa la zhes bya ba'i grong khyer chen po zhig gi rgyab na — 30 —

༄7/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/mkhar gong gi brag chen po zhig yod pa las/ brag de nyil te mu stegs kyi grong khyer thams cad bcom/ mu stegs rnams la la khrag tu skyugs te shi/ la la lcebs/ la la mig 'bras brul nas thams cad tshar bcad nas/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa dar bar byas so/ /mkhar gong mthu yis bcad ces grags/ zhes
