'byung ngo / /bod yul du byung ba ni/ jo mo mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gyis dben sa 'o yug mkhar ba sna ru mdzad pa'i dus su/ byang phyogs kyi bye ma spyang ki 'dra ba la thebs/ de yang byang phyogs na yar ldong ston gyi tshong pa mang po yong ba las/ tshong dpon nam tshong lha rgyal po shel ging gis byed pa las/ rgyal po khros te/byang spyang bcu bzhis rta bong rnams nyal bsad/ tha ma mi la za ru byung ba las tshong pas lha 'dre'i brdzur yin pa shes te/ yul na byin rlabs che ba su yod dris pas/ mkhar ba sna na jo mo bzhugs zer te/ der jo mo'i drung du zhus pas/ jo mos de rnams bstan pa mchod pa'i sbyin bdag yin par mkhyen nas/ spyang ki rnams kyis rjes sa khyer la shog gsungs pas/ bye ma la rjes 'dug pa blangs te phul bas/ jo mos rjes sa dang bag phye la gzugs bcu bzhi byas nas phur pa btab pas/ spyang ki bcu bzhi po dngos su mkhar ba sna'i gnya' na mar la hril li li 'dril nas lhung byung / spyang ki la thebs zer yang / rgyal po shel ging la thebs so jo mo'i gsang mtshan ni/ be'u shin+ting rtsal zhes so/ / 'di'i slob ma mi nub rgyal ba'i snying po yin te/ 'di'i jo mo la dkor nor sna re la/ nor sna khri tsho re ri ba bdun phul/ dar gyi dge tshe'i steng nas jo mos bshad/ mthing shog la gser gyis bris te glegs bam du byas/dben sa ga'u sha'i rong(gar sha mkha' 'gro'i gling yin)/ gsang mtshan me dpung col/ bya rog la thebs te/ de yang 'phreng ba na bza'i khar bzhag ste dbu sku bsil bas bya rog gis phreng ba khyer ba la/ brtag pas bya rog bdud nag po skrag med kyi sprul pas bar chod byed par mkhyen nas/ bya rog gi grib ma la phur pa btab pas/ bya rog sa la lhung nas shi'o/ / bya rog la thebs zer yang / bdud la thebs pa'o/ / de'i slob ma lo dpal gyi blo gros yin te/dben sa spa gro stag tshang seng ge phug gsang mtshan rdo rje drag po rtsal/ mon dmag la thebs/ de yang slob dpon mon na bzhugs dus dmag gis dgon pa bshig nor rdzas khyer/ de nas dgongs rgyud rtsa 'brel tsho bsnams te spa dro stag tshang du byon/ bsnyen pa byas pas rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gzigs/ lho'i spa'i khyim la dmigs nas phur pa btab pas/dngos su spa khyim la phur pa bcur gcur byung nas mon pa rnams kyi snying la phur pa re thar thar zug nas kun bsgral lo/ / lho'i spa khyim la thebs zer yang / mon pa la thebs so/ / de'i — 31 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/slob ma ngam 'bre klu'i rgyal mtshan/ dben sa nyang stod srin mo ri'i co to/ gsang mtshan bdud 'dul grags pa rtsal/ dgra la btab pas bgegs la thebs/ de yang slob dpon 'dis phur pa 'grub pas dgra bgegs gnyis la ngang ngam shugs kyis thebs/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga la thebs te lta dgongs phul du phyin/ bar chad dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral nas/dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa dgu la sku 'das te/ spur sbyangs pas gdung rus ci yang ma byung ste/rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku zhal gsum phyag drug pa chag gang pa zhig dang / gī lā ya 'bur dod cig phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin thob pa'i rtags su byung ngo / / de'i sras ngam 'bre sa le shes rab dbang phyug ste/ 'dis bla ma la 'bul ba chen po byas te rma gtsang skyi gtsang gi 'gram du zhus/dben sa gong ma dang gcig la/ gsang mtshan bgegs rigs 'joms pa rtsal/ des bgegs la btab/ de yang srin mo ri na sgrub pa la bzhugs dus/ nub gcig 'od chen po gcig byung / 'od de la phur pa btab pas/ tho rangs mi dkar po gcig byung ba na re/slob dpon gyi bka' 'khor la gnod pa mi byed kyi nga'i phur pa thon zer/ der kho la mna' bgags nas phur pa bton te/ 'od la thebs zer yang / rgyal po la thebs so/ / bla ma 'di nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang chu la mi 'byings pa la sogs pa dngos grub du ma la dbang 'byor pa yin no/ / 'di'i slob ma lang lab rdo rje yin te/ rma chu rab kyi pha rol skyid chu rab kyi tshu rol/ dbye ma yug mor zhus/ phyis gser srang brgyad cu las byas pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sku gcig phul/ deme sna drangs te nor sna bdun phul/ lang lab kyi dben sa 'khor re'i rdo rje rtse 'dus/ gsang mtshan 'phrin las mthar phyin rtsal/ 'dis spyir dgra bgegs kun la thebs/ lang lab kyi nor rku la shor ba las/ rkun ma'i rjes sa la phur pa btab/ 'bre grags po bya ba zhag gsum na shi ste/ shul mi rnams kyis nor bskyal lo/ /slob dpon 'dis sgrub pa mdzad pa la phur pa rnams 'phar ba dang mchong ba dang / me dang du ba la sogs pa byung / lcags phur gcig brag gi ngos la btab pa la phyugs rdzi dang shing 'thu ba dag gis lag pa 'jus te spyangs la dbyug pa sogs rtsed mo byed pa byung ngo / / 'di yan chod du phur pa chig brgyud yin no/ / 'di las gong du bstan pa ltar slob ma mang du byung la/ slob ma'i mchog bzhi las/ sna snam shes tshul gyis thugs zin pas/ phrin las dang lag len man ngag tu gril nas gnang / rgyud 'grel che ba rnams ma gnang la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud rdo rje khros pa'i dum bu gnang / 'di rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma yin zer/ man ngag 'phrin las bzhi'i don 'di la gnang ba rnams shin tu zab par byed do/ /skyi gyang bsnyel ni/ yul mi rnams kyis nor phyugs khang — 32 ge

༄khya/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/zhing thams cad 'phrogs pa la brten nas/ lang lab kyi rtsar byon nas gdams pa zhus pas/zla ba dgu lha bsnyen gyis la/ de nas bse lcags shel gsum la zla ba gnyis sgrubs shigadon 'grub nas 'ong gi gsungs/ de ltar bsgrubs pas lung drod tshad du phyin/ de nas gyang gi drung na mi mang po nyi ma la 'ong zhing 'dug pas thams cad dgra ru ma gyur pa mi 'dug ste/gong khug nas phur pa phyungs te gyang la btab pas/ gyang 'gyel ba'i thib 'og tu mi kun shi bas/ skyi nag gyang bsgyel du grags/ gyang la thebs zer yang dgra la thebs/ 'di shes rab che bas rgyud 'grel man ngag thams cad gnang ngo / / sprangs phu ru mgo ni/ sngar nas phur pa mang po shes/ slob ma yang mang ngo / / 'dis kun la kha mthun par jo mo mkhar chen bza'i thugs dam gyi phur pa jo bo lang lab la yod zer bas/ nas bong khal drug sha khog pa drug snum ban gang / chang rkyal pa gang rnams khyer te 'khor rer 'ongs/ der lang lab bza' mi gnyis la sras ni mi mnga'/ nor rdzas srab mo las med pas/ khang pa'i sgo glegs dang / shing cha btsongs nas za ba las/ sprangs phu ru mgo bong khal ded nas phyi sgo med pas khang ba'i nang du btsangs kyis byung ba dang / lang lab kyis jo bo sngags pa ni mgron khang ma lags sgo nor ba ma yin nam/ byas pas/ sprangs na re/ ma lags 'di khar chos kyi bka' drin zhur mchis pa lags/ zer nas khal tsho phog ces pa phul/ gtam mthun sbyor mang po btang / de nub mar me btegs/ chang dang sha drangs/ nas phul nas phur pa jo mo lugs zhu 'tshal byas pas/ da 'o na zla ba phyed nas shes par bya gsungs nas gnang ste/ dpa' bo gcig par sgrub pa'i don zab tu gnang ngo / /de sras sprangs kyis rong du slob ma mang du bsdus/ khong rang gi phur pa gcig brgyud mang po shes pas/ de tsho nas btus kyin sgrub thabs mang du brtsams/ 'di jo mo mkhar chen bza'i thugs dam yin/ lang lab byang chub rdo rje'i phyag nas 'ongs zer zhing / slob ma rnams la so sor mi 'dra ba mang po bstan pas/ phur pa rtsa dum gyi chos skor 'chal mgo zug so sor mi 'dra ba mang bas sprangs kyi slob ma rnams kyang nga'i 'di jo mo lugs yin zer zhing gcig la gcig mi mgu/ da lta jo mo lugs kyi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba mang po byung ba yang de yin/ zhes lo rgyus su 'byung /bdag gis ni/ sprangs kyis byas pa'i yig cha ma mthong bas 'thad mi 'thad spro bas mi nus so/ /da ni slob ma bzhi pa nyang nag dbang gi shes rab kyi lo rgyus brjod par bya ste/ de yang lang lab yab yum gnyis zas nor gyis phongs par yod pa la/ nyang nag gi 'o yug rol por gong mar spyan drangs zhabs tog byas/ der lo gsum song ba dang / jo mo de khar bzhag — 33 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/ nas/ slob dpon ltong kha smad na mar rnyed pa tshol bar byon nas zla ba dgu'i bar du ma byon/der jo mo skyo zhing yid chad nas/ nangs mo zhig jo mos nyang nag bos nas/ slob dpon 'di bas snying thag ring ba ma byung gi/ khyed rang chos 'dod na ngas sbyin no zer/ 'don dang bdag dga'o byas pas/ 'o na sgro ba nag po 'di kha phye zhig zer nas/ slob dpon lang lab kyis la rgya yod pa bcag nas kha phye/ dbang ma thob pa la dgongs brgyud bris pas/nyang nag la bkra mi shis pa byung ste/ gnag phyugs mang po yod pa la gnag nad byung ste/phal cher shi/ rta la tsug byung / der yi ge 'bri 'phro bcad/ slob dpon gshegs pa'i phyogs kyi ri mtho sar phyin te gter tshogs mang po bshams nas bshags pa byas/ slob dpon spyan drangs nas nor rdzas kyi phyed 'bul ba byas pas/ gnag nad dang bkra mi shis pa kun chad/ slob dpon spyan 'dren pa btang ngo / / der slob dpon byon pa dang / sngar jo mos gsungs pa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus bsnyad pas/ slob dpon na re e he he lha'i khug mar srin gyi lag pa brdzangs ang gsungs/ der gong gis dam bcas pa'i nor rdzas tsho phul nas chos zhu 'tshal byas pas/ slob dpon na re/ 'o na sngon la khyed pha spad dbang zhig thob pa bya dgos gsungs nas yab sras gsum la chos kyi dbang rdzogs par bskur te/ 'di ltar dbang phyi nang gsang gsum bskur ro/ / der sras che ba de sngar bu yin pas yab dang ma yar sdang zhing dbang chung bar 'dug bu chung ba ni gces phrug byed de de'i ming tshu le zer ba yin/che ba la gnang nge zer te 'di rig pa can sngags kyi snod dang ldan par gzigs nas/ lang lab kyi ming spos nas/ shākya rgyal mtshan zhes btags/ de nas slob dpon lang lab kyi zhal nas nged rgas 'khogs gnyis kyis nor 'di tsho nya ra mi yong ba gda' yi/ 'di tsho khyed rang yab sras mdzod lags/ nged mi gnyis ma shi bar du mi sdug pa zhig zhu gsungs/ der nyang nag dbang gi shes rab thugs ma bde ste/ slob dpon khyad par can 'di la gdung brgyud cig byung na bstan pa dang sems can la'ang phan/ nga'i bu tsha rgyud rnams kyis phyag mchod pa 'bul sa zhig kyang dgos pa 'dug snyam nas jo mo bgres mo lo lnga bcu nga brgyad lon pa de la rgyu mtshan smos te/ nga la bsam blo 'di 'dra zhig bdog nor rdzas 'di tshor bdag po gcig kyang dgos pa gda' bas jo mo zhig blangs na rung ngam byas pas/ jo mos de shin tu legs so gsungs/ de nas slob dpon la zhus pas mi byed gsungs/ der gong gi rgyu mtshan tsho zhib tu brjod de/ jo mos ni gnang lags byas pas/ rgan mo la mi dga' ba mi 'dug gam gsungs/ jo mo dgos pa gda' lags zhus pas/ 'o na bya na yang bya gsungs/ der rus — 34 —

༄khya/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/'o phya bza' yin pa'i bu mo zhig blangs nas/ jo mo la phul bas sras gnyis byung ste/ che ba la grags chung zer/ nu bo la grags pa dbang phyug tu btags/ de tsa na nyang nag dbang gi shes rab kyi chos thams cad khong du chud/ bla ma yab yum gyi zhabs tog kyang 'di nyid kho na bzang ba yin no/ / de nas skabs shig tu nyang nag gis shog gu mang po sbyar nas yod pa la/slob dpon na re/ ci 'bri ba lags gsungs/ rgyud 'grel zhal bshu ba lags byas pas slob dpon gyi zhal nas bdag ni nyi ma rgas kha 'dra/ chos kyi bdag po nyid lags kyis/ bla dpe zhal ma bshu bar tshags mdzod cig gsungs/ bla dpe sras gnyis la dgos mod byas pas/byis pa gnyis gsang sngags kyi snod du rung zhing mthar phyin pa'i nges pa med/ de ltar byung na de dus su gdams pa byin pas chog mod gsungs/ bla dpe po ti dpe klog can bya ba/dgongs rgyud kyi glegs shing la bse'i lha mo bzhi bris pa'i po ti gnang ngo / / mi kun na re/nyang ro kho re ru lang lab byang chub rdo rje rabs chad/ 'o yug phu ru sras gnyis skyes/ ya mtshan che zer/ phyis sras gnyis po chos par ma song / phyug po chen po gnyis byung /grags chung la bu gnyis las che ba yon bdag ldeng rtse / 'dis gsung rab mang po bzhengs so/ / de ltar yin mod kyi/ jo mos la rgya bcag pa'i gtam 'di la ston te/ sna snam dang /skyi nag dang / sprangs gsum nyang nag gis bka' rkus zer te/ phyis nyang nag sras kyi thu bor gyur pa yin no/ / byin rlabs dang nus mthu yang phul du byung ba'i gtam rgyusargyud)mang la/ dben sa ni 'o yug sgo mo'i rgyab(skam ma skam gyi brag phug zer)snyam bzang gi brag phug tu'o/ /gsang mtshan rdo rje gshog rgod col/ snyam bzang phug par sgrub pa mdzad pas/phur pa nam mkha' la lding ba dang / 'od dang sgra dang bcas pa byung / dgra bgegs thams cad btul ba yin no/ /'dis dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga bzhes nas 'da' khar sras tshul le la zhal chems gsungs pa/ shākya rgyal mtshan gyis ni man ngag thams cad shes/ khos dpe cha kun khyer ba 'ong ngo / / 'og khang gi ka zhu'i kha na po ti bse glegs can yod do/ / bu rang tshags gyis la sbos shig gsungs/ der 'og khang na shākya rgyal mtshan yod pas tshor te/ yid chad nas po ti bse glegs can yod pa khyer nas bros phyin snye bu'i gnas bya ba na yab kyi slob ma gnang hūṃ ka ra bya ba zhig yod pa de'i sar phyin te/ yab ni grongs su cha ba yod/ tshul le la zhal chems gsungs/ yid chad pa'i tshul smras pas/ gnang hūṃ ka ra ha las te/ slob dpon grongs su cha na/ po ti khyer nas bros pas dam tshig nyams nas 'gro bas/ nangs par rang re gnyis ka 'dengs/ chos nu bo la yang sbyin dgos zer/ nangs par phyin tsa na — 35 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/yab grong nas 'dug der gnang hūṃ ka ras spyan gnyis mthun par byas so/ / de nas dus re zhig na bshags pa mang po byas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo mang po bskor/ de nas dben sa ru mched gnyis kyisarnabasnyen bsgrub mdzad pas rtags dang mtshan ma mang po ni byung / nub cig mar me mi gsal/ sgra snyan mang po grags pa dang / shākya rgyal mtshan spyan mi gsal bas/tshul le la mar me de chos dang gsungs/ tshul les mar me bcos par phyin pas sgra snyan mang po thos shing / dkyil 'khor du bkod pa'i lha phur tsho bro sa do rar zhugs pa bzhin cod paṇa zing zing 'khrab me stag phro phro 'dug go /gcen la 'di ltar gda' byas pas/ rung gsungs nas/zang nag chen po zhig bsnams nas/ phyag tu sba 'khar dngul mgo can bsnams nas sa la btsugs te/ mched gnyis kyis bstod pa mdzad de dngos grub blangs so/ /de nas ring zhig na/ slob dpon shākya rgyal mtshan gyis tshong pa mang po'i dpon mdzad de ldong kha na phar byon pas/ 'dar nag po'i rta pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gis tshong pa thams cad bcom/ de sting res gshegs nas gzigs pas nom pa bgo ba mthong nas ber sngon po de phud nas/ lha bos klu bos nas brdab pas/ mi rgan zhig gdong du byung nas/ lung pa 'di sa gnyan rdo gnyan/de tsug ma byed zer/ gnyan po kho na 'dod/ mi rung pa kho na 'dod gsungs/ de'i nub mo mi nyal tsam pa'i dus tshod la ngu cong dings pa zhig byung nas rta pa gsum shar song /nangs par nyan tsa na tshong dpon gyi bu'i mgo la slon dpon gyi rta yis 'phra brgyab ste shi ru cha zer skad der slob dpon 'khor bcas kyis nub mo bros nas phyin/ phyi de lo dus na rta pa bcu dgu shi'o/ /gnyis kyi dpon slob can du 'ongs nas 'bangs byas so/ /der nyang nag ber sngon can zhes phyogs kun tu grags so/ /dben sa mnyam mnyam brag phug gsang mtshan rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal/ brdabs pa ber sngon po brdabs pas thebs pa 'dar nag po la thebs so/ /'di'i slob ma lhan gyi slob dpon grags po dben sa lhan gyi stag lung grog po/ gsang mtshan rdo rje bde chen rtsal/ thebs pa zhang po nyang nag la thebs/ de yang gnubs yul rong gi sa'i cha 'grogs bya bar 'khrungs/ mi mang po nye res med pa zhig yin/ chung ngu la pha ma shi nas/ zhang po nyang nag gi ris ban+de 'phen po mang po yod pas de rnams kyi nor rdzas thams cad phrogs nas sprang du btang ngo / / der slob dpon shākya rgyal mtshan dang mjal/lo bco brgyad nas sum cu'i bar du bla ma'i gnag rdzi byas/ bla mas gsang sngags kyi snod du rung bar gzigs/ shes rab che bas phyugs skyong rin la man ngag thams cad gnang / phyag bzhes thams cad la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ der bla ma'i zhal nas/ da ni ngas kyang lo da 36 da

༄7/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/brgyad cu gya lnga lon snang ba yal las su chad/ rgyud 'grel 'di tsho zhal bshus gsungs/der slob dpon drag po la yul na nor bag tsam yod pas der bri ba 'am zhus pas/ legs kyi 'dir bu gnyis po phrag dog skyes pa srid do gsungs/ der po ti kun gnang nas yul du 'dri yin yod tsa na/ slob dpon gyi sras che ba chos tshul bya ba byon nas/ a po drag po yab ni grongs nas med/ po ti bse glegs can yang mi 'dug de su la 'dug pa zhig la mgo bskyel ba la zer/ slob dpon grongs nas mi dga' ha las pa'i steng du/ po ti bse glegs can su 'dug pa la mgo bskyel zer bas yang dang yang du ma dga'/ po ti nga la yod zer ni ma phod/ der bla dpe slob dpon drag po la lus so/ / de tsa na bla ma drag po'i zhang po nor 'phrog mi kun gyis slar yang 'di nyang nag ber sngon can gyis mthus bsnyem pa yin nam/khyod la zo zhig ci nus pa rems shig zer kha smras byed do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis lhan du byon te/ bud med cig la yul zhing brten thub tsam zhig 'dug pas/ de dang lhan du bsdad/ der lhan gyi stag lung grog por dben sa byas te sgrub pa mdzad pas rtags mtshan mang du byung / zhang po dregs pa can de kun gyis ltums byed du ni ma 'dod pa'i khar/ zla ba zhig na slob dpon drag po mthus bsgang gis btang gi zer/ g.yas ru gtsang po'i rtsa ba na brag phug yod pa der nyang nag ban+de bcu gsum bzhugs nas mthu byed do/ / slob dpon gyis kyang stag lung grog por drag las byas pas/ de nas zla ba gsum na nyang nag ban+de bcu gsum po la glo tsha thebs nas kun shi'o/ / phyis 'grogs lung par ltad mo chen po zhig byung ba la/slob dpon drag pos zang nag chen po gcig gyon/ dre'u gcig chibs/ 'khor mang pos bskor te bltas(ltad)mo la byon pas zhang ne+e mo kun gyis sa gtor te/ zhang mi thong po ngan pa byung ngo zer zhing 'a tsi 'a tsi zer ba la/ khron pa kun na re/ 'a tsi bya ba khyod rang yin mod/dang po yal zhing phrogs/ bar du zlum mi byed par mtha byed/ tha ma ban+de bca gsum srog rirab 4〉tho rmeng ri9tshotshor zi sna rang char tshor nore/tsho la modang bral nas phung / 'a ca bya ba chod rang cha yan mad zar zhang ya ga bsgrags sa/ / slab dpon drag po 'dis dgongs brgyud skor la mi mkhyen pa med cing / mthu dang sku bsod che bas dbus gtsang gi mkhas btsun thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs so/ / 'di mar pa lo tsā ba dang dus mtshungs pa yin/ de tsa na sna snam shes rab tshul khrims la sras gnyis yod pa'i che ba sna snam 'bro ban la sku dgra zhig byung nas/ dgra de dag gi mthu zlog pa la gnubs zam nag stod pas/ jo bo stag ram spyan drangs so/ / lan cig sna snam 'bro ban dang /gnubs stag ram zam kha gcig tu mjal ba dang / sna nam gyis jo bo stagawa ram // phyag byas

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/te/ dge bshes pa/ mi 'di pas bdag la mi 'tshams pa'i las mang po bgyis pas/thugs dam la dgongs la 'di pa'i bsrung ba mdzad par zhu byas pas/ gnubs stag ram gyi zhal nas/ lang lab byang chub rdo rje'i phur thung res sbos pa/ nga mthu bzlog byed kyi/ ci nus rems zer/ sna snam khros nas gos nag brdabs/ ngas ma nyes ma yo'o byas so/ / de nas dus btab ste/ gnyis ka phug tu zhugs pas/ zla ba gsum na gnubs stag ram khrag skyugs te shi'o/ / gshin rje mkhan po phur la rdugs bya ba dus der yang grags la/ der sna snam gyis chang mang po btsos te/ nyang ro'i ban+de phur pa shes zer tshad spyan drangs te tshogs 'khor byas so/ /gtang rag chen po btang / gral du glu 'di blangs so/ //rdo rje gzhon nu'i gzhu mo la/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs rgyud kyi brgyus/ /khro bo pha bcu'i mda' smyug la/ /khro mo ma bcu'i sgro yis sgron/ / phur pa sras mchog gi mde'u bcug / dam can rnam gsum gyis brgyus pas dkris/ /bse lcags shel gsum gyis ngar zhig blud/ /'phangs ni zang nag gi phyogs su 'phangs/ / phog pa jo bo stag ram la phog / mda' tshabs mi chung che bar gda'/ /zhes glu blangs so/ /de nas dar chos pas phur pa rtsa dum 'chal chos te/ nyang ro'i rgyal khams rtsam du lod/ zhes zer te/ bdag cag la ni cha med lags/ de ji ltar las chad pa na sna snam shes tshul gyi slob ma rgya ston sangs rgyas bya bas/ shangs kyi lung par phur pa rgyud 'grel gzhan nas bkab nas phur pa rtsa dum la brten pa'i sgrub thabs mang po brtsams/jo mo mkhar chen bza'i gdams ngag can gyis bltas pa na bsres kyang ma 'dres skad do/ /gdams ngag dang mi ldan pas ni bsres pa dang bslad pa mi shes/ rgya ston sangs rgyas kyi slob ma rgya rtsags shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis kyang rtsa dum gyi sgrub gzhung mang po brtsams/ shangs pa dgon ston gyis kyang brtsams/ de'i slob ma sgro ston dar gtsug gis kyang sgrub thabs mang du byas/ la la gsang skor gyis bslad/ la la mdo skor gyis bslad/ de dag gi sgrub thabs kyi ming ni man ngag drug pa dang / man ngag gsum pa dang / rma'i khug chos/ bskyed pa sku'i thebs yig dang / las bzhi'i 'phyongs drug dang / phur pa sgrub lugs dang / dme phur nag po dang / phur pa 'dul bzhi la sogs pa/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang po btags skad/ dus de tsa na jo bo ston pa kun na re/ nga'i 'di jo mo mkhar chen bza'i thugs dam yin/ gzhan ma yin zer zhing gcig la gcig mi mgu skad/ spyir dang por sprangs phu ru mgos sgrub gzhung mang po brtsams/ bar du rgya ston sangs rgyas la sogs pas shangs lung par gzhung mang po brtsams/ tha mar gang zag shes rab can rnams kyis legs su re mang po — 38 —

༄/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/re byas/ ming phur pa rtsa dum du btags nas mi 'dra ba grangs las 'das/ bka' dang brgyud pa man ngag ma chad pa chos ma bslad pa man ngag thob pachigacig gis bltas na 'chal ba yin par shes/ bod du 'gyur ba'i chos la phur pa rtsa dum 'chal che skad/ phur pa rtsa dum slad med yod pa slob dpon drag po yin/ zhes 'byung ngo / / kho bo ni gong gi de dag la lang lab kyi khyad chos jo mo mkhar chen bza'i thugs tig 'di ma grags pa yin gyi/ de dag gi brgyud pa rnams la gang zag bzang po sha stag byon pa yin pas/ rang rang gi sgrub gzhung de dag la 'chal ba'i skyon yod par mi sems la/ yang sgrub thabs kha cig ni sbyor dngos rjes gsum ma tshang pa dang / ma 'brel ba dang / nor ba la sogs pa kha yar snang mod kyi/ deng sang ni nub nas nyams len byed par mi 'dug pas/ zhib du bri ma dgos so/ /slob dpon drag po la slob ma mang yang / thugs kyi sras su gyur pa ni gnyis yin te/ byang ro rgyan khar gyi so ston khri rgyal dang / nyang stod kyi lce ston shākya rgyal mtshan gnyis so/ / de la lce ston shākya rgyal mtshan ni ston pa chen po zhig yin pas/ 'khor mang pos bskor te gdugs spur re byon te/ slob dpon drag po mjal bas mkhyen pa la thugs mnyes nas rgyud 'grel thams cad gnang yang ston pa 'di sku bsod che bas lag len ma lobs te mi mkhas/ rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa ni mkhas so/ / phyis lag len dang man ngag zhu bsam ste byon tsa na slob dpon drag po ni grongs nas mi bzhugs/ slob dpon gyi jo mo skyi gu rang gi yul du spyan drangs nas dbyangs tsho chod tsam byung / man ngag gi brgyud pa ma zin no/ / lce ston gyi slob ma skye chung pa shes rab grags bya ba shes rab can zhig gis dgongs rgyud bcos nas la stod du mang po la spel/'go ba bya spos kyang rgyud la bcos skad/ der dgongs rgyud la gnyis byung / skyi ston gyis man ngag med par rgyud 'grel gzhan gyis bslad nas mang du bshad do/ / slob dpon drag po'i chos rgyud zin pa'i slob ma ni so ston khri rgyal kho na yin te/ rgyud 'grel man ngag kun la mkhas/ dben pa rgyan mkhar gyis ngo dmar brag phug gsang mtshan rdo rje gter sgrub rtsal/rtags dang mtshan ma phul tu phyin/ phur pa dgra bgegs gnyis la thebs so/ / 'di'i slob ma lha rje phur ston ring mo yin te/ zhabs tog gis bla ma mnyes pa mang po mdzad de gdams pa ma lus pa thob/ sku gzhon nu'i tshe slob dpon drag po la yang rtsa ba tshar gnyis zhus/dben pa khra ri'i rdo rje gnam rdzong / gsang mtshan rdo rje las rab rtsal/ dgra dang bgegs la thebs/ rtags mtshan mang du thon/ bka' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sras yum bcu bdun bzhengs pa la sogs dge ba'i las rgya cher mdzad/ khra ri gnam rdzong bya ba de la stod — 39 ge

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal gyis rtsibs ri'i byang nas rgyang tsam song ba'i ring la brag seng ge gnam du mchong ba 'dra ba gcig yod/ de'i steng na rdzong bar snang la lding nge ba(la stod zur tsho yin)'dra ba zhig yod/de ru bsgrubs pas rtags dang mtshan ma thob po/ /de'i slob ma rgya ston nam mkha' rgyal pos khra ri gnam rdzong du bla ma mnyes par byas nas/ gdams pa man ngag tshang bar zhus kyang dbang ma thob pas/ phyis rang gi gcen smyos ston nyid la rdo rje bya ba lha rje phur gyi thugs sras la zhus/dben sa ding ri srag nye'i bang steng dgon par bla ma smyos dang rgya ston gnyis kas bsgrubs pas rtags dang mtshan ma mtha' ru phyin/ gsang mtshan gnyis ka mthun pa rdo rje drag po col/dgra bgegs gnyis ka la thebs/ de ltar gnyis kas lha rje phur la thug kyang / dbang rgyud gtso che bas/ lha rje smyos ston nyi ma rdo rje/ rgya ston nam mkha' rgyal po zhes 'dod do/ /nam mkha' rgyal po'i slob ma rang gi sras gnyis las/ sras chung ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan pa la rgyud 'grel gdams ngag tshang bar gnang / chung ngu nas yab kyi drung du phyag phyir lag len mang po mdzad pas lag len dbyangs dang bcas par shin tu mkhas/ yab kyi bsnyen sgrub la bcug pas rtags dang mtshan ma mang po brnyes/ dgra bgegs gnyis ka la thebs/ grub thob byin rlabs can du grags so/ / de'i slob ma nyang ban shu mang lung pa chen po yin te/ bla ma la dbang rgyud 'grel man ngag tshang bar zhus/ dben sa rong rgyan mkhar gyi thog phug gsang mtshan rdo rje dbang 'dus rtsal/ dgra bgegs gnyis la thebs/ de'i slob ma 'jam gling paṇ+ḍi ta nag po/ 'di ni mi che bas nyang stod kyi bya chos mkhar po che la sogs pa mkhar gsum gyi bdag por gyur/ rong du smugs bsam gling gi lha khang bzhengs/ dben sa mon mo gtsug rum/ gsang mtshan rdo rje 'dus pa col/ dgra bgegs gnyis la thebs/ lha 'dre bran du 'khol ba la sogs pa'i yon tan mnga' 'o/ / de'i slob ma shangs rdo rje gling pa bla chen rdo rje rin chen yin te 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan du ma dang ldan/ sku las tshul khrims kyi dri 'phro/ bla ma 'jam gling pa rang gi dgon par spyan drangs nas dbang gdams pa zhus/ dben sa rgod tshang brag dgra 'dre gnyis ka la thebs/ de'i slob ma chu bar nyi phug pa chen po yin te/ dben sa bros phu bsam gtan phug gsang mtshan rdo rje thog 'bebs rtsal/ dgra sa spun po dang / rgyal po la thebs/ de'i slob ma gtsang nya ri ban grong gi ston pa gsang sngags rdo rje yin te/ dus phyis byon pa'i sngags pa rang la mkhyen pa dang nus mthu gnyis ka che/ slob dpon pad+mas mchims rdo rje spre'u chung gi skye bar lung bstan/ bod la phan pa'i rten 'brel mang po byed dgos 'dug pas/ mnga' ris rdzong kha'i chos rgyal gyi — 40 —

༄7/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/gdung brgyud rnams kyis mthun rkyen sbyar te sna dga' re yang grub/ rdzong kha rgyal po'i sku rim gyi nub re'i thun gtor 'phangs pa'i tshe mo dngos 'gro ba skye bo kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa sogs nus mthu'i grags thon/ rdzong khar yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ 'dis sku gzhon nu'i dus su sgro sbug gi dben sar phur pa'i sgrub pa zhag bdun mdzad pas rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gzigs/ phur pa dgra bgegs gnyis ka la thebs so/ / de la mang yul skyid grong gi thugs rje chen po dang mtshungs pa 'phags pa wa ti bzhugs pa'i lha khang du/ bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po des gsan pa yin te/ 'di ni chu pho rta'i lo la mi nyag 'ga'(mkhar) dang nye ba'i sar sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bco brgyad lon pa'i tshe sa g.yos kyi 'jigs pas nang mi dang grong pa kun shi bas thugs skyo ste dbus gtsang du chos la byon/ de nas yar lung btsan thang du gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas pas dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer spyan drangs/ btsan thang dbang mo cher grags pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba dang thug ste sngags gsar ma'i dbang bka' dang / rgyud 'bum gyi lung gsan/ rje 'gos lo tsā ba la sbyor drug gi khrid gsan pas zla ba drug bsgoms pa la yon tan thams cad rdzogs par rje nyid shin tu dgyes te/ khyod chos 'di la bag chags sad pa zhig 'dug gsungs/ skabs der rdo rje zam pa gnang ba dang thug pas rnying ma'i chos skor la dad pa mchi ma 'khrugs pa tsam skyes/chos thams cad thob pa zhig bya dgos snyam pa shar/ su la yod dris pas/ dbu du na zhogs thar pa gling bya ba na/ sangs rgyas dbon po la yod zer/ der byon te rdzogs pa chen po bka' gter phal cher gsan/ 'bri gung du chos rje kun dga' rin chen la 'bri gung pa'i skor yongs rdzogs gsan/ chos rje'i sku mdun du gsang phu ba'i bka'i bcu bstan gsal bya bas/ dgong zhig la dgag pa mang po byas pa la/ lan btab pas chos rje dang bkab bcu gnyis ka dgyes/ bka' bcu ba na re/ khams pa khyod 'di 'dra'i shes rab che ba lags mod/ phyogs bslab na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta 'dra ba zhig yong par 'dug zer/ der ban dkar ba 'jam dpal bzang po'i 'bri gung du byon/ khong la paṇa chen nags rin gyi chos skor zhus/'bri gung chos rjes/ khyed la bka' brgyud kyi bstan 'dzin zhig re bas stag lung du song gsungs/ bka' shog dang bcas brdzangs/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa la/ bo dong pa'i chos bka' tsam las bka' brgyud ma thob kyang / lo bzhi bzhugs te thugs gtsigs che/slar 'bri gung du byon pa na chos rje gshegs/ dpon po kun rin pa rten bzhengs kyi 'bul sdud la myang long la byon song 'dug pas yar klungs su byon/ 'on mthing ma sngags 'chang — 41 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/g.yu 'brug rdo rje la mdo dbang dang / sems phyogs gsan/ de nas spa dro stag tshang du ka thog pa ye shes 'bum pa la rgyud 'bum gyi lung dang / bka' ma'i chos bka' mang po zhus/rat+na gling pa'i dris lan mdzad kyi 'dug pas/ de khyer nas lho brag shar du rat+na gling pa la phul/khong gi gter chos yongs rdzogs dang / yang dgon pa'i ri chos/ phur pa bka' ma kha yar thob/ de nas la stod byang du byon/ rgya mkhar se ston pa la zhi khro phur gsum gyi skor dang /ma mo lho 'grims/ sgang shar sogs ma mo'i rgyud lung mang po dang / tshe bdag pad lugs/ur mo/ kha thun/ gshin rje gdong drug pa/ gshin rje dmar po la sogs pa khong la bzhugs tshad kyi chos gsan pas/ po ti phyed dang sum brgya tsam gyi dbang lung thob/ bla ma 'dis lto gos chos gsum ka gnang / lhag par bstan khur che bas 'di bas lhag pa'i bla ma med gsungs/ lo rgyus gsungs pa na'ang spyan chab 'byin/ de nas bal po dang / gar sha dang / na ga ra ko ṭa la sogs pa'ang gzigs par byon/ la stod lhor sngags 'chang nam bkras pa la bka' brgyad bka' gter mi gcig pa bdun dang / rdzogs chen a ro'i skor phal che ba dang / kha rag skor gsum/ phyag chen brda' rtsa/ do ha skor gsum/ grub rnying / a ma ṭha si ka ra'i skor/ do ha mdzod 'jam dpal rdo rje'i skor la sogs pa mang po gsan/ de nas yar klungs su byon/ khrus khang lo tsā ba la rngog dkyil bdun skor gsan/chag lo rin chen chos rgyal la lde'u ra ba'i chos skor rdzogs pa dang / chos rje nam bkras pa la bka' gdams kyi skor mang po gsan/ zhwa dmar pa bzhi pa la karma pa'i chos skor mtha' dag dang / yab du byang sems chen po la zhi byed skor/ gtsang smyon pa la ras chung ba'i snyan brgyud la sogs pa mang po dang / zing sa stag mgor rgyal mtshan pa la kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i chos skor dang / dol pa sgrub chen ma la gcod yul dang / bla ma dgongs 'dus la sogs pa sangs rgyas gling pa'i chos skor ma lus pa dang / bsam gtan gling pa la khong ra'i a ti'i skor dang / sa skya bka' 'bum/ lam 'bras la sogs pa mang po dang / rgyal dbang chos rje kun dga' dpal 'byor pa la 'brug phyogs tha dag thob cing / shangs 'ba' rar nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa la stod 'brug dang bar 'brug dang 'bar chos mtha' dag dang /'jags pa la shangs pa bka' brgyud skor dang / sku drung nyi zla ba la kun skyong gling pa'i chos skor dang / ngor du chos rje 'dren mchog la lam 'bras dang / dbang mang po gsan/ zha lu ba dkon mchog bzang po la yo ga dang zha lu ba'i chos bka' phal cher gsan/ chos rje byang chen pa la 'chims nas brgyud pa'i dbu ma'i khrid sogs snar thang pa'i skor dang / gtam — 42 —

༄khya/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/shul du mnga' bdag gi gdung dang slob brgyud rnams la lugs kyi chos mang po dang / gnas snying bsam gtan sgang pa la chos dbang rin po che'i gter sogs mang du gsan cing /mdor na bod du dar ba'i chos la ma gsan pa med pa lta bu yod kyang bdag gis ni brjod par ma nus so/ /de nas gra thang du zha lu lo tsā ba'i drung du byon/ sgra slob bsam/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid zhu gsungs pa la/ rim lnga zhus pas rlung lnga'i kha dog so sor gzigs/mnal lam du bzung nas zhing khams mang po bgrod/ bar srid thogs med du gzigs/slob ma dang yon bdag dam tshig gtsang ma rnams kyi bde dge mkhyen pa'i mngon par shes pa mnga' ba sogs yon tan du ma byung bas/ sna 'ga' gsungs pa la brten nas yul mi kun gyis kyang bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba rgya chen byas shing / thugs dam brtag pa zhu ba mangs pas g.yeng ba la thugs sun zhing tshe gcig sangs rgyas grub par dgongs nas bya bral la zhugs te/ mon yul du bros nas 'tsho ba ngan ngon la bsten te tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyams pa dang /snod ldan gyi slob ma byung na chos kyi sbyin pa lhug par stsol bar dam bca' mdzad/ mkhar chur le'u bdun sgrub pa mdzad pas/ zha lu lo tsā ba la sku tshe'i bar chad drug cu rtsa gcig gi dgung steng du 'dug pa de/ nyid kyis phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad na slar sum bcu'i bar phyir nur te dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa gcig bzhugs par 'gyur zhes/ re ma ti'i lung bstan byung pa la de'i nangs par rang dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas zla ba dgur sgrub pa la bzhugs/ de dus bsnyen phur gyi kha nas me stag phro phro byung ba dang / nga la dgra zhig yod na bsgral chog pa la dgra med dgongs pa byung / yang sgu chul phyug po la bsod snyoms kyis nas bcol ba ma sprad pa'i khar bla ma la dug btang / yon bdag kun dang phra ma bcug pa de thugs kyis dran pas phur pa ldeg ldeg pa dang / me lhab lhab/ du ba sngo phyur phyur byung / der nga'i bla ma'i sku tshe mthud yod dam/ phur pa ni grub byung dgongs nas/ thug rdor gyi phag sha skam po tshal pa gcig yod pa de tshogs 'khor byas/ gtor ma rgyas par bsngos nas mnal lam brtags pas/dkyil 'khor gyi nang nas yin bsam pa la/ yang res sgrub khang nas yin bsam pa'i bud med rta pa mang pos shing gi phur pa mang pos shing gi phur pa dkar po dang / grod pa mang po khur byung nas sgu chul bzhis sgar song nas grod pa nas khrag mang po gtor ba gcig rmis/ de nas zha lu lo tsā ba'i drung du byon tsa na 'bul ba cang med nas sku 'phrag nyul bas/ a ru ra rlon pa sum cu so gcig byung ba bla ma la phul bas/ shin tu dgyes te phyag tu bzhes/ gcig tshur gnang nas rang gi khar bcug pa rmis/ gnyid sad tsa na/ bla ma'i sku tshe mthud 'dug — 43 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/ste/ nga la gcig gnang ba des lo gcig gis nyung du song ba 'dra snyam pa byung ste/ phyis de ga ltar byung ste dgung lo dgu bcu bzhugs pa yin/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam nas sgu chul ba tsho la bshal rims byung nas rang re la sems gnag tshad shi/ dug gtong mi phyug po tshang gi grong skad stong / phur pa 'dis nga'i bla ma'i sku tshe mthud de/ nga ngan song du de'u skyur/ de nas zhi khro dang / gtsug dgu dang / mi 'khrugs pa dang / kun rig dang / gtsug tor dri ma med rnams kyis sgrib sbyong la lo re re ste lo lngar mtshams bsdams/ mi che chung lnga bcu tsam shi ba 'drong e yod yin te skyon che gsungs/ spyir bla ma 'dis mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang /grub pa thob lugs/ thos bsam sgom gsum la thugs rtsol mdzad lugs sogs ni sems can gyi blor shong ba dka' zhing yon tan de dag gi cha shas tsam yang bdag lta bus brjod par mi nus la/ rnam thar mdo tsam zhig 'dri bar zhus pas ma gnang / phag tu zin bris btab pa gcig yod pa de yang mngon shes kyis dgongs nas longs shog gsungs/ drung du phul bas/khyod rang dad pa che ste/ dus ngan gyi sems can tsho sdig pa gsog lugs 'dis chog pa 'dug pa la/ nga la bsten nas sdig pa 'thob gsog tu ma 'jug ma dad pa skye na sdug ge tsho dmyal bar skye/ nga la yon tan yod tshul su la yang ma lab gsungs nas zin bris me la btab/bka' rgya dam pas brjod du yang med lags/ phyis sku thim par nye ba na/ da lo'i 'brum nad 'di la nga thag ring gcig la bros 'gro dgos gsungs nas/ skabs shig gar song cha med du song / de nas me tog gi char dang / nam mkha' 'ja' dang / sa g.yo ba dang nyi ma bdun bstud mar byung / shar phyogs su sgra chen po grags pa sogs kyi ltas la brten nas/slob ma re gnyis dang yon bdag chos nyams ldan pa dag ni sku ma spangs mkha' spyod du gshegs sam zhes zer ro/ / de ltar yongs 'dzin dam pa 'di dgung lo ji tsam bzhes zhes zhus pa na/brgyad cu rtsa lnga tsam a mi lon/ da rgas nas brjed de mi gda' zhes thams cad la gsungs pa cig yin mod kyi/ gong ma grags 'byung / rje 'gos lo/ dmar ston sogs kyi drung du chos gsan pa dang / thog mtshungs pa yin pas mi yul du lo nyis brgya lhag tsam bzhugs pa 'dra zhing / yon tan gzhan rnams smra ru med kyang / rdo rje phur pa la brten nas dngos grub brnyes tshul phur pa brgyud pa'i lo rgyus 'dir med na mi rung bas/ cung zad bris pa la dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin rgyal mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pas gnang ba bstsal te/ bdag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi gegs su mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/de ltar lha mchog phur pa'i gor bzhugs pas/ / rig 'dzin grub thob rim par byon — 44 —

༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/ pa'i tshul/ / rgya bal bod du bgrang gis mi lang la/ / sngon byung lo rgyus ji bzhin 'chad nus pa'i/ /blo gros spobs pa bdag la ma mchis mod/ /de lta na yang rang gis thos pa tsam/ /yi ge'i lam du gsal bar ma byas na/ / deng sang brgyud gzhung mkhyen pa smos ci dgos/ /gtam tsam rna bar sgrog pa mi snang bas/ /nub par phangs nas dge ba'i sems kyis bkod/ /nongs na bla ma lha la bzod par gsol/ / e ma rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ / sngon chad bod 'dir dar la rgya che zhing / / bstan 'dzin mkhas grub tshad mar gyur pa dang / / nyams len mdzad pa'i gang zag bsam mi khyab/ / deng sang dus na nam langs skar ma bzhin/ /bstan la phan pa thams cad zhing gzhan gshegs/ /gsang sngags 'dzin par 'dod pa 'ga' zhig kyang / /'phral dgos za chog slob par mi nus na/ /rgya chen rgyud 'grel lag len lta ci smos/ /ming dang rtags tsam 'dzin pa nyid du gyur/ /thos bsam sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i blo med cing / /bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru 'don pa'i 'dun pa bral/ /bzang brdzu 'ug pa sbos ltar 'gyings pa yi/ / gang zag mthong bas rang sems lhag par skyo/ / phyi tshul bzang po'i gos kyis rnam spud cing / /nang du khyim pa'i sems dang mi 'bral la/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don la rgyab kyis phyogs/ / 'di 'dra'i bstan 'dzin mthong tshe snying nas skyo/ / 'dzum pa'i zhal nas bstan pa spel zhes lo/ / kha phrad mig tshum sems can snying rje skad/ / zhe nas lag len rang gi rnyed bkur sgrub/ / bstan 'gro'i bya ba bshol 'di snying nas skyo/ / mang pos bkur ba'i zas nor gyis ci bya/ / rang gi sems la rang gis mi khrel ba'i/ / slob gnyer bsnyen bsgrub lam rtags thon tsam re/ /med na rang gis rang la ma bslus sam/ /bdag ni 'dod pa'i lha yi bdud dbang gis/ / nyin mtshan dal med grong chog bon ltar rgyug / dkor gyi phung pos shes rgyud sgrib pas non/ / yon tan gsar du skye ba lta ci zhig / sngar shes skyabs 'gro tsam yang brjed de thal/ / dal 'byor don med rnam g.yeng dbang du song / / 'di 'dras 'gro la phan pa mi 'grub pas/ / da ni dben par don gnyis sgrub par smon/ / 'di ltar snod bcud nyams pa'i dus dbang gis/ / sangs rgyas bstan dang skye dgu'i bde skyid nyams/ / rang dang gzhan gyi spyod tshul mtha' dag la/ / bsam bzhin bsam bzhin skyo ba gting nas skyes/ / da ni gzhan skyon sems brjod nyes dmigs che/ / rang skyon 'don pa dam pa'i spyod pa lags/ /de'i phyir rang drin rang la che ba'i thabs/ /legs nyes yin min kha 'chams mi smra bar/ / thos bsam sgom gsum brtson pa'i lam zhugs te/ / ring por mi thogs rang btsan zin par smon/ /rang don bslu ba'i gzhan don ltar snang 'dis/ /sngar — 45 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/yang don med bya ba du ma byas/ / da ni sol ba 'bad de mi bkru bar/ / skal ldan srid na de don byed par smon/ / yun ring srid par 'gro don brtson pa dang / / khyad par dam chos nyams pa de gso ba'i/ /lugs 'di rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa lags/ /de phyir chos rnams ci nus spel bar smon/ / des na mdo rgyud man ngag rgya mtsho dang / /khyad par lam bzang rdo rje phur pa'i gzhung / /ma lus mi nub gsal bar ston nus par/ /skye ba 'di dang brgyud mar 'gyur ba smon/ /'on kyang dman pa bdag 'dra'i spyong/ tshul gyis/ /rgya chen lam bzang snang bar ma nus na/ /de slad rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje yis/ /'gro kun sngags kyi snod du 'gyur bar shog / kun kyang mang du thos pa'i mthar son te/ / bsam pas don rig bsgoms pas dngos grub thob/ /rig 'dzin rnam bzhi rim gyis mngon gyur te/ /skyob pa pad+ma rgyal po der mtshungs shog / ma gyur drin can mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /las dang dus kyi sbyor ba las byung ba'i/ /mi mthun rgud pa mtha' dag nyer zhi nas/ /bskal pa rdzogs ldan bzhin du bde bar shog /rdo rje phur pa'i chos tshul nyi 'od kyis/ /bstan dgra mun tshogs mtha' dag drung phyung ste/ / srid par bdud kyi sbyor ba las gyur pa/ / chos kyi bar chad ma lus zhi bar shog/ rta gdong kun nas tsha ba'i me dang ni/ / gaṅgā'i klung dang pak+ṣu'i rgyun bzhin du/ / rgyun mi chad pa srid pa ci srid bar/ / dam pa'i chos 'di mi nub dar bar shog / thub dbang bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun te/ / de yang bdag rkyen byed la rag las pas/ / gang zhig bstan pa mchod pa'i sbyin bdag yang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /'dis mtshon bdag gis ji srid sangs rgyas bar/ / dge tshogs ji snyed gang zhig thob 'gyur ba/ /shel dang zla ba kun+da ltar dkar ba/ / des ni 'gro 'dis phur pa grub gyur cig /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi byung tshul lo rgyus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs zhes bya ba/ rang dang skal bar ldan pa rnams kyi brjed byang du/ shākya'i btsun pa nam mkhar spyod pa zhes bya bas sa mo bya'i lo dbo nya'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes la rdzogs par sbyar ba 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu rgyas pa dang /'gro ba rnams bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal la dus kun tu spyod par gyur cig / mgi lam̐/dge'o/ /

༄khya/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /badz+ra gī la ya dharmā ga tha/ rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi gtam/ bla ma dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i rig 'dzin 'dus pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang rig 'od gsal mar me'i 'od zer gyis gsal ba thugs rje'i rtsal 'gag pa med cing gnyis su ma mchis par byin gyis brlob pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum drag dur khrod chen po'i nags tshal du/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor nyabs snang stong pa'i gzugs/ / gī la ya yi sems nyid nam mkha' gang / / phyi nang rtsa khams sna tshogs yi ger shar/ /rang sems khyab brdal ye shes phur pa'i dkyil 'khor nang / / byang sems bde ba 'gyur med rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ / phra rgyas phra men mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyil ya'i/ / rang sgra rgyud kyi nges don rdo rje'i glu ru len/ / e ma 'di ltar ngo mtshar che/ /sems nyid kun tu bzang po la/ /rdo rje phur pa mang shar zhing / /gsang sngags thams cad ston par byed/ / rang byung me long nang na ci snang ltar/ / rang snang rang 'dus 'dir ni cir yang snang / / rgyal ba'i thugs kyi gter sgo phye/ / chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /rang byung chos kyi skye gnas rdol/ / rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i che ba/ rgyud sde sngon byung gi gleng gzhi ston pa'i rnam thar dang sbyar ba/ rig 'dzin rigs sngags 'chang ba'i chos kyi rtogs pa brjod pa byang chub kyi sems la gzhol zhing mang du thos pa dang las la mkhas pa dang / lha nye bar gyur pa dang / mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang /ldog pa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / 'bras bu gzhan la re ba med pa dang / dam tshig rnam par dag cing nyams pa med pa ste/ bdag nyid phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dang / byin rlabs phun sum tshogs pa dang / bzlas brjod phun sum tshogs pa dang / phrin las phun sum tshogs pa bdun dang ldan pa'i tshul gyis bshad par bya'o/ /de la thog mar sngags kyi che ba mdo sngags kyi khyad par sogs rgyud sde spyi'i rnam bzhag mdzad pa po mang pos yang yang gsungs pa rnams ni bzlos nas bshad mi dgos la/ 'dir — 47 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/sngags kyi ming tsam thos pa dang / sngags kyi spyod pa la mos pa tsam gyis phan yon bstan pa theg pa chen po'i mdo/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod chen po/ mi zad pa'i gter gyi sgron ma brtul zhugs chen po grub pa'i rgyud las 'di skad ces/ sngon 'das pa'i dus lha'i gnas su 'od ldan zhes bya ba'i lha'i bu zhig 'chi ba'i dus byol song du skye bar shes nas 'jigs te/ gsang ba'i theg pa 'di'i mtshan thos dran par byas pas/ ngan 'gro las grol te sngags 'dzin pa'i gnas su skyes so/ / yang bram ze byams ldan zhes pa zhig sngags la mos shing sngags ston pa'i slob dpon ma rnyed par smre sngags bton pas/ nam mkha' nas lus kyi khrag phyung la mchod do/ / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlab par mdzod do zhes pa'i sgra byung nas rang gi lus las khrag drangs te mchod pas rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su gyur to/ /yang sngon dge ba'i rgyal po bkod pa zhes bya ba'i lha'i bu zhig tshom bu 'bum dang bcas sngags spyod pa las/ 'od ldan zhes bya ba'i lha'i bu zhig gis dad pas tshogs kyi 'khor lo thob ces smras pas dngos grub thob par gyur to/ /yang sngon rgyal po dbang phyug 'od ldan zhes bya ba tshom bu 'bum dang bcas sngags spyod cing dngos grub thob pa'am/gzhan sde bram ze dge sbyongs zer ba zhig dad nas yo byad mang po dang bcas tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsol ba btab pa las/ rgyal pos ma gnang yang dad par byas shing smon lam btab pas rgyal po dang dngos grub mnyam par thob bo/ / yang sngon bram ze gsal ldan zhes bya ba 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa la dad cing / bram ze dge ldan zhes bya ba rgyu'i theg pa la dad pas/ de gnyis tha tshig byas te gcig gis mchod sbyin rgya cher byas/ gcig gis tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa byas pas sngags spyod pa de tshe der sangs rgyas thob/ rgyu'i theg pa la spyod pa de bskal ba grangs med gsum nas sangs rgyas so/ /yang sngon khyim bdag dad pa can mos sbyin zhes bya ba 'khor brgyad dang bcas pas gsang ba'i theg pa'i mdo 'di bcang bas rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'dra bar thob bo/ / yang sngon drang srong ka ma ya na zhes bya bas drang srong mang po la sngags bshad pas/ drang srong mang pos rig pa 'dzin pa thob/ chos ston pa po gsang ba chos kyi rgyal por gyur to/ / zhes sngags la mos pas zhugs pa dang /sngags kyi spyod pa yang dag par spyod pa'i phan yon rgya cher gsungs so/ / de bzhin du rgyud sde mang po las gsungs shing khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i rigs sngags bzlas pa dang / sbyor sgrol yang dag par spyod pa'i che ba ni/ rdo rje khros pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las 'di skad ces/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya sarba bigha nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ lha rnams kun gyi snying po ste/ / ma sgrub na yang myur — 48 —

rgu/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/'grub cing / /tshe yi rig 'dzin sa thob cing / /khams gsum thams cad nus zhes dang / /phur pa rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ 'di rnams bcu phrag brjod pas kyang / /tshe rabs gzhan gyi rig 'dzin rgyud/ / gang gi brtsam par mos pas kyang / / de la mkha' 'gro byams par 'gyur/ /gang gi sa ya bcu yi ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin las/ /rnam pa gzhan du ma nges so/ /zhes rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa ni/ nges par rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa thob par gsungs shing /de lta bu'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i sngags spyod drag po'i phrin las kyi che ba yang 'di ltar/ rdo rje khros pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdo rje phur pa'i bsam gtan gnas/ / khams gsum sems can bsgral gyur na/ / bsad pa 'di yis mchog thob cing / / rdo rje rigs su mngon sangs rgyas/ / zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud thams cad las/ mngon spyod kyi phan yon gsungs pa mtha' dag bshad kyis mi lang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang rdo rje dngos grub kyi rgyud dang / dpal mchog gi rgyud dang / 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / ngan song yongs su sbyongs ba'i rgyud dang / legs grub kyi rgyud la sogs pa sngags gsar ma'i rgyud sde las kyang rdo rje phur pa'i mngon spyod kyi che ba rgya cher gsungs te/gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud las/ grangs med 'byung po thams cad ni/ / de nyid sbyor bas bsad par bya/ /skye ba 'dir ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces sogs dang / rdo rje rigs kyi mnyes par byed pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud las/ sangs rgyas bka' ni bsrung ba dang / /sems can don ni sbyang ba'i phyir/ /rngams pas mngon spyod las byas pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mnyes par 'gyur/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /de bzhin du sbyor ba thabs lam bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon byed pa'i sngags lam gyi che ba yang rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa mtha' dag 'dir brjod kyis mi langs so/ /de ltar gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i che ba sbyor sgrol gyi phan yon bstan nas gnyis pa sbyor sgrol rang rgyud du spyad pa'i nyes pa ru tra'i sngon 'byung sngags kyi bstan pa snyigs ma lnga'i 'jig rten du dar ba'i rgyud bshad pa/ de yang ru tra zhes bya ba ni bod skad du drag po 'e/sa bya ste/sems gdug pa can ma rung zhing drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ shin tu drag po'i spyod nga/sa sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mi nus pas/de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis khro bo'i skur bzhengs nas drag po'i phrin las kyis 'dul dgos pa'o/ / de skad du'ang / phur pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ bdag rtog zhe — 49 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/sdang las 'khrul pa/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i ru tra 'di/ /sngon yang bskal pa re re la/ /bar chad srin por gyur pa ste/ / 'di ma btul na sems can dag / thams cad ma lus dmyal bar 'gro / sangs rgyas kun gyi dpung bzlog la/ / shes rab thabs sbyor chen po yi/ / de bzhin gshegs pa khro bor bya'o/ / zhes gsungs/ ru tra 'byung ba'i rgyu ni sbyor sgrol gnyis rang rgyud(par)spyad pa las 'byung ba ste/ phur pa gsang ba'i don rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u las/ sbyor sgrol rang rgyud las kyis srin por skye/ / rnam par smin pas dmyal khams bco brgyad du/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du sdug bsngal myong / /de bas rnal 'byor phal gyis byar mi rung / /zhes gsungs/ de yang dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs te/ gzhan la 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i rnam par smin pas ngan song du skyes/ sngags la mos shing zhugs pa'i phan yon gyis drag po bsod nams kyi stobs dang ldan zhing / yi dam gyi lhas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ba'o/ /ru tra'i rnam par dbye ba he ru ka gal po'i rgyud las/ 'di ltar ru tra rnam pa bzhi yod de/ gnas lugs rgyu'i ru tra dang / gol rkyen lam gyi ru tra dang / gol ba sngon byung ru tra dang / gol 'gro rjes 'jug ru tra yin/ zhes dang / rang rgyud phyi'i ru tra dang /sprul pa nang gi ru tra zhes gnyis su bshad de/ rang rgyud phyi'i ru tra yid sems can gdug pa mi thul bas/ sprul pas 'dul bar gyur pas na sprul pa'i nu tra yod pa yin/ zhes gsungs/dpal khro bo'i rgyud las/ phyi bzung ba'i yul med pa la/ bzung ba'i yul du 'dzin pa ma tram̐ ka ru tra/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems med pas na/ sprul pa 'dzin pa'i sems su bzung ba ni/a ka ru ru tra/ gzung 'dzin gnyis sems bltas pa las grub pa ni/ kha tram̐ kha ru tra'o zhes bshad/ dpal mgon po'i rgyud las kyang / a kar sha ru tra dang / ma tram̐ ka ru tra dang /kha tram̐ ka ru tra gsum zhes lha mi klu rnams kyi ru tra dang / gzhan yang bdud ru tra nag po/srin po nag po/ gnod sbyin ru tra/ gza' ru tra/ ma sangs ru tra/ btsan ru tra/ ma mo ru tra'o zhes dang / yang 'di skad ces/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dgongs pa ste/ / ma rtogs bdag 'dzin ru tra'i rgyu/ / nges tshig ru tra rnam pa gnyis/ / rtag par rang rgyud ru tra dang / / chad par stong tsam ru tra'o/ / rtag pa'i ru tra pho mor bshad/ / lta log stong nyid chad pa'o/ /stong rtsal 'gags med stobs po che/ /ru tra ma ning chol pa'o/ /dbye ba rnam pa gsum yin te/ / rtag pa rgyun gyi ru tra dang / / 'khrul pa rang rgyud ru tra dang / / thugs rje sprul pa'i ru tra'o/ / gzhan yang ru tra rnam pa bdun/ / lha chen klu chen srin po dang / /log sred can dang mi ma yin/ /'byung po yi dwags la sogs yin/ /dgos byed rtogs dang bhe 50 —

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/ —ma rtogs khyad/ /de ni res dang rtag chad dang / /sangs rgyas thugs rje byin rlabs dang / /ru tra rjes bzung phan yon bstan/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ba dang / /mthar thug rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /zhes gsungs te/ yang ru tra phal che ba ni log sred can gsang sngags spyad nyes pa'i dbang gis byung ba dang / 'ga' zhig ni bsod nams kyi mthu dang ldan yang smon lam log pa las gyur to/ / 'ga' zhig ni byang chub sems dpa' bsam bzhin du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'byung ba'i rkyen du 'byung ba dang / sprul pa'i ru tra bsgral bas rang rgyud pa rnams skrag par 'gyur ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas te/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ khro bo'i rgyal po sngags dag dang / /yul gsum dag kyang bsam mi khyab/ /rtogs pa'i bdag nyid bsam mi khyab/ / zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyu mthun pa las byung ba'i phyir sgrub pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab po/ / zhes gsungs/ de phyir yul dus kyi khyad par sogs so so skye bo'i blos dpag par mi nus pas phyogs mthun gung bsgrigs te bshad par bya'o/ / de yang ye shes rngams pa'i rgyud las/ sngon bskal pa kun bkod la/ sangs rgyas sngon byung gi rgyal po mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu/ bzang rgyan zhes bya ba zhig gis gsang ba'i tshul bcos nas log pa'i 'khor bskyangs pas/ 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa ngan 'gror lhung bar gyur to/ /yang bskal pa kun bkod la dpal sbyin zhes bya ba zhig gis rang log pa'i chos spyod cing nges pa'i don spyod pa'i rnal 'byor la smad pas bskal pa bcu gnyis kyi bar du mnar med du skyes so/ /yang sngon dge slong dri med spyod pa zhes bya ba zhig gis sngags log par spyad pas 'khor tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa dregs pa chen po ru trar bskal pa grangs med par skyes so/ /zhes bshad/ dbang chen 'dus pa'i tan+d+ra las/ kun tu bkod pa'i bskal pa la/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ / dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu la/ / thar pa nag po dan phag gnyis/ / gsang don yan lag dbang zhus pas/ / ji bzhin de nyid ma bcos na/ / nam mkha' la ni sprin bzhin du/ / rnal 'byor de nyid dam pa'i lam/ / de nyid las ni so sor gol/ /zhes mngon dga'i zhing du byung bar bshad de/ ming gcig kyang yul dus mi 'dra'o/ /yang rak+ta dmar gyi rgyud las 'di nyid ltar/ sngon bskal pa grangs med pa'i sngon rol du/bskal pa dga' ldan zhes bya ba la/ ston pa 'od bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bstan pa la/ rgya gar gyi yul 'od ma can zhes bya ba na rgyal po 'od snang zhes bya ba/ yum pad+ma can zhes bya ba la sras gcig 'khrungs/ de nas yab rgyal bo lha yul du gshegs nas brgya byin gyi stan phyed la — 51 ge

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/dbang byas so/ / rgyal po des rgyal srid longs spyod sangs rgyas 'od bsam gyis mi khyab pa la phul nas smon lam btab pa/ nga bstan pa 'di 'das pa'i 'og o rgyan gyi yul byan lag mchong gi ri kong chu btsong ma thang dang srin bu'i gnas su/ yang zhe sdang dug gi ral pa can/yul 'dod chags khrag gi ral pa can gyi bur skyes nas ru tra gdug pa can du 'gyur ba'i smon lam btab pas tshul de ltar bur gyur pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bka' bgros nas che mchog he ru ka byon te sras de la byin gyis brlabs shing drag po'i 'phrin las bskul te lus ma bor bar sangs rgyas te/ dpal khrag 'thung zhal gsum phyag drug pa sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed par sprul nas/ yab ru tra bsgral/ yum kro ti shwa ri byin gyis brlabs/yum gzhan rnams ke ri brgyad/ seng ha dang sgo ma dang / dbang phyug nyer brgyad/ mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis/ 'bar ma brgyad/ ma mo bdun/ sring mo bzhi ma mo khrag shog tu byin gyisarnabarlabs nas/ yab phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la mgon por byin gyis brlabs/ yum 'khor dang bcas pa khrag 'thung gi lhar sangs rgyas so/ /zhes bshad do/ /de'i dus kyi sras de ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ skus 'dul ba la 'jam dpal gshin rje/ gsung gis 'dul ba la dbang chen/ thugs kyis 'dul ba la badz+ra he ru ka yon tan gyis 'dul ba la che mchog phrin las kyis 'dul ba la rdo rje gzhon nu/ gzi brjid kyis 'dul ba la bla med mngon rdzogs/ dregs pas 'dul ba la dregs pa kun 'dul/ stobs kyis 'dul ba la stobs ldan nag po/ byin rlabs kyis 'dul ba la rig 'dzin bla ma/ de yang phyi zhi bas 'dul ba la rdo rje sems dpa'/ kri ya'i dus na rdo rje rnam 'joms/ yo ga'i dus na rnam par snang mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa'i dus na phyag na rdo rje/ mdor na bde bar gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i rnam par rol pa ste/ bi to las/ bde bar gshegs pa gar gyi bdag / 'dod dgur bsgyur bas gar yang bde/ / gar gyi dbang phyug chen po la/ /mkhas pas phyogs ris mi rtog go / zhes yang gsang bla med thugs kyi zhal du gsungs so/ /da ni don gsum pa rgyud kyi gleng gzhi ston pa'i rnam thar dang sbyar te bshad par bya'o/ /de yang rdo rje phur pa 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhir/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 'og min gyi gnas gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang dang rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum tshogs dang gnyis su med par bzhugs te/ stong chen po'i 'jig rten la gzigs shing rigs lnga sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsol ba btab nas thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis stong chen po'i 'jig rten rnam par snang zhing rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor — 52 —

sgo/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/sprul nas sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad par gsungs pa bzhin/ chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du khro bo bcu la sogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul 'di ltar/ rdo rje gzi ldan 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ sngon bskal pa grangs med pa'i sngon du bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i dus tsam na/ yul dur khrod shing gcig ces bya ba'i yab bram ze ke'u shu dang / yum bram ze mo dbyings ma gnyis la sras brgyad de/ thu bo ta ka ya dang / sing ha ra/ bram ze ra ta/ me ka ra/ ba ta la/ rgyun shes/ bram ze phaṭa nya/ tha chung lo ta ka rnams so/ / de brgyad la khyim thab dus gcig tu byas nas chung ma re re dang bcas 'khod pa las/ de rnams kyi gnas su gcan gzan dang / sha za srin po dang / mi ma yin mang pos gtses pa las byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ bdag cag pha ma bza' phran bcu po 'di/ nam zhig mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cigasangs rgyas nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzhal yas khang sgo dang phyi'i bsrung mar gyur cigarnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi sdong grogs su gyur cig dam pa'i chos la bar chad byed pa thams cad kyi gnyen por gyur cig bdud dang bgegs thams cad 'dul zhing tshar gcod par gyur cig rnal 'byor pa gang gis gzhung bzhin mi shes kyang gsang ba'i don la mos pa dang yi rangs pas bdag gis bzlas pa'am/ bskul tshig gam na(mna')tshig tsam 'dzin pas kyang de'i mthu dang grogs su gyur nas de'i sdong grogs su byed par gyur cig mtshan tsam brjod pas kyang gang la bya ba 'grub par gyur cig rnal 'byor pa shes rab zhen pa la mchod pa dang yo byad phud la rlom pa la bdag cag gi bka' bden pa bdar ba tsam gyis dengs par gyur cig rnal 'byor pa'i bka' mi nyan cing dam las bzlog pa'i ma mo dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / srin mo shas che ba'i 'khu ldog med par gyur cig gang gis sdig pa 'ba' zhig spyod pas dmyal bar skye nges pa dang / ngan pa'i ngang tshul can thugs rje'i dpyang thag chad pa rnams kyang bdag cag gis lung bzhin du bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par gyur cig ces spyir smon lam btab cing so sor nas kyang hūṃ ka ra la sogs pa'i khro bcur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bcu'i srung mar gyur nas chos byed rnams skyong zhing gdug pa can rnams 'dul bar smon lam btab nas/ lus longs spyod thams cad sbyin par btang nas mi ma yin pa la sogs pas zos shing med par byas so/ / de nas bram ze rnams lha'i rgyal po'i sras su skyes nas lha ma yin dpung bzlog go / de nas tshe 'phos te 'od kyi phur por gyur nas 'og min gyi gnas su rigs lnga yab yum gyi sras su gyur te — 53 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur mnga' gsol/ chos byed rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad sgrol zhing sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' ngag gi dbang phyug la 'di skad ces/ sems can thams cad la khro bo bcus don mdzad pa dang / khro bo bcu'i rang bzhin sangs ma rgyas pa gang yang med do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar khro bo bcu la sogs pas byang chub tu thugs bskyed cing rig pa'i rgyal po'i rigs sngags 'chang ba'i gtso bor ji ltar bskos pa'i tshul gzhan yang / rig pa mchog gi rgyud las/ sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung dgu'i bye ma snyed 'das pa na/ 'dul dka' ba zhes bya ba'i bskal pa la/'jig rten gyi khams 'di rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gyur/ de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes sgron ma chen po'i 'od zer zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' chen po khrag khrig brgya stong phrag drug cu la mun nag rnam par sel ba rnam par byed ces bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs ston par mdzad pa na/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i khyu mchog tu gyur pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po zhes bya bas rdo rje gsor bzhin du bsgyur nas bzhag phyag byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de la 'dzum par mdzad pa'i rgyu zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das de'i thugs dpal be'u las 'od zer rgya cher 'phros pa las/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje rig pa'i rgyal po chen po byung zhing / gzhan yang mtshan dpe'i 'od zer las khro bo chen po stobs po che la sogs khro bo bcu dang khro bo chen po gī li gī la dang / pho nya mo bcu la sogs 'khor dang bcas pa phyung nas/ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes sgron ma chen pos byin gyis brlabs/ de la sogs pa sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i drung du bdud pham par mdzad nas bstan pa bsrungs so/ /de'i 'og tu bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa drug pa la 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir/ sangs rgyas don gzigs zhes bya ba'i gsung rabs la bdud bcang ma smra ba zhes bya ba pham par byas nas don gzigs zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas brgyad cu dang / sangs rgyas bye ba dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bstan pa la bdud pham par byas shing bstan pa bsrungs so/ /de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas stong snyed kyi gsang ba 'dzin pa dang bstan pa bsrungs par gyur te/ de bzhin du sbyar te tha mar gtsug tor can/ rnam par gzigs/thams cad skyob/ gser thub/ log par dad sel dang / mi 'khrugs pa dang / 'od srungs la sogs pa'i bstan pa bsrung bar bshad cing / nga'i bstan pa la ma 'dul ba 'dul ba dang / de bzhin du gsang ba 'dzin cing / bskal pa bzang po la 'jig rten gyi khams mi — 54 —

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/mjed 'di nyid du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed de/ bskal pa bzang po'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed pa thams cad la de bzhin du mthar gyis thabs 'dis bstan pa la bya ba byas nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas rdo rje'i rtsal gyi 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs so/ / de ltar gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje gzhon nu khro bo bcu'i tshogs dang bcas pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa bsrungs shing /drag po gdug pa can thams cad 'dul bar bsngags pa bzhin/ phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud 'byung po kun 'dul las 'di ltar/ sngon 'das pa'i dus bskal pa 'bum gyi sngon rol tu sangs rgyas 'jigs rten sgron ma zhes bya ba'i dus/ dge slong thub dka' zhes bya ba la slob ma thar pa nag po zhes bya bas gsang ba'i don zhus pas rkun po ming sring gnyis kyis phag nyan byas te gsang don log par bsgrubs shing log par smras pas/ skye ba 'phos nas las kyi sdug bsngal myong zhing / skye ba brgyad nas lang ka'i grong brdal du srin po lang ka mgrin zhes bya ba dang / kha 'bar ma zhes bya bar skyes/ bong bu'i rna ba can mgo bo gsum pa sprul zhing ral pa lus dang mnyam pa kha nas me 'bar zhing dud pa 'byung ba/ spre'u'i pags pa gyon pa bu chung dang dud 'gro dag brkus nas za ba las kyi srin po'i ris gshog pa dang ldan par gyur nas ming 'brog te'u nag po dang / nag mo bya'i mgo can zhes grags/ bdud pho mo de'i bu tsha ming sring bcu gcig sde tshan dang bcas 'gong po'i sprul pa mang pos sems can thams cad la gnod cing dge ba'i bar du gcod/ thar pa'i gegs byed pas de dgra 'dul ba'i phyir/bcom ldan 'das 'byung po thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/'og min gyi bar du 'bar ba'i drag po'i gzhal yas khang sprul zhing khro bo bcu/ yang sprul sum sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'jig rten gang zhing / 'jig rten khams drag po'i gtun khung khyams rim pa gsum dang ldan par sprul te/ ru tra'i sde dang / dam log dang / dam sri thams cad khyams khang du chud cing bros pa'i gnas med pa khro bo chen po rnams kyis gzir ba'i rdzu 'phrul chen pos dam log dang ru tra'i sde thams cad btul/ phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud sde chen po la sogs pa rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher gsungs so/ / yang rdo rje phur pa gsang ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ dang po ru tra zhes bya ba/ / bskal pa brgyad khri'i sngon rol du/ /dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu la/ /thar pa dan phag 'khor bcas kyis/ /gsang sngags theg chen gdams ngag nyan/ / gcig gis legs par go gyur te/ 55/ thar pa

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/nag pos log par go /de yi rnam smin nges pa yin/ /khro bo'i gzugs can ru trar skyes/ /bstan pa re la re re byung / /tha ma brgya byin bu mor skyes/ /srin po lang ka mgrin bcu la/ /chung mar byin pas kho ni sde/ /phyi la bros te mtshor gnas pas/ /pha ni brgya byin smon pa yi/ /de yi ming ni 'gong po'o/ /yab ni zangs tog rgyal po dang / /yum ni zangs mgrin ldem pa'i sras/ / bse lo bse yi skyes bu ni/ / g.yog 'khor rnam pa bsam mi khyab/ / srid pa khus 'debs rgyal mo ni/ /tshangs pa dung gi thor gtsug can/ /e ka dza ti gnyis kyi sras/ /sho na spyan gcig gnyis yin te/ /'di rnams ru tra'i 'khor yin no/ /gsang sngags log par spyad pa yin/ /gnod sbyin srin po'i lus su skyes/ /da ni ngas btul phan chad du/ /sangs rgyas sa la nges pa yin/ / 'di rnams gtam tshig shes gyur na/ / las rnams ma lus myur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs/ yang phur pa za byed 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ 'das pa'i dus bskal pa mnyam gnas zhes bya ba la/ dur khrod chen po rab tu rtsub mo zhes bya ba/ srin po ma tra ka ru zhes pa/ yul 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyas byed ma zhes bya ba dang / 'khor lha srin sde brgyad/ lha chen po bcu/ zhe sdang gdug pa'i gcan gzan drug 'dod chags gdug pa'i 'dab chags drug gti mug za gsod drug las byed srin po pho mo drug 'jigs pa'i sgo ma bzhi dang bcas sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bas/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis bka' bgros te/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur bzhengs te/ bdud 'dul ba'i phyir thal chen/ lha bdud dmar po 'dul ba'i phyir rak+ta'i rtags/ gte mug gi bdud 'phar mgo gsum 'dul ba'i rme ba gsum brtsegs thugs khar btab/ gza'i bu mo 'dul ba'i phyir stag sham/ klu 'dul ba'i phyir sbrul chun/tshogs bdag 'dul ba'i phyir glang chen ko ba/ srin po 'dul ba'i phyir zhing chen g.yang gzhi/bdud dga' rab dbang phyug 'dul phyir thod pa gsum gyis brgyan pa/ sdug bsngal rgyas byed ma 'dul ba'i phyir/ 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mas 'khril zhing / rdo rje dang kha ṭ+wāṃ phur pa ste rang rtags kyi phyag byumatshan dang / phrin las don rtags kyi phyag mtshan bsnams shing ru tra btul/ khro bo bcu spros nas phyogs skyong bcu btul/ de dag gi lag cha rnams dpa' rtags kyi phyag mtshan du bzhes/ zhe sdang gdug pa'i gcan gzan drug btul te za byed pho druga'adod chags gdug pa'i 'dab chags drug btul te gsod byed mo drug gti mug las skyes pa'i za gsod drug dug gsum cha mnyam tu spyod pa'i dod dang pha waṃ btul te khra thabs nyi shu'i tshogs su mdzad do/ /phung sri khyi mo dmar lcam/ dam sri lte phur nag mo/ rgyal sri dun+ti da 56 da

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/nag mo/ dug gsum gyi sri can gsum btul te/ bcom ldan 'das gī la ya'i thugs yi ge 'bru gsum khar bcug pas shwa na ma bzhi/ bdag nyid ma bzhi/ rgyal mo bzhir sprul te ma mo bcu gnyis kyis rang rtags srog snying phul te phur pa'i srung mar bkod/ de bzhin srin po'i tshogs bdag kyang btul te 'khor gyi lhar mdzad nas phur pa za byed 'bar ba la sogs pa'i rgyud kyi tshogs rgya cher gsungs so/ / yang dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu thugs rje khros pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/ sngon dpal chen po dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pas ru tra bsgral ba'i dus/ru tra snying khrag yar ba las/ ru tra'i sras drag byed ma hā de ba dang / yum ral gcig ma byung zhing / de gnyis la sras bcu byung ste/ steng du yab nyi ma 'bar gsal yum sgra 'byin ma/bu pho nyi ma phag gi mgo can/ bu mo zla ba smig bu'i mgo can/ de bzhin du shar du dri za rgyal ba'i sgra yab yum/ sras stag dang bya rgod mgo can/ shar lhor me lha dbyug pa can yab yum sras g.yag dang bya rog mgo can/ lhor gshin rje yab yum sras shwa ba 'ug pa'i mgo can/lho nub tu srin po pho mo bu gzig dang kha ta'i mgo can/ nub tu chu lha pho mo bu byi la pu shud mgo can/ nub byang lha pho mo bu spyang ki dang khra'i mgo can/ byang shar 'byung po khams gsum bdag po pho mo bu dom dang sre mong / 'og tu sa bdag gzhan stobs 'joms pho mo bu dred dang byi ba'i mgo can rnams/ gnas sems can yongs la 'cho ba las/ de dag 'dul ba'i phyir o rgyan gyi dur khrod chos kyi dbyings su drag po'i gzhal yas khang chen por dpal rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi mkha' gsang nas/ khro bcu khra thabs dang bcas pa phyogs bcur spros nas/ dam sri bcu gdan du byas nas 'khod cing khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal/ rig pa'i rgyal po bye ba khrag khrig dang / ye shes kyi khro bo dpag tu med pa dang bcas pas drag po'i mchod pas mchod cing rgyud gsungs par gsol ba btab ste/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i nges tshig 'khor 'das dbyer med nges don gyi gleng gzhi las brtsams/ rdo rje phur pa gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rgya cher gsungs so/ / de bzhin du rdo rje khros pa rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / phur pa gsang ba'i dgongs rgyud dang / 'jig rten snang byed la sogs pa'i rgyud mang por ru tra btul ba'i tshul dang / phyogs skyong bcu bsgral ba dang bsrung ma rnams dam la btags pa'i tshul mang po gsungs pa phal cher mtshungs la/ 'on kyang 'ga' zhig rang rgyud pa dang / 'ga' zhig sprul pa'i nu tra btul bas rang rgyud pa rnams skrag ste rim gyis 'dul ba'i thabs dang / gzhan yang phyi srid pa'i phur pa dregs pa rang rgyud pa dang sbyar ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / nang de dag bsgral zhing byang chub la bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / gsang ba nges don mthar thug — 57 ge

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/dkyil 'khor thams cad bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol thog ma med pa nas rang bzhin lhun grub tu yod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi gzigs snang dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams teng nge 'dzin gyi snang ba dang / 'dul bya so sor skye bo'i las snang sna tshogs te/ chos kyi sku dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul pa'i mdzad pa yul dus rnam pa ma nges pa sna tshogs su 'byung ba'o/ /de'i phyir phur bsrung dregs pa'i tshogs kyi skye rgyud sngon byung phur pa mdung rtse dmar po'i rgyud las 'di ltar gsungs so/ / bcom ldan 'das 'og min gyi gnas na rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa la/ karma he nu kas zhus te gsungs pa/ sngon 'jig rten 'di chags nas stong par gyur te/ yang chags pa'i dus shig gi tshe/ lha'i sprul pa bya rgod gcig sring mo'i sprul pa stag mo zhig byung ba las/shar phyogs shel gyi brag dkar po la bya'i tshang bcas pa/ bya dang stag gnyis ma 'phrad yid kyis chags pa spyad pas/ sgo nga bdun dang chu sbur gnyis byung ngo / / de yang sgo nga bdun ni/shel dang / dngul dang / lcags dang / gser dang / zangs dang / g.yu dang /mchong gi sgong nga'o/ /chu sbur gnyis la yid ma ches nas chus brdol bas bu mo bdun byung bas bya 'grogs('drogs)nas tshang bor ro/ / bud med bdun las gcig gis shel sgong brtol bas mi dkar po dpral ba na mig gcig yod pa byung / yang bud med gcig gis dngul sgong brtol bas mi skya bo ra'i mgo can gcig byung / yang bud med gcig gis lcags sgong brtol bas/ mi nag po lag pa dgu pa gcig byung / yang bud med gcig gis gser sgong brtol bas mi ser po mig dmar gcig byung / yang bud med gcig gis g.yu sgong brtol bas mi sngon po sbal ba'i mgo can gcig byung / yang zangs sgong brtol bas mi dmar po rwa skyes kham pa la zhen pa gcig byung / yang mchong sgong brtol bas bud med nag mo mig gcig nu ma gcig yod pa zhig dang / gcan gzan gyi mgo can zhig dang / gzhan bud med bzhi ste drug byung / de nas mi dkar po mig gcig pa dang / bud med nag mo mig gcig pa gnyis brtsis pas/ bu dgu mda' gzhu dang mdung thogs pa dang bu bco brgyad byung ngo / /yang mi skya bo ra'i mgo can dang / bud med khyi'i mgo can gnyis brtsis pas spre'u mgo can nyis brgya dang / byis pa bong bu'i mgo can nyis brgya/ byis pa bu chung gi mgo can nyis brgya ste bu stong byung ngo / / mi nag po lag pa dgu pa dang / bud med bzang mo gcig rtsis pas khye'u gsum byung ngo / / mi dmar po rwa skyes mo zhon pa dang bud med bzang mo gcig rtsis pas khye'u gsum bu mo gsum byung ngo / /mi ser po mig dmar can dang / bud med bzang mo gcig rtsis pas da 58 da

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/bu mo gsum byung ngo / / yang chu sbur gcig brtol bas/ bdud dkar mo dpral ba na mig gcig yod pa/ bud med ser mo ral gcig gnam du bsgreng ba/ bud med dmar mo lcags kyu thogs pa/ bud med sngon mo dbyug tho thogs pa byung ngo / /de dag gis sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pas/ 'dul ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gsum phyag drug par sprul te zhal bar snang tsam du gdangs te/ mi dkar po bud med dang bcas zhal du gsol nas pho nang du bton pas 'jigs skrag skyes te skyabs su song / bdag gi mdog dkar 'di bzhes g.yas zhal dkar ser ston par mdzod cig ces bud med dang bcas srog snying phul te dam la bzhag rgyal po blon pos spyan gcig pa dang / chung ma la bdag nyid chen mor ming btags so/ /thod pa'i phreng ba yang phul lo/ /de nas mi skya bo ra'i mgo can dang / chung ma khyi'i mgo can gnyis bu stong dang bcas pa zhal du brngub pas/bud med glang chen gyi ko rlon phul/ srog snying bzhes shing dam la btags/ gnam the'u dkar po ra'i mgo can du ming btags so/ /chung mas mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi phul/ shwa na mu khar ming btags/ bu rnams the'u rang stong tsher ming btags / yang mi nag po lag dgu 'khor dang bcas pa zhal du gsol nas btul bas sku nag po 'di phul/ zhal dbus mthing du ston par mdzod/ bdag gi chung ma 'di yang sbyor yum du 'bul/ bu tsha 'khor du 'bul brer srog snying bzhes nas dam la btags/ bdud rnam rol zhes ming btags so/ /chung ma'i lag tu rdo rje byin nas rdo rje ya byin ming btags so/ / yang mi ser po mig dmar po chung ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol zhing btul/ skyabs su song nas stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang chang bu mor bcas pa phul/ srog snying bzhes dam la btags/ chu gza' mig dmar du btags/ chung ma la dbang bskur lag tu rdo rje byin / rdo rje de byin du ming btags so/ / yang mi dmar po rwa skyes la zhon pa de btul/ sku mdog dmar po 'di yang bzhes/ zhal g.yon dmar po la dngas par mdzod zer/ srog snying bzhes dam la btags/btsan shud pa rdo rje zla ba zhes btags / chung ma la dbang bskur/ rdo rje bse byin du ming btags so/ / mi sngon po sbal pa'i mgo can chung ma dang bcas pa btul bas de sbrul gyi rgyan rnams phul/ chung ma sbyor yum du phul zhing srog snying bzhes nas dam la btags/ ming klu dengs po zhes bya bar btags/ chung ma'i lag tu rdo rje byin nas dbang bskur rdo rje phag byin du ming btags so/ / bud med rnams zhag gi mtsho la gnas pas zhag gi zor ris phul/khrag gi mtsho la gnas pas rak+ta'i thig le phul lo/ / ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhis thal chen — 59 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/gyi tshom bu phul/ srog snying bzhes dam la btags/ rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ / rdo rje gsal ba glogs 'dzin ma/ / rdo rje kun bzang mthu mo che/ / rdo rje ye shes chen mo/ / rdo rje gsungachen 'od 'bar ma/ / rdo rje gsung sgrog chen po/ /rdo rje sgrol ma za byed ma/ zhes ming btags so/ / gzhan yang shar gyi dkar mo rdo rje spyan gcig ma/ lho'i ser mo rdo rje ral gcig ma/ nub kyi dmar mo rdo rje dbang sdud ma/ byang gi sngon mo rdo rje las mkhan ma zhes ming btags shing dbang bskur srung mar bkod/ phur srung rnams kyi sgrub thabs las tshogs kyi rim pa rgya cher gsungs/ yang yum gzung ma'i dngos grub chen po'i rgyud las/ sngon 'das pa'i dus kyi bskal pa zhig la 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir nyi zla stong rtsa gnyis shar nas ri rab kyi phyi rol na snang zhing srid pa'i skye 'gro thams cad tshig mi snang ba las/ ri rab kyi khong dpag bsam shing gi rtse mo na/ yum chen srid pa bde 'gro khams gsum yum mchog ces bya ba bzhugs pas nyi zla dbang du sdud pa'i phyir/ sprul pa'i ma mo dkar mo g.yu'i ral pa can gcig bskyed pas/ des nyi ma rnams thod dang 'phreng ba bcing / zung gcig btang bas srid pa cha snyoms shing chags so/ / yang de'i tshe ri rab kyi 'og tu mtshe'i steng na bdud ka la chen po zhes bya ba gnas te dkar mo nyi zla dang sbyor bar byas pas/ bu mo spun bzhi skyes te/de nas rim gyis dreg pa pho rgyud mo rgyud kyi lha tshogs byung zhing / dpal chen pos dam la btags shing chos kyi bsrung mar bskos so/ / mdor na bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad dang / don yod grub pa dang / dpal chen po dang / khro bo chen po bcu la sogs pas bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed nas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa yongs su sbyangs shing sems can dpag tu med pa theg gsum gyi byang chub la bkod cing / khyad par du yang snyigs ma lnga'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i sems can ma rungs pa rnams zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar dka' bas/ mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis ru tra la sogs pa'i sems can dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad pa'i tshul de dag bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi snying po'i smon lam gyi khyad par dang rjes su mthun pa'o/ /de'i phyir che mchog kun tu bzang po dang / rdo rje phur pa dang / shākya thub pa rnams dbyer med pa ste/ byang chub kyi sems rmad du byung ba'i rgyud las/ kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku de bzhin nyid rnam par dag pa longs spyod rdzogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ chos thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la spyod pa rnam par dag pa mngon par byang chub pa'i sku ni gzugs khams su dkyil 'khor 'byin pa'i sku/ sprul pa'i sku ni thabs la mkhas ge 60 —

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/pas gnas thams cad du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku rnam par dag pa'i sku ni de bzhin nyid dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba las byang chub chen po'i sku/ ri rab ri'i rtse mo'i khang bzang na zhal rab tu rgyas so/ /thabs la mkhas pa bya rgod phung po'i ri la rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs su 'jam dpal la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje can gyis zhus nas rgyu 'bras lhun grub kyi theg pa gsungs par bshad do/ / de bzhin du rdo rje sems dpa'i nam mkha' che zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid bde ba'i mchog gi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor sprul bshad cing /skus byin gyis brlabs nas/ stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su thub dbang byon/mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan cing / sprul pa sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang /'og min chos kyi dbyings yum gyi gzhal yas su/ chos kyi sku dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhu lan gyi snang bar/ chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa dang / sku dang ye shes bstan pa la sogs pa rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsungs par bstan te/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i rdo rje snying bo rgyan gyi rgyud las/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sprul bshad kyi skabs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab nas/ bcom ldan 'das gdug pa thams cad 'dul ba shākya thub pa 'og min gyi gnas nas byon te/ dga' ldan gyi gnas su bzhugs nas/ lha'i bu rnams la chos bstan nas zas gtsang gi rigs la gzigs te/ mngon par byung nas byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs te/ bdud las rnam par rgyal ba dang mngon par byam chub pa'i / tshul rgya cher gsungs pa dang mtshungs so/ / de'i phyir mdo sngags gsar rnying dgongs pa gcig pas thub pa'i rnam par 'di ltar/ gī la ya bcu gnyis kyi mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa/ la lar yongs su lung bstan tshul/ /la lar lhums su bzhugs par ston/ /la lar mngal na bde bar ston/ /la lar lhums nas gshegs par bltams nas ston/ /la lar phyogs bzhir gshegs par ston/ /la lar gzhon nu rol rtsed ston/ /la lar khyim pa lta bur ston/ /la lar khab las rab tu ston/ /la lar dka' thub mdzad pa ston/ / la lar sems can skyo bskyed ston/ / la lar bdud tshogs 'dul bar ston/ /la lar byang chub shing drung du/ /la lar rdo rje gdan la gshegs/ /la lar cho 'phrul chen por ston/ / la lar rnam pa bcu gnyis su/ / lan gsum dag tu 'khor lo bskor/ /la lar mya ngan 'das par ston/ /la lar sku yi gdung du ston/ /la lar sprul pa'i mchod rten — 61 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/ston/ la lar chos kyi glegs bam ston/ zhes sogs so/ / de bzhin du he ru ka gal po'i rgyud las kyang 'di skad ces/ sprul sku bya ba grub pa yi/ /ye shes ngo bo las ni gyur/ /spyir ni 'dul ba rnam pa bzhi/ /mdzad pa khyad par rnam pa gsum/ /sku bltams rang byung dka' thub mdzad/ / sangs rgyas bdud 'dul 'khor lo bskor/ / cho 'phrul bstan nas mya ngan 'das/ / mdzad pa mchod rten brgyad pa snang / / 'jig rten pa dang mthun byed phyir/ /'jig rten mdzad pa rnam pa drug / 'khor ba las ni rnam par grol/ / de phyir 'das pa'i mdzad pa drug sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku rnams las/ / mi yi gdul bya 'dul mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan shākya seng ge yi/ / mdzad pa nyi shus byang chub bo/ / zhes gsungs/ de'i phyir thun mong gi mdzad pa phal cher yongs su grub pa ltar bshad kyis mi lang / khyad par mdzad pa sngags spyod he ru ka'i rnam par thar pa dang sbyar ba cung zad bshad na/thog mar sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa ni nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyud 'jig rten 'das pa'i mdo las 'di skad ces/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i sprul pa srid pa'i rtse mo nas dmyal ba yan chad sems can g.yo 'gul thams cad kyi lhums su zhugs pa las/ sprul pa'i sku sna tshogs su 'khrungs te/ so so'i rgyal por sprul te so so'i sku dang skus chos ston te/ 'jig rten du sku mngon par gshegs pa'i dus na/ bstan pa theg pa chen po nyid 'byung ba'i rtags su/ shākya thub pa glang chen
