dkar por sprul nas/ sku las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros nas/yum gyi dbyings gshegs pas yum gyi rmi lam du bab ste yum gyi lhums su chags nas mi yul du gshegs pa'i dus na 'chi bdag gi bdud la sogs pa rgal te/ phyogs bcur bdud sdig can yang sprul te/ nam mkha' la mtshon cha'i char bab pa las/ mchod pa dang rin po cher byin gyis rlabs nas bzhag go / zhes gsungs so/ / yang rdo rje gzi ldan 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje yum gyi ltums na 'khore byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang thabs dang shes rab chen po gnyis su med pa'i dgos pa chen po la dbyer med par bzhugs pa na/ 'jig rten log par spyod pa'i chos sna tshogs dang de dag gi rgyab gnon pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren mang du ba byung ba las/ byang chub sems dpa' ngag gi dbang phyug gis lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod nas/ e ma ho/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na bgegs dang /phyogs skyong ba rnams rnal 'byor pa dang / sems can rnams lam rung par bgyid na de gang gi dus la bab lags/ 'e/sa gsol pa dang / khro bo chen po bcu'i sngon byung dang / che ba'i — 62 —

sgo/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/yon tan gsungs te/ de dag gi 'dul ba'i dus la bab par bka' rtsal pas/ byang chub sems dpa' ngag gi dbang phyug gis kye 'di'i dus la bab bo zhes gsol bas/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes khro bo'i tshogs bskul zhing bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang thams cad 'dul ba'i gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin la zhal gsum phyag drug pa rdo rje dang rin po che dang 'khor lo dril bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'i skur gyur cing / khro bo rnams kyis kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa bka' ci stsal zhes gnas pas phyogs bcu nas khro bo rnams sngon gyi thugs dam smon lam gyi dbang gis byonapas/ de'i gdan gshoms shig ces bka' stsal nas/ khro bo bcu'i snying bo dang sngags rnams gsungs shing / khro bo chen po rnams kyis kyang sngon thugs dam smon lam gyi dbang gis ba byon nas rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa chen pos bgegs dang log 'dren rnams 'dul bar mdzad cing mtshon cha lnga'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo chen por gyur pa dang / bgegs dang log 'dren 'dul ba'i tshul rgya cher gsungs so/ / gzhan yang sku bltams pa dang / gzhon nu rol rtsed dang / khyim nas mngon par byung ba'i skabs thams cad du yang / lag na rdo rje dang khro bo chen po bcu rig pa'i rgyal po 'khor grangs med pa dang bcas pas bsrung zhing / bdud dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa ru tra gdug pa can dag btul ba'i sngags kyi spyod pa mi g.yo ba'i rtogs pa dang / khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / rdo rje gsang ba la sogs par dkyil 'khor mang po gsungs par bshad do/ / yang gnod sbyin gdong gsum pa'i rgyud chu te sngon mo zhes bya ba las/ sngon gyi dus byang chub sems dpa'i gnas shing drung rab tu dga' ba'i tshal na/ bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ lhas sbyin log pa'i spyod pa byed pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi 'od zer las/ lho phyogs ri rgo rtse gnyis pa dmar nag 'khyil ba'i dur khrod ma mo gshin rje'i gnas na/ gshin rje nag po rab tu khros pa 'bar bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer gyis bskul nas/ spyan gyi 'od zer dang thugs kyi sbyor ba bkye bas lhas sbyin rab tu dngangs so/ / de'i tshe bram ze mo mdzis ldan ma la sogs pas gsol te/ lhas sbyin la sogs pa dug lnga'i rang bzhin can zhi bas mi thul bas/ 'dul ba'i sbyor ba mdzad par gsol bas sangs rgyas mthus 'chi bdag chen po des thugs ka nas 'od zer bkye ste/ 'jigs byed nag po'i thog phab pa las lhas sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa dngangs shing brgyal bar gyur/ de'i tshe gshin rje nag po de mgo bo ri rab kyi rtse las thal te lha rnams dbang du bsdus zhabs rgya mtsho'i gting du brkyangs pas klu rnams dbang du bsdus/ phyag bar snang du brkyangs pas bar lha — 63 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/srin sde brgyad dbang du bsdus/ ba spu bye ba sa ya las 'od zer spros/ bdud kyi dmag dpung bye ba sa ya rdul du brlag go /de nas bcom ldan 'das la slar phul bas 'char ka nag po khyod legs so/ / byang chub sems dpa' khyod legs so/ / zhes gsungs so/ / gzhan yang gī la ya bcu gnyis kyi mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba gsum gyi bdag po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug zhing gi rdul snyed dang thabs gcig yum gzhis rdo rje'i glus bskul nas/ rol pa'i sku zhal gsum phyag drug par bzhengs shing / 'dod chags chen po'i sbyor bas rigs lnga yab yum bzhi sems dpa' sems ma mched/ lho sgo skyong sogs sprul zhing bsgyur bar gsungs pa'i tshul dang / rdo rje phur pa sangs rgyas mdud pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud gleng gzhi dang / phur pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rtse mo zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang / phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang / phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud gleng gzhi zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor sprul bshad mdzad tshul rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo dang dgongs pa mtshungs te/ byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa/ dka' thub las bzhengs te/ byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa mngon du phyogs pa na/ 'dzam bu'i gling de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med grangs med pa dag gis til gyi gang bu bzhin du gang zhing de bzhin gshegs par re re'i sku las kyang sangs rgyas grangs med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus te dbang bskur zhing ri rab kyi rtse mor rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sprul zhing lha chen po la sogs pa'i drag po ma rung pa thams cad kyang bkug cing yongs su btul nas byang chub kyi snying bo ga la bar gshegs te/'jig rten dang mthun par bya ba'i phyir rtse bslang ba sogs mdzad cing byang chub kyi snying por rtswa'i gdan la bzhugs te/ bdud sde dang bcas pa pham par byas nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan par bshad do/ /bdud ji ltar btul ba'i tshul khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba'i rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal stong phrag stong ha ha bzhad pa/ zhabs stong phrag stong brkyangs bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ phyag stong phrag stong rdo rje phur bu dang ral gri dang rtse gsum dang / tho ba dang / mda' gzhu/ lcags sgrogs la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ sku ri rab dang mnyam pa'i ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas spul pa'i khro bo rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa 'jigs pa'i sgra sgrogs pa dang / khro bo chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spros nas bdud bcom par gsungs so/ /de bzhin du rgyud kyi rgyal po 'jig rten snang byed las kyang / 'jig rten gyi khams yum lnga'i bha ga'i klong / lhun — 64 —

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/grub drag po'i gzhal yas khang chen po/ bcom ldan 'das dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa'i gī la ya chen po/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang / stag sham las 'od zer rab tu 'bar bas rigs kyi khro bo phra men pho mo sgo ba ko ri seng ha dbang phyug ma'i tshogs thams cad dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / 'jam dpal dang / spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa 'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / sa dang lam la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin gyi tshogs dang bcas snang zhing dga' bar mdzad/ dgra bgegs ru tra'i tshogs thams cad sgrol ba'i tshul gsungs so/ / gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das mngon par sangs rgyas nas mi g.yo ba'i teng nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas rdo rje phur pa chos thams cad kyi gsang ba'i don dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po yang gsungs so/ / gzhan pa bdud btul ba'i tshul khyad par mi 'dra ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyud las 'di ltar ma tram̐ nu tra bya ba des lha srin thams cad dbang du bsdus nas lha'i dbang pos kyang mi thul ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bsgral bar dgongs nas/ nyung dkar dang tshos bub smug po'i nang du srin mi nad gtong ma btsal te/ ru tra'i phyogs su gtor bas kho'i lus la phog ste/ yan lag thams cad khrag dang chu bur gyis gang bar gyur/ de nas lcags dang shing tsher ma can gyi phur pa gza' chen brgyad la bskur/ 'phang pas ru tra'i lus la ldog go /de'i 'og tu lcags kyi sdig pa dang / rte rkang gcig btsal te gza' brgyad rbad cing drag sngags btab pas gshin rje'i bdag po ma tram̐ ru tra bkums so/ / de'i ro mgo bo lho nub rkang pa byang shar du bstan nas mi yul gcig tu mi shoms par ro stod seng nga'i yul du bzhag pa las/ dur khrod chen po gcig chags shing / rdzu 'phrul gyi chos dar ro smad rgya gar du bzhag dur khrod chen po gcig chags shing dam pa'i chos dar/ nang khrol rnams bal yul du babs dur khrod chen po phyed chags/ rdo yi mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad rang byung skyes/spyan ras gzigs kyi sku mngon par byung / yul 'di gsum ni dur khrod phyed dang gsum zhes bya'o/ /de nas ma tram̐ gshin rje'i bdag po 'gum pa'i bu med 'khor bcas bdud ma tram̐ ru tra'i 'khor du 'dul/ bdud kyi ba dan dang rgyal mtshan ni btsugs/ ri rab 'dzub mo'i thod la bzhag nas spyi bo la lan gsum bskor te gnas pa las/ de 'dul ba'i phyir ston pa nyid dpal hi nu kar sprul nas/ bdud kyi 'khor srin mo rnams kyi nang du byon nas dbang du bsdus/ thabs kyi sbyor bas sprul pa'i sras hi ru ka chen po dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa la mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa zhig bskyed cing / gzhan yang sprul pa'i khro bo khro mo phra men gyi tshogs spros te 'khor thams cad btul/ nyung kar dang drag sngags kyis bdud ma tram̐ ru tra da 65 da

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/bsgral te/ ro so sor gtor bas smad rgya gar stod sing nga'i yul/ nang khrol bal yul/sta zur g.yas rgya nag g.yon stag gzig gi yul/ lag pa li yul/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon/o rgyan dang / kha che'i yul du babs so/ / de bzhin du bdud kyi 'khor stobs po che thams cad kyang bsgral te/ ma tram̐ ru tras rang gi skye ba bskal pa gsum gyi bar gar skyes dran zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs spyi bor blangs/ dam tshig bsgrags te ma hā ka lar bzhag go /tshul 'di las 'phros nyung dkar gyi tshogs rgya cher gsungs so/ / yang gsang ba nor bu'i thig le'i rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs dang /byang chub sems dpa' dang / lag na rdo rje rnams sprul te/ rdo rje dbyings dang khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor gsungs shing / lag na rdo rjes sems can gdug pa can rnams gang gis 'dul gsol bas bcol ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa bzhin rdo rje sems dpas lha chen po la sogs pa'i drag po gdug pa can rnams rdo rje lcags kyus bkug cing / khro bo chen po hūṃ ka ras gzir zhing rdo rje spyi bor bzhag cing bka' bsgos pas/ chos kyi srung mar khas blangs/ so so'i chung ma rnams bcom ldan 'das la phul bas dbang bskur zhing / rnal 'byor dbang phyug khri phrag mang po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te gsang ba mchog gi chos rgya cher gsungs so/ / gzhan yang bde ba chen po byang chub kyi sems rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi snying po na bzhugs pa'i dus/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang zhu len gyi tshul du/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba sogs 'gog pa'i phyir/ 'khor 'das dbyer med de bzhin gshegs pas ye shes kyi lta ba rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs rgya cher gsungs so/ / he ru ka gal po'i rgyud rnams kyang skabs 'dir gsungs te/ he ru ka gal po che rtsa rgyud le'u dgu pa las/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus te/ byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba byang chub kyi snying por bzhugs pa gang na ba der gshegs te/ byang chub sems dpa' de la ched du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bstan nas 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to/ / zhes 'byung ngo / / chos thams cad kyi gsang ba'i don dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po la sogs pa skabs 'di dag tu gsungs so/ / gzhan yang rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' che/ zhes bya ba'i rgyud dang / byang chub kyi sems rmad du byung ba'i rgyud gzhan dag las kyang shākya thub pa la phyag na rdo rjes zhus nas rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsungs pa'i tshul rgya cher yod pas/shākya thub pas rdzogs chen ma gsungs brer ba'i rnying ma dang gsar ma'i sngags pa rnams kyis — 66 —

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/gzigs shig sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i rgyud mang po yang rdo rje dbyings kyi rgyud dang mtshungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi phrin las 'dul bya'i snang ba mi 'dra ba dang / 'ga' zhig snga phyi'i khyad par la phyogs su lhungs par go'o/ / gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor lo bya ba'i rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das mngon par byang chub nas 'og min gyi gnas sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i mdun sa chos bzang na bzhugs pa na/ khams gsum na gnas pa'i mthu dang dbang btsan pa thams cad 'dus tshangs pas phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das spyan ma 'dzum zhing dgongs pa la bzhugs pa lags zhes gsol pas/ nga nyid mngon par rdzogs par byang chub nas lha'i gnas 'dir gshegs te/ 'gro ba sems can gyi don la dgongs par mdzod dang / zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 'khor thams cad kyis mchod cing / tshangs pas chos gsungs pa'i skabs dbye bar zhus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas sngags dang phyag rgya bstan pas/ steng gi nam mkha' thams cad rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du gyur to/ /de nas yang 'khor thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas rgyal ba'i sku bstan du gsol ba btab pa dang / kun tu bzang po yab yum gyi skur bstan te thabs shes su gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs rigs lnga spros/ 'byung ba lnga yab lngar byin gyis brlabs pas thabs shis su gyur to/ / sems dpa' sems ma rnams dang / sems can rnams byung / chos dang dge 'dun yang byung zhing / dad pa'i phyir thabs mkhas pas dgongs te lha chen po brgyad dang / nyi zla dang /sa bdag rnams bka'i dam la btags te phyogs skyong bcu bskos so/ /khro bo chen po bcu spros nas/ rang rang gi yum dang bcas/ phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi steng du bkod de/ snying po phog cing lag cha gtad dbang bskur ro/ / gzhan yang bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang gzhan sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' mang po dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang dam can mang po ming btags shing snying po phog lag cha gtad nas rang rang gi las grub pa la btsud/ de dag dang rjes su mthun par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgya cher gsungs so/ / tshul de bzhin du gī la ya bcu gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyud theg pa chen po'i mdo zhes bya ba las/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba gsum gyi bdag po/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gi zhing gi rdul snyed du bzhugs pa la yum bzhis rdo rje'i glus bskul nas rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' sems ma thub pa drug mchod lha sgo skyong sogs sprul te/ byang chub sems kyi nges par dkyil 'khor gyi rim pa bshad pa/ phyag rgya rnam par spros pa sku gsang da 67 da ༄

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/thugs kyi sprul pas 'gro ba ji ltar 'dul ba'i tshul khyad par rdo rje phur pa dbu stong phyag stong khams gsum gyi rdul dang mnyam pa/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba'i skur bzhengs te/ drag po'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bkod pa sogs las brtsams rdzogs rim rdo rje rnal 'byor 'od gsal rtags bcu 'char tshul sogs dus kyi 'khor lo dang / dgongs pa gcig par gsungs so/ / rgyud kyi rgyal po las kyi 'phreng ba zhes bya ba las kyang / rgyud chog las kyi phreng ba 'dir/ /dus kyi 'khor lor rab gsungs pas/ /phyi nang gza' dang rgyu skar dge /nang du khams dgu 'du lugs rtogs/ / gsang ba yum gyi bha ga rgyas/ / zhes kyang 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mchog dam pa'i gsang chen zhes bya ba'i rgyud rnal 'byor ma chen po de kho na nyid stong phrag lnga brgya pa las/ rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i le'u las kyang / rdo rje phur pa'i zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor sprul bshad rdor dbyings dang mtshungs par gsungs shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa theg pa chen po'i mdo las kyang / rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis dregs pa thams cad 'dul ba'i phyir/ dpal phyag na rdo rje mngon par dbang bskur te/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor chen po spros te rdo rje phur pa'i snying po dang /phyag rgya dang las sna tshogs gsungs pa bstan no/ /mdor na phur pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rtse mo'i rgyud dang / rdo rje phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud chen po dang phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyud la sogs pa mang por rdor dbyings dkyil 'khor sprul bshad mdzad tshul phyogs mthun par yod pas/ bcom ldan 'das mngon par sangs rgyas nas yun ring po ma lon pa'i dus su gsungs par nges so/ / yang phur pa phrin las 'khor lo gab pa'i rgyud las/ston pas gdul bya zhi ba'i chos kyis 'dul ba rnams la/ bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lor gsungs nas/ yang lag na rdo rje zhus te/ zhi bas 'dul ba ma yin pa rnams la drag po'i skur bzhengs/ lcang lo can du dam chos bdud rtsi phur pa'i chos rnams sku'i sgo nas bstan zhing / yang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su 'jigs byed chen po rdo rje phur pa zhal gsum phyag drug par sprul te/ dpung rnams par 'dzoms zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dpung rnam par sdud pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zil gyis gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa drag po'i 'phrin las kyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ dbu'i gtsug tor dang thugs kyi dpal be'u dang / phyag zhabs kyi 'khor lo dang / lcags kyi pad+ma la sogs las drag sngags pho nya mo spros shing /ge 68 —

rgu/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/bdud dang log 'dren la sogs pa sgrol ba sngags drud phyag rgya drug 'khor lo drug la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/ / gzhan yang bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang pos 'dus pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad pa dang / bdud sdig can gyi bdud ris kyi dmag dpung chen po bshams pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'joms pa'i sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis pham par mdzad pa dang / cho 'phrul chen po'i mdzad pa'i ston pa drug dang / bdud kyi rigs thams cad bskrad cing pham par mdzad pa sogs kyang 'dul bya'i rim pas gang la gang 'dul drag po'i 'phrin las chen po'i khro bo'i tshogs srin po'i dmag dpung lta bu 'jigs pa gad rgyangs chen po sgrog pa sprul zhing lag na rdo rje me ltar 'bar ba thogs nas bdud dang mu stegs byed rnams 'dul bar mdzad pa yang / drag po ru tra'i tshogs bsgral ba yin zhing /tshul de dag dang rjes su 'brel ba/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsungs pa rnams las dgra bgegs bskrad pa dang / ling ga sgrol ba la sogs pa thams cad khro bo chen po bcu dang / rdo rje phur pa'i rigs sngags las tshogs dang rjes su ma 'brel ba med de/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje phur pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs te/khams gsum thams cad ye shes kyi sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje phur pa zhes bya ba 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rnams las byung ngo zhes dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las e ma ho rdo rje rnam par 'joms/ /phur 'debs sangs rgyas thams cad kye/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen te/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ / phur bus btab pa yang dag bshad/ /ces gsungs/ de bzhin du gsang ba thams cad ston pa rdo rje ye shes kyi rgyud sde ji snyed las 'byung ngo / / de bzhin du he ru ka gal po'i rgyud du/ yang dag thugs kyi sprul pa la/ /rdo rje rigs dang thugs kyi lha/ / thugs yang sku gsung thugs gsang bzhi 'gyur/ /mkha' 'gro bde mchog zhes bya ba/ /sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sku yi rgyud/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo can/ /'khor lo bde mchog gsung gi rgyud/ /thugs kyi sgyu ma bde mchog 'di/ /he ru ka yi gal po nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /de'i phyir rnying ma dang gsar ma'i rgyud sde chen po rnams dgongs pa'i gnad mi 'gal ba ye shes phur pa'i nges don rdzogs rim nges don zab mor shes par bya'o/ / mdor na de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa thams cad sde snod gsum rgyud sde bzhir 'dus shing / de yang theg pa chung ngu'i 'dul ba las theg pa chung ngu'i mngon ba mang de las theg pa chung ngu'i mdo sde mang /ge 69 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/de thams cad las theg pa chen po'i mngon pa mang / de las theg pa chen po'i mdo sde mang / de thams cad las bya ba'i rgyud mang / de las spyod rgyud mang / de las rnal 'byor rgyud mang /de las rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud mang bar gsungs shing / rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud la yang /bi to ta ma la 'bum sde'i rgyud la sogs pa chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de yang rdo rje phur pa de bzhin gshegs pa chen po'i rgyud ces bya ba las/ mi mjed kyi zhing 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas/ rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud rnams ji ltar gsung pa bzhin du/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten dga' ba'i zhing na sangs rgyas dad pa'i dbang po zhes bya bas kyang rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud gsungs so/ / de bzhin du nub phyogs kyi pad+ma can zhes bya ba dang / byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas 'phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub pa zhes bya bas kyang gsungs so/ /gzhan yang 'dzam bu gling bye ba phrag brgyar yang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs par bshad do/ / 'o na sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs shing dus nam yang 'byung ngam zhe na/ khyab brdal ye shes kyi phur pa dang / byang chub sems kyi phur pa dang /tshad med snying rje'i phur pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gsang ba mchog gi rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel ba'i tshul mang po ni/ mdo rgyud thams cad dang dgongs pa mthun zhing yang dang yang du byung ste/'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ / ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ / da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang / / zhes pa ltar ro/ /rdzas kyi phur pa ye shes kyi lhar sgrub cing mthun rdzas drag sngags mang po'i sgo nas/ dgra bgegs log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs kyis sdig sgrib nyon mongs pa/ rgyu mthan gyi tshal du ra ra༅sbyong ba thabs dang shes rab rdo rje mngon spyod rnam par rol pa theg pa ni 'dul bya'i dbang las/zhing khams dag pa rnams dang bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzang po rnams la yang mi 'byung zhing / dam pa'i chos kyi sgra tsam yang mi grags pa'i 'jig rten dus ngan pa'i mthar thug na yang mi 'byung / sems can gang dag dug gsum shas che zhing dbang po rno ba/ sngags spyod pa'i bsod nams dang las 'brel bzang po yod pa la ltos pas/ phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud las 'di skad ces/ rdo rje 'duse pa'i rgyal po gsang ba'i theg pa 'di ni 'byung ba shin tu dkon no/ /dper na u dum wa ra'i me tog 'jig rten du byung ba dang mtshungs so/ / gsang ba'i theg pa 'di ni sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs chen po'i 'bras bu'i theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de'i tshe de'i dus na gsang ba'i theg pa 'di ma bshad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dus de'i 'gro ba rnams ḍi~Xng ba'i theg pa 'di'i snod du gyur pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du sngon 'das

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis kyang gsang ba'i theg pa 'di ma bshad do/ /sngon bskal pa kun tu bkod pa zhes bya ba'i tshe/ sangs rgyas mngon byung gi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i bstan pa la rgya cher grags te nges pa'i don rgya chen spyod do/ / da ltar gyi bstan pa 'di la lha'i gnas su brgya byin la sogs pas spyad do/ / klu'i gnas su 'jog po la 'jam dpal dang /spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan cing dar ro/ /mi'i gnas su rgyal po dzaḥl phyag na rdo rjes lung bstan cing dar ro/ /dus nam zhig na snyigs ma lnga'i dus 'ong ste/ sprul pa'i sku ru lung bstan pa'i tshe dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang snyigs ma lnga'i dus 'dir/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher gsung pa la dgongs shing / de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas lung bstan/ lnga brgya tha ma la nye ba'i dus/ rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher gsungs shing / ri kha ba can gyi ljongs su rim par dar bar dgongs so/ /de yang rdo rje phur pa'i chos thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i skabs/ bcom ldan 'das 'og min gyi gnas drag po 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs yum bzhi sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ rdo rje phur pa'i skur sprul zhing nyid kyi ye shes kyi rol pa las/ karma he ru ka sprul te/ zhu ba zhu lan gyi tshul du 'di skad ces/theg chen gsang ba'i bstan pa 'di/ /rgya cher grags par 'gyur ba ni/ /mya ngan 'da' khar lung bstan te/ /'bras bu byang chub ston pa ni/ /rdul bral dri med bstan pa zhig /mchog gi zhing khams dam pa 'dir/ / snang ba thob pa'i skal ldan la/ / don gyi ngo bo bshad par bya'o/ /nga yi snang ba 'di nub nas/ /chos kyi me long dam pa zhig /nga 'das gling gi 'jig rten 'dir/ / 'byung ba'i dge slong skal can la/ / bstan pa'i char chen bab nas ni/ /kun dang mthun par grags gyur cig / lo ni brgyad dang bcu gnyis na/ zhes dus kyi nges pa dang bcas lung bstan to/ / de nas yang snying rje rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas/sngon 'das pa'i dus ma tram̐ ru tra btul ba bzhin / da ltar gyi dus 'di yang 'byung po gdug pa 'dul ba'i rdzu 'phrul dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bka'i bgro ba mdzad de/ 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ / las kyi gdug pa'i ru tra ste/ / rgyal ba 'das pa'i sbyor ba yin/ / ji ltar khro drag btul ba ltar/ / de ltar tshe na 'byung ba yi/ / dus gsum brtsegs pa'i ri bo 'di/ /'bar khro 'khrug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /ji ltar mtshams pa bzhin du 'os/ / sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus gzugs kyang / / khro bo sprin nag gtibs pa yis/ /— 71 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/mngon spyod rol pa'i thabs chen gyis/ / 'khor ba sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ zhes bya ba sogs bka' bgros nas/ 'byung po gdug pa can ru tra 'dul ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pas se gol gyi sgra mdzad pas/ go'u ta ma khyod kyis bdag thul ba ma lags te/ khyod rang gi gnas su dka' thub bde bar mnos shigs/ zhes nga rgyal bsgrags par byas pas/ khro bo rta'i tshogs kyis 'dul bar bsgos shing / dpal rta mgrin gyis cho 'phrul bstan nas/ ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse la so btsugs so/ / de nas srin po ling byed pa'i bar la srin po'i gling du gshegs nas/ srin po'i grong khyer phyi rol du khrag gi mtsho dang mi gtsang ba'i 'dam la sogs mi sdug pa'i rdzas yod pa rnams bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs nas gsol/srin mo'i tshogs la thabs kyi sbyor ba mdzad de/ mgo brnyan sprul pa'i sras mang po sprul te/de nas yang bcom ldan 'das gī la yas srin po ru tra'i gzugs su sprul te srin mo kro ti shwa ri dang sbyor bar mdzad de/ yi ge smra gyi tshogs las srin mo'i lhums su sras 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i skur byin gyis rlabs nas chos kyi dbyings su gshegs so/ / de nas rta mgrin gyis rdo rje glus sbran nas/ srin po ngus pa na rang gi gnas rnams 'gyur ba mthong nas yid mi dga' bar gyur pa la/ srin mo'i mngal na sras yod par gsol to/ / dga' zhing 'dod pa skyes nas 'dod pa'i sbyor ba la zhugs pas/ gī la ya srin mo la srin po ru tra skyes pa'i tshul du sprul nas/ rngams pa'i skad phyung bas srin po brgyal bar gyur to/ / brgyal ba sangs nas bltas pas gī la la dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad par mthong zhing / srin pos nga rgyal bskyed de/ ru lu ru lu zhes brjod nas mgo bo gsum lag pa drug par sprul pas gī la ya zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi par gyur te tshwa tshwa 'phros pas/ srin po'i mgo lnga yan lag bcu drug par gyur te/gī la ya de bzhin du gyur te/ srin po'i ngag gi nyes pa 'phrog cing nyams par mdzad do/ /yang srin po mgo nyi shu par sprul pa na/ gī la ya dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig phyag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis par sprul te nus pa 'phrog go de nas yang srin po nga rgyal lhag par bskyed de/ rkang pa mi yul du zug pa/ mgo bo srid pa'i rtse mor slebs pa/ kha nas nad kyi rlangs pa gtong ba zhig tu gyur pa na/ gī la ya chen po nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i phyag rgya cir yang ma nges pa'i skur sprul te gzir bas 'jigs shing brgyal te 'gyel ba/ rdo rje dbang gi phyag rgyas sked pa nas bzung ste zhal du mid pas/ ru tra'i las byang zhing skye ba dpag tu med pa dran zhing zhal nas phyung / skyabs su song zhing dam la bzhag phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la bkod nas/rdo rje rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i zhing du/ rdo rje rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po zhes par lung — 72 ge

༄khya/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/bstan no/ / srin po'i bud med dang 'khor dregs pa'i tshogs kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas byang chub sems dpa'i sa la bkod nas dpal chen po rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du byinagyis brlabs shing sprul te phur pa mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i rgyud sde gsungs so/ / de yang bcom ldan 'das gyad kyi yul klung ha ri la be ta'i 'gram shing sa la zung gi tshal du yongs su mya ngan las bzla('da') ba'i dus srin po la sogs pa'i ru tra'i tshogs 'dul ba'i phyir/ rdzu 'phrul gyis srin po'i yul du gshegs te gsungs la/ de bzhin du byang sgra mi snyan du gshegs te/ a li kā li chu klung gi rgyud gsungs/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe dbu'i thod pa las/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud byung ba sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'dul bya'i dbang gis yongs su mya ngan las bzla('da') ba'i tshul ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing / yang dag par na de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sku 'gyur ba med pa nyid do/ / de ltar rgyud kyi sngon byung gleng gzhi ston pa'i rnam thar dang sbyar ba'o/ /da ni rdo rje theg pa spyi dang khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud sde chen po rnams/ 'dzam bu'i gling du dar ba'i mdzad pa rig 'dzin sngags 'chang ba'i tshogs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ phun sum tshogs pa bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bshad pa 'di ltar/ rdo rje phur pa gsang ba'i rtsa ba rnal 'byor chen po yang dag pa'i rgyud las/ rgyud gsung ba mthar phyin nas/ yongs su gtor ba'i skabs badz+ra gī la ya gar gyi cha luṭa bstan rdo rje srin po'i gsungs/ rdo rje rnam par gsor nas 'khor rnams la gdams pa/ nyon cig gsang bdag nga la nyon/ / rdo rje phur pa'i tshogs kun la/ /khyed la sogs pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /shin tu dwangs bas nges par shog / phyi rab dug lnga sman pa yis/ / sems can rnams la snang bar gyis/ / mkhas shing ngang tshul bzang ba dang / /rigs ldan dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /gang sgrub las rnams 'grub par nges/ /de la rab tu gnang bar gyis / /bstan pa'i snying po gang gnas pa/ /dam can yongs kyi gnas 'gyur te/ / der ni legs par mang po 'byung / / khyed kyi de yi grogs mchog gyis/ /zhes dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'dus rtsal la sogs pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin gyi tshogs dang / rin chen gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin gyi tshogs dang / 'khor lo gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin gyi tshogs dang / pad+ma gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin gyi tshogs dang / ral gri gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin gyi tshogs dang / de bzhin du yang hūṃ ka ra la sogs pa'i khro bo bcu'i gdung 'dzin pa'i rig 'dzin gyi tshogs dang /— 73 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan yang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la ni bi to ta ma la 'bum sde la sogs pa 'phrin las phur pa'i rgyud mtha' dag gsungs shing yongs su gtad/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo dang / bram ze mi'i thod pa can la sogs pas bsdus/ de nas mi'i yul du rim gyis dar te/ rdo rje sems dpa' nas/ dga' rab rdo rje/ bzhad pa rdo rje/ rgyal po u ru de shan/ klu mo rgya mtsho ma/rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi/ slob dpon dha na sang kṛ ta/ dha na u pa ya/ blo ldan mchog sred/yang na dha na saskṛ tas slob dpon pad+ma/ bi ma la mi tra/ bal po shī la mdzi gsum la bshad do/ / yang rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyal po dzaḥl glegs bam gyi char babs pa las brgyud de/rgyal po des lha lcam go ma de wi/ rgyal po shā kra pu ri/ de nas rim par brgyud de rgya bal bod gsum du dar ro/ / yang bram ze mi thod kyis/ mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo la gtad/des mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par gter du sbas so/ / de shrī sing has 'thon/ de nas slob dpon pra hi te la bshad/ de nas slob dpon pad+ma la brgyud do/ /yang dag par na rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rdo rje sems dpa' dngos las gsan cing / slob dpon chen po 'di'i thugs dam lha'i gtso bo rdo rje phur pa yin par grags shing / rgya bod 'gro lding o rgyan gyi yul la sogs par rdo rje phur pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rigs sngags drag po'i 'phrin las kyis bstan pa dang / sems can la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can mang po bsgral te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan par btsud/ 'phrin las phur pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ slob dpon nyid nas ding sang gi bar du byin rlabs zhal gzigs kyi rgyun ma chad pa ste/ de yang lo rgyus mtha' dag ni brjod kyis mi lang / rags tsam 'di ltar/sngon rgya gar lho phyogs tri ling ga dang nye ba'i tsan dan gyi nags khrod cig tu dbang phyug gi rten ling ga khru gang tsam zhig rang byung du byung / der mu stegs rnams kyis dmod pa drag po byas pa tsam gyis nang pa'i sde rnams la gnod pa cher 'byung ba zhig dang / shar bhang ga lar mtsho chung zhig la/ mu stegs la dga' ba'i klu gdug pa can zhig gnas te/ der mu stegs rnams kyis gtor ma phul ba tsam gyis rin po che mang po rnyed cing / sangs rgyas pa'i sde rnams la cho 'phrul gyis gnod par byung / ma ga dha'i rgyal po'i khab na shel gyi pha bong zhig la/ mu stegs pa'i bram ze'i rigs kyi 'byang po dag gnas nas/ dka' bas sgrub mi dgos par ༄mig mthong dang / rna nyan dang mo rtsis kyi mngon shes ston pa zhig yod pas/ de dag 'dul ba'i shaṃr ṭ+wāṃb dpon gyis rdo rje gdan du sgrub pa mdzad pas phur pa rnams 'bar ba dang /

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/bzhad pa la sogs pa'i rtags cher 'byung bas khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phur bu slob dpon gyis blangs nas/ skad cig la lho phyogs ri ma lar byon nas liṅgā dang nye bar shing sdong zhig la btab pas/ me 'bar te skor gyi nags thams cad tshig liṅgā thal bar song ngo / /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phur pa dkyil 'khor gyi gzung ma rnal 'byor ma ngang tshul can zhes bya bas blangs te/ bhang ga la'i mtsho de la btab pas klu 'khor bcas thal bar song zhag bdun nas mtsho yang skam mu stegs kyi grwa rnams zhig go / phur pa chung ba zhig sgrub g.yog rnal 'byor pa rat+na shrī la zhes bya bas blangs te rgyal po'i khab kyi shel gyi pha bong de la btab pas sil gyis zhig go /yang sngon rgya gar du nags tshal me shor te/ zhag mang por me ma shi bas/ sems can mang po la gnod pa cher byung bas/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis seng ldeng gi phur pa sor brgyad pa zhig btab pas/ me shi ste nags tshal sngar bas phun sum tshogs pa skyes so/ /yang slob dpon chen po bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu yang dag mar me dgu'i sgrub pa mdzad pas/ yul de'i 'dre srin rnams kyis bar chad byas te/ lo gsum gyi bar char ma babs par rtsi shing nags tshal dang lo thog thams cad skam/ chu bo dang chu phran thams cad rgyun chad pa'i dus byung ba na/ slob dpon gyis sgrub pa'i bar chad du dgongs pa na/ nam mkha' las bar chad 'di dag gzhan gyis 'dul ba'i thabs med kyi/ rgya gar na len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang nas rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud sde spyan drongs shig ces sgra byung ngo / / de nas bal po'i mi gnyis la gser bre gang bskur nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya la phul nas lo rgyus gsol pas/phur pa'i chos skor 'bum sde tsam gyi nang nas po ti mi khur gnyis brdzangs so/ / de bal yul yang le shod du slebs pa tsam gyis bar chad zhi ste dus kyi char babs/ rtsi shing nags tshal dang / lo thog phun sum tshogs par gyur to/ / de tsa na phur pa'i chos 'di bkra shis shing /byin rlabs myur pas phyogs thams cad du rgyas par bya snyams du dgongs nas/ rgyud sde rnams kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos lta ba bi to la/ sgom pa phun sum tshogs pa/'phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu/ gdab las kha tshar dang bzhi ru phye ste mdzad dus der slob dpon pad+ma dang / bi ma la mi tra dang / bal po shrī la mdzi gsum gyis/ bal yul yang lo shod du sgrub pa mdzad pa'i rtags thon/ de skabs drod tshad nyul ba'i phyir/ lha bdud sprul nas lcags kyi sdig pa 'jigs su rung ba zhig thog babs su tho chos su 'byung ba la slob dpon nyid/phag tu brdzus nas zos par chas pas sdig pa de rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur/ drag shul gyi las thogs pa med pa'i dbang thob ste/ bsnyen phur bsgril zhing nga che nga btsan gyi mgur bzhengs — 75 ge

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/pa ni/ didha tsakra phur pa'i lha/ / mthing nag gcer bu ral pa can/ /sku stod khro bo chen po la/ /zhal gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste/ /lte ba man chad phur pa'i dbal/ /drag por gyur pa phur pa ste/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra ba/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /btab na lha yang brlag 'gyur na/ /gnod pa rnams la smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bstan bcos rnams paṇ+ḍi ta rnams la gzigs phul bar chas te/ rgya bal gnyis kyi sa mtshams chu mig byang chub ris su gzigs pa na mnal lam du grod pa snyams byung ba na phyag gis nyul pas thugs ka nas sems can gyi dngos po zhig zin te spar bur bcug rdo rjes rgyas btab nas bzhag nangs par gzigs pas bu mo mtshar sdug dang ldan pa bzhi 'dug ste/ khyod su yin dris pas de rnams na re/ sngon bcom ldan 'das dpal chen pos dregs pa pho bsgral mo sbyor ba'i dus dam la btags te/ 'gro ba'i srog la dbang bskur ba'i ma mo bzhi lags te/de'i thugs dam gyis 'dir 'ong pa lags/ slob dpon gyis kyang bdag cag dbang bskur cig zer bas/ rdo rje phur pa sgom sgrub byed pa la bar chad byed pa rnams kyi srog la dbang gyis shig gsungs nas dam la btags so/ / de nas na lan+t+ra'i gtsug lag khang du phebs te/spo ti rnams paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya la gzigs phul bas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags shing / phyag dang bkur sti cher byas so/ / de nas mkhas pa rnam gsum bka' bgros te/ bi to tarnam la 'bum ste las phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud la sogs pa rgyud sde sum cu rtsa gnyis la 'grel bshad sgrub thabs sogs rgyas par mdzad do/ / de'i dus su srod la shwa na ma bzhis/ srog snying phul/nam gung bdag nyid ma bzhis srog snying phul lo/ / de nas ji ltar dar ba ni/ bi ma las gzung ma dam pa la bshad/ gnyis kas rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi la bshad/ de nas rgya gar gyi yul du dar zhes grags/ yang slob dpon pad+mas bal po shākya de wa la bshad/ de gnyis kas o rgyan rgyal po dharma ko sha la bshad/ de nas o rgyan gyi yul du dar/ bal po shrī la mdzis smad 'tshong ma shin+ta la bshad/ des bal po'i rgyal po gu nas ta la bshad nas bal yul du dar ro/ /'di gnyis kyis kyang phur pa'i grub pa brnyes te/ bi ma las gaṅgā'i 'gram du sgrub pa mdzad pas/ klu zhig khros te chu bo gaṅgā lud pa na slob dpon gyis phur pa sor brgyad pa zhig btab pas klu de la thebs te gaṅgā yar mar du chad pa'i nus pa b.ristan to/ / bal po shrī la mdzis kyang mu stegs dang rtsod pa mdzad pa na/ brjod rgyu thams cad tha snyad mtha' la gnas/ /don dam ma mthong grol bar ga la 'gyur/ /mu stegs 'chal ba'i gtam gyis ci zhig bya/ / chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen po 'dzugs par bya/ / zhes phur pa bsgril bas maṇ+ḍal zhes bya — 76 bhe

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/ba'i grong khyer gyi rgyab mkhar gong gi brag yod pa nyil te/ mu stegs la la khrag skyugs te shi/la la lce gas/ la la mig 'bras brul zhing tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar byas so/ / de bzhin du slob dpon mang po zhig gis rdo rje phur pa'i sgo nas grub pa brnyes nas mu stegs byed rnams pham pa dang bstan pa rgyas shing dar bar mdzad do/ de nas bod yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzugs par dgongs nas/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa na/ bod kyi lha srin gdug pa can rnams khros nas rtsig tu ma ster bas rgyal po thugs ngal zhing skyo bar gyur pa na/ mkhan po bodhi sa twas o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rdo rje phur pa'i dngos grub thob pa zhig yod/ de spyan drangs na bar chad zhi bar 'gyur ba'i tshul sngon gyi gtam rgyud dang bcas te gsungs/ de nas rgyal bos sna snam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ mchims shākya pra bha/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge gsum brdzangs te spyan drangs pas bal yul nas bzung / yul so so'i 'dre srin rnams 'dul zhing phebs/ ri gong zhig tu bal po'i lha 'dre rnams kyi kha gnon du rdo'i mchod rten bzhengs/ phur pa gsum rdo la nub par btab nas bzhag de nas rim gyis lam du zhugs pa las/ gung thang dang mang yul kha la'i rong sgo ru dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis thog mang po dus gcig tu 'bebs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa dang / slob dpon gyis thog me tog gi char du bsgyur ba dang / sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la blangs te/ klad la bskor ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pas skrag nas srog snying phul zhing dam la btags/ phur pa'i srung mar bskos so/ / de ltar lha 'dre mang po dam la 'dogs bzhin du byon te/ gnam mtsho dang thang lha'i bar du sbra dkar phub nas bzhugs pas thang lhas thog char pa ltar phab/ slob dpon gyis sbra dkar rdo rje'i mkhar du bsgom pas thog 'phangs te mtsho nang du song bas srog chags mang po shi bas/ ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga mdzad de byang chub la bkod/ thang lha'i gangs la sdigs mdzub gtad pas/ gangs zhu nas g.ya' brag tu song ba dang / kho skrag nas srog snying phul zhing dam la btags/ der kho la bka' bsgos pas lha 'dre phal cher bkug byung bas srog snying 'phrogs shing dam la btags so/ de nas gnam gyi shugs pa sdong du dregs pa gnad 'bebs kyi sgrub pa mdzad pas srod la ri nyil ba lta bu'i sgra dang bcas/ thang lha 'khor dang bcas pa byung bas khyod de tsam gyi cho 'phrul yod na pho bdud nyi khri chig stong / de dag gi khrod na mthu rtsal che ba dag khrid shog ces bka' bstsal pas/ bdud la dbang che ba bzhi dmag — 77 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/dpon rnam rol dang lnga/ shar nas dbang che ba bzhi dmag dpon khyab 'jug dang lnga/gnyan la dbang che ba bzhi klu rje thod dkar dang lnga/ btsan la dbang che ba bzhi yam shud dmar po dang lnga/ de dag gi las mkhan ḍā ki nag po rnams khrid byung bas dam la btags/phur pa sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dpal 'byor dang tshe spel bar khas blangs so/ / de nas rim gyis bsam yas su phebs te rgyal po la sogs pa yid ches pa'i phyir/ gzi mal ba lha lung mtsho zhes par gnyan la sogs pa la pra rten byas te/ 'od zer can ma dang rgyal chen bzhi'i pra phab ste bod la gnod pa'i lha 'dre gnyan dgu'i ming du smra bcug cing / lha 'dre ma rungs par rags rim zhig dngos su mi la phab nas dam la btags/ 'ga' zhig sbyin sreg mdzad cing / rgyal po pe har 'dul ba'i sgrub pa mdzad pas pe har gyis dkyil 'khor la lta ru 'ongs pa na mig la phur bu btab/ sngags nyan pas rna ba la phur bu btab/ sngags zlos pa'i lad mo byas pas lce la phur bu btab/ de bros par 'dod pa la yan lag bzhi la phur pa btab cing dam la btags so/ de ltar 'dre srin gdug pa can phal che ba rdo rje phur pa'i phrin las kyis 'dul bar mdzad nas/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub par gyur/ rab tu gnas par mdzad do/ de nas rgyal po dang / jo mo mkhar chen bza' dang / sbyan 'dren pa mi gsum la sogs pa las can mang po la rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur rgyud dang man ngag bstan cing bsgrubs/ phur pa rgyal po lugs dang / snam lugs dang / shud bu lugs dang / mchims lugs dang jo mo lugs bzhi ru byung / de rjes rong ban la gnang bas rong zom lugs dang/ 'khon klu'i dbang po la gnang bas 'khon lugs sa phur du grags so/ / yang cog ro bzas slob dpon dngos la thug kyang / dbang yi dam la zhu bar 'dod pas/ yi dam slob dpon gyi thugs kar bsdus pas dbang skal chad/ phyis jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis man ngag zab dgu gnang bas phur pa lcam lugs zhes bya ba byung / rje btsun mi la'i drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag yang 'di'i chos skor yin par grags/ gzhan yang lang 'gro(gro) lo tsā ba la gnang zhing gter du yang sbas/ phyi rabs gter ston rat+na gling par byon pa sogs gter ston rig 'dzin mang po'i sprul gzhi skal ba dang ldan pa'i skyes bu mang po la yang gdams so/ / de'i tshe sdig blon rnams kyis slob dpon gyi mthu stobs dang mngon mkhyen ma bzod cing / bag tsha bas yang yang gshegs par bskul bas de dag snang ngo la gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas bod kyi ri brag dben gnas mang por phebs/ spa gro stag tshang dpal phug tu rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub pa mdzad cing rdo rje khro bo stag la chibs te/ rdo rje phur pas — 78 —

rgu/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/bgegs kyi tshogs gzir zhing 'joms pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis bdud dang dam sri thams cad bsgral/phyi rabs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'byung ba'i sgrub gnas mang po byin gyis brlab po/ / de bzhin du seng ge rdzong gsang phug chen mor slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ jo mo mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ lang 'gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas la sogs thugs sras nye ba'i 'khor bco brgyad dang bcas/ rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas zhag nyi shu sgrub pa mdzad pas/ rig 'dzin bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad sprin bzhin 'dus/ phur srung bcu gnyis dang dge bsnyen nyer gcig rnams kyis bka' bzhin du nyan/lha srin sde brgyad rnams kyis srog snying dngos su phul/ phur pa sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi sku tshe bsring zhing 'phrin las sgrub par dam bcas/ 'grub rtags su tshe chu'i rgyun babs/ bsnyen phur brag la btab po/ /gzhan yang rgya bod kyi mtshams gangs brag mtshon cha gzengs pa lta bu dang / sman ri nags ljongs chen po phal cher du rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub pa mdzad cing / phur srung bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs dam la bzhag ste bod la mu stegs kyi chos log bsrung zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong bar bskul nas/ lho nub srin po'i kha gnon la gshegs par dgongs te mon bod shing gi ri nas nam mkha'i lam 'gro lding gi yul du phebs/ der yang rdo rje phur pa'i rigs sngags kyi sgo nas mi ma yin mang po 'dul bar mdzad de/ yul de'i bud med phal cher ni phra men ma yin la/ skyes pa yang 'byung po mi'i gzugs can mang po yod pas 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams la gnod pa che bar byed pas/ de dag 'dul ba'i phyir gling de'i brag dag tu bzhugs nas khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag bcu gnyis tsam dbang med du bkug cing bros par brtsams na/ yan lag thams cad la phur bus btab cing srog snying 'phrog gtso mo rnams dkyil 'khor du bcuga'akhor rnams la sems bskyed phog sems can la gnod 'tshe mi byed par mna' dgag te/dam bzhag snga phyi lan gsum gyi bar mdzad do/ /de yang dam bzhag dang po'i gnas la ma sar+sha zer/ brag la phyag gis bcos pa'i me thab yod/ dam bzhag gnyis pa mdzad pa'i gnas la a lpa ṣ+pe zer/ mkha' 'gro rnams phur pas btab pa'i rjes stong phrag tsam yod do/ /de nas grub pa'i phur pa de rnams skye bo phal pa'i spyod yul du mi sdod pas gzhan thams cad yal bar gyur/ phur pa gcig ma 'ongs pa'i sems can yid ches pa'i don du/ ye shes pa slob dpon gyi sku la bstim nas rdzas kyi phur pa bzhag pa yin zer ba bcos ma mi 'dra ba rang byon lta da 79 da

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/bu mi bongs sum 'gyur tsam zhig yod cing / de yang dang po shing la bzos pa'i phur pa chung du re yod la/ de 'grub dus rab tu 'phel zhing / che chung blos gang byas su 'gyur zhing /'gro 'ongs dang gsung gi sgra gdangs sogs lha dngos dang 'dra ba 'bar pa'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs par gyur la/ de skabs phra men ma'i gtso mo zhig gis lus ri tsam du bsgyur nas/bros par brtsams pa las phur pa de yang ri bo tsam du gyur nas btab/ slar yang ye shes pa slob dpon la bstim nas/ lhag ma ma lus pa'i tshul de gyur to/ /ces grub thob bud+dhā na thas gsungs so/ / de nas yul de'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yang rigs sngags kyi mthus btul te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad cing / ring zhig bzhugs nas nam mkha'i lam la gya gyur gshegs nas rnga yab srin po'i gling du phebs so/ / slob dpon chen po de la slob ma mang po yod kyang phur pa'i bka' babs pa jo mo mtsho rgyal yin zhing / slob dpon srin yul du gshegs khar bdag bud med blo dman pas nyung la bslab sla ba'i chos shig zhu/ nyon mongs pa rags pas nyon mongs 'joms pa'i chos shig zhu/ tshe thung bas 'grub thag nye ba'i chos shig zhu/ dgra mang bas mthu che ba'i chos shig zhu/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor gnang ngo / / de nas mon kha ni ring seng ge rdzong du phur pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pas lha tshogs thams cad zhal gzigs/ rdzas kyi phur pa rnams bzhad cing 'od zer 'phro ba dang / jo mo'i dgongs pa la phur pa 'grub na gdab las bya zhes pa la su la brdeg snyams phur pa bsgril bas/ pha mes kyi srog gcod pa'i za 'dre la btab pa snyam du dgongs pa dang /phur pa nam mkha' la song nas/ pha yul gyi khang pa'i stod na 'dre de gnas pa'i skyer phung zhig yod pa la babs/ rtsa ba nas bsreg cing 'dre de bsgral/ phur pa de yang dbon rgyud rnams kyis bcang / gdengs pa tsam gyis gdon bgegs 'joms pa byung ngo / / yang lan gcig jo mo yul khar ba sna ru bzhugs pa'i dus/ byang phyogs nas sdong ston gyi tshong pa mang po yong ba la rgyal po'i cho 'phrul gyis spyang ki bcu gnyis kyis rta bong rnams bsad/ mthar mi za ru byung bas lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul yin par shes nas jo mor skyabs zhus pas/ spyang ki rnams kyi rjes kyi sa khyer shog gsungs/ rjes kyi sa dang bag phye la gzugs bcu gnyis byas te phur pa btab pas/ khar sna'i gnya' nas mar spyang ki bcu gnyis 'gril byung ste rgyal po shel ging la theb pa'o/ / jo mo'i dngos slob ni me nu rgyal ba'i snying po ste/ 'dis ga sha'i rong du sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus bdud nag po bkrag med kyis bya rog tu sprul nas phyag phreng khyer bas/ bya rog gi grib ma la phur pa btab ste bya rog sa la lhung nas shi'o/ /'di'i slob ma lo dpal gyi blo — 80 —

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/gros mon na bzhugs dus mon po'i dmag gis dgon pa bshig nor rnams 'phrog pas/ spa gro stag tshang du byon nas seng ge phug tu sgrub pa mdzad pas rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal gzigs/mon po'i khyim la dmigs nas phur pa btab pas/ dngos su sbag khyim la phur pa cur cur byung ste mon pa rnams kyi snying la zug nas shi'o/ / de'i slob ma ngam 'dre klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis nyang stod srin mo'i rir phur pa sgrub pas phur pa dgra bgegs gnyis la thebs cing phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin thob/ dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa lnga la sku 'das te/ gdung nus gzhan med par rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku phyag gang ba zhig dang gī la ya 'bur dod du byung / de'i sras ngam 'dre('bre) sa le shes rab dbang phyug nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa'i dngos grub thob cing / srin mo rir sgrub pa la bzhugs dus/ nub gcig 'od chen po zhig byung ba la phur pa btab pas/ rgyal po la thebs te/ tho rengs mi dkar po gcig byung ste/ slob dpon gyi bka' 'khor la gnod pa mi byed nga'i phur pa 'thon zer/ der kho la mna' bsgags nas phur pa bton te/ 'di'i slob ma lang lab byang chub rdo rje yin/ sku gzhon nu nas pha ma grongs/ pha spun gyis zhing chung gcig las ma byin pas/ ngam 'dre sa le dbang phyug gis ma bzod cing snod du rung bar mkhyen nas phur pa'i gdams pa gnang nas/ kho rang rdo rje rtse 'dus su sgrub pa mdzad pas/ phur pa rnams 'bar ba dang me 'od 'phro ba sogs byung /lcags phur gcig dgra la btab/ dgra thams cad tshar bcad/ yang rkun ma byung bas rkang rjes la phur pa btab pas/ 'gre grags se bya ba zhag gsum nas shi/ shul mi rnams kyis nor tshur bskyal lo/ / yang skabs shig ra lo chen po 'khor de lha khang du chos 'khor la byon pa na lang lab kyis phyag ma mdzad pas/ mi blun po zhig yin nam zhes dri ba mdzad pas/ kho mthu che zhing phur pa la mkhas pa zhig yin byas pas/ 'o na kho nga rgyal gyis sbos nas nga la phyag mi byed pa yin 'ong ste/ kho la do nub kyi tshe las med/ sdod cig gsungs/ chos thun grol 'phral drag po'i sbyin sreg mdzad pas/ dgug gzhug dang po la rtsang phur gyi char babs te tho phyi'i grwa pa rnams rmas/ bar pa la khro bcu'i lcags phur gyi char babs 'khor rnams bros dgos pa byung / mtha' ma'i tshe nam mkha' la me dpung dang bcas 'ur sgrasasgrugang / ra lo nyid kyi gzigs snang la phur pa ri do chad tsam zhig dbu la babs la khad byung bas de nyid du bzod par gsol/ lang lab la 'dud phyag mdzad par dam bcas pas/ cho 'phrul rnams yal lo/ / de nas lang lab spyan drangs te phyag dang zhe sa bsnyen bkur 'bul ba bzang po ma mdzad pas gshin rje mkhan po phur par rdugs zhes grags so/ / slob dpon 'di yan chig — 81 ge

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/brgyud lta bu yin/ 'di'i slob ma la kho ro rgyal thang gi sna nam shes tshul/ mong dgu'i kyi ban byang chub rin chen/ nag gyang 'gyel rong gi skrang phur mgo 'og phug rol pa'i nyang nag dbang gi shes rab bzhi las/ sna nam shes tshul la man ngag 'phrin las bzhi don byas bya ba dang / rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa'i dum bu tsam gnang / skrang phur mgo la dpa' bo gcig par sgrub pa'i man ngag tsam gnang zhing nyang nag gi slob dpon 'ol phug tu spyan drangs nas zhabs tog nor rdzas kyi phyed phul nas chos zhus pas/ nyang nag yab sras gsum la phur chos rdzogs par gnang zhing / spo ti se glegs can bya ba yang gnangs so/ /de nas sgrub pa mdzad pas phur pa nam mkhar lding ba sogs rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po brnyes so/ /ring zhig na nyang nag gi sras shākya rgyal mtshan tshong la byon pas/ 'dar nag po rta pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bcom/slob dpon gyis ber sngon po phud nas brdabs pas/ de nub mi nyal tsam nang du chom dir byung / jag dpon de'i bu'i mgo la slob dpon gyi rtas phra brgyab ste shi/ yang de'i lo dus la rta pa bcu dgu pa shi/ de nas nyang nag ber sngon can zhes mthu che bar grags/ de'i dus su slob dpon drag po ni chung du nas pha ma shi nas/ zhang po rnams kyis nor 'phrog nas sprang du btang bas/ slob dpon shākya rgyal mtshan dang mjal/ lo bco brgyad nas sum cu'i bar gnag rdzi byas/ snod du rung bar gzigs nas dbang man ngag thams cad gnang / bla ma gshegs khar bla dpe yang g.yar po'i tshul gyis gnang / de nas lhan gyi stag lung gro bor sgrub pa mdzad pas rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po byung / zhang po rnams 'jigs ban de bcu gsum po mthu len byed du bcug pas/ slob dpon gyi drag las byas ban de bcu gsum po glo tshad thebs nas shi'o/ /yang dus de tsam na sna nam shes rab tshul khrims kyi sras/ rnam snang 'gro phan la sku dgra gcig byung bas/ dgra des jo bo stag ram pa brer ba'i sngags ban zhig la mthu bzlog zhus pas/ lan gcig rnam snang 'gro phan dang / snubs stag ram pa mjal bas rnam snang gis phyag mdzad de dge bshes mi 'di pas bdag la mi 'tshams pa'i las mang po byas pa/ thugs la dgongs la 'di pa bsrung ba mi mdzad pa zhu byas pas/ lang lab byang chub rdo rje'i phur thung des sbos pa/ nga mthu zlog byed kyi ci nus re rem zer bas rnam snang khros te gos nag brdab ngas ma nyes ma yo'o byas/ de dus btab ste zla ba gsum nas stag rem pa khrag skyugs te shi'o/ / gshin rje mkhan po phur pa rdugs bya ba dus der yang grags so/ / de nas rnam snang gis gtang rag chen po btang glu 'di blangs so/ / rdo rje gzhon nu'i gzhu mo la/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs rgyud kyis brgyus/ /khro bo bcu yi mda' smyug la/ /khro mo bcu yi sgro yis — 82 —

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/sgron/ /phur pa sras mchog gi mde'u btsug /dam can gsum gyi bsdus pas dkris/ /se lcags shel gsum gyi ngar gcig blud/ /'phangs pa zangs nag gi phyogs su 'phangs// /phog pa jo bo stag ram la phog /mda' tshabs mi chung che bar gda'/ /zhes glu blangs so/ /slob dpon drag po slob ma yang thugs sras gnyis te/ byang rgyan khar gyi so ston khri rgyal dang /nyang stod kyi lce ston shākya rgyal mtshan no/ / de nas gu ru rin po che'i bar du byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma nyams pa'o/ /yang kyi ban byang chub rin chen gyi lo rgyus ni/ kho la pha sprun yul pa rnams kyis dgra byas te nor gzhis thams cad 'phrog pas/ lang lab las phur pa zhus nas sgrub pas lung drod tshad du phyin nas/ de nas skabs gcig yul du byon pas gyang gi drung na mi mang po nyi ma la 'dug pas thams cad dgrar ma gyur pa mi 'dug pas/ gong khug nas phur pa phyung ste btab pas/ glo bur du gyang 'gyel nas dgra thams cad dus gcig la shi bas/ kyi nag gyang 'gyel zhes mthu che bar grags so/ / de nas rngog tsha bsod nams byang chub kun mkhyen 'dzam gling paṇa chen/ snub thub pa rgyal mtshan snub ston bsod nams blo chen/ myang mchog rig pa 'dzin pa/ myang mchog lhun gyis grub pa/ myang rta mgrin rdo rje/ de'i sras myang bdud 'joms rdo rje dang bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ste byin rlabs zhal gzigs kyi brgyud pa dang ldan la/ phur srung dam can bran du 'khol ba'i mthu stobs ji ltar mnga' ba la sogs pa'i lo rgyus zhal rgyun las thos pa 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /yang phur pa rong zom lugs su grags pa'i ring brgyud ni slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug ā tsar+ya dpal me togasgro rdo rje gzhon nu/ zhang phung yon tan grags/ rong pa yon tan grags/ rong pa yon tan rin chen/ nye rgyud rong ban gyis slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dngos las zhus/ des mi yul du lo sum brgya bzhugs te/ mthar sku ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs/ de'i sras rong ban rin chen tshul khrims kyi mi lo phyed dang nyis brgya bzhugs/ de'i sras rong zom yin la 'dis lo brgya bcu dgu bzhugs/ brag la phur pa 'debs pa sogs grub rtags mang po bstan/ jo bo rje dang mjal/ khyod rgya gar gyi ā tsar+ya nag po chen po de'i skye ba yin zhes bsngags brjod chen po mdzad do/ / de nas yol dge bsnyen dbang phyug yol lcags grub/rgya ston stong 'bar/ rnal 'byor gzhung / pho rog mdo sde mgon po/ yol lcags sangs rgyas nyi 'bum/ don grub gzhon nu/ dpyal 'phags pa dpal/ dpyal kun dga' dpal nyi ma/ dpyal kun mkhyen chos rgyal sogs nas deng sang gi bar dbang lung rgyun ma bye 83 ge

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/chad par bzhugs so/ /yang phur pa lha nag tu grags pa ni slob dpon pad+ma yab yum yan spyi dang 'dra/ de nas ā tsar+ya nu ru/ 'di ni phur pa'i grub pa thob pa ste tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes nas deng sang yang bzhugs so/ / lang lab kyis kyang de dang mjal nas par thob pa'i phur pa'i chos la zhu dag byas tshar/ gcig zhus ces byung / phyis 'gro mgon 'phags pas smad las drag po'i sgrol dbang gsan par bzhed nas/ 'di lta bu'i dbang thob pa 'dug na sprang po zhig la 'dug kyang khrid shog gsungs nas btsal kyang ma rnyed / phyis bal po nas tshong pa'i skad cha la jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi slob ma ā tsar+ya nu ru bya ba tshe'i rig 'dzin thob pa zhig bal po na phur pa'i chos gsung gin 'dug zer/ 'o na bal por yod do gsungs pas med/ bsil ba tshal la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su mkha' gro ma rnams kyi don mdzad pa yin zer/ skabs skabs su byon nas gdul bya skal ba can rnams la chos bag re gsung ba gda' zer/ 'o na de bal por byon na nga la skad thong pa gyis gsung nas gnang sbyin mang po gnang / de nas lo 'ga' na lan byung bas/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen la gser mang po bskur nas zhu bar btang / de nas 'phags pa rin po ches gsan cing dar/ yar 'brog pa gu rub kyi yang dag gi rgyud mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba la brten nas lha thams cad nag po mdzad lha nag ces kyang grags/rtse pa rgang pa dang / snyon med pa la babs te phrin las che bar byung /sa phur du grags pa ni/ 'khon klu'i dbang pos slob dpon pad+ma la zhus nas sgrub pas grub pa thob cing / gcung rdo rje rin chen la gnang / des kyang phur pa la brten nas grub pa thob/ de nas sras rim bzhin gnang zhing deng sang gi bar du thugs dam gyi lha'i gtso bo mdzad cing grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma mang po 'thon/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas shang sreg shing du phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu'i rgya dpe gzig shing bsgyur nas rtsis su mdzad pas tshul de la brten nas bu ston sogs sngags rnying ma la dgongs bzhed chung ba'i mkhas pa dag gis kyang thugs yid ches kyirnaganas su gyur pa'o/ /gzhan yang phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud mtha' dag nas bsdus/ phun sum tshogs pa dang gsham sngon can gyi skor du grags pa paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra nas brgyud de dar ba'i tshul ni/chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan zhing brjes nas btsun mo dmar rgyan bza' me tog sgron gyis lo tsā ba kun la sdang bar byas pas/ lo tsā ba chen po rnams sa mthar bzhugs dgos byung skabs/gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra yar 'brog tu bzhugs pa la/ rang gi pha spun po snyags dge la ston — 84 —

rgu/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/gyis slob dpon bkrong / dgon pa bshig pa'i gos bshams nas yul der ma chags par kong po mchims yul gyi rting du byon pas lung stong gi phu na ra bdun 'dug pa bdag po med bsam ded pas/ mchims bya rog gis rkun khag btsugs shing bzhugs su ma ster/ de nas dbus su byon pas 'gro sras chung shwa ba gcig ded nas byung ba dang phrad nas kho'i rta 'drogs shwa ba yang shor bar kho khros nas gsod du chas pas bros thar tsam byung / de nas bi ma la'i sbyan sngar byon pa la/ lo tsā ba skyid dam gsung pa la/ yar 'brog sgang du skyid bgyi ru/ /dge la ston gyis ma ster ro/ / mchim yul rting du skyid bgyi ru/ / bya rog dmyal bas ma ster ro/ /bod yul dbus su skyid bgyi ru/ /'gro sras chung gis ma ster ro/ /zhes brnyas glu phul bas/ bi ma las brtse bar dgongs te phur pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / sham sngon can ma bu gnang ste/ lho brag mkhar chu'i brag phug tu seng ldeng phur pa nyer gcig la brten nas sgrub pas rtags dang mtshan ma thon te/ mchim bya rog skyob pa'i lha dang sgo khyi yan chad bsgral/yang slob dpon nyid dang sog po dpal gyi ye shes dang / 'o bran dpal gyi gzhon nu gsum gyis phur pa'i sgrub pa mdzad nas/ gnyags dge la ston dang / 'gro sras chung 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bsgral lo/ /de rjes dpal gyi slob ma brgyad las khams dang / lho brag dang mnga' ris rnams su dar zhing snyags kyi dbon brgyud rnams la dar zhing 'phrin las che'o/ /mdor na gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir rdo rje phur pa'i dbang lung man ngag gi tshogs byin rlabs kyi rgyun dang ldan pa mang du dar zhing / sngon gyi lo paṇa rig 'dzin chen po rnams kyis rgyud sde chen po 'di dag bsgyur bar mdzad do/ / de yang 'di ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes thams cad 'dus pa sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i rgyud ces bya ba rdo rje phur pa'i bskyed rdzogs rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam par bzhag pa ston pa le'u bco lnga brtags pa dang po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po dge slong be+e ro tsā nas bsgyur/ de bzhin du 'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rtse mo'i rgyud le'u drug cu rtsa gnyis pa rgyud kyi rgyal po 'jig rten snang byed ces bya ba le'u nyer bdun yod pa'ang bsgyur/yang rgyud kyi rgyal po phur pa 'bum sde'i nang nas byung ba brtag pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis bstan pa phur pa zhe sdang yongs su dag pa'i rgyud/ rgya gar ka ma la ru pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta nag po'i zhabs dang /lo tsā ba shrī bha la ku tra dha na de bas bsgyur/ phur pa rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyud le'u bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi yod pa/ lci ku mā ra dza dang / bram ti dza ya rak+ṣi tas bsgyur/ de bzhin du phur pa gsang da 85 da

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i rgyud 'byung po kun 'dul zhes bya ba'i le 'u bcu drug pa dang / lce dzñā na ku ma ra dang /bram ti dza ya rak+ṣi tas bsgyur nas/ mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal la gdams so/ / yang phur pa phrin las 'khor lo gab pa'i rgyud ces bya ba'i le'u bcu gnyis yod pa dang / yang de'i nang nas le'u drug pa gsang ba 'khor lo'i le'u yan slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas su rang bsgyur mdzad/ yang phur pa rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud ces bya ba slob dpon shrī dzñā nas bsgyur/ mnga' bdag khri song lde'u btsan gyi thugs dam du mdzad/ phur pa gsang ba sbas pa mdung rtse'i rgyud le'u dgu yod pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñān gasgo dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba be+e ro tsā nas bsgyur/ yang rgyud kyi rgyal po las kyi 'phreng ba zhes bya ba 'phrin las spyi'i rgyud le'u dgu pa slob dpon dharma shri pra bha ba dang / bi ma las bsgyur/ yang dpal rdo rje gzhon nu thugs rje khros pa rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya ba le'u bcu gcig yod/ rgya gar kha che'i yul dur khrod bi sa ga'i rang byung mchod rten gyi rtsar dngos grub brnyas pa'i rje btsun ma rdo rje sems ma dang / lo tsā ba 'bre yon tan rgyal bas bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab/ rgyud 'di la bshad pa'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum yod/ 'di yang 'gyur mdzad rtsa rgyud nyid dang gcig go / yang phur pa 'phrin las kyi rgyud ces bya ba'i le'u bcu bzhi pa/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / rong zom lo tsā ba gzhon nu blo gros kyis bsgyur/yang rdo rje phur pa'i rtsa ba rnal 'byor chen po yang dag pa'i rgyud nyi shu yod pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad+ma sam+bha ba dang / lo tsā ba pra dhi dza ya rak+shi tas bsgyur/ yang rgyud kyi rgyal po rdo rje 'phreng ba le'u bcu drug pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gasgo dang / lo tsā ba be+e ro tsa nas brgyur/ phyis skad gsar bcad kyi dus kyang bcos so/ / yang phur pa gsang ba'i dgongs rgyud chen po le'u brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma thod phreng dang bod kyi lo tsā ba mang yul gyi lce ku ku dra dza dang / bram ti dza ya rak+ṣi tas bsgyur/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mchog dam pa'i gsang chen zhes bya ba'i rgyud rnal 'byor gyi ma chen po de kho na nyid stong phrag lnga brgya pa las rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i le'u bcu bdun pa bam po bzhi pa dzñā na gar+bha dang bai ro tsa nas bsgyur/ yang phur pa bcu gnyis kyi rgyud ces bya ba bi ma la dang / dzñā na ku ma ras bsgyur/ yang phur pa mdung rtse dmar po'i rgyud le'u nyer gnyis /o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / lo tsā ba gnyags dzñā na ku ma ras bsgyur/gzhan rdo rje khros pa rtsa ba'i rgyud phur pa 'bum sde'i rtsa rgyud chos thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud chen po phur pa bcu gnyis kyi mdo le'u nyer bzhi pa/ phur pa gtor ma'i rgyud phur pa — 86 —

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/gsang ba gdams ngag can rdo rje phur pa gsang ba'i don dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa/phur pa za byed 'bar ba shwa na dkar nag gi rgyud se sgrom dmar po'i rgyud la sogs pa rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud sde mang po zhig rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rang bsgyur mdzad cing las can gyi rje 'bangs rnams la gtad/ de bzhin gshegs pa chen po rdo rje phur pa'i bshad rgyud dri med 'od ldan zhes bya ba'i le'u bzhi bcu zhe gnyis pas 'phrin las phur pa'i don rgyas par gtan la phab/ yang phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma dang / lo tsā ba ā tsar+ya dzñā nas gtan la phab/ ā tsar+ya rin chen mchog gi skad gsar bcad kyis bstan to/ /mdor na sngon gyi lo paṇa rig 'dzin rje 'bangs phal cher gyis thugs dam lha'i gtso bo yang phur pa la mdzad pa mang zhing / o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis 'di skad ces/ phur pa mkhan po bkra shis/ phur pa mkhan po dpal che/ phur pa mkhan po tshe ring / phur pa mkhan po nor phyug phur pa mkhan po 'khor rgyas/ phur pa mkhan po srid 'phel/ phur pa mkhan po mthu che/ phur pa mkhan po mtha' btsan te/ phur pa mkhan po yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'o/ / zhes ched du brjod pa mdzad cing / jo mo mtsho rgyal la sogs pa skal ldan las 'phro smon lam gyi mthu dang ldan pa mang po la gdams shing yongs su gtad/ gter du sbas nas gter ston rig 'dzin mang po yang rim par byon zhing bod gangs can gyi sngags 'chang phal cher gyis yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas dar rgyas su gyur/ khyad par drin can co ba'i bla ma lung rig kun dga' rgya mtsho yang mes dbon brgyud dang bcas pa dang / zhang po lce ston gu ru rin po che yab mes dbon brgyud pa dang bcas pa thams cad dang / rang nyid kyi yang pha mes gnyen 'khor thams cad kyi rigs kyi lha dang dngos grub kyi rtsa bar gyur pa ste/ de yang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i yab myes myang ting 'dzin bzang po nas bzung / myang mchog lhun gyis grub pa la sogs pa rdo rje phur ba'i rig 'dzin chen po 'ga' zhig yin zhing / yab myang rta mgrin rdo rje'i skabs phur bsrung rdo rje sna yon ser po bran du khol bas/ gnod par sems pa thams cad la mi shis pa'i rtags 'phral du 'byung zhing yul gyi phyug po zhig dgrar bzung ba na/ khyim bdag bza' mi nyal ba'i khyim gyi gdung chag nas gnyis ka'i mgo bor lhung nas shing kyi nag gyang 'gyil dang 'dra ba'i mthu'i grags pa byung bar gyur/ bdag gi bla ma des kyang yab mes kyi gnas de'i yang dben phug ces bya bar sku mtshams lo gsum la bzhugs te/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pas zla ba bcu gsum song ba na lo gsar rgyal gyi zla stod la mtshan mo zla mthong la — 87 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/bzhugs te bzlas pa mdzad pa na/ nam mkha'i dkyil nas sdig pa rwa can gyi phung po chen po zhig 'ur sgra dang bcas sku'i mdun du lhungs/ bzhugs sa thams cad sdig pa rwa can mang pos gang bar gyur pas dngangs skug ste sgo'i phyir 'thon par brtsams pa na/ bug sgo dam por rtsigs yod pa ma phye ste thugs dran pa 'di ltar/ spyir yang nam mkha' nas sdig pa rwa can mang po 'di lta bu mi yong / lhag par da lta dgun grang ba'i skabs rang yin pas srog chags 'di lta bu dngos su mi yong cho 'phrul zhig yin par thag chod snyams/ sdig pa rwa can gyis gang ba'i dbus su thugs dam la bzhugs pas rim gyis yal nas mthar ci yang med par gyur/de nas re zhig na dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog dmar po kyi la ya'i sgra sgrogs pa zhig gsal bar gzigs/ bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal te phur pa dbang gi dngos grub brnyes/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po 'bad med du 'grub pa'i bsod nams stobs dang ldan par gyur to/ / yang zhang po lce ston gu ru rin po che'i yab mes rnams kyang rdo rje phur pa'i rig 'dzin mthu stobs dang ldan pa dag ste/ sngon skabs shig na bod du ro lang gi 'jigs pa chen po byung ste/ rong chu tshan kha dang / khro khang la sogs pa yul grong mang po ro langs kyis brlag cing skye 'gro thams cad 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' bar gyur pa'i dus/ yang nad yams chen po byung ste grong gcig tu mi mang po dus gcig la shi ba'i dbang bskur la spyan drangs pa na/mchod g.yog pa la/ bsrung ba la lcags phur zhig bskur nas sngon du gtang bas ro langs kyis dzings du byung bas phur pa de ldings shig btab pas ro langs rnams 'gyel bar gyur te/phur pa ro langs bdud 'dul du grags/ sgrub g.yogs pas kyang 'di ltar byung na bla mas lta ci smos kyang ci zhes byin rlabs che ba'i grags pas khyab bo/ /yang skabs shig lce ston rnam rgyal mgon po la sogs pas phur pa'i sgrub chen mdzad pa na tshogs pa rnams lto bza' ba'i skabs gī la ya'i sgra bung ba'i skad lta bu byung ba phal cher gyis thos shing gang nas byung snyams brtags shing dpyad pas gtso phur gyi zhal las byung bar shes te/ chos kyi dbyings nas gī la ya'i sgra dang dngos su grags pa grub pa'i rtags mchog tu gyur pa'o/ yang lce ston gu ru rin po che de ni byang chub sems kyi phung po'i dgongs pa zab mo mngon du gyur pa ste/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bka' las byo mda' nas zhabs drung bgres po 'di byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhig yin par 'dug 'di drung na byon pa tsam las sems zhi mal gyi 'gro ba'i byin rlabs kyi rtags chen po 'dug gsungs/ nad pa gdon gyis zin pa la yang hūṃ rtu phaṭa phaṭa ma dgos par gtad pa tsam gyis phan par myong bas grub cing / srin bya rgyu ba'i las la phur pa btab — 88 —

rgu/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/ —pa tsam gyis/ phyogs de la 'byung po'i rigs phyis kyang 'khor ba'i rgyun chad par gyur pa sogs nus mthu dang ldan zhing / bka' srung dbyings kyi ma mo ral gcig las bka' nyan cing 'phrin las sgrub par byed do/ / yang bdag gi pha mes gong ma rnams nas bzung lce ston rig 'dzin rim par byon pa rnams kyis rjes su bzung zhing dam tshig rdo rje lu gu rgyud du gyur la/sngon yul gtsang 'gram lha khang dang kho ro'i phyogs su gnas pa'i skabs slob dpon lang lab kyi chos rgyud dang yang 'brel ba'i rten 'byung bzang po las rdo rje phur pa rigs kyi lhar bzung nas lo re bzhin lo gsar du tshes pa'i dus bzang la 'khor 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis lce ston rig 'dzin chen po las phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par lha dbang thabs dang shes rab rdo rje mngon spyod rnam par rol pa'i 'phrin las rig 'dzin gyis mnga' gsol bkra shis kyi mtha' rten rdzong chen tshe'i dbang dang bcas pa zhu bar byed cing rdo rje phur pa'i dbang lo grangs dang mnyam par thob/ 'khor tshom bu grangs med pa dang bcas dus gsum gyi rig 'dzin 'dus pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen bzang por gyur to/ /phur pa gsang ba'i dgongs rgyud las/ gang zag rnams la dbang bskur na/ /dus 'di phan chad rgyal ba'i sras/ /ngan song gsum du ltung mi srid/ /lha dang mi yi dbang por 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ba bzhin du 'ong / khyad par du bdag gi pha sngags 'chang chen po dge bsnyen bzang po de nyid ni phur pa 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyud las byung ba'i phun sum tshogs pa bdun dang ldan phur pa sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor yang dag pa'i sbyin pa'i sdig pa sogs bya byed sdig pa'i 'khor lo spang ba/ rnal 'byor chen po'i gding dang / dpal chen po'i rnam par thar pa dang rjes su mthun pa/ bdag nyid phun sum tshogs pa dang / dus dang gnas phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dang / byin rlabs phun sum tshogs pa dang / bzlas brjod phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa bdun dang ldan nges te 'di ltar/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin chen po rat+na gling pa'i skye bar grags pa bre'u gdan pa sngags rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rjes su bzung ba sogs bdag nyid phun sum tshogs pa'o/ / sngon gyi bsod nams kyi mthus sgrub rten phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku chen po sa gzhi skyong bas dngos grub kyi tshul bstsal zhing thugs dam bsnyen phur yang bod gangs can gyi ljongs na legs par grags shing gzugs phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /gnas ni gī la ya bcu gnyis kyi rgyud las 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid 'dod dgu phun sun — 89 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/tshogs pa dang ldan zhing / rdo rje 'dzin pa mang pos zhabs kyis bcag shing byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /dus kyi khyad par phur pa las kyi phreng ba'i rgyud las 'di skad ces/ dus kyi 'khor lo rab gsungs pa/ / phyi nang gzhan gsum rgyu skar dge / zhes pa ltar dang khyad par gyi dus nyid kyi bsnyen pa'i tho ni 'di ltar/ thog mar lha mchog bsnyen pa'i dus/ lo zla zhag dus dmigs bsal du gsungs pa ched du rtsol ba ma dgos pa 'grig pa ni/ gdug pa can gyi lo zhig la bsnyen dgos pa/ lcags mo phag zla ba sogs nya ba zhig dgos pa zla ba bcu gcig pa/gza' phur dar ba zhig dgos pa/ dus khyad par can mar ngo'i nyer lnga/ dbang drag gi las 'grub pa las brtsams gsungs so / /byin rlabs phun sum tshogs pa ni rdzas kyi phur pa ye shes kyi lhar byin gyis rlabs pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa mang po las phur pa bka' gter gyi dbang lung mang po gsan zhing byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma nyams shing dbang mchog rnam par dag pas dus bzang po rnams la bdag 'jug gi dbang len par mdzad cing rtags kyi rim pa gzhung dang mthun pa 'ga' byung gsungs pa dang / mkhar las stobs chen po'i sa rdo slong ba dang shing gnyan mang po bcad kyang 'ul las pa sogs la yang / sa bdag 'dre srin gyis gnod mi nus pa dang / dgra thams cad dar zhing 'gro ba dang / bya ba 'gang che ba gang yang dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas 'grub sla ba ngo shes pa byung gsungs so/ /bzlas brjod phun sum tshogs pa ni thog mar phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs thams cad 'dus pa'i rig 'dzin chen po rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi bsnyen sgrub/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsnyen sgrub/ yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas pa 'bum phrag mang po dang / phyag na rdo rje/ sgrol dkar/tshe dpag med/ mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can/ lha mo dud sol ma rnams kyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin gnang / rtags so so'i gzhung dang mthun par byung gsungs khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i bzlas brjod 'bum phrag lhag song gsungs pa/ / phur pa rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ /gang gis sa ya bcu yis ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin las/ /rnam pa gzhan du ma nges so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang mkhas pas grangs dang rtags nas kyang / /dgos pa'i rang bzhin thob par bya/ / rgyal chen bzhi yi nyin phyed kyi/ / phyag rgya chen po thob par 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ba dang rjes su mthun par mthar phyin zhing rjes byed dus kyang gnas lugs rtags nam mkha' sprin dang bral bar gyur to/ /— 90 —

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/phrin las phun sum tshogs pa ni/ khyim du gnas kyang bya byed sdig pa'i las la mi 'jug cing sgo thams cad nas dkon mchog mchod pa la sogs pa dge ba rnal 'byor chen po'i gdeng dang rdo rje mngon spyod rnam par rol pa'i 'phrin las bdun la sogs kyi spyod pa la mos pas tha na rim gyi ched du yang rang gzhan 'jug pa'i mig ltos kyis byis pa rnams kyang gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul la mos pa'i rnam 'gyur skal ba bzang po dang ldan te/ phur pa rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ gang gis brtsams par mos pas kyang / / de la mkha' 'gros byams par 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ba bzhin du ma nges kyang bzlas brjod rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la zhugs te/gī la ya bdun 'bum nyi khri la sogs pa'i bsnyen pa tshad du phyin zhing / skabs shig pha de phyogs gzhan du gshegs byis pa rnams gzhon pas phyi nang gi 'tsho tshis ma nyid kyis mdzad pa las yul myang gi chu bo rgyas te zhing dang bla tshal sogs la gnod pa cher 'byung ba na/ ma nges kyang lcags kyi phur pa zhig chu mtshams su btab pas gnod pa can gyi chu bo'i rlabs chen po bzlog pa mngon sum du grub bo/ /yang hrul mo btsun mo zhig gis kyang phur pa'i bsnyen pa mang du song zhing 'byung po'i cho 'phrul la mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng chen po mdzad do/ / a jo sngags 'chang chen po de ni/ gtsang rong snar dang g.yung zhes bya ba rung / / shud bu'i skye ba rigs sngags 'chang byed pa/ /rdo rje'i ming can gdong shugs ldan pa 'byung / /zhes lung gis zin pa'i sngags 'chang rdor rgyan pa zhes bya ba'i skye ba yin zhing / kun gsal me long las/gtsang gi phyogs su rab brtan ming can 'byung / / zhes sog bzlog pa'i grangs su lung bstan/phur pa'i bzlas brjod dang gdab las mang po mdzad cing bsnyen phur gyi spyi bo nas spos ring gi du ba lta bu 'then pa'i mtshan ma gzigs/ mngon spyod kyi las sdeb shor rlung 'khor sogs la yang mkhas shing myong ba nus mthu dang ldan par bod kyi sngags bon thams cad yid ches pa yin no/ /spun zla ming sring gnyen 'khor gzhan gyis kyang rdo rje phur pa'i bzlas brjod rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la mos pas 'jug blo tsam re byed/ 'di ni bcu phrag brjod pas kyang / / tshe rabs gzhan gyi rig 'dzin brgyud/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /bdag ni thog ma'i 'jug sgo mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer la brtson pa chen pos bzhugs pa na/ pha nyid kyi bka' las mtshan nyid ni gzhon dus yin rgas nas mkho che rgyu rang med/ khyod sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zhig byed dgos gsungs/ ma dang zhang po lce ston gu ru rin po ches kyang sngags rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin zhig byed dgos zhes yang yang gsungs/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma des kyang khyed tsho'i yab de phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin song ba'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun yod pas bsnyen sgrub gang grags— 91 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/(drag) mdzod ces bskul bar mdzad pas rdo rje phur pa'i bzlas brjod mang du song bas/phur pa'i rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ / de ni sa ya brjod pas ni/ / bdag nyid chen po kho nar nges/ / bye ba yi ni grangs kyis kyang / / 'bar ba'i gzugs brnyan mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang phyogs mthun gyi rtags kyang cung zad snang / tshangs par spyod pa sngags kyi theg pa la 'jug pa'i tshul/ rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud sde las 'byung ba 'di dag gi don bsam zhing nyams len la 'jug pa'i tshul byas te/ / phur pa gsang ba'i dgongs rgyud las/ / phung po lha dang gnyis su med/ /sems ni chos nyid ngang la gnas/ /theg pa bsam yas sems la gnas/ /lta ba mi 'gyur gdeng du 'jog /sgom pa ma yengs don la bsam/ /dam tshig nyan thos sdom khrims bsrungs/ / rgyud 'brel sgrub thabs kun la mkhas/ / rdzas dang lag cha rtag tu 'chang / /don dang man ngag gzhung du sgrub/ /tha ma phyi rabs 'dzin la mkhas/ /tshul dang ngang tshul bzang la brtan/ /sbyor sgrol mchod pa rgyun mi chad/ /rnal 'byor rtogs ldan dam pa ste/ /las su bya ba kun rdzogs nas/ /'dzab bzlas grangs med rgyun du zlos/ /sngags dang phyag rgya mthu byin che/ / las dang bya ba gdon mi za/ / nges par brtsams pas ci 'dod 'grub/ /las su gtor ma gzhung bsrang zhing / / ci bgyis bka' nyan la mkhan(mkhas)pas/ / ci bcol phrin las 'grub phar byed/ / drag shul thabs kyi pho nya ni/ / rdzu 'phrul shugs las thabs kyis 'gyed/ / rtog pa mtshan ma thabs kyis 'dul/ / de dag byas nas 'gyur shog 'grub/ / shes pa nang nas dam pa ni/ / rgyud 'grel blo zhen sgrub la zhugs/ /yi dam lha la rtag gnas pas/ / de la bar chad 'byung mi srid/ / ces so/ / de yang gzhi 'dul khroms la gnas pa'i steng na/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas bskyed rdzong kyi lam dang sbyor sgrol sogs sngags kyi spyod pa la zhugs na gol pa chung bar sems te/ phur pa'i rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ skas kyi rim pa dza bzhin du/ /sa dang lam la mi gnas na/ /sangs rgyas bya ba thob mi 'gyur/ /de bas rnal 'byor thabs ldan gyi/ /bskal pa mang po du ma nu/ /skas kyi rim pa bzhin du 'gro /zhes so/ /des na rnal 'byor thabs lam dang ldan par byed pa la grogs rig ma dgos kyi dge slong dngos po la gnas pas mi rung / zhes dang / tshul khrims la nyan thos dman pa'i chos zhes smra ba mang yang / phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud du/ las kyi mkha' 'gro bsgrub pas sangs mi rgya/ / brda dang rtags la brten nas kun sgrub pa/ /mtshan ma'i chos kyis ting 'dzin g.yeng ba'i rgyu/ / de bas sems dang sems las byung bar bya/ /zhes so/ / de dang rjes su mthun par sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las kyang / mig ni da wa 92 da wa

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/sring mor gyur pa ste/ / rna ba tsha mo nyid yin no/ / sna ni ma ru gyur pa ste/ / lce ni bu mo nyid yin no/ /yid ni chung mar gyur pa ste/ /lnga po de rnams mchog lha mo/ /phyag rgya chen po rab ster ma'o/ / zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ / de bzhin du rdo rje dbyings rgyud las kyang /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ru/ / bdag nyid kyang ni mtshungs pa ru/ / lus ni yang dag sbyor ba ni/ / dbang po snyoms 'jug brjod bya yi/ / zhes dang / dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags brtag mi bya/ /zhes gsungs/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ blo ngan phung po'i lcags kyus zin/ /'khor ba las ni 'byung mi nus/ /rtag tu bud med chags gyur pa/ /de la grub pa yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs shing phur pa rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud las/ 'dod cing chags pa'i sems can gyis/ / yang dag lam gyi chos sgrub kyang / / lha gnas gsum las yongs mi 'da'/ / zhes gsungs te rgyud sde mang po dgongs pa gcig par spyir
