sbyor ba dang rang rgyud du spyod pa dang / dgos tshangs par spyod pa'i rten la dngos dbang len pa dus kyi 'khor lo dang 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud la sogs par bkag go / 'o na dbang gsum pa'i nyams len ji ltar byed ce na/ gsang ba nor bu'i thig le zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das thog mar sgrub pa bgyi ba gang lags/ rig pa'i rgyal mo thog mar sgrub par bya ste/ gang gis sems can rnams la gsang ba ster bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs shing / rdo rje garnyo ri dang / sgrol ma dang / ye shes gyi rnal 'byor ma mang po'i sgrub thabs gsung zhing phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud la sogs par khro mo rnams dang / phur srung mkha' 'gro rnams sgrub nas/ gsang dbang sgrub pa'i grogs byed par gsungs pas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang dngos su 'grogs nus na slob dpon pad+ma lta bu dang / sa ra ha sogs kyi mig 'dren byas pas rung ngo / / de bzhin ma yin na phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud las/ de bas sems dang sems las byung bar bya/ / zhes dang / phur pa 'jig rten snang byed kyi rgyud las/ de nyid thabs kyi man ngag 'di/ / bying rgod rmugs ni rab zhi nas/ / khams kyi zas dang rnam bral nas/ / dal la bsdu ba 'byung bar byed/ / de nas gzugs kyi mthong ba'i chos/ /smig rgyu lta bu'i rnam pa dang / /ngu ba lta bu'i rnam pa dang / /srin 'bu me khyer 'dra ba dang / / mar me'i tshul dang nam mkha' bzhin/ / 'od gsal zung 'jug bde ba che/ /ye shes bde ba de nyid las/ /zla ba drug dang bcu gnyis dang / /bco brgyad bcu dgu sum cu gnyis/ / de bzhin skye ba gcig gis 'grub/ / gal te des kyang ma 'grub na/ /gnon pa'i tshul gyis sgrub par bya/ /'phags pa'i thugs rjes ma byung yang / /ge 93 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/rang rig ye shes blo ldan na/ / mi tshe gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ / 'di ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /rnam par grol ba'i lam du grags/ zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du phur pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i rgyud las kyang gsungs so/ / mdor na rig ma sogs la brten pa'i zhu bde 'gyur bcas ni/ mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes te/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin spang bya 'pho ba'i bag chags spong ba'i lam dngos ma yin zhing / stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo ma brten nas zhu bde 'gyur med kyi bde ba ni mtshon bya don gyi ye shes dang rdo rje theg pa'i lam dngos yin no/ / de bzhin du he ru ka gal po'i rgyud las/ smig rgyu du ba me sprin mkha'/ / ting 'dzin phyi na gong bur byas/ / bdag nyid lha nu sgom pa yin/ / sbyor ba yan lag drug gis bsnyen/ / zhes 'byung ste dus kyi 'khor lo dang dgongs pa gcig go / de phyir rang rig ye shes kyi phur pa chos kyi dbyings su 'debs pa sor bsdud dang bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor/byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum lnga'i chos 'byung du 'debs shing / tshad med snying rje'i phur pas rgyud drug 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad rang sems bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi chos dbyings su sgrol ba'i tshul/ srog rtsol 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor dang sbyar te/ snang srid thams cad ye shes skad cig ma'i rang bzhin rdo rje phur pa'i ngo bor thag bcad/ khyad par du sang(seng ldeng) phur pa gsang ba'i dgongs rgyud la sogs par rang gi lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs yin par gsungs pa la yid ches nges shes pa dang bcas/ stong gzugs sna tshogs lhar shar ba'i tshul gyis rgyas btab/ gtum mo'i 'bar snang gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i thig le'i 'od zer rang rig rang gsal gyi mar me'i 'od kyis gsal ba'i ngang gzhom med na da'i rang sgra dang / 'byung ba'i sgra sna tshogs gī la ya'i sgrar shar ba/ bzlas brjod rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / gzhan yang bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i rgyud las 'byung ba ltar/mchod pa rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin phur pa sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba ltar/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi gtum mo ye shes kyi me'i 'od zer gyis chos nyid kyi co ba dang rgyud kyi rtsa ba dang / yon tan gyi rtsa/ thabs shes kyi rtsa thams cad dkyil 'khor lha'i rang bzhin du gsal zhing / dgyes pa chen po cho 'phrul dbang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi lugs ldog gis dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes mngon du byas/ seng ge rnam par lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis chos thams cad mi dmigs shing de nyid kyi ngang nas phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rol pas byin gyis rlabs/ bdag nyid chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dam can gyi tshogs bskul/ dgra bgegs thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs shing chos kyi dbyings su — 94 —

༄/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/bsgral te mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa'i mos blo tsam gyis cho ga yang sbyar ro/ / gzhan yang phur pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po las 'byung ba rdo rje phur pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga'i rim pa rdo rje phur pa chos thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba/ mngon spyod mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam mchog zab mo/ rdo rje phur pa zhe sdang yongs su dag pa'i rgyud las 'byung 'i rdzogs rim/ rdo rje phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba nges don byang chub sems kyi phur pa'i sgrub thabs rdo rje phur pa zhi khro'i cho ga phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud 'byung po kun 'dul las 'byung ba drag po 'phrin las 'byung po 'dul ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rim pa/ rdo rje phur pa chen po gtor ma'i rgyud las 'byung ba phur pa byang chub kyi sems dang sbyor ba'i rim pa gtor chen sgrub pa/ phur pa 'phrin las 'khor lo gab pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba/ bsnyen sgrub drag po las kyi rim pa nges pa'i gnad sbyor sgrol khrus lung rdzogs pa chen po'i don zab mo bstan pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'jig rten snang byed snying po'i cho ga phur pa rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa sa lam bstan pa/ phur pa gsang ba gdams ngag can gyi rgyud snying po bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa 'dzab kyi dgongs pa bstan pa/ rdo rje phur pa chos thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud las don dam ye shes phur pa'i sgom rim/ phur pa sbas pa gsang ba mdung rtse'i rgyud kyi snying po'i cho ga phur pa za byed 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ phur gdab nges don gyi gnad bsgrub pa/ phur pa phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba phun sum tshogs pa bdun gyis 'phrin las zab mo'i don bstan pa/ las kyi 'phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud las tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dus sogs bstan pa/ rdo rje khros pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba'i tshe sgrub/ phur pa 'phrin las kyi rgyud snying las bzhi sgrub pa'i rim pa bstan pa/ rdo rje phur pa'i rtsa ba rnal 'byor chen po yang dag pa'i rgyud las phur pa'i nges don snying po/'jigs byed rgyud kyi rgyal po rdo rje 'phreng ba las nges don rdo rje phur pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang sngags kyi rim pa/ rdo rje khros pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las byug bdug brdegs gsum rdzas kyi sgrub thabs bstan pa/ phur pa gsang ba'i dgongs rgyud chen po las/ rdo rje phur pa'i lus kyi sgrub thabs phur pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi snying po/ de bzhin gshegs pa chen po rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud dri med 'od ldan zhes bya ba'i sa spyad phur pa bcu gnyis kyi rgyud snying po/ gī la ya bcu gnyis kyi rgyud snying bo/ gī la ya bcu gnyis kyi mdo las 'byung ba'i sgom rim sems bsdus bzhag thabasadang / lam bgrod tshul bstan pa/ phur pa mdung rtse dmar po'i rgyud — 95 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/las phur bsrung gi 'byed tshul dang sgrub thabs bstan pa/ sho na dkar nag gi rgyud las phur srung rnams kyi srog snying dang sgrub thabs bstan pa/ se sgrom dmar po'i rgyud kyi phur srung sgrub thabs rdo rje phur pa'i bka' srung dkar mo nyi zla dang / bdud rgyal thod phreng can la sogs pa ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can dregs pa'i tshogs kyi sngon byung yum bzung ma'i dngos grub chen po'i rgyud las 'byung ba phur srung dkar mo nyi zla dang bdud rgyal thod phreng lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs yum bzung ma'i dngos grub kyi rgyud las gsung pa'i phur srung dkar mo nyi zla'i sgrub thabs zur du bkol ba/ phur srung gi sgrub thabs dang bskul ba rgyas pa bshad kyang dri med 'od las 'byung ba rnams zur du bkod cing nyams su blang pa'i bsam pa theg pa chen po blo sbyong dang gong mthun pa dang / rgyud sde chen po 'di dag la thos bsam gyi rnam grangs su yang 'gyur zhing /sngon dpal chen po'i spyan sngar bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong bar khas blangs pa'i phur srung dam can rnams kyis dgongs shing skyobs pa'i rten 'brel du yang bsam nas rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud sde mang po'i le'u spyi sdom sa bcad dang bcas nges don gyi gnad mang po phyi nang gi yi ger bkod cing / rdo rje phur pa de bzhin gshegs pa chen po'i rgyud las/ lam mchog rgyal ba mngon pa ni/ /nyan dang 'chad dang klog pa dang / /de bzhin yi ge 'bri mchod dang / /kha ton sbyin pa sgom pa ni/ /rnal 'byor rab kyi skal pa ste/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar bsam nas yang rdo rje phur pa de bzhin gshegs pa chen po'i rgyud 'jig rten snang byed las phur sgrub yang snying zab mo/ phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud las ting nge 'dzin gyi de nyid bsdus pa mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba'i tshe sgrub rgyas pa/ rdo rje phur pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi ye shes rtse mo'i rgyud dang / phur pa mdung rtse'i rgyud dang / zhe sdang yongs su dag pa'i rgyud dang / phur pa gsang ba'i rgyud sogs las 'byung ba phur pa'i rgyud bco brgyad las phur pa ji ltar sgrub pa'i las sna tshogs bstan pa/ rdo rje phur pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud las/ pho nya rnam shes sbyangs pa'i man ngag phur bsrung lcags kyi gabre ma rkang gsum gyi las tshogs / rdo rje phur pa'i thugs dam bskul ba'i rim pa phur srung bcu gnyis kyi rgyud las 'byung ba/ phur pa gsang ba'i dgongs rgyud las gsungs pa'i bla 'gugs phur pa'i rgyud dri med 'od las gsung pa'i lha dbye'i cho ga gzugs dbab pa sogs gdug pa 'dul ba'i lha drug gi cho gaphur pa bshad pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa phur btab bsdus pa/ dri med 'od las 'byung ba rdo rje phur pa bdud rtsi mchog gi phrin las bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub rdzas rak+ta'i las tshogs gsang ba'i rgyud pa sogs las gsungs pa/ yang sgrub rdzas nyung kar gyi las da 96 da

༄khya/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/tshogs ye shes rtse mo'i rgyud sogs las 'byung ba/ sgrub rdzas gu gul gyi las tshogs rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud sna tshogs las gsungs pa/ drag po'i lha drug gi las tshogs 'khor lo'i rim pa phur pa 'phrin las 'khor lo gab pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor chen po yang dag pa'i rgyud sogs las gsungs pa/ rdo rje phur pa khro bo bcu la sogs pa'i gtor ma gdug pa 'dul ba'i las mtha' phur pa'i ba lit+ta chen po'i rgyud las 'byung ba/ rgyud 'jig rten snang byed las thebs ldog bstan pa/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dri med 'od dang gsang ba'i dgongs rgyud dang /phrin las rgyud rnams las gsungs pa rnams zur du rang bzo med par bkod nas/ rgya gar bhe har gyi grong khyer chen por las bzhi'i sbyin bsregs nyi ma sbrel nas byas/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gi dus byi la du ba sogs phra men gyi cho 'phral che bar byang yang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i (/rdo /ste/ spyorag rwazigatsho ri 1dros rir ra rgyu tsho mishārig mjugangang nas da da snyang rja' phur pa btab / /yang rgyas pa dbang drag ga sbyan bsrag rnams kyi skabs bram ze'i bla ma mang pos dag snang gi yang yang blta bar 'ongs shing me tog dkar ser gyi phreng ba dang / so rtsi dang / rak+ka dmar po'i 'bras bu dag 'bul bar byas shing / ra dzas kyang mar khu dang ka ra dang 'bru dkar mang po'i mthun rkyen gyis bkra shis par byas so/ /gzhan yang rgyud kyi rgyal po phur pa ye shes rtse mo dang / phur pa sangs rgyas 'dus pa dang /phur pa myang 'das chen po'i rgyud dang / phur pa zhe sdang yongs su dag pa'i rgyud dang / phur pa 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud sde mang po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi snying po ngag 'don du bsgril ba rdo rje phur pa'i rig 'dzin 'dus pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje phur pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs mang po dang sbyor ba/ dbang gi lung sbyor rgyud sna tshogs las bsdus pa/ dngos grub blang ba'i dbang mchog bshad rgyud dri med 'od las gsungs pa/ ye shes phur pa'i nges don rdo rje rnal 'byor rdzogs pa chen po rnal 'byor yangs pa'i rgyud las byung bar khyab brdal ye shes kyi phur pa'i nyams len nges don rdzogs pa chen po'i rdo rje rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa rgyud sde sna tshogs dang sbyar ba/ don rang sems chos kyi dbyings kyi nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa'i klong 'od gsal rtags bcu'i dkyil 'khor du byang chub sems kyi phur pas khams gsum yongs sgrol bsam pa bzang pos nyams len gyi khungs byas so/ / gzhan yang phur pa ye shes rtse mo dang / 'khor lo gab pa dang / gsang ba'i dgongs rgyud la sogs pa'i nges don/ gdab las skoradrug la sogs pas dgra bgegs thams cad kyi sdig sgrib myong ba rgyud mthun du sbyor ba/ rdo rje phur pa'i rig 'dzin 'dus pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi smad las khrus lung dgra bo'i byang chog chen po dang /97phushāri pa

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/kad+malas kyi rgyud las 'byung ba/ phur pa ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho galiṅgā'i bsreg sbyang zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg nye bar bsdus pa sngags 'chang las dang po pa rnams la sbyor sgrol rang rgyud du sbyong ba'i nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir bkod cing gdab las kyi phan yon rgyud sde mang po las gsungs pa yang phyogs gcig tu bkod pa'o/ gzhan yang rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs phur srung dam can thams cad la gtor 'bul gyi cho ga bskang gso bstod bskul bzlog pa sri mnan mtha' rten shis brjod la sogs rgyud las gsungs pa la rang bzo med par gung bsgrigs nas bkod/ de yang dus snyigs ma'i chos byed phal cher la bdud kyi bar chad 'byung bas/ de lta bu'i bdud 'dul ba la/ spyir dkon mchog gang gis kyang thul/ khyad par rdo rje phur pa las lhag pa'i yi dam ma mchis pas yi dam gzhan sgrub kyang rdo rje gzhon nu bsrung ma'i tshul du sgrub/ ci'i phyir na srung ma ye shes dang 'jig rten pa gnyis ka yin pa dang / gang la gang 'dul phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir zhes/ yang zab thugs kyi zhu lan las gsungs shing / bskang gso bstod bskul sogs gal che ste/ khro bo bcu'i sngon gyi smon lam las kyang shes so/ /de ltar sngags rnying ma'i rgyud lung man ngag ji snyed las gsungs pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs nges don man ngag gi gnad mang po kun gzhi'i glegs bam la shes rab kyi yi ger bris shing / gzhan gsang sngags gsar ma'i rgyud rnams kyi nang na yang / dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyis bzung zhing bgegs sbyangs pa dang / bsrung 'khor dang mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las liṅgā sgrol ba sogs gang la yang phur pa dgos shing / rdo rje phur pa'i rigs sngags kyi cho ga gsungs pa rnams kyang legs par bltas nas rang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir zur du bkod pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rgyud las phur pa'i rigs sngags las rim cho ga dang bcas pa/ dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud las/ khams gsum thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje phur pa zhes bya ba'i rigs sngags las rim cho ga dang bcas pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi rgyud las 'byung ba rdo rje phur pa'i rig sngags las rim cho ga dang bcas pa dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las rdo rje phur pa drag po mchog gi sngags dang /las rim rdo rje mkha' 'gro khro bo'i sbyor ba la dgra bsad pa'i le'u zhes bya ba las byung ba/gsang ba thams cad ston pa rdo rje ye shes kyi byin gyis rlabs pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud las byung ba'i rdo rje phur pa'i las rim/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu 'joms par byed pa'i rgyud las/rdo rje phur pa'i rig sngags ri rab chen po'i khang pa brtsigs pa'i gzungs/ rigs sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che'i mdo las/ rdo rje phur pa khro bo bcu bsrung ma dang bcas pa'i sngags — 98 —

rgu/ /rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba/gsungs pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i rtogs pa las rdo rje phur pa'i rigs sngags gsungs pa/ gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud las rdo rje 'chang gi sprul pa/ phur srung gnod sbyin phur zhabs can gyi sgrub thabs dregs pa'i srog snying gi rgyud rnams zur du bkod cing /gsang sngags gsar snying gi rgyud sde chen po gang dang gang las kyang rdo rje phur pa'i rigs sngags kyi che ba gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po rnams las drag po'i phrin las kyi che ba'i yon tan bsngags shing rjes su gdams pa mang po yang phyogs gcig tu bsdus shing /theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong dang rjes su 'bul bar bsam ste/ snyigs ma lnga'i zhing yongs su sbyong ba dang / sems can ma rungs pa rnams smin cing grol bar byed pa'i thabs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bla na ma mchis pa ste/ snyigs ma'i dus su he ru ka/ / sgrub na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes dang / phur pa sbas pa gsang ba mdung rtse'i rgyud las/ 'byung po mang po gang yod par/ / byas na las la phan thogs yod/ / bkra mi shis par byas gyur na/ /grags 'byin thugs kyi ting 'dzin 'grub/ /sa la g.yul ni 'gyed pa na/ /byas par shin tu zab pa'o/ / zhes dang / phur pa gsang ba'i rtsa ba rnal 'byor chen po yang dag pa'i rgyud yongs su gtad pa'i skabs las/ phyi rabs dug lnga smin pa yi/ / sems can rnams la gnang bar bgyi/ /mkhas shing ngang tshul bzang ba dang / /rigs ldan dam tshig ldan pa yi/ /gang sgrub las rnams 'grub nges pa'i/ /de la rab tu gnang bar gyis/ /bstan pa'i snying po gang gnas par/ / dam can yongs kyi gnas 'gyur te/ / der ni legs par mang po 'byung / /khyed rnams de yi grogs mchog gyis/ /zhes gsang ba'i bdag po dang / phur srung rnams la bka' bsgos shing / lung bstan gnas dus la babs par 'jig rten du rgyal po dregs can dag 'thab pa'i g.yul ngor skye 'gro srog chags grangs med bsad pa'i khrag gi mtsho 'khyil zhing / mi ro dang rta ro'i phung po chen po la dur bya mang po lding zhing / sha la dga' ba'i 'byung po lang long du rgyu ba'i dur khrod chen po grub par gyur/ 'dre srin gdug pa can thams cad kyang 'thab cing 'khrugs pas gdug tsub kyi nyi zla'i 'od kyang sgrib par rtsom pa na/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs snying rje chen po'i spyan gyis gzigs shing / khyad par byang chub sems dpa' mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i rigs sngags 'chang ba'i tshogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa thams cad sngon gyi thugs dam dgongs nas phur bsgrub grogs mdzad pa dang / khyad par ru tra dang dam log gi tshogs sgrol ba'i khro bo chen po bcu la sogs pa'i bskul tshig tsam brjod pa yang mkhyen — 99 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/cing 'phrin las sgrub pa rdo rje gzi ldan 'bar ba'i rgyud la sogs par gsungs pa la nges shes yid ches kyi dad pas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing phur pa sgrub par dam bcas nas rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub gnas/ brag dmar rdo rje phur pa rang gi gnas dang / brag phug ma ra ti ka dang /tshe chu brag dang / brag hūṃ yig can gyi phug pa dang / stag tshang seng ge'i skyed tshal dang /ra rgod brag dang / brag yig drug can gyi nags tshal rnams su rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub pa mang du byas shing / de nas yang mtha' brag ces bya ba'i gnas dang / mon mtshams shing gi ri bo'i khong rnams brgyud de rgya gar gyi nags stag gi rgyu srang lce spyang ku sgra 'byin pa'i dur khrod/dbang phyug gi gnas mi'i mgo dang ma he'i rus pa mang po chal du bkram pa'i nye 'dabs su sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dmigs rnam tsam dang rjes su 'brel bar rdo rje phur pa'i bzlas brjod mang du byas/ rtags snang lha'i rnam pa phur zhabs can mang po shar/ de nas yang gtum drag dur khrod chen po brago ri zur gsum dpal chen drag po'i gtor ma spungs pa lta bu'i nags rong / dug sbrul dang / dur phag dang / stag gzig tshang ma la gcan spyang dur bya kang ka mang po nga ro sgrog cing lding ba'i tshal nang mi rus dkar po tshal du bkram pa'i sa gzhi smyugs ma'i lding khang me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan par rdo rje phur pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs te rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub chen nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu bzlas pa'i rgyun bzung ste/gtso bo la bdun 'bum/ 'khor khro bcu za gsod phur bsrung gi tshogs kyi sngags rnams 'gro gang che bzlas ba'i khungs byas/ dus gsum tshogs 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor can/ /dmigs pa'i don gyis rtse gcig mthur ldan na/ / rnal 'byor che mchog sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin thob/ / yang skabs de'i rang skal pa bzang po'i ched du bsam nas/ phur pa'i rgyud sde sna tshogs kyi nges don cho ga'i tshogs rnams kyang rim pa bzhin nyams su len pa'i khung byas/ gsang ba snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las/ sems kyi rang bzhin yi ge ste/ / yi ge'i dngos po yod ma yin/ / dmigs med de nyid sna tshogs pa'i/ / sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo che/ / sku gsung thugs kyi ngo mtshar gyis/ / ya mtshan 'phrul chen rab 'khrug pa'i/ / dbyings la dbyings kyi bris pa ste/ /ye ge zhes ni de phyir brjod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /sems kyi 'char sgo mig gi rnam par shes pa'i ri mo/ yi ge'i gzugs sna tshogs shar zhing / / lus kyi lpags pa'i ri mo dang / phyi rol rig pa gang du btang ba'i sa rdo la sogs pa'i ri mo phra rags thams cad yi ge'i gzugs sna tshogs su shar zhing rna ba'i rnam par shes pa gang du gtad par sgra snyan — 100 —

zhing 'tsher ba dang 'ur sgra chen po 'byung ba'i ngang la rtse gcig tu sgril zhing bzlas brjod la rtsol ba na/ sngags kyi sgra che chung sna tshogs pa rang sems kyi dbyings nas rang byung du sgrogs pa'i nyams shar/ phyi nang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bzang po'i dbang las/ rgyud sde gleng gzhi sna tshogs bsdus pa'i chos kyi gtam 'di dag kyang legs par brtsam mo /zhes rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung rgyud sde mang po'i gleng gzhi phyogs gcig tu gung bsgrigs pa 'di ni shākya'i dge slong 'jam dpal rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ / sarba maṅgā lam/

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/)tsho/ /rdo rje phur pa'i bshad bum slob dpon rnam gsum gyi dgongs pa slob dpon chen po pad+mas mkhar chen bza' la gdams pa bzhugs so/ /phur 'grel 'bum nag ces gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i thugs kyi ti la ka'o/ /'gro ba'i don phyir da lta rnga yab gling na bzhugs pa yi/ /'khrungs dka'i skyes bu gcig pu nges don theg pa gcig tu bzhed/ / skye brgyud gnyis las 'khrungs shing rmad du byung ba'i rigs gnyis ldan/ /gdug pa rnam gsum btul nas dngos grub rnam gsum brnyes pa po/ /che ba bzhi ldan rig 'dzin bzhi yi ngo bor gyur pa khyod/ / grub chen brgyad ldan gsang ba'i mtshan brgyad ldan la rab tu 'dud/ / rig 'dzin sa thob pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ / yar klung shel gyi brag phug mngon dga' der/ / las dang skal bar ldan pa'i mtsho rgyal la/ /gtad pa'i gdams pa ma nor bstan par bya/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ rtsa ba dkyus ngan sngags su phyung ba/ phar thebs la tshur mi ldog pa/ nyung la kha tshar tshang ba/ lta ba chos nyid dang mi 'gal ba/gzungs ma mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal la gtad de/ de nyid gang zhe na/ rgyud kyi bsdu thabs gnyis/ rgyad kyi bshad thabs gsum/ rgyud kyi khog don drug rgyud kyi them sbyor bcu/ rgyud kyi gnad tho bcu gnyis/ rgyud kyi srog them nyi shu rtsa gcig phur pa rtsa ba'i lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig yan lag gi lha nyis stong phyed dang drug brgya dang gcig go /de yang dang po rgyud kyi bsdu thabs gnyis ni/ rdo rje phur pa la rgyud sde mang yang rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud genyis su bsdu ste/ rtsa rgyud ni rtsa thung rdo rje khros pa'o/ / bshad rgyud ni gsang rgyud dang khrag 'thung rtsa ba'i rgyud la sogs pa rgyud sde brgya rtsa brgyad bzhugs so/ /gnyis pa rgyud kyi bshad thabs gsum ni/ phur pa rgyud ltar bshad pa dang / phur pa lung ltar bshad pa dang / phur pa man ngag ltar bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud la tan+d+ra sde bco brgyad yod pa ltar du rdo rje khros pa klong chen po bco brgyad nas bshad pa dang / gnyis — 102 —

rgu/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagapa rdo rje phur pa 'di lung thams cad kyi bla ma yin pas na/ rdo rje khros pa lung nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bshad pa dang / gsum pa rdo rje phur pa 'di man ngag gi nges don yin pas rdo rje khros pa 'di man ngag brgya rtsa brgyad du bshad pa'o/ / gsum pa rgyud kyi chings drug ni/ phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lngas sgrub pa las kyi gzhi bzung / dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas te don gyi khog dbub/ khams gsum gis(gyis)srog la dbang bskur ni srog gis ye shes sems dpa'i srog la dbang bskur te/ ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs shing mchod cing bsnyen pas dngos grub kyi bcud blang / gab pa'i sngags drug dang tshe lung khrus lung gis kha bskang ste gdab pa'i las bya/ mnan sreg 'phang gsum gyis las kyi mjug bsdu ba dang drug go / bzhi ba rgyud kyi them sbyor bcu ni/ gleng gzhi rnam pa gsum gyis spyi'i khog dbub/mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum gyis don gyi shan dbye/ phur bu'i rgyud bzhis gang zag rnam pa bzhi mthar dbyung / sgrub lugs chen po gsum gyis phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang / thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags kyis lha gnad la dbab/ ngan sngags btu yig drug gsum bco brgyad kyis mkha' 'gro ma dngos su bkol/ srog gi don po gsum gyis dmigs pa gsum gyi gnad bkrol/ bsgral las chen po bco brgyad kyis brnag pa'i las bya/ mthar phyin brgyad kyis las kyi kha bskang / mtha' bsdu gsum gyis las kyi lto ba gdab ces pa dang bcu'o/ /da lnga ba rgyud kyi gnad tho bcu gnyis ni/ dkyus kyi tshig drug ma shes na phrin las gong 'og gi shan mi 'byed/ gabarupa'i sngags drug ma shes na sngags gzer drag po dgra la mi phog sbas pa'i 'phyang drug ma shes na gab sbas kyi thag mi chod/ man ngag srog gi chan pa ma shes na dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa mi chod/ gshog pa rlabs chen gyi cho ga ma shes na dgra bgegs kyi bla mi khugs/ gsang phur seng ge kha 'thab kyi cho ga ma shes na rnal 'byor pa nang 'thab na bsgral ba'i thabs med/ gnad gcod kyi thabs ma shes na las la sbyar na tshur ldog 'khor lo'i bskor thabs ma shes na las mi 'grub/ liṅgā'i bca' thabs ma shes na dmigs pa'i gnad brlag kun gzhi'i gnas lugs ma shes na btab pa la don med/ tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pa ma shes na ngan sngags dang khyad med/ gnas spar ba'i cho ga ma shes na bshan pa dang khyad med ces pa'o/ / drug ba rgyud kyi srog them nyer gcig ni/ lag len mngon rtogs kyi srog them bdun/ dris lan gegs sel gyi srog them bdun/ man ngag gnad kyi srog them bdun te nyer gcig go /bdun pa phur pa rtsa ba'i lha nga gcig ni/ khro bo khro mo nyi shu/ mgo brnyan nyi shu/ sras mchog lnga/ sgo ma bzhi/ yab yum gnyis te nga gcig go / brgyad pa da 103 da

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/de las spros pas lha nyis stong phyed dang drug brgya dang gcig go /de rnams ni spyi'i don to/ /da ni yan lag gi don la gleng gzhi rnam pa gsum gyis spyi'i khog dbub ces pa las/ de la gsum ste/ dang po gu ru'i gleng gzhi/ ston pa'i gleng gzhi/ rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang gsum las/dang po gu ru'i gleng gzhi bstan/ de la'ang gsum ste/ dang po skye rgyud/ gnyis pa mdzad pa'i las bstan/ tha ma ji ltar brgyud lugs so/ / dang po skye rgyud ni/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes grub thob thams cad kyi spyi mes dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang gleng mo mdzad pa/ shes rab nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ ma mo mkha' 'gro dang / snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad dbang du bsdu zhing bran du khol ba de la skye rgyud rnam pa gnyis ni ji ltar skyes/ rigs rnam pa gnyis dang ji ltar ldan/ che ba rnam pa bzhi ni gang yin/ rig 'dzin bzhi'i ngo bor ji ltar gyur/ gsang ba'i mtshan brgyad dang ni ji ltar ldan zhe na/ dang po ni mngal skyes su 'dod pa dang / rdzus skyes su 'dod pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi dbang du byas na/ rgyal po'i rigs dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs kyi dbang du byas na/ mi bskyod pa rdo rje'i rigs so/ /gsum pa ni/ rigs kyi che ba/ mkhyen pa'i che ba/ nus pa'i che ba/ grub pa'i che ba'o/ / bzhi ba ni/ rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin no/ / lnga pa gsang ba'i mtshan brgyad ni 'og tu rgyas par 'byung ba'o/ /de las 'dir slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas de mngal skyes kyi dbang du byas na/nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul na/ rgyal po shakra bya ba dang / btsun mo dza len+d+ra gnyis las/'brug gi lo'i ston zla ra ba'i tshes nyi shu gcig la/ gza' pa sangs/ skar ma dmar po mgo la/ dus nyi ma rtse shar tsa na sras gcig btsas pa dang / zhal khro gnyer mche ba bag tsam gtsigs pa/ lag pa g.yas ral gri'i phyag rgya can/ g.yon pa gurnye'i phyag rgya can gcig btsas pa la/ ma de 'jigs shing bred nas smras pa/ mi'i bu ma yin 'dre'i bu bag tu snang /gzhan gyis mthong na ltas ngan chen por 'gyur/ de bas gzhan gyis ma tshor ba la dben par bzhag go zer ba la yab kyis smras pa/ sems can skye ba mi lus thob pa la/ /gzugs dang kha dog mi mthun so sor snang / /de bas bram ze mtshan mkhan khug la ston/ /zer te bstan pas/kye ma/ g.yas g.yon phyag ni phyag rgyar ldan/ / khro gnyer skra mtshams shin tu mtho/ / zhal bgrad 'jo sgeg khro bo'i gzugs/ /rig byed dag las bzang bar bshad/ /ces brjod nas — 104 bhe

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagapū dza phul/ phyag btsal nas mtshan bshad pa/ g.yas kyi phyag rgya 'dis dug gsum gyi dgra bgegs 'joms pa yin/ g.yon gyi phyag rgya 'dis dngos grub rnam gsum thob pa yin/spyan ldog khro gnyer bdud dang mu stegs 'dul ba yin pas rgyal bu'i mtshan rdo rje bdud 'dul du thogs zer nas btags so/ /de yang 'brug lo la skyes pa grags pa che bar 'ong / ston zla ra ba la skyes pa la 'bras bu'i theg pa/ mgo la skyes pa sngags kyi mgo 'dren/ pa wa sangs la sdug bsngal sangs/ nyi ma shar ba thugs rje shar ba yin/ lo skor gcig tu mi la ma bstan/bstan na 'bangs snying dang 'dra ba gcig la ngan no zer ro/ / de nas lo bcu lon tsa na phyir shor ba dang / blon po gha ru de wa gzhon tsa na bu ma sos/ shin tu rgas pa la bu gcig yod pa la/ de shing gi grib bsil la bsnyal ba'i dpral ba na sha sbrang zhig gis za yin 'dug pa la/rgyal bu rdo rje bdud 'dul gyis sor rdo zhig brgyab pas/ sbrang ma dang bcas pa klad pa'i rgyas su gtsang gis song nas shi'o/ / der blon po rnams na re/ chad pa bcad dgos zer te/mi rnams kyis shing re dang spe sna re khyer 'ong nas rgyal bu bsreg par brtsam pa las/ bu bsad pa'i pha gha ru de was smras pa/ lus kyi rten ni mgo bo yin/ / mgo bcud lus kyis ci byar yod/ /'bangs kyi rten ni rje bo yin/ /rje med 'bangs kyis ci byar yod/ /de bas chad pa tha ma tsam/ / zer ba dang / chad pa'i tha ma sgyugs pa yin pas/ g.yog po ga ra bya ba dang / tsu ta ka bya ba gnyis g.yog tu byas nas sgyugs so/ / de gsum pos shin tu mi dga' yin phyin pa dang / rgyal bus grogs po gnyis la smras pa/ rgyal po'i rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing la/ / kho bos nyes pa shor ba slar la log na ni/ / rgyal khrims nyams par 'gyur gyi skyong bar mi 'gyur bas/ /rgyal khrims blon pos skyong gis khyed gnyis slar la log /byas pas/ byis pa gnyis kyis smras pa/ rgyal khrims me dang 'dra ste rgyal sa chu dang 'dra/ / me dang chu gnyis mi rtag mi mthun te/ / rtag cing brtan la bde ba'i 'byung gnas kyi/ / chos srid bskyang gi rje 'bangs chos la gshegs/ / zer/ gu ru sangs rgyas gsang ba can du phyin te/ rgyal bus smras pa/ kye/ thugs rje nyi shar khyad par dro ba bzhin/ / nyam thag sems can kun la skyob par mdzod/ /kho bo rmongs pas khrims la nyes pa shor/ /slar la log tu ma mchis rjes su gzung bar zhu/ / zhes zhus pa dang / gsum ga rab tu byung ste/ rgyal bu la shākya bshes gnyen du btags/ g.yog gnyis la shākya mi tra dang / shākya pra bhar btags/dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la mkhas par bslab/ yo ga tsakra/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel ba/khro bo dam pa rgyan/ zhi ba rin chen drwa ba rnams bslabs so/ / de ni mngal skyes su 'dod pa — 105 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/rnams de skad smra'o/ /gnyis pa 'dzam bu gling pa phal che ba ni/ rdzus skyes su smra ste/ de yang nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul de na/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po gcig dang / rgyal srid skyong ba'i rgyal po gcig dang gnyis yod pa las/ dang po chos kho na don du gnyer la/ gnyis pa de srid kho na don du gnyer ba yin no/ /yul de na mtsho gaṅgā dri med ces bya ba zhig yod pa las/me tog pad+ma shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam mang du skyes ba las/ de'i nang na khye'u mdangs dang ldan pa zhig skyes nas 'dug ste/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po de la sras med pa las/ khye'u de longs la shog nga'i sras bya'o/ / pad+ma de khyer la shog nga'i zas bya'o/ / gsungs nas/ de'i 'khor bas gru btang nas blangs so/ /de blangs pa dang yul khams de'i nad dang mu ge thams cad zhi zhing bkra shis par gyur to/ / bu de pad+ma las byung bas na pad+ma 'byung gnas bya bar mtshan btags te dang po'o/ / de nas bu zhun mar gyis gsos pas skyed shin tu che ste/ gzhan gyi lor gsos pa las de'i zla ba skyed che/ gzhan gyi zla ba las de'i zhag skyed che bas 'dis rgyal po'i gdung 'tshob par 'dug zer te/ de la rgyal po gdung 'tshob skyes bur mtshan btags te mtshan gnyis pa'o/ / de nas rgyal bu de gyad dang / mchongs dang / bang dang /'phongs dang / rtsal la sbyangs pas shin tu 'byongs te/ mkhar khyim thams cad la mchongs pas/ spyir o rgyan de na khang thog tu bya khu ta babs na ltas ngan du byed pas de bsrung ba'i phyir lcags kyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga btsugs yod pa la rkang pa reg pas 'gyel te bram ze'i phru gu gcig la phog nas shi'o/ / de rgyal srid skyong ba'i rgyal po des chad las phab par/ rgyal po yin pas mtha' la spyugs par bya'o/ /der yab la phyi phyag byas pa/ pha med ma med rgya mtsho'i gling las skyes/ / rgyal pos thugs la dgongs nas sras su byas/ / sngon gyi las kyi grogs mchog sug par lhung / /khrims dang 'gal bar mi byed ci bder mchis/ /byas pas/ yab kyis sras la lan du/ rgya mtsho'i gling las skyes pa'i khyad par can/ / bu yis phongs pas sras kyi dam par blangs/ / dregs(drag)spyod rtse(rtsed)mo'i dbang gis bram ze bkum/ / khrims dang 'gal bar ma byed ci bder gshegs/ / gsungs nas/ der ri bo'i ngogs la phyin te srin po'i spyod pa sbyor sgrol la zhugs te/ pho byung ba bsad/ mo byung ba spyad pas/ bdud dang /srin po dang / gcan gzan thams cad dbang du 'dus so/ /de'i dus su srin po shān+ta rak+ṣi ta bya bar gsang mtshan btags te gsum pa'o/ / yang rgyal srid skyong ba'i rgyal po de na re/'dis yang dang yang du rgyal srid nyams par byas so zer te/ 'phrang gcig tu kho rang gi sras 'phongs rtsal can gcig lcags mda' lcags gzhu bkang nas bzhag mi gzhan gyis ri — 106 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagabashus te/ der shān+ta rak+ṣi tas gzhu ma bdungs par bros pa dang / sngar gyi rgyal po lcags gzhu 'gengs pa'i bar la rak+ṣi tas gzhu bdungs pa dang 'gengs zin te/ rgyal bu de'i mig tu brgyab pas bsad de shor ro/ / de'i dus su bdud shor ba gzhon nur mtshan btags te gsang mtshan bzhi pa'o/ /de nas dur khrod chen po bsil pa'i tshal du byon nas/ ro re re la chang ban re dang zan dang sha lhu lnga lnga yong ba (yod pa) de zos/ ro ras gyon pa dang /mjug tu ro bshas te sha khrag zos pa dang / yang bdud shor ba gzhon nu 'dug zer nas ri bshus nas bton no/ /der skyo ba skyes nas slob dpon chen pos sangs rgyas gsang ba can du 'ongs nas/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan shākya bshes gnyen du btags te gsang mtshan lnga pa'o/ /de'i dus su bal po shī la mdzi dang / bi ma la mi tra gnyis kyang rab tu byung ste/ shākya pra bha dang / shākya mi trar btags so/ / de nas khong gsum gyis slob dpon pra bha ha sti rtsal la phur pa zhus so/ / rtogs pa mi 'dra ba gsum byung ste/ gzhungagacig tu bkod pas rdo rje phur pa rnam gsum skor zhes grags so/ / de nas shākya bshes gnyen des kyang ma tshims te/dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal na mkha' 'gro ma bde ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba dpal rdo rje gzhon nu dngos kyi slob ma zhig yod zer nas/ der byon pas mkha' 'gro ma'i g.yog mo chu 'chu ba dang 'phrad pas/ phrin bskur bas bros pa la chu ban dang sa sbyar ro/ /mo na re/ khyod rdzu 'phrul ston na ngas ston zer nas/ brang mdzub mos kha phye nas/ rdo rje phur bu'i dal gsum 'dug pa bstan no/ / mos kyang ḍā ki ma la phrin byas pas/ pad 'byung yin gyi yar la khugs byas pas/ pad 'byung gis mkha' 'gro ma'i drung du phyin pa dang / ḍā kis pad 'byung hūṃ zhig tu bzhus nas shangs khung du rngubs te/ ḍā kis spyi bo bde chen du nub gcig bzhag bum pa'i dbang bskur/ lus kyi dri ma dag par byas/ sku'i dngos grub byin/ sprul sku thob bo/ /nub gnyis pa mgrin par bzhag gsang dbang bskur/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi dngos grub byin/ longs sku thob bo/ / nub gsum ba snying ga chos 'khor du bzhag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur/ sems kyi dri ma dag par byas/ thugs kyi dngos grub byin/chos sku thob bo/ / nub bzhi pa gsang bar bzhag dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag bde chen gyi sku thob bo/ / ḍā ki ni'i gsang ba'i pad+ma nas bton pas gsang mtshan pad+ma saṃ bha war btags te gsang mtshan drug pa'o/ /de nas ḍā ki ma'i g.yog mo phyag rgyar snang ste/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug btags nas spyod pa byas pas/ gsang mtshan pad+ma thod phreng du btags te gsang mtshan bdun pa'o/ / de'i dus su — 107 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/dang po'i o rgyan gyi yul du byon pas/ sngon gyi rgan mo gcig gis ngo shes te/ 'dis sngon nyes pa mang po byas pa yin zer nas/ me la til mar byugs pa dang / tsan+dan gyi shing la me sbar te bsregs pa las/ sngon gyi ma des mthong ste/ sngon yang sgyugs pa'i sdug bsngal spyod/ /da lta me la 'chi dus med/ / zer te bltar phyin pas me mdag gi ra ba las ma thar ro/ /de nas zhag bdun du me ma shi/ de nas mi rnams kyis bltar phyin pa dang / mtsho chung zhig gi nang na pad+ma'i sdong po zhig skyes/ de'i steng na sku zil ba phrom mer bzhugs pa mthong nas/ mas smras pa/ rgyal bu rdo rje bdud 'dul ni/ / da lta rdo rje 'chang du bzhugs/ /zhes zer ro/ / mi rnams ngo mtshar skyes te/ kye/ mi las lhar gyur ngo mtshar che/ / spyod pa rmad byung ngo mtshar che/ / rdzu 'phrul mchog ldan ngo mtshar che/ / mthu stobs dpag med ngo mtshar che/ / zer te/ pad+ma dang mtsho las skyes pas mtsho skyes/ mes ma tshig pas rdo rje/slob dpon chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje bya bar btags te gsang mtshan brgyad pa'o/ /de rnams ni gu ru'i skye rgyud do/ /gnyis pa mdzad pa'i las thabs la gsum ste/ dang po mthu dang dngos grub ji ltar brnyes/ bar du sde brgyad gdug pa can gar ltar btul/ tha ma bsam yas kyi sa 'dul dang rab gnas ji ltar mdzad pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ ru'i sngar gyi grogs po shākya mi tra dang / shākya pra bha gnyis kyang byung ste/ khong gsum gyis bgros pas/ a su ra'i brag phug rdzas mod pa sidhi nye ba 'dir bsgrub dgos byas te/ der bsgrubs pa las/ grub rtags rab 'bring tha gsum byung ste/ rab phur gcig nam mkha' la lding ba de/ ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis blangs te/ tsan+dan gyi nags la brgyab pas thul gyis tshig nas slar la lo 'dab 'khrungs so/ /dgos pa ci yod na/ de'i gseb na mu stegs kyi gnas khang yod pa de bcom pa'o/ / yang rtags 'bring phur pa gcig maṇ+ḍal steng na 'gul zhing 'phar ba zhig byung / de bi ma las blangs te chu bo gaṅgā la btab pas chu bo chad do/ / de la dgos pa ci yod na/ klu nor rgyas bya ba mu stegs pa la 'tsho ba ster ba zhig yod pas de gzhom pa'o/ / yang rtags tha ma phur pa zhig 'dzum zhing rgod pa zhig byung bas/ de shī la mdzis blangs te/ mkhar gong gi brag la btab pas phye mar phung gis song / de la dgos pa ci yod na/ de la the'u rang gi pho brang yod de mu stegs la mngon shes ston pa yod pas de rnams btul ba yin no/ / yang de gsum gyi gsang mtshan ni/ slob dpon blo ldan mchog sred col/ dha na saṃ skṛ ta/ dā na u pa ya gsum po des rgya mtsho'i gling la bsgrubs pas steng gza' dang rgyu skar gyi thog ser phab — 108 —

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum naga'og klu dang sa bdag gis rgya mtsho lud du bcug bar snang gi lhas dus ma yin pa'i char dang rlung nag btang bas/ slob dpon pa thugs khros te/ phur pa zhig gnam la bsgril bas/gnam gyi gza' skar thams cad thang la lhung ngo / / phur pa zhig mtsho la btab pas/ mtsho skems te klu phrug tsho cho nge dir gyis song ngo / /phur pa zhig bar snang la btab pas bar snang lha dang dri za rnams sa la lhung song ste/ srog snying phul gus pas btud do/ / de nas yang ru de rnams kyis bal yul yang le shod du byon pa dang / srod thun la ru'i dbugs thums rngubs pa zhig byung / phyag gis byugs pas ci cig 'dra ba zhig zin pa snyam byed de/ za ma tog tu bcug ste mu dras rgyas btab pa las/ nangs par bltas pas bud med bzang mo bzhi 'dug ste su yin dris pas/ bse'i lha mo bya ba yin zer/ khyod ci 'dod byed pas/ nga gling bzhi'i srog dbugs 'dod zer/ der phyag rgyas bsdams pa dang / srog snying phul/gsang mtshan re re btags/ rta re re bskyon/ yang phur srung mar dbang bskur mthu che bar 'dug nas yul so sor bkar nas bzhag go / yang nam phyed tsam na bud med nag mo ral pas sa gzhi khebs pa mang po kha nas nad kyi kha rlangs 'don pa lag na mtshon gyi gru gu thogs pa byung ba la khyod su yin ci 'dod byas pas/ nga bdag nyid chen mo bya ba yin/ khams gsum gyi srog dbugs 'dod zer/ der phyag rgyas bsdams te sngags dang phur bus gzir bas/yang srog snying phul/ yang phur srung mar dbang bskur ro/ /yang tho rangs kha zangs kyi wa mo la zangs kyi bud med chen po zhon pa 'phar spyang rol du khrid pa byung / su yin dris pas nga shwa na mu kha bya ba yin/ ci 'dod byas pas/ nga stong gsum gyi srog dbugs 'dod zer/yang phyag rgyas bsdams te gzir bas/ srog snying phul/ yang phur srung mar dbang bskur ro/ /de nas yang skyes bu zhub dkar can mang po byung / su yin ci 'dod byas pas skyes bu ging yin/ glo bur ye 'drog 'dod zer/ phyag rgyas bsdams te gzir bas srog snying phul/yang phur srung mar bkod nas bzhag go /de yang shwa na ma 'das pa'i ma mo/ bdag nyid ma 'das ma 'das mtshams kyi ma mo/ bse mo bzhi 'jig rten pa'i ma mo yin te/ de ltar slob dpon gsum pos grub pa de ltar brnyes pa'o/ /gnyis pa bar du gdug pa can ji ltar btul na/ de ltar gsang ba'i mtshan brgyad dang ldan pa/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin thob pa des/ o rgyan na bzhugs pa las dus de tsam na bod yul dbus nas/ dbus kyi rgyal rgo khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bsam yas bzhengs nas/ lha 'dres brtsig tu ma ster ba dang / dbas mdzi paṇ+ḍi ta nus pa can tshol du btang bas slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas mtsho ma — 109 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/pham la thig btab/ tshon bkye nas dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te/ sde brgyad la dbang bskur gyi 'dug nas zhwa phud pas/ nga la de'i nus pa med/ nga'i slob ma pad 'byung khugs zer nas/ rgyal po la sangs rgyas gsang bas chos lnga skyes su bskur ro/ /de yang khri srong lde'u btsan/ bornadhi sa twa/ pad 'byung gsum/ sngon phag phrug gsum du skyes nas/ drang srong grub thob gcig gi mchod rten la shig phrugs pas sar kha bsub pas/ de'i skye ba phyi ma la phag rdzi gsum du skyes te/ mchod rten gyi ser kha la gcig gis 'bog dug brlan/ gcig gis mi mdzis zer te bsal/ gcig gis 'jim pa byugs pas/ de'i skye ba phyi ma la bram ze spun gsum du skyes nas 'jim pa'i mchod rten bzhengs nas smon lam btab pas/ gcig gis gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i yon bdag tu gyur cig ces smon lam btab/ gcig gis de'i sa 'dul bar/ gcig gis de'i rab gnas byed par smon lam btab pas/ smon lam mtha' btsan pa'o/ / der rgyal bo khri srong gis/ ru pad 'byung o rgyan na bzhugs pa las/sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ 'chims shākya pra bha/ shud pu dpal gyi seng ge/ gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra bzhi spyan 'dren du btang ba las/ ru pad 'byung gi thugs la shar nas/ sdun bsur byon pa las/ gtsang kha la la thog tu mjal/ nga yin no gsungs nas/ spyan 'dren mi bzhi bo dga' nas bsnyun smed pa/ kye/ mi las lhar gyur rdo rje 'chang gi sku/ /'gro ba'i dpal gyur khams gsum sa ler mkhyen/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes khyed sku ma bsnyel tam/ /byas pas/ rus lan du/ bsgom du med pa'i chos nyid zab mo la/ /brjod du med pa'i smra bsam yul las 'das/ /bzung du med pa'i phyag rgya lus la rdzogs/ /sku gsung thugs ldan bde ba chen po'i ngang / /gsungs so/ /de'i dus brtan ma bcu gnyis na re/ ru 'di bod du song na bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad dam la btags nas bran du khol du yong bas/ da lta lung pa kha srubs nas bsad zer thog ser phab pas/ ru'i dbu zhwa'i steng du sol dum bcu gnyis su song / rus mkhyen te ri bo'i zom la byon nas/ srid pa'i ma mo mu tsa ma bros pa ded pas/ gnam mtsho phyug mo la bros pas/ rus sems can gzhan la mi gnod/ mo la gnod pa'i sngags phur par btab nas 'phangs bas/ mtsho lan gsum khol nas rus pa dkar zad byung bas/ gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu sgron du ming btags/ srog snying phul/bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis su bkod do/ / de nas kha la rong sgor slebs tsa na/brag dmar srin po'i phyag brnyan la bdud dmag dpon sgrol ging / 'bar nag sha za nag po/ gu lang nag po/ khu le lag dgu/ 'dzam gling skyes gcig la sogs pas bsus nas/— 110 —

rgu/ /phur 'grel 'bum nag cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pa dang / rus phyag rgyas bsdams te gzir bas/ thams cad kyis srog gi snying po phul nas dam la btags so/ /de nas la stod byang nas mar byon pas/ brag zang zing dang mtsho mo 'khun 'khun bya ba'i klus ma bzod de/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan/ru'i chibs brkus pas/ rus ser ba phab pas ser ba rta'i mgo tsam byung nas/ srog snying phul lo/ / de nas stod lung du byon pa dang / thang lhas cho 'phrul bstan pas/ rus rdo rje brgyab pas sked pa skyog song bas gangs kyang skyog por yod do/ /ru'i gur dkar la thang lhas thog phab pas/ yar la log gin zhur zhur song bas na yar zhur zhes bya'o/ / yang rus gangs la ting nge 'dzin gyi me sbar bas/ g.ya' nag lhang lhang zhu bas kyang thang lhas yar zhur ro/ /de'i nangs par thang lha khye'u chung ral pa can zhig tu byas nas/ bdag ni dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa zhes kyang bgyi/ gnyan chen thang lha zhes kyang bgyi bas srog snying phul/ gro dang gser phye bre gang phul lo/ / de nas stod lung gzhong par mthu chu bton gyin bro btab bo/ /de nas klu ma dros gzi chen gyis bsdos pas ma thub ste/ gro dang gser phye bre gang phul/srog snying phul nas 'jus so/ /gzhan yang gnam mtsho phyug mo'i khar bdud po nyi khri chig stong btul/ de rnams kyi nang nas gza' mig dmar la sogs pa bzhi/ btsan zla ba gdong la sogs pa bzhi/ klu rdo rje thod dkar la sogs pa bzhi/ re sde 'gong yag la sogs pa bzhi/rgyal po 'od lha dkar po la sogs pa bzhi/ rdo rje legs pa la sogs pa bzhi/ de rnams rdo rje phur pa'i srung mar bkod do/ /tha ma ji ltar bsam yas bzhengs pa ni/ de nas bsam yas su slebs pa dang / rgyal po dang / ru gnyis phyag la 'khangs pas/ rus rgyal po'i phyag 'khar la phyag gcig mdzad pas dum bu brgyar song bas/ der rgyal pos phyag byas so/ / de nas rtsig pa'i gseb tu bzlas yungs gtor bas me 'bar ro/ /de yang rgyal po pe dkar 'di klu tsha gza' ma ti bya ba yin pas/ sa gzhi thams cad zhang po klus dbang ba la/ mis 'phrog pa la ma bzod nas 'khor the'u rang stong sde bshig tu btang bas/ der phyin pas me 'bar nas 'gong po spun dgu la rje cig lags/ gzhig pa'i brlag mi gda'/ 'du 'phro me ltar 'bar/ tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrig cing gda' zer ro/ / der 'gong po spun dgus kyang bshig tu phyin pas/ me 'bar te pe dkar la sngar ltar brer ro/ /der pe dkar rang gis phyin pas kyang me 'bar te ma shigs pas/ 'di ci las gyur snyam pa dang / de ring gi mon bu a tsar+ya de yin snyam nas sngags ci zlos sam snyam ste nyan du phyin pas/ rus mkhyen te nyan pa'i rna ba la phur pa zhig btab pas rna 'on/ lta ba'i mig la phur pa zhig btab pas mig long / rkang — 111 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/pa la phur pa zhig btab pas rkang pa zha nas der 'gong po spun dgus kyang khyogs la btegs nas song ngo / / der khos zhang po klu la sa gzhi thams cad mon bu a tsa ras phrogs/ nga'ang 'di ltar btang nas/ da khyod sdod dam byas pas/ klu rnams las dbang ma dros pa che bas/nged kyis kha ning dus sa gzhi dang srog snying phul ba yin no/ / da khyod rang yang skyabs su songs zer te/ der rgyal po pe dkar gyis kyang srog snying phul/ g.yog tu khas blangs so/ /der lha ma srin thams cad rus dam la btags pas/ lha 'dre thams cad kyis bsam yas kyi brtsigs grogs byas pa ni/ nyin mo mis brtsigs pa las/ nub mo lha 'dres brtsigs pa mtho bar byung ngo / /phub kyi dus tsa na seng ldeng gi gdung mgo la btsugs nas skyel ba mang du byung /lcags bzo'i dus na lcags nag tshugs pa ru khur nas skyel ba byung / sprul ba'i lha bzo ba mang du byung / de ltar dpal gyi bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa dang / nu bo dhi sa twa spyan drangs nas pad 'byung dang gnyis kyis rab gnas mdzad pas/ rus bskor ba mdzad pa'i dus su/lha thams cad rgyab yol dang gdan khri bzhag nas/ ru'i rjes nas bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/ rang rang gi gdan khri la 'khod do skad/ zangs kyi khyi mo la rgya nag tu thos pa'i skad byung / de nas rgyal po la sogs pa rnams la gsang sngags mang du gnang / lha srin gdug pa can thams cad ni btul/ bod khams thams cad bde ba la bkod/ 'brug lo dbyar zla ra ba'i ngo la/ ban gzhis ni zla phyed gnyis kyi sngon du btang / tshes bcu'i nyin mo btsan po rje 'bangs brgya lhag tsam zhig gis zhal gyi da tshal du bskyal te mkhan po'i gur nang du rje 'bangs rim pa nyi shus zhabs spyi bor blangs te phyag byas pas dgyes te/ bstan bcos dang mdzangs yig mang du gsungs/ mgur mang po bzhengs/ de nas rje 'bangs rnams mar log go /las stabs tshar ro/ /gsum pa mthar ji ltar brgyud lugs la gnyis te/ grub thob kyi brgyud pa dang /gang zag phal ba'i brgyud pa'o/ / dang po ni/ ngam 'bre gsal le/ cog ro bza' dpal gyi mchod gnas ma/ mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gsum nu'i phyag phyi byas nas 'brangs so/ /ru'i zhal nas/ khyed rnams mar log gsungs pas/ dngos cag phyag phyir 'brang byas pas/ru'i zhal nas/ nga gnam la bya ltar 'phur nas 'gro na khyed rnams kyis 'ong ngam/ sa la byi ltar 'dzul nas 'gro na khyed kyis 'ong ngam/ chu la nya ltar 'phyo nas 'gro na khyed kyis 'ong ngam/nga lho nub srin po'i kha gnon la 'gro ba yin gsungs so/ / 'o na bdag cag la yang dag pa'i gdams ngas/ zhu byas pas/ de la dbang bskur dgos gsungs/ 'o na dbang yang bskur — 112 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagabar zhu byas pas/ de ma thag tu hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ gsungs pa dang / ye shes kyi dal gsum dngos su byung ngo / / der ru'i zhal nas khyed rnams ye shes lha la dbang zhu'am/ nga la dbang zhu gsungs/ der cog ro bza' na re/ ru las bka' gnyan cing drin che ba ma mchis kyang /ye shes kyi lha dngos su byon pa 'di la bdag ni ye shes kyi lha la dbang zhu zer/ mkhar chen bza' na re/ ye shes kyi lha dngos su byon yang ru'i cho 'phrul lags pas/ bdag ni ru las dbang zhu zer/ ngam 'bre na re/ ru'i thugs dgongs dang sbyar ba zhig zhu zer/ der rus saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ byas te dal gsum thugs kar bsdus bas/ cog ro bza' la dbang bskur mkhan ma byung ste/ phyi bon stabs su bshad/ gyer shas che/ mthu ni byung / bkra yang shis/ phur pa lcam lugs bya bar grags so/ / de nas mkhar chen bza' dang ngam 'bre gnyis ka la ru'i dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur/ dbang chos zhu ba'i skabs su mkhar chen bzas zhus don bzhi zhus pa ni/ dngos cag bud med kyi lus 'di blo dman pas tshig nyung la don du 'dril ba zhig zhu/ dngos cag bud med kyi lus 'di nyon mongs pa che bas nyon mongs pa 'dul ba zhig zhu/ dngos cag bud med kyi lus 'di bya ba che bas/ grub thag nye ba 'i chos zhig zhu/ dngos cag bud med kyi lus 'di khas nyen pas mthu che ba'i chos zhig zhu/ zhes zhus pas/ ru dang po dbang zhu ba la mnyes/ de nas gdams pa zhu ba la mnyes te/ sder(der)sgrub sde chen po brgyad la thugs dgongs btang bas/ de bzhi ka phur pa rtsa ba 'di la tshang 'dug ste/ ru'i zhal nas gsang sngags zab mo 'di chig brgyud yin pas ngas khyod la bshad do/ /khyod kyis ngam 'bre la shod gsungs so(lung skor shākya pra bha la gnang / mdo skor shud bu dpal gyi seng ge la/ gsang skor rdo rje bdud 'joms la/ rtsa skor jo mo la/ 'di lho rgyud dang byang rgyud gnyis/ de la mi nub rgyal ba'i snying po/ lo ston dpal gyi blo gros/ 'bre klu yi rgyal mtshan sogs kyi bar/ mchan)/ / de nas ru pad 'byung des spa gro stag tshang seng ge phug nas tshes bco lnga'i nyin la kha na tse re re ba la khad kyis gshegs pa la slad kyi dris pas mang yul du'ang nyi ma la kha na tse re re ba la byon nas gda' skad/ bal mo shākyas 'bras skyems dang / bu ram gyi zhal zas drangs/ dar men gyi na bza' phul nas bzhugs par zhu ba phul bas ma gnang bar rnga yab kyi gling du srin po 'dul du gshegs so/ / lo brgya brgya na khye'u lo brgyad pa rer 'gyur gyin bzhugs/ yang rab tu byung / dge tshularnadang dge slong gi sdom pa rdzogs pa dang lo brgya bzhugs/ yang khye'u lo brgyad par gyur gyin da lta'ang de kha ltar bzhugs so/ / de ltar grub thob chen po de'i slob ma thams cad kyang grub pa thob pa ste/ mkhar chen bzas mchims phu'i gnas la me shor ba la phur pa btab pas me shi nas nags tshal skyes/ mkhar chen dpal gyi — 113 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/dbang phyug gis spyang ki sngon po la bzlas nyung brgyab pas snying shun khud du byung / sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis 'on 'jang gdong gi brag la phur pa btab pas 'dam du bying bzhin song / gnyags kyis ya gtsang gi gtsang po la phur pa btab pas/ chu chad gram pa skya skyog song / ngam 'bre gsal les tshe lo stong thub ste gsang spyod la byon pa dang / dpal chu bo rir lang lab byang chub rdo rje pha spun bco brgyad dgrar langs pa dang mjal bas sdug gtam btang bas/ ngam 'bres rdo rje phur pa ji lta ba bshad do/ / lang lab kyis gsang spyod du bsgrubs pas/ nub gcig na rmi lam du shing sdong po bco brgyad la bcu bdun sta gris bcad/gcig la sta kham gcig rgyab pa dang gnyid sad pas pha spun rnams kyis lang lab kyis nged la mthu gtong ba 'dug pas bsad pa dga' zer nas/ khyim zhig tu ra gcig bsad/ de'i dmar la bsdus pa las/ spun gzhon pa zhig gis chu 'chur phyin pa dang tshur log pa'i rkang pa ya gcig them pa'i nang du chud pa la/ khyim rdib nas bcu bdun shi/ gcig gi rkang pa chag ste mthu bo cher grags so/ / grub pa thob bo/ / de nas lang lab byang chub rdo rje la thugs kyi sras bzhi bya ba slob ma bzhi byung ste/ dang po nyang ber sngon can bya ba byung ste/ de'ang gtsang du mu gecebyung nas/ lang lab kyis jo mo dang bcas te dbus su phyin pas/ nyang gis lang lab la bshos drangs/ jo mo la rgyags gtad do/ /ston yul du byon pas mi mang po shi 'dug pas nyang la drin lan du gdams pa sbyin no byas pas nyang gis jo mo brid nas dpe rkun byas 'dug pas/ der lang lab thugs khros te/ lang lab byang chub rdo rjes cis kyang ma lan/ltog pas lan gsungs nas/ jo mo zla la ma btsud/ dre'u la dpe cha bkal nas 'ongs pas/jo mo khrag skyugs nas shi/ nyang bred de nam kyang 'chi snyam nas nor rdzas thams cad ru la phul nas kho ma shi/ zhal 'dres ma gnang bar yig chung du bris kyin byin pas/ phur pa yig chung can bya ba byung ste/ gser 'grel/ dngul 'grel/ dgongs 'grel/ sin dhar tha/'phyang drug la hom bu sgril bsreg pa'i 'phyang / bhad+dhā mu kha mnan pa'i 'phyang / skyer mda' ser po zor gyi 'phyang / a yudzñā na tshe yi 'phyang / srog thig dmar po sngags kyi 'phyang / tsa ra rog po bzlog pa'i 'phyang / mi bzad pa'i phur pa drug ging bzhi/ dam can mo gsum rnams gnang ngo / / mthu ni byung bkra ni mi shis zer ro/ / de nas(dbang gi shes rab/mchan)skyi gyang 'gyel bya ba pha spun bco lnga dgrar langs pa'i sdug gtam btang bas/ skyi la ngan sngags kyi lugs su bslabs te/ stod kyi las la gdeng gsum gces/ / smad kyi las la gzer brgyad gces/ / zhes bya ba snying gzer che 'bring chung gsum/ khong gzer che 'bring — 114 —

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagachung gsum/ dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig gi spyi sgrub dang sgos sgrub rnams byin te/ skyis bsgrubs pas rtags kyang ma byung ste/ yi mug nas phug nas thon pa dang / sngar med pa'i se phung zhig sgo rtsa na skyes 'dug pa gcig bcad de/ phur pa gcig bzhog cing yul du phyin pas/pha spun bco lnga po gcig kyang ma yal bar gyang phag na pho le byed cing 'dug pas/ tshig pa zos te gyang la phur pa btab pas gyang 'gyel te/ thibs 'og tu shi bas skyi gyang 'gyel bya ba mthu bo cher grags so/ / yang sprang phur mgo bya ba zhabs tog che la shes rab chung ba zhig byung ste/ de la phur pa nor bu lugs bya ba('dus pa bzhi skor yang zer/ mchan)stod kyi las tho bcu gsum gyis nor bu lugs su 'ching ba/ smad kyi bsad pa'i phur pa drug gi 'dren pa/ dam can mo gsum gyis sgrub pa rnams gnang bas/ mthu byung bkra yang shis/ phur pa sprang lugs bya bar grags so/ / yang lang lab bgres khar sna nam shes rab tshul khrims bya ba zhabs tog dang shes rab che ba zhig byung / de la khyad par bsnyin pa dang / nye bar bsnyen pa dang /sgrub pa dang / sgrub pa chen po bzhir dril nas/ lha 'dzab la brten te bla na med pa'i byang chung skrub pa dang / dgra 'dzub la brten te dgra bgegs tshar bcad pa dang / stod las dang / smad las dang / dbang dang dngos grub blang ba la brten te dbang bskur gyi gdams pa dang / tshe lung khrus lung la brten te tshe'i cho ga dang / rdo rje me dbal snying sreg la brten nas sbyin sreg gi gdams pa/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig la brten nas bam sgrub kyi gdams ngag rta mchog rol ba la brten nas rta mgrin klu 'dul gyi gdams pa/phrin las bzhi'i tsha tsha dang / phur bu'i rgyud bzhi la brten nas gang zag rnam pa bzhi mthar dbyung ba la sogs nyung la kha tshar tshang ba gnang ngo / / de yan chad grub thob kyi brgyud pa byung ngo / /gang zag gi brgyud pa ni/ sna nam shes rab tshul khrims la/ slob ma mang yang thugs zin gyi slob ma bzhi sras gnyis te drug byung ngo / / de yang gtsang ston rin chen blo gros la rnam gsum srog gi 'khor lo bshad/ blo gros kyis phur pa'i lha khang zhig kyang bzhengs/ phur pa gtsang lugs bya bar grags so/ / g.ya' theng la dha ti bshad/ so ring la 'dus pa bshad/zur chung shes rab grags la btu yig bshad/ sras gnyis po la thams cad bshad/ yang rgya ston sangs rgyas la bshad/ des gtsang ston rin chen blo gros la bshad/ des gtsang ston tshul khrims la bshad(bka'i khye'u chung myang nad la dha ti che 'bring du gnang / slob brgyud sras brgyud gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyung po shes rab/ khyung po grags seng / ru shes rab ston/ ru ya gam/ rnal 'byor 'dus pa/ skog pa'i cho lo ston pa'i bar zhal gzigs brgyud pa'o/ / mchan)/ des gtsang ston ye shes rin chen la bshad/ des gtsang ston 'od zer la bshad/ des 'ba' ra rgyal — 115 da

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/mtshan la bshad/ des gtsang ston dbang sornal bshad/ des 'jam dpal la bshad/des dgra 'dul la bshad/ des slob dpon grags pa la bshad/ des gtsang ston shes rab seng ge la bshad/ des 'bro ston la gnang / ru'i gleng gzhi tshar ro/ /gnyis pa ston pa'i gleng gzhi la gsum ste/ gdul bya khyad par can de la 'dul byed khyad par can gang gis/ 'dul thabs khyad par can ci ltar btul zhe na/ de yang gdul bya ji ltar byung tshul ni/ phur pa myang 'das kyi rgyud las/ karma he ru kas khrag 'thung chen po la zhus pa/ srin po ru tra gdug pa 'di/ /rgyu dang rkyen ni ci las byung / /'bras bu gang du smin par 'gyur/ / las skal spyod pa ci zhig byed/ / ma btul ba yi skyon ni ci/ / btul na yon tan ci zhig thob/ / ces zhus pa dang / khrag 'thung rdo rjes bka' stsal ba/ / log pa'i sems can chen po 'di/ / dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu las byung / / rkyen ni bla ma spangs pa'o/ /'bras bu nyon mongs lnga ru smin/ /las skal chags sdang spyod pa zhen/ /ma btul lha mi'i srid pa brlag/ / sangs rgyas zhing yang stongs par byed/ / btul na yon tan dpag med de/ /dug gsum rtsad gcod 'khor dong sprug /ces bshad do/ /rtsa ba rdo rje khros pa'i rgyud las kyang bshad do/ / de'i don mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ sngon 'das pa'i dus bskal ba kun nas bkod pa zhes bya ba la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sngon byung zhes bya ba'i bstan pa la/ khyim bdag ke'u ka'i bu thar ba nag po zhes bya ba la/ g.yog dan 'bag ces bya ba dang gnyis byung ngo / / de'i dus su dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu zhes bya ba/sku nyan thos/ gsung mdo sde/ thugs gsang sngags la spyod pa zhig byung ngo / /thar ba nag pos/ dge slong gi drung du phyin te smras pa/ nyon mongs pa lnga ma spangs par spyad pas grol ba'i chos zhig yod dam med byas pas/ dge slong gis gsang sngags la dgongs te yod rung byas pas/ thar nag na re/ kho'ang khyod kyi rjes su 'brang zer ro/ / de nas g.yog dan 'bag khrid de zhus pas/ dge slong gis smras pa/ ji ltar de nyid ma bcos na/ /dngos po bzhi la spyad byas kyang / / nam mkha' la ni sprin bzhin te/ / 'di ni rnal 'byor dam pa'i lam/ /zhes bshad pa/ dgongs pa ma shes te/ thar nag gis gsang sngags sgra ji bzhin par spyad do/ / g.yog dan 'bag gis dgongs pa can du spyad pas ma nor ro/ / der dan 'bag gis thar nag gis nor ro byas pas/ 'o na ru la thug zer te thug pas/ dge slong thub dkas dgongs pa can no byas pas thar nag khros te/ dge slong thub dka' yul phyung ngo / /gnod pa byas te 'tsho ba phrogs so/ / kho rang gis dngos po bzhi la spyad do/ / de'i skye — 116 ge

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagab phyi ma las spyang kir lan lnga brgya skyes so/ / de'i phyi ma la 'phar ba lag sdebs dang / ce spyang sngon po dang / gcan gzan rnams su lan lnga brgya lnga brgyar skyes so/ / kho rang yang gnyen po re res bsad do/ /de nas 'bu sbur dang / yi dwags dang / dmyal ba rnams su skyes shing rgyud sbyangs so/ / mjug tu ri ma la ya'i drung du smad 'tshong ma zhig gi bur skyes te/kho yan lag rag pas ma de bu gar shi'o/ / mi rnams kyis ma'i ro dang bu gnyis ka dur khrod du bskyal lo/ /bus ro'i 'o ma 'thung / de nas chu ser 'jibs/ de nas nu ma zos pas zhag bdun phyid do/ / de nas brang phug ste glo snying zos so/ / de nas phyi sha zos so/ / ma'i bub zad pa dang / gog shes par song ste/ ro gzhan tsho zos pas/ lus la spu khab 'dra ba skyes/sder sen lcags kyu 'dra ba byung / rgyab nas gshog pa skyes te 'phur shes pas steng 'og thams cad kyi sems can thams cad bsad cing zos/ ru dra ma tram̐ ru ma tra zer zhing nga las dbang che su yod zer/ lha'i rgyal po ma tram̐ ka nu yod zer nas der phyin te kha nas me dbal btang nas bsad do/ / de'i chung ma'ang phrogs so/ / lha ma srin sde brgyad dang / sing ha skru rī phyogs skyong bcu/ dbang phyug ma thams cad dbang du bsdus so/ /de'i tshe sems can thams cad log lta skyes te/ rgyud las/ bdag nyid chen po rtag pa yis/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab la/ /'gro ba'i tshul du sngon byung ba'i/ /de tshe sems can thams cad ni/ /'o dod 'bod cing ltung bar 'gyur/ / zhes bshad do/ / de ni gdul bya'o/ / gnyis pa 'dul byed khyad par can ji ltar byung na/ de'i tshe karma he ru kas dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bskul te/ 'og min du bka' bgros te sems can thams cad kyi don du ru tra 'dul bar byas pas/ ru tra de bam ri thod mkhar gyi nang na/ bam chen gyi steng na/ srin mo kro dhi shwa rī dang 'dod pa la rol cing / bdud dang srin po lha ma srin gyis bskor/ phyi na rak+ta'i rgya mtsho dang / keng rus kyi ri rab kyis bskor yod pa la/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pas ye shes kyi sprin dmar nag tu gtibs/ thugs rje chen po'i 'brug sgra bsgrags/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan phyar te/ phrin las bzhi las dang po zhi bas 'dul bar dgongs te/ sprul sku dbu zlum dang / zhabs rjen/ lhung bzed/ gseg shang can mang du sprul pas/ thar nag na re/ go'u ta ma khyod rang gi dka' thub la nos shig ltog na zas zo/ / skom na chu grang 'thung brer ro/ / se gol gtogs nas song ngo / / 'od srung gser thub rnams kyang 'gre'o/ / yang bud+dhā rnams kyis bka' bgros pa la/ shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo la/ /khro bor da 117 da

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/de bzhin gshegs kun mdzod/ / khro bo'i tshul can khros pa dang / / 'jig rten gsum dag sreg byed na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad khros pa yis/ /khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos/ /zhes bgros pas/ bud+dhā thams cad thugs rje chen pos khros te/ rdo rje rta'i tshogs la bka' bsgo ba/ song song lo ka na srin po 'khor bcas sems can gyi ling byed pa thul cig ces bsgo bas/ rta'i dbyangs sgrog cing song bas 'khor rnams bred de/ ru tra na re/ mgrin bu ltogs na ri gsum rtsa zo/ skom na lung gsum chu 'thung zer ro/ / rdo rje rtas rta bro byas pas ru tra khyur du mid do/ / rta mgrin gyis lus brgyangs pas skad ngan thon te rta mgrin spyi bo nas 'thon no/ / de nas gshin rje'i gshed btang bas/ nu tra na re/ gsus po che sems khral skyungs zer ro/ /de ltarakhro bo rim gyis btang bas ma thul lo/ /gsum pa 'dul thabs khyad par can ni/ yang dus gsum gyi bud+dhā thams cad bka' bgros te/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed la dgongs te de thabs kyis 'dul dgongs pas bka' stsal pa rdo rje rta'i tshogs la/ ru tra 'khor bcas ling la song ba'i dus/ ri ma la yar so tshugs shig ces bsgos/ yum bzhi dang bcas te so btsugs so/ /ru tra'i pho brang thod mkhar gyi nang na/ bam chen gyi khri steng na srin mo kro dhī shwa ri yod pa las/ dus gsum gyi budha thams cad kyi sprul pa gcig tu bsdus te/ru tra thar pa nag por sprul te/ srin mo'i krodhi shwa ri can du phyin pas/ sgeg po dpa' bo byon nam zer te/ 'khor ba smin pa'i dung phor du/ nyon mongs pa'i gar chang gis bkang nas drangs pas de gsol te/ gzhan yang rak+ta'i rgya mtsho yang 'thung / sha chen gyi lang ling zos/rus chen gyi khral khrol 'chos so/ / srin mos bltas pas/ rang gi khyo bas bzhin bzang ba mthong ste the tshom skyes pa dang / sprul pas srin skad bsgrags pa dang yid ches te/ ma chags thabs kyi sbyor ba mdzad/ srin mo'i lhums su zla dal la byang sems hūṃ du phab ste bzhag go /sprul pa gzhan yang bkyes/ dbang phyug ma sring mo byi mo thams cad la sbyor ba byas te bzhag go/sprul pa srin mo'i 'dod pa'i rgya mtsho las ma thar ro/ / rdo rje rtas ru tra 'ong ba'i mtshan ma mthong ste/ rdo rje rta'i 'dur glus sbran no/ /dus gsum bud+dhā'i sprul pa de dbyings kyi ngang du mi dmigs par gyur to/ / de nas srin po ru tras rang gi gnas su 'ong bas/ nyams mi dga' skyi g.ya' 'jigs te smras pa/ e ma su 'ong zhes smras pa/ srin mos bsus nas sgeg po dpa' bo de lta bu'i tshig ngan pa ma gsung / khyod kyi dgongs pa bdag gis bsgrubs te/lhums na'ang gdung 'tshob pa mchis so/ /zhes brjod pas/ kho yid ches te chags pas sbyor ba byas so/ / de nas zla ba rim gyis tshang ba dang / 'khor gtum mo dang / srin mo rnams ge 118 —

༄khya/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagal la phag gi mgo can dang / dom gyi mgo can la sogs pa ltas ngan mang po skyes so/ / ru tras srin mo kro dhī shwa dī la bu ston byas pas/ rdo rje gzhon nu dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa rdo rje'i gshog pas bar snang khyab pa kyi la ya'i sgra dang bcas pa skyes pas ru tra 'khor dang bcas pa rnam brgyal lo/ / kha nas khrag sgyugs so/ / rdo rje khros pa'i rtsa rgyud las/ khro tshul chen po rab tu khros pa mthong pa yis/ /skad cig tsam la ru tra dngangs shing skrag /phyogs bcu kun tu 'bros pa'i tshul kyang bstan/ / sdug bsngal chen po de yi dus su myang / / zhes so/ / de nas brgyal ba bsangs pa dang / ru tra langs te 'khor rnams bos nas/ dbang phyug nga yi phru ma la/ / gang phyir gdug pa chen po skyes/ / khyed kyis brlag pa'i dus la bab/ / dam tshig gang la bsrung mi bsrung / /yongs su rtog pa de dag med kyang sla/ /de 'dra'i dam tshig sgyu ma yin pas na/ /de la dam tshig su zhes zer/ /zhes mang du brjod pa dang / bdud kyi dmag dpung ni gtibs/ bdud kyi ru mtshon ni phyar/ bsro dang cha'i sgra sgrogs shing byung bas/ nu tra dbu gsum phyag drug tu byas te rtsol lo/ / yang rdo rje gzhon nu'i ba spu'i bu ga nas de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spros te ngag phrogs te lce bcad pas khrag gi bol ba ltar gyur to/ /yang ru tras dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad par sprul ba dang / rdo rje gzhon nu dbu stong phyag stong du sprul te dbu dgu pa ba spu'i bu ga nas bkye'o/ / khro bo bcur sprul bas/ phyogs skyong bcu gdan du bting ngo / / rdo rje gzhon nu'i spyi gtsug nas ha sa ya ra hri ta na ya thon/ ru tra'i spyi gtsug tu zhugs pa dang / ru tra 'go ba'i lha dang bral/ gab pa'i sngags drug thim pas ru tra'i lus gangs ri'i rgyud chad pa ltar du 'gyel lo/ /bdud kyi 'khor rnams kyang byer ro/ / dus der rdo rje gzhon nu la dus gsum gyi bud+dhā rnams kyis rdo rje srin po'i dur dbyangs kyis bstod do/ /rdo rje rta'i tshogs kyis rta'i rngam dbyangs kyis dpa' bkod do/ /dus der rdo rje gzhon nus kho'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga phrogs te/ kho rang la thur mar btsugs te/ a la la ho gsungs nas/ zhal du gsol nas khyur mid mdzad de phyal du sbyang ngo / / skye ba grangs med pa'i lus blangs pa ni dran/ las dge sdig mi bslu ba ni rig dus der ru tras smre bshags brjod do/ / de nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i 'doms nas bton te sngun du bzhag nas/ spyo ba brgyad kyis spyos so/ / 'khor sde brgyad kyis kyang bshags pa re byas kyin rang rang gi mgo bcad de phul lo/ / ru tras smras pa/ kye/ 'doms nas bton pa thugs rje chung / /'bangs su mchi'o gtsigs ma chung / /bka' las 'das na tshig par 'gyur/ /ma dang srin mo bran mo rnams/ /'bangs su 'bul lo bka' la thog /dbus su mchis skal mi ldan gyi+o/ /— 119 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/'bar ba'i dal gyi mtha' la zhog / phud la 'tshal skal mi ldan gyi/ / lhag ma kha phru'i bran la stsol/ / ces so/ / rtsa rgyud las/ ru tra ma rungs de yi dus su btul/ / khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gzhon nu la/ / gzugs kyi phung po gdan du rab tu bting / / rna ba'i dbang pos zhi ba'i chos kyang nyan/ /yid ni 'gyod pas smre bshags mang du byas/ /zhes pas ru tra gtso bo'i gdan du bting / 'khor rnams kyis phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa pho kha sbubs/ mo gan rkyal byin pa 'khril bar gdan du bting / rna bas chos nyan no/ / de nas ru tra 'di ma ha ka lar byas te sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa bsrung nas/ 'og phyogs kyi 'jig rten rnam par rol ba'i zhing khams su rdo rje rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po zhes bya bar sangs rgya bar lung bstan to/ / r+ghaṃ zhes brjod pas kho'i thod mkhar de rdo rje phur pa'i gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas phur pa'i lha tshogs thams cad de ltar du byung ste/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed la dgongs par bshad pa'o/ /ston pa'i gleng gzhi tshar ro/ /gsum pa rgyud kyi gleng gzhi la gsum ste/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di dus nam byung ba dang / chos thams cad theg dgur ji ltar bsdu ba dang / rdo rje phur ba'i rgyud sde 'di rnams theg pa gsum gang du gtogs pa dang rnam pa gsum mo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ston pas ji ltar gsungs tshul dang / mi yul du dus nam byung ba'o/ /dang po phyi rgyud sde gnyis las/ kri ya ni/ sprul sku shāka thub kyis gsungs pa/ yo ga ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud rnams ni ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis chos 'byung yangs pa'i gnas su gsungs pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni mi yul du dus ni nam byung ba la gnyis te/ kha cig na re/ bud+dhā mya ngan las 'das khar lung bstan pa/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgyad dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying bo dam pa zhig/'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri las byung / /lag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs kyis/ / zhes bshad pa las/ lo brgyad dang bcu gnyis na rgyal po dzaḥ'i yul du byung ste/ rgyal po'i rmi lam du phyogs thams cad du 'od kyis gang ba dang / rin po che'i glegs bam rang babs su rmis nas gnyid sad pa dang bltas pas 'dug ste/ ma shes pas ḍā ki nī la gtad/ ḍā ki nī'i ke tshang nas klu sgrub la sogs pas rim gyis spyan drangs zer ro/ /kha cig na re/ dpal ri'i phug nas ku ku ri pa yod pas des shes snyam zhus pas/ ru'i bsam pa/ rgyal po gtum pas gal te ma shes na chad pas gcod srid pas/ sngon la lta rtogs bya yi gsungs nas byas pas/ kha cig ma shes te/ de'i nang nas rdo rje sems dpa'i — 120 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagasgrub thabs shig byung nas bsgrubs pas zhal mthong ste/ des po ti rnams bshad pas de nas byung ngo zer ro/ /rang gzhung ni rgyud sde rnams nas/ sprul sku shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'da' khar/ rigs can lnga ma gtogs slob ma rnams 'dus pas/ de'i nang nas rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po kuñdza ras zhus pas/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa sde snod gsum po gsungs kyang /'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa ma gsungs par mya ngan las 'da' 'am/ gdung gsob pa'i skyes bu su 'ong zhes pa la sogs pa zhus pas/ bud+dhā'i zhal nas the tshom zhu ba legs so/ /de kho na nyid nges pa'i theg pa gsang sngab/sa chen po ste/ gnas skabs gnyis dang bcur 'byung ste/ gang zhe na/ rmongs pa gdung ba sel ba na'ang 'byung / gang sgron ma yongs su bkod pa na'ang 'byung / gang gi nyes pa rnyed pa na'ang 'byung / snying bo byang chub tu nges pa na'ang 'byung / dgongs pa nges par 'grel ba na'ang 'byung / gdul bya thabs la bab pa na'ang 'byung / byin rlabs gnang ba na'ang 'byung / brgyud pa thams cad grags pa na'ang 'byung / gang gis ched du mdzad pa na'ang 'byung / lung chen nges par bstan pa na'ang 'byung / las rgyun yongs su gcod pa na'ang 'byung / dgongs pa rnam par 'gro ba na'ang 'byung / thams cad nas thams cad du 'byung ngo / / kun tu snang bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /gdung 'tshob skyes bu phyag na rdo rje 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs nas mya ngan 'das par gyur to/ / de nas lo brgyad dang bcu gnyis 'das pa dang / dam pa'i rigs can lnga nang du yang dag 'jog las langs te/ bud+dhā 'das pa la ngus nas/ ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtser 'dus te/ kha gnam du bltas nas mgrin gcig tu smras pa/e ma kyi hud e ma klong / ye shes kyi sgron me nub pas mun pa gang gis sel/ ston pa 'das nas bdud dang mu stegs su yis 'dul/ nges don gsang sngags dus nam 'byung / rin thang med pa'i rin po che dug dang nam brje/ bud+dhā'i bstan pa nam 'byung / ci tsam gnas/tha ma gar nub 'gro/ mya ngan 'das nas gar gshegs/ gang du bzhugs/ 'jig rten mgon med rnams kyi mgon skyabs sus byed/ gdung 'tshob sus byed ces pa la sogs pa gdung ba nyi shu rtsa lnga bton to/ /gdung ba de rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyis gsan nas/ gsang bdag phyag rdor la gdung ba sel bar bskul bas/ phyag rdor gyis ri ma la ya'i rtser byon no/ /rigs can lnga po ngo mtshar skyes te/ su yi pha gang ma gang yul gang yin dris pas/smras pa/ nga ni mi 'khrugs rdo rje yin/ /stong pa chen po nga yi yul/ /rdo rje rigs chen nga yi gdung / / pha ni thabs mchog dpag tu med/ / ma ni shes rab brjod las 'das/ / thog ge 121 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/ma med pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /nga yi yid bzhin nor bu stor/ /nor bu rin chen bdud rtsi de/ /yod pa ma dran stor ba tshor/ / thar med nad kyis gzir gyur cing / /mun pa mun nag smag tu 'khyams/ /bshes gnyen dam pa zhig gis bstan/ /nor bu rin chen rtsad bcad pas/ /gzhan las ma rnyed rang las rnyed/ /rnyed pa nyid na rnyed med de/ /stor ba nyid la stor bral med/ / shes pa rnyed btags ma shes la/ / stor zhes tha snyad btags par zad/ / 'dir 'gros gsal bar bshad byas pas/ / lha dang mi yi rig 'dzin las/ / rim par brgyud de grags par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / yang zhus pa/ sngar gyi gdung ba bsal du gsol/ /byas pas/ gsang bdag gis bka' stsal ba/ ye shes sgron me nub kyis gdung ba la/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'/ /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te/ /ma rig smin mdzad 'dul ba na/ /le lo can la phan gdags phyir/ /byung nas mya ngan 'da' bar ston/ /sems nyid 'od gsal mun pa sel/ / zhes so/ / bdud dang mu stegs sus 'dul la/ /gang dag gdug pa ma rungs pa/ / bdag med stong pa'i stobs kyis 'dul/ / zhes so/ /gsang sngags nam 'byung la/ gsang sngags gdul bya'i snod las 'byung / btsong na ci nyes la/ dug dang bdud rtsi brje ba ni/ /gnyis ka phung byed brlag par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bstan pa gar 'byung gar nub la/ /dang po skye 'gag med las byung / /tha ma bsdod bral med par 'gyur/ /thog ma tha ma med pas na/ /byung yang snga phyi yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /'di nas gar gshegs gar bzhud la/ / 'di nas de bzhin nyid 'dir gshegs/ / brdal khyab chen po'i zhing na bzhugs/ /sems nyid 'od gsal bstan pa sgrogs/ /zhes so/ /mgon med mgon skyabs sus byed la/ / skye med dbyings kyi ye shes de/ / sems can mgon med skyabs chen yin/ / ces so/ / sangs rgyas kyi gdung 'tshob su 'byung la/ dpag tu med pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /'khor ba'i sems can brgyud las 'byung / /'khor ba'i sems can rgyun chad nas/ /sangs rgyas gdung yang rgyun chad yin/ /sprul pa rang byung rang zhi las/ /de nyid de la nub pa med/ / 'das dang ma 'das gcig nyid de/ / bral dang ma bral ga la yod/ /ces pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs pas bsal lo/ /des na rmongs pa gdung ba sel tsa na'ang gsang sngags 'byung zhes pa'i don no/ / gnyis pa gdul bya thabs la bab tsa na'ang gsang sngags 'byung ste/ ru tra btul tsa na'ang byung bar lung ston pa'i gleng gzhir bstan zin to/ / gsang sngags kyi byung tshul tshar ro/ /gnyis pa chos thams cad theg par rim pa dgur ji ltar bsdu na/ de la gnyis te/— 122 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagasku gsum las bshad tshul dang / theg pa rim pa dgur bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa las/ phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /skye med 'chi ba med pa'i ngang / /spros med bsdu ba med pa'i ngang / / ngang nyid rdo rje'i chos dbyings las/ / chos sku'i byin rlabs longs sku las/ /ston pa'i tshul du nga yis bstan/ /rdo rje'i don dang mi 'gal bar/ /rgyud rnams legs par bshad par bya/ / zhes pas/ dang po chos sku'i ston pa la gsum ste/ston pa ni spros med ye shes so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /zhes so/ /gnas ni chos kyi dbyings te/ ngang nyid rdo rje'i chos dbyings las/ / zhes so/ / 'khor ni rang snang ste/'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /zhes so/ /longs sku la gsum ste/ ston pa ni 'od dang rgyan 'bar ba'o/ /mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba yis/ /zhes so/ /gnas 'og min te/ nam mkha'i dkyil nas zhes so/ / 'khor lo khro bo khro mo ste/ / srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ / zhes so/ /sprul sku la gsum ste/ ston pa ni rdo rje 'chang ngo / /rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod/ /ces so/ / gnas ni bha ga ste/ sku yi dbyig tu bdag bskyed cing / / zhes so/ / 'khor ni rigs drug lhar bskyed pa ste/ srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /zhes so/ /des na longs sprul gnyis kyi rgyud sde gsungs pas na/ dam tshig chen po'ang sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ces so/ / gnyis pa ni/ des na rdo rje khros pa rtsa rgyud las/ gang zag rtag chad bye brag smra/ /'jig rten byis pa skye bo dman/ / gzung bya 'dzin pa'i nyan thos dang / / rang rgyal rang sems 'dzin pa dang / / rgyu 'bras 'gal sgrub byang chub sems/ / yang dag rje ltar kri ya dang / / don dam grogs tshul yo ga dang / / lta spyod gnyis 'dzin u pa ya/ / cha mthun tsam las don dam min/ / mchog gyur rdo rje phur pa 'di/ / sna tshogs sems kyi rnam 'phrul tsam/ /ma hā yo ga'i rgyud las bskyed/ /sems nyid sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la/ /a nu yo ga'i lam ltar bsgom/ /skye med 'gags med spros bral ba'i/ /a ti yo ga'i 'bras bur rdzogs/ /ci phyir thabs dang shes rab dbyings/ /rang byung ye shes yin phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas theg pa dgu ni blo tha ma la gsum/ 'bring la gsum/ rab la gsum ste dgu'o/ /dang po ni/tha ma'i tha ma la nyan thos kyi theg pa/ tha ma'i 'bring la rang rgyal gyi theg pa/ tha ma'i rab la byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'o/ /yang 'bring gi tha ma la kri ya'i theg pa/ 'bring gi 'bring la u pa ya/ 'bring gi rab la yo ga'i theg pa'o/ / yang rab kyi tha ma la rgyud ma hā yo garab kyi 'bring la lung a nu yo ga rab kyi rab la man ngag a ti yo ga ste de ltar dgu'o/ /des na rdo rje phur pa 'di spyod pa ni ma hā yo ga dang mthun/ lta ba ni a ti yo ga ltar rtogs/— 123 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/sgom pa ni a nu yo ga ltar bsgoms pas gol sa med pa'o/ / de yang lung a nu yo ga la rgyud sde dpag tu med kyang / bsdu na thabs kyi rgyud/ shes rab kyi rgyud/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud/ gsang ba spyi rgyud chen po'i rgyud dang bzhir yod pa las/ de yang lha mo mang / mi dmigs pa shas che ste/ shes rab kyi rgyud/ lha pho mang / ma 'gags pa shas che ste/ de thabs kyi rgyud/ lha pho mo gnyis ka ston pa gnyis med rgyud/ lta ba skye med spros bral ston pas phur pa ni thabs shes rab gnyis med rgyud de/ gsang ba spyi rgyud chen po bya ba yin no/ / theg pa dgur bsdu ba tshar ro/gsum pa gar gtogs ngos bzung ba la gnyis te/ drang don dang sbyar ba dang /nges don dang sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'o na rdo rje phur pa 'di rgyud gang nas btus/ mdo gang gis gtan la 'bebs/ lung gang nas bshad/ bla ma'i gdams ngag gang ston zhe na/rgyud rigs pa mchog gi rgyud bikhyot+ta ma la 'bum sde'i nang nas rdo rje rigs kyi le'u phyung ba yin no/ / mdo khu byug rol pas gtan la 'bebs/ lung ni dkar po gnas lung / dmar po srog lung / nag po sngags lung la sogs kyis bshad do/ / gdams ngag ni slob dpon pad 'byung gi zhal gdams yod pa'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa phur pa gsang rgyud nas ston/ rdzogs rim thams cad phur pa myang 'das nas ston/ gab pa'i sngags drug gab pa 'khor lo nag po nas ston/ las ka thams cad phur pa ngan sngags gtsug lag gi rgyud las ston to/ /rgyud sde mang po'i bcud bsdus pa yin no/ /des na theg pa che chung gnyis las chen po/ sngags dang mtshan nyid gnyis las sngags/ sngags la'ang phyi nang gnyis las nang pa/ theg pa dgu las theg pa brgyad pa yin no/ / drang don tshar ro/ /gnyis pa nges don dang sbyar na/ chos thams cad la rdo rje phur pas ma khyab pa med de theg pa rim pa dgu/ mdo sde bcu gnyis/ rgyud sde bzhi/ sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum/bslab pa gsum/ rgyud lung man ngag thams cad la khyab pa'o/ / dang po ni/ nyan thos la phur pa bsangs nu nag po byung / rang sangs rgyas la phur pa gze ma nag po byung / byang chub sems pa la phur pa gsang ba nag po byung / kri ya la phur pa rdo rje rnam 'joms byung / yo ga la phur pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba byung / u pa ya la phur pa gtsug tor dkar nag byung / rgyud ma hā yo ga la phur pa khu byug rol pa byung / lung a nu yo ga la phur pa bikhyot+ta ma la 'bum sde byung /man ngag a ti yo ga la phur pa stag seng kha 'thab kyi rgyud byung ngo / / yang rdo rje phur pa la/rgyud mdo sde dang 'bum sder longs pa yod pas mdo'i sde/ co ba tshigs bcad du yod pas — 124 —

gyi/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagatshigs su bcad pa'i sde/ lhug pa dang spel mar yod pas dbyangs su bsnyad pa'i sde/ ru tra btul ba lta bu yod pas rmad du byung ba'i sde/ rgyud lung thams cad kyi gleng gzhi yod pas gleng gzhi'i sde'o/ /des 'gre'o/ yang lus ngag gi bya ba ston pas bya ba'i rgyud/ sems kyi bya ba ston pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ lus ngag gnyis ka'i las ston pas gnyis ka'i rgyud/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la rol pas bla na med pa'i rgyud yin no/ / yang rdo rje phur pa'i chos kyis sems mi mngon pa mngon par byed pas mngon pa'i sde snod/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ston pas 'dul ba'i sde snod/ drang don nges don ston pas na mdo sde'i sde snod yin no/ /yang bsrung bya dang gdams bya mang po ston pas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ stong nyid ston pas shes rab kyi bslab pa/ bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa mang du ston pas ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'o/ /yang phun sum tshogs pa lnga bshad pas rgyud kyi rgyal po'ang yin/ lung drug cu rtsa bzhi bshad pas lung gi bla ma'ang yin/ gdams ngag brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bshad pas man ngag nges don yin te/ dkar po gnas lung las/ phur pa rgyud kyi rgyal po yin/ / phur pa lung gi bla ma yin/ / phur pa man ngag nges pa'i don/ /zhes pas
