mngon no/ /rgyud kyi gleng gzhi tshar ro/ /da ni rgyud kyi khog don drug bshad de/ gang zhe na/ dang po phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lngas sgrub pa las kyi gzhi bzung / dal rnam pa gsum sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas pas don gyi khog phub/ khams gsum gyis srog la dbang bskur zhing srog gi ye shes sems dpa'i srog la dbang bskur/ ye shes kyi dal spyan drangs shing mchod cing bsnyen pas dngos grub kyi bcud blang / gab pa'i sngags drug dang tshe lung khrus lung gis kha bskang ste gdab pa'i las bya/mnan sreg 'phang gsum gyis las kyi mjug bsdu ba dang drug go /de la dang po phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lngas sgrub pa las kyi gzhi bzung ba ni/ gī la ya me lce gsang ba'i rgyud las/ gnas dang bdag nyid 'khor rdzas dus/ / phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan na/ / las rnams gang 'dod 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes pas gang zhe na/ bdag nyid phun sum tshogs pa/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ rdzas phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /dang po sgrub pa po bdag nyid kyang / mu stegs can dang / log lta can dang / sdig can dang / dam nyams lta bus sgrub pas chog gam zhe na/ des kyang mi 'grub ste/ rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa las/ blo sbyangs rgyud goms ting 'dzin gsal/ / theg dgu sde snod don la mkhas/ / dad ldan thugs brtse bag tsha med/ /rig 'dzin bla mar de bshad do/ / zhes pas yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa de rab/ sum — 125 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis tshang ba de 'bring / tha ma gsum cha tshang ba zhig dgos/ yang na yon tan gnyis te sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / rang bzhin gyi yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ rab rgyud sde dang / sde snod mtha' dag shes pa/ 'bring tan+d+ra sde bco brgyad shes pa/ tha ma rang gi skor ma nyams pa shes pa zhig dgos/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyud bzang ba/ ngang ring ba/dad pa che ba/ snying rje che ba/ sgrub pa la mos pa'o/ / de yang phur pa myang 'das las/phun sum tshogs pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /byams dang snying rje sngon btang la/ /srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub par bya/ /zhes pas mngon no/ /gnyis pa gnas ni/ bshan pa'am/ sdig can gyi khyim mam/ skye bo tha ma'i khyim mam/ sgo khang ngam/ srang kha lta bur sgrub pas 'grub bam zhe na/ des kyang mi 'grub ste/ gnas la gnyis las/ bsnyen pa'i gnas dang / sgrub pa'i gnas so/ / dang po la bzhi ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhabs kyis bcags pa byin che ba'i gnas dang / grub pa thob pa bkra shis pa'i gnas dang / gzhung dang mthun pa sgrub thag nye ba'i gnas dang / yid dang mthun pa nyams dga' ba'i gnas so/ / de ltar yang myang 'das las/ gnas kyi dam pa bstan pa las/ / gzhung ldan bkra shis byin can dang / /nyams dga' ba yi gnas dang bzhi/ / zhes pas mngon no/ / de yang dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhabs kyis bcags pa'i rgyal po'i khab bam/ bya rgod phung po'i ri lta bu'o/ / gnyis pa grub pa thob pa bkra shis pa'i gnas ni spa gro stag tshang seng ge phug lta bu'o/ / gsum pa gzhung dang mthun pa la gnyis te/ spyi'i gzhung dang mthun pa dang / 'di rang gi gzhung dang mthun pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas de'i shar gdal ba dang 'dra ba/ lho bres pa 'dra ba/nub skyobs pa 'dra ba/ byang skyor ba 'dra ba/ yang na shar na ri'am brag 'bru'i phung po gdal ba 'dra ba/ lho na ri'am brag dar dkar gyi yol ba 'dra ba/ nub na ri'am brag rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra ba/ byang na ri'am brag btsun mo go zu gyon pa 'dra ba yod na bzang ngo / / yang na zhib tu brtags te/ shar lho na me lha'i dud ris med pa/ lho nub na srin po'i mdung rtse med pa/ nub byang na rlung lha'i ba dan med pa/ byang shar na dbang ldan gyi rbab khung med par btsal lo/ / gnyis pa 'di rang gi gzhung dang mthun pa la/ ri'am brag rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku 'gying ba 'dra ba la 'dug na gtso bo nye bar 'ong / ri'am brag khro bo'i sku 'gying ba 'dra ba la 'dug na khro bo bcu nye bar 'ong / ri'am brag mgo brnyan gyi sku 'gying ba 'dra ba la 'dug na mgo brnyan nye bar 'ong / shar lho'i mtshams na brag gcan gzan thur la rgyug pa 'dra ba 'dug na shwa na ma nye bar 'ong / lho nub mtshams na mtsho bzhi — 126 —

gyi/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagabaskyil ba 'dra ba 'dug na bse mo nye bar 'ong / nub byang mtshams na skyes bu zhub dkar langs pa 'dra ba 'dug na skyes bu ging nye bar 'ong / byang shar mtshams na bud med nag mo dar 'phyar ba 'dra ba 'dug na re ma ti nye bar 'ong ngo / / bzhi ba yid dang mthun pa nyams dga' ba'i gnas ni/ phu nas dri ma med pa'i chu 'bab pa/ mda' na rtsi shing nags tshal lo 'dab rgyas pa/ bya skad rnam pa sna tshogs sgrog pa ste/ gsang rgyud las/ me tog mang po'i gling yod dang / /ri ni rin chen spungs pa 'dra/ /skyed mos tshal dang dpag bsam shing / /ngang ba bung ba'i sgra sgrogs cing / / skad snyan bya ni sna tshogs sgrogs/ / gnam ni 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'dra/ / sa ni pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'dra/ / gnas ni dbyibs legs kha shar bltas/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa sgrub pa'i gnas ni/ gnam ni gri 'dra ba/ sa gru gsum/logs la tsher ma can skyes pa ste/ myang 'das las/ drag po gnas kyi dam pa ni/ / dur khrod shing gcig rgya gram lam/ / gcan gzan mang pa'i rgyu srang dang / / gnam ni gri 'dra sa gru gsum/ / logs la tsher ma can gyi shing / / de ni drag po'i sgrub gnas so/ / zhes pas mngon no/ /gsum pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dam nyams sam/ rang bzhin ngan pa can nam/ mkhon grib can gyis 'ong ngam zhe na/ des mi 'ong ste/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba'o/ / dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa las/ dad ldan dam che gus la brtson/ / shes rab gsum la blo sbyangs shing / /rtsa ba'i sngags zlos gtsang me+e chung / /dal bri mkhas pa 'khor gyi rgyu/ /zhes pas yon tan kun tshang ba rab/ 'bring sum gnyis/ tha ma gsum cha tshang ba dgos so/ / yang na bka' blo bde ba/ gyong khengs med pa/ brtul shugs che ba/ sgrub pa po la dad pa'o/ / dbye na bzhi ste/ phyi nang brda sbyor gyi 'khor/ rdul phyags skyes bu'i 'khor/ thugs 'thad pa yum gyi 'khor/ mchod pa stob pa'i 'khor ro/ / dang po ni/thal skyel me len chu 'chu ba de'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ g.yos sogs bya ba byed pa'o/ / gsum pa ni/ gzungs ma mtshan ldan no/ /bzhi pa ni/ bsnyen sgrub ji lta ba shes pa des/ rang khams ma bde na thun mi chag pa dgos so/ / gnyis pa dus ni/ nam dga' dga' dang ci thod thod gtam 'chal du gzhug pas 'grub bam zhe na/ mi 'grub ste/ zla ba dang / tshes grangs dang / skar ma dang / gza' bzhi rtsis te/ gsang rgyud las/ ra ba bzhi la bsnyen pa'i dus/ /'bring po bzhi la sgrub pa'i dus/ /tha chung bzhi la las sbyor bya/ /zhes pa dang / yang zla stod thams cad bzlog pa yin/ /zla smad thams cad thebs pa yin/ /zhes pa dang khyad par du/ ra ba bzhi la gdab las sdog /'bring po bzhi la zor las ldog /tha — 127 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/chung bzhi la las dag bya/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa tshes ni/ gsang rgyud las/ dpyid zla gsum la brdeg pa ni/ /nyi shu gnyis(tha)dang bcu drug('bring)bcu bzhi'o(rab)/ /shar dang de bzhin shar lhor blta'o/ /dbyar zla gsum la brdeg pa ni/ /brgyad dang(rab)bco lnga('bring)dus drug tu(tha)/ / nub byang byang shar kha blta'o/ / ston zla gsum la brdeg pa ni/ / nyi shu(rab)bco brgyad('bring)nyer gsum(tha ma)la/ / byang shar byang dang nub tu blta'o/ /dgun zla gsum pa brdeg pa ni/ /bcu gsum(rab)bcu drug('bring)nyi shu(tha)dgu/ /byang dang lho ru kha blta'o/ /dpyid zla gsum la ldog pa'i dus/ /bcu bdun bcu dgu(rab)tshes gcig('bring)nyi shu brgyad(tha// /dbyar zla gsum la bzlog pa ni/ /tshes gnyis(gcig zer ba'ang 'dug mchan)lnga dang bco lnga dang / /tshes gsum('bring)bcu drug bcu bzhi'o(tha ma'o)/ / ston zla gsum la ldog pa ni/ / nyi shu lnga(rab)dang gsum('bring)dang gnyis(tha ma)/ /dgun zla gsum la ldog pa ni/ /bco brgyad(rab)nyi shu('bring)nyer bdun(thama'o)no/ /zhes so/ /skar ma smrel po dang mgo gza' phur bu/ nyi ma bdud kyi nyi ma drag po la gtad do/ /bsnyen pa la gza' skar gang bzang la bya'o/ /lnga pa rdzas dang yo byad(rten dang rdzas med kyang sgrub tu rung ngam zhe na mi rung ste)phun sum tshogs pa la lnga ste/ 'tsho ba zas kyi yo byad/ lha sgrub pa'i yo byad/ thugs dam bskang ba'i yo byad/ dgra bgegs gsod pa'i yo byad do/ /dang po 'tsho ba zas kyi yo byad ni/ rten dang rdzas mi gtsang bas sgrub tu rung ngam zhe na mi rung ste/ bza' ba/ bca' ba/ btung ba sgrub dus dang sbyar te ldong thabs su bskyed dgos te/ brgya lam gal te ma 'grub na spogs chog dgos pa'o/ / gnyis pa rkyen bzlog sman gyi yo byad la gnyis te/ phyi'i rkyen bzlog pa dang / nang gi rkyen bzlog pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ dgra bzlog pa dang / bgegs bzlog pa'o/ / dang po ni/sngon du sgrub khang btsan po rgyan dang ldan pa/ rbab khung dang / mda' g.yab dang / yang khang dang / brtsegs khang dang / mdzod chung dang ldan par bya'o/ /gnas der go cha dang /phub chung dang / mda' gzhu dang / mdung thung dang / 'khrul 'khor dang / sbyogs the rang rkang dang ldan par bya'o/ / gnyis pa bgegs bzlog pa la sreg rdzas dang / zor rdzas dang / thun rdzas dang / bzlas nyungs dang / thod ngan dang / dug khrag dang / gu gul dang / tshil chen dang / ro ras dang / shing shun dang / lirga dang / 'khor lo'i rdzas rnams tshud par bya'o/ / gnyis pa nang gi rkyen bzlog pa la gnyis te/ nad 'dus pa las gyur pa bzlog pa dang / nyon mongs pa rang dbang med par bzlog pa'o/ / dang po ni/— 128 —

gyi/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagarlung la rlung sman dang / tshad pa la bsil sman dang / grang ba la drod sman dang / mkhris pa la lca sga dang bu ram/ nad 'dus pa la sman thams cad tshang bar bya/ btsag cha dang /thur ma dang / spra ba la sogs pa gsog go /gnyis pa nyon mongs pa langs na/ zhe sdang la byams pa/ 'dod chags la mi sdug pa/ gti mug la rten 'brel lam/ yang na chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes par byas la/ bla ma'i snyan brgyud zab mo thos pa tsam gyis grol ba/ bsgom pa tsam gyis byin rlabs 'byung ba sta gon du bya'o/ /gsum pa lha sgrub pa'i yo byad la/ brag btsan po'am sa bzang po la sgrub khang btsan po byas la/ de'i dbus su dkyil 'khor 'dom gang gru bzhi pa brtsigs te dpangs khru gang ba/ der yang dur khrod du grub par bya ba'i phyir thod tshal la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bris la gzhug longs spyod che bar bya ba'i phyir rat+na lnga dang 'bru sna lnga gzhug nad nyung bar bya ba'i phyir sman lnga gzhug grags pa thob par bya ba'i phyir dri lnga gzhug bum gter bcug la me long gyi ngos 'dra bar bya/ de yang shar mtho na nor la gzan/ lho mtho na nad 'ong / nub mtho na srog la gzan/ byang mtho na rigs rgyud chad/ dbus mtho na rang la ngan/ byang shar dma' bar bya'o/ / de'i zur bzhi srung ma'i stegs bu dpangs sor bzhi/ rgyar khru re yod pa bzhi brtsig pa bya'o/ /de nas dal gyi dbus su mi'i keng dus brla dang rje ngar du bcas pa rkang mthil gyen la bstan pa'i khri'u chen po gcig bya'o/ / de'i steng du lce spyang gi khog pa'am/ mi'i rtsibs khog gcig bzhagade'i nang du sha sna snying sna 'bru sna las byas pa'i dpal chen po'i dkyil gtor bya/ de'i steng du 'bar ba'i lha tshogs bskyed la zas phud btung phud lo'am mi rabs su 'bul/ thun mtshams kyi bzlas pa la gzhol/ tshil chen gyi sprin khebs bya/ rma bya'i gdugs phub la bzhag go /de'i g.yas su gta' gtor bzang du bsham/ sras mchog lngar bskyed/ zas phud 'bul/zla ba re la kha bran/ g.yon nam rgyab tu gtor ma gsum bca'/ phyi'i lha mo lngar bskyed pa phyi'i gtor ma/ nang gi lha mo lngar bskyed pa nang gi gtor ma/ 'dod yon lha mo lngar bskyed pa gsang ba'i gtor ma'o/ / mdun du gtso bo'i 'gying phur gdan dang bcas pa dar mthing gi cod pan btags pa gzhug de'i sngon du lha phur lnga bcu rtsa gcig thod pa nas kyis bkang ba gzhug gzhan yang gdab phur nyi shu rtsa gcig sgrub phur brgya rtsa brgyad/ mgyogs phur/ phur pa sil bu rnams gsog go / zur gyi srung ma'i stegs bur rang rang gi dam rdzas dang / gtor ma bshams te/ de'ang lhor shar gyi stegs bur shā na ma'i rdzas/ rgyud las/(dam rdzas yod na shugs kyis 'du/ rang shugs su las byed do/ /) spyang khu 'phar ba wa dang khyi/ /— 129 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/shā na ma yi rdzas su bzhag / mar khu zhag dang 'o ma khrag(lhonub tu)/ bse mo bzhi yi rdzas su bzhag / mda' dar stag ras(nub byang du)gzig ras rnams/ / skyes bu ging gi rdzas su bzhag /bya nag(byang shar gyi)lug nag rta nag nal bu'i sha/ /re ma ti yi rdzas su bzhag /dpal chen(dbus su)rta yi bsgying gtor gcig /dbus su khri'u'i steng du bzhag /dza gad rak+tas mtha' ma bskor/ /zhes pas bsregs rdzas thams cad shar lho me lhar bsham/ mnan rdzas thams cad lho nub srin por/ zor rdzas nub byang rlung lhar/ thun rdzas byang shar dbang ldan du/ mchod rdzas thams cad rang gi mdun du bsham/ srog la 'khor lo bskor ba lho nub tu bsham mo/ /bzhi pa thugs dam bskang ba'i yo byad ni/ gnas der zhing chen gyi bla bre/zhing chung gi za ra tshags/ tsit+ta'i pho tog bhad+dhā skam rlon gyi tsha tshar/ rgyu ma bus pa'i brla rgyan/ sha chen gyi lang ling / rus chen gyi khral khrol/ khams gsum gyi rak+ta/ dmar gyi gtor ma/ dpal gyi yang phud/ zhal zas tshogs kyi gtor ma(mchod pa zer ba'ang snang /mchan)rnams bsham mo/ / lnga pa dgra bgegs bsad pa'i rdzas ni/ srog la 'khor lo bskor ba dang / srog la liṅgā bca' ba'o/ / de'i 'brub khung gru gsum pa bca' ste/ rgyud las/dkyil 'khor dang ni 'brub khung gnyis/ / so so yin te mi gcig go / liṅgā dang ni nya bo gnyis/ / dmigs pa gcig ste rgyu mi gcig / liṅgā nya bo'i snying gar bzhug / ces pas/zan la nya bo bca' ste/ rgyud las/ grog mkhar sa dang rkang rjes sa/ /phyi sa dri chu gos dum rnams/ / nya bo bya ba'i rdzas su bshad/ / shun chen gro ga shog shog rnams/ / liṅgā bri ba'i rdzas su bshad/ / ces pa'i rgyu rkyen drug la/ phar rkan tshur rkan(rkang rjes sa)sa/ gtsug(skra)ma'i lo ma/ gangs(snabs lud) kyi dum bu/ rnam snang(phyis)/ sha shul(drichu)/zhing ras(gos dum)dang drug go / lha khang dang mchod rten rnying ba'i sa/ rabs chad sa/mi phung sa rnams la nya bo rus shing dang bcas pa bya/ khrag nad gtong ba'i phyir khrag sna gzhugadug nad gtong ba'i phyir dug sna bzhag nad tshad pa gtong ba'i phyir drod sman gzhugagrir bsad pa'i phyir gri khrag gzhug 'dre la byed na rten gyis gzhug lder bzo byas la ming rus liṅgā'i snying gar gzhug gnyis pa liṅgā bri ba la/ rgyud las/ dus dang bri mkhan snag tsha gsum/ /dus ni smin drug sa 'og dus/ /'bri mkhan rang bzhin yon tan can/ /snag tsha dme khrag gsum gyis byas/ / rgyal po la ni rkyang khru'o/ / ban+de la ni bcag khru'o/ / skyes pa la ni mtho gang ngo / /bud med la ni mdzub gang ngo / /byis pa la ni sor bzhi'o/ /zhes so/ /de la ligau tsakra 'bri dus su kha rlangs mi btang / lag pas mi 'ju/ snag tsha gsar du sbyor/ spyi bor rus bri/ snying gar ming bri/ brla la bla dwags bri/ 'doms su tsha bri'o/ /— 130 —

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagasngags la dpral bar ha sa bri/ lte bar a we sha bri/ yan lag la shri kri bri/ lce la dz+wa la pa ya bri/ spyi bor ta tha ya bri/ 'doms su bid ya bri/ oṃ lam̐ hūṃ lam̐ gyis mtha' bskor/ rtsibs thams cad du 'dus pa bri/ de'i mthar khro bcus bskor/ de'i mthar srung ma'i sngags kyis bskor ro/ / gtad byed pa'i mdze thod la dpral ba shri kri bri/ spyi bor ta tha ya bri/ rna bar bi da ya bri/ ltag par ha sa ya ra bri/ mgrin par a we sha ya bri/ rkan la dza la pa ya bri/gzhan 'dra/ bgegs gnon pa'i khyi thod la/ smin mtshams su ha sa bri/ 'tshul par a we sha bri/ 'gram par shri kri bri/ rkan la dz+wa la ya bri/ spyi bor ta tha ya bri/ ma mkhal la bi da ya bri/ de nas sngar ltar ro/ /rkyen drug la/ rang lhar gsal ba/ gzas pa po dngos su gsal ba/ 'brub khung dregs pa'i zhal du gsal ba/ rtsang phur ba'i srung mar gsal ba/thun khrag mtshon char gsal ba/ thun brgyab pas khong khrag lud nas myags myags song bar bsam mo/ / nya bo de'i lus kyi gnas bcur khro bo bcu'i phur pa bcu btab la bzhag lus kyi mtsho bzhi la sgo ma bzhi'i phur pa bzhi btab/ gnam gyi 'ju thag bcad pa dang / sa yi rten phur phyung sa rnams su phur pa drug btab la bzhag de yang bsnyen dus su gan rkyal mgo phar bstan du bya/ sgrub dus su kha sbub mgo tshur bstan no/ /de rnams shin tu gal che ba yin no/ / sgrub pa las kyi gzhi bzung ba tshar ro/ /spyi don gnyis ba dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum sngon du 'gro ba phrin las kyi rim pa dang bcas te don gyi khog dbub pa la gnyis te/ sngon du 'gro ba dang dal gsum dngos so/ /dang po la bdun te/ dang po mtshams bcad pa/ brda sgo dbye ba/ brda phyag 'tshal ba/ rtags gdab pa/ bshags pa bya ba/ byin dbab pa/ rnam gsum byin gyis brlab pa'o/ / de rnams ni zhi khro la sogs pa phrin las spyi'i sngon du 'gro ba yin no/ / de la dang po 'bar ba mtshams kyi dal gyis mtshams bcad pa la mdo gsum/ rtsa ba brgyad/ yan lag(de rnams mi shes na mtshams gcod la mi re'o/ /)sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /de la dang po mdo gsum ni/ re re la'ang gsum gsum mo/ rtsa brgyad po gang zhe na/ dang po mtshams gcod mkhan gyi rten gyi gang zag gsum dgos pas gang gis bcad/ gang bcad rgyu'i mi mthun phyogs las gang bcad/ mtshams bcad pa'i don gyi ngo bo gsum po gang yin/ de la mtshams kyi gzhung chen po gsum yod na gang yin/ gzhung de gsum la gang nas bshad kyi khungs gsum yod na gang yin/ mtshams bcad pa'i gnas skabs su 'bras bu gsum ji ltar 'byung /mtshams re re la gsum gsum re dbye ba dgu yod na gang yod/ mtshams bcad pa la 'bras — 131 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/bu rnam pa gsum po ci ltar 'byung ba yin/ zhes pa dang brgyad do/ / de la dang po gang zag gsum ni rab lta ba rtogs pa/ 'bring bskyed rim brtan pa/ tha ma slob pa res 'jog pa'i gang zag go / de yang gang zag rab des snang ba chos skur rtogs pas spang blang med pas mtshams bcad zin/ 'bring des snang ba lhar rtogs pas 'dre med de bcad zin/ tha ma de la ma bcad na 'dre 'ong / bcad na 'dre mi 'ong bas bcad dgos so/ /gnyis pa bcad rgyu mi mthun pa ni gsum ste/ phyi'i g.yeng ba dang 'du 'dzi/ nang rkyen dang bar chad/ gsang ba rnam rtog phra rags so/ / gsum pa mtshams bcad kyi ngo bo ni/ lta ba'i ngang mtshams/bskyed rim gyi rang mtshams/ sngags dang phyag rgyas srung mtshams so/ / bzhi gi de gsum po gzhung chen po gsum ste/ lta ba la me khrag 'chol ba'i mtshams/ bskyed rim la khro bo 'chol ba'i mtshams/ sngags dang phyag rgya la mtshon cha 'chol ba'i mtshams sokyi / lnga pa gang nas bshad kyi khungs gsum la/ me khrag 'chol ba ma gshin gyi rgyud nas bshad/ khro bo 'chol ba zhi khro'i rgyud nas bshad/ mtshon cha 'chol ba yang phur gyi rgyud nas bshad do/ / drug pa gnas skabs kyi dgos pa ni/ phyi mtshams bcad pas g.yeng ba zhi/ nang mtshams bcad pas bar mi chad/ gsang mtshams bcad pas sems chos skur gnas pa'o/ /bdun pa dbye ba la gsum ste/ snang ba mi'i mtshams bcad pa/ mi snang ba bgegs kyi mtshams bcad pa/phra ba rnam par rtog pa'i mtshams bcad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ yul dpon la bka' phog pa/nga yi rten sgrub ma thon par 'tshe ba ma btang zhing ces bka' bsgo'o/ / gnyis pa mi snang ba la gsum ste/ phyi mtshams/ nang mtshams/ gsang mtshams so/ /dang po la gsum/ phyi'i phyi mtshams su gser skyems btang zhing bden pa bdar/ phyi'i nang mtshams su rgyal chen bzhi'i tho bzhi gzug phyi'i gsang mtshams su khro bo bcu'i phur pa gdab pa'o/ / nang mtshams la gsum ste/ nang gi phyi mtshams su gshin rje gshed kyi sgo byang phyi sgo la gdags/nang gi nang mtshams su bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sgo byang nang sgo la gdags/ nang gi gsang mtshams su dam sri them 'og tu mnan pa'o/ /gsang mtshams la gsum ste/ gsang mtshams kyi phyi mtshams su gnas srung khro bo bcur bskyed/ gsang mtshams kyi nang mtshams su bdag srung rdo rje gzhon nur bskyed/ gsang mtshams kyi gsang mtshams su lha dang bgegs la bka' bsgo ba'o/ /brgyad pa 'bras bu ni sku gsum thob ste/ rgyu 'bras ma 'chol ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar so so la gsum gsum ste yan lag sum cu rtsa gsum ma shes par mtshams gcod la mi theng ngo / / 'bar ba mtshams kyi dal tshar ro/ /— 132 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagaganyis pa brda sgo dbye ba ni/ dal gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo phye ste bltas pa dang / gtso bo nas sgo ma'i bar du bltas pas zhal thal ler mthong bar bsgoms la/ 'di skad brjod do/hūṃ/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs gnyis/ / ye'am gdod nas gnyis su med pa las/ /bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pas bsgribs pa yis/ /log rtog mtshan ma'i rtog pa'i sprin gyis bsgribs/ / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal yang ma mthong bas/ / bdag 'jug dkyil 'khor sgo 'di dbye ru gsol/ /ma rig mun pa'i tshog/sa kyi bar chod pas/ /thugs rje nyi zla'i 'od kyis bsal du gsol/ /oṃ ku mā ra dzñā na ma hā maṇ+ḍa la sarba de wa ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ya hoḥpra we sha phaṭa/ ces brjod/ de nas gsum pa rtogs pa brda'i phyag 'tshal ba ni/hūṃ/ chos sku bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / / longs sku phyogs bcu khro rgyal dkyil 'khor dang / / sprul sku badz+ra 'dus pa'i sras mchog gī la ya/ / dkyil 'khor rnam gsum 'bar ba'i sras mchog la/ /rjes su yi rang shin tu ngo mtshar che ba yis/ /phyag rgya brda dang gar gyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra dzñā na ma hā maṇ+ḍal sarba de wa a kā ro ma mi na mo zhes brjod/ de nas bzhi ba rtags gdab pa ni/ mched lcam rnams gral byas la/ ye shes lha'i rtags su rak+ta'i thig le sna rtse mkhur tshos gnyis mtho sar gdab/ thal chen gyi tshom bu ni spyi gtsug mgrin pa snying gar byas pa la dpral ba kha ṭ+wāṃ ka bri/ zhag gi bro ris ni snying gar zla phyed rdo rje bri/ de nas rdo rje gral byas/ gral phyag bya'o/ / de nas lnga pa nyams chag sgrib sbyang gi dal la bshags pa bya ba ni/ mdo bzhi/ rtsa ba brgyad/ yan lag sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ / dang po mdo bzhi ni re re la bzhi bzhi'o/ / rtsa ba brgyad la/ dang po bshags mkhan gyi rten gyi gang zag bzhi yod na gang yin/ bshags rgyu'i sdig pa bzhi gang yin/ bshags pa'i yul bzhi po gang yin/ bshags pa'i ru chen bzhi bya ba gang yin/ bshags pa'i gzhung chen po bzhi bya ba yod na gang yin/ de la mdzad mkhan gyi slob dpon bzhi bya ba yod na gang yin/ bshags pa'i dgos ched bzhi bya ba yod na gang yin/ bshags pa'i thabs bzhi bya ba yod na gang yin/ dang po gang zag bzhi las/ dang po skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa thob pa dang gcig de nas sems bskyed thob pa dang gnyis/ de nas dbang bskur thob pa dang gsum/de nas bskyed rdzogs shes pa dang ldan pas bshags dgos te/ tha mal las ni ye nyams chen po yin pas bshags chag chad pa'o/ / gnyis pa bshags rgyu'i sdig pa la'ang bzhi ste/ rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba dang gcig so sor thar pa'i sdom pa shor ba dang gnyis/ byang sems kyi sems bskyed shor ba dang gsum/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang bzhi po — 133 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/bshags dgos so/ /gsum pa bshags pa'i yul bzhi ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bla ma dang gcig dngos grub ster pa'i yi dam lha dang gnyis/ thugs rjes skyob pa'i bde bar gshegs pa dang gsum/ legs nyes stangs 'dzin gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro dang bzhi la bshags dgos so/ /bzhi pa bshags pa'i ru chen bzhi la/ rtogs pa lta ba'i sgo nas bshags pa dang gcig sgom pa bskyed rdzogs kyi sgo nas bshags pa dang gnyis/ bsrung bya dam tshig gi sgo nas bshags pa dang gsum/ gdung ba smre sngags kyi sgo nas bshags pa dang bzhi'o/ / lnga pa de la gzhung chen po bzhi yod de/ lta ba la ma mo'i klong bshags dang gcig bskyed rdzogs la ye shes sku mchog dang gnyis/ bsrung bya la dam tshig nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa dang gsum/ smre sngags la ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bshags pa dang bzhi'o/ /drug pa mdzad mkhan bzhi ni/ bram ze mi'i thod pa can gyis lta ba'i klong bshags mdzad/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po ches ye shes sku mchog mdzad/ rje ti tra ma tis dam tshig nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa mdzad/ a tsar+ya gnyan dpal dbyangs kyis ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bshags pa mdzad do/ /bdun pa dgos ched bzhi ni/ yang dag don gyi gcugs sbyang ba la lta ba'i klong bshags/ lha dang mi'i gcugs sbyang ba la ye shes sku mchog rtsa ba dang yan lag gi gcugs sbyang ba la dam tshig nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ ma mo dang mkha' 'gro'i gcugs sbyang ba la ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bshags pa mdzad do/ / brgyad pa bshags thabs bzhi la/ lta ba seng ge'i nga ros rang bzhin med par byas te bshags/ sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mes bsregs te bshags/ spyod pa glang po che'i chus bkrus te bshags/ gdung pa'i smre sngags dbyangs dang bcas bshags pa dang bzhi'o/ /sgos bshags ni rang rang gi ci rigs par thong ngo / / de nas drug pa byin dbab pa ni/dzaḥhūṃ baṃḥhoḥzhes se gol bsnol mar gdab pas rtsa ba'i bla ma de la brgyud pa'i bla ma dang /dpa' bo dpa' mo 'bum gyis bskor bar nam mkhar thibs se byon par bsam/ de 'og rigs lnga gdan tsho lnga la dus gsum gyi bud+dhās bskor ba rnams byon/ de'i 'og rig 'dzin 'bum phrag du ma la ma mo mkha' 'gros bskor ba byon par bsam la/ sa ma ya hoḥ byas pas yum rnams kyis bskul/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ byas pas yab rnams kyis gnang ste sbyor ba mdzad pas/ sbyor mtshams nas byang sems bdud rtsi babs pa bdag gi spyi gtsug tu thim/ lus ngag gi sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ a la la hoḥzhes pas/ dngos grub stsal bar bsgom/hūṃ/ byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das/ /dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dbang cig bskur/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin cig phob/ /ces brjod — 134 ge

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagacing rol mo'i sgra btang / gsur chen gyi dud pa btang ngo / / bdun pa byin rlabs rnam gsum gyi dal la mdo gsum/ rtsa ba brgyad/ yan lag sum cu rtsa bdun no/ / mdo gsum re re la'ang gsum gsum mo/ /rtsa ba brgyad la/ gang gis byin gyis brlabs pa gsum bya ba yod na gang yin/ gang du bshams pa'i snod rnam pa gsum bya ba yod na gang yin/ gang bshams pa'i dngos po gsum bya ba yod na gang yin/ gang gis sbyangs pa'i sbyong byed gsum ni gang yin/ gang bca' pa'i phyag rgya gsum po ni ji ltar bca'/ gang bskyed pa'i lha gsum po ni gang bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs la phyi nang gsum yod na gang yin/ sngags gsum po 'dzab kyi grangs su bgrang ba dang brgyad do/ / dang po byin gyis rlob byed gsum la/g.yas dkar gyi bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pas g.yas su bsham/ g.yon dmar gyi rak+ta byin gyis brlab pas g.yon du bsham/ dbus mthing gi gtor ma byin gyis brlab pas dbus su bshams te go rim yang bstan to/ / gnyis pa snod la gsum/ rtsa rgyud las/ pho thod mo thod ma ning thod/ / ba lī rak+ta bdud rtsi sbyar/ / zhes pas ma ning thod par bdud rtsi bsham/pho thod du gtor ma bsham/ mo thod du rak+ta bsham par bshad do/ / gsum pa bshams pa'i dngos po gsum ni/ gtsang phud la a mri ta sbyar ba dang / 'bru sna la dpal zan rgyan dang bcas pa dang / khrag sna tshogs tshad sha sna dang bcas pa bsham pa'o/ /bzhi pa sbyang ba gsum la rgyud las/ ram̐ yi khaṃ gis bsregs sbyang bkrus/ / zhes pas/ ram̐ las me 'bar nyes skyon bsregs/ yam̐ las rlung byung thal ba gtor/ khaṃ las chu byung sbyangs par bsgom mo/ / yang rgyud las/ 'bru gsum yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs zhes pas/ oṃ dkar pos bdud rtsi brlab/ āḥdamar pos rak+ta brlab/ hūṃ mthing gas gtor ma brlab par yang bshad do/ /lnga pa phyag rgya gsum la bdud rtsi la dung phor 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya bca'/ gtor ma la gzhong pa 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya bca'/ rak+ta la pad+ma 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya bca'o/ / drug pa bskyed pa'i lha gsum la/ bdud rtsi'i lbu ba las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed/ gtor ma'i lbu ba las khams gsum rnal rgyal bskyed/ rak+ta'i lbu ba las rta mgrin bskyed/ bsrung yang srung la bya ba'ang byed do/ / bdun pa byin gyis brlab pa la gnyis te/ rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa la gsum/ bdud rtsi phyi ltar byin gyis brlab pa dang/ nang ltar byin gyis brlab pa dang / gsang ba ltar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ / dang po ni/ bdud rtsi'i snod ma ning gi thod pa de mi dmigs pa las/ r+ghaṃ las thod pa'i gzhal yas khang rdo rje'i ra bas bskor bar bsgom/ de'i nang bdud rtsi'i steng — 135 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/du zla ba/ de'i steng du a dkar po bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros pas stong gsum gyi lha'i bdud rtsi dang / mi'i bdud rtsi dang / shing gi bdud rtsi dang / sman dang bcud thams cad bkug ste a la thim/ 'dzab bzlas pa dang a zhu nas bdud rtsis khengs par bsgom/de nas rdzas la bsang gtor bya/ bdud rtsi'i mtshams bcad/ gtor bas bgegs bros/khro bo'i gur du bsam pa ni phyi ltar brlab pa'o/ /gnyis pa nang ltar brlab pa ni/ snod 'dra nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi bsgom/ shar du glang sha dri chen/ lhor rta sha dri chu/ nub tu bya sha rak+ta/ byang du khyi sha klad rgyus/ dbus su mi sha byang sems/ de las gdan lnga bskyed/shar du oṃ lam̐ dkar/ lhor swā paṃ ser/ nub tu s+t+waṃ byā dmar/ byang du tī tī ljang / dbus su(zhing bcu'i sems kyi dwangs ma dang / hūṃ las 'od 'phros zhing bcu'i sha dang / bdud rtsi bkug pa sogs kun 'gre'o/ /mchan/)hūṃ mū mthing / gsung gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de yongs su gyur pa las/ shar tu tsakra dril bu/ lhor rat+na dril bu/ nub tu pad+ma dril bu/ byang du rgya gram dril bu/ dbus su rdo rje dril bu'o/ / de ni thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ / de la hūṃ badz+ra sgrikra/māṃ dha ti shwa ri/ oṃ dzi na dzi kra/ lī de ṣa ra ti/ swā rat+na dh+rikra/ mi mo hā ra ti/ ā+oṃ a ro bla kra/ byā rā ga ra ti/ hā pra dzñā dh+rikra/ tī badz+ra ra ti/ des sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan rnams rdzogs par bskyed pa ni sku yi dkyil 'khor ro/ / ye shes pa gzhug thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus sku yab yum la thim/ de zhu bdud rtsi chen po'i ngo bor bsam pa ni/ nang ltar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /bsang gtor sogs 'dra'o/ /gsum pa gsang ba ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ snod 'dra/ zla steng hrīḥdamar po bsam/'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pas rta mgrin gsang ba'i yum bzhi dang bcas pa bskyed de/ yum bde ba rgyas byed mas mdun nas 'khril/ yum rmongs byed mas g.yon nas 'khril/ yum tshe 'phel mas g.yas nas 'khril/ yum za byed mas rgyab nas 'khril/ de la dmigs te 'dzab bzlas pas/ dus gsum bud+dhā'i thugs kyi bdud rtsi rta mgrin la thim/ des bskul sbyor ba byas pas bde ba ma bzod bdud rtsir zhu ba rdo rjes dkrugs pas bdud rtsi rgyas pa ni gsang ba ltar brlabs pa'o/ / gnyis pa de tsam ma nus na bsdus pa ni/ lus kyi phyag rgya bca'/ngag tu sngags bzla/ sems kyis bdud rtsir bsam mo/ / bdud rtsi brlab pa tshar ro/ /gnyis pa gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa la gnyis te/ rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ ba lī phyi ltar byin gyis brlab pa dang / ba lī nang ltar byin gyis brlab pa dang / ba lī gsang ba ltar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ / dang po ni/ gtor snod zlo las thod — 136 —

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagapa'i gzhal yas khang rdo rje'i ra bas bskor bar bsam/ gtor ma'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa bsam/ steng du hūṃ las(hūṃ dang n-i gnyis bsam)'od 'phros/ khams gsum gyi bla ma'i(zhing bcu 'dul 'di bzla)sku dgra bsgral ba'i phyir zhing bcu'i dam nyams(n-i la thim ste zhu)bkugaro'i phung por bsgom/ 'dzab bzlas pa dang / dhu pe dkar mo spos chen mo/ puṣ+pe sngon mo me tog ma/ ā lo ke dmar mo mar me ma/ gadhe ljang gu dri chab ma/ re re la'ang dpag tu med par 'phro ba ni phyi ltar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ / gnyis pa nang ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni/yang hūṃ las 'od 'phros zhing bcu'i lhu dum phung por bsgom/ 'atreb bzlas nga/ nga/nga / lā se dkar mo rdo rje 'gying / / mā le sngon mor rat+na phreng / / gīti dmar mo pi waṃ glu/ /nīrti ljang gu gar ma la/ /re re la yang grangs med 'phro brnani nang ltar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /gsum pa gsang ba ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yang hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ zhing bcu'i glo snying gi phung por bsgom/ 'dzab bzlas pa dang / gzugs kyi lha mo me long dkar/ /sgra yi lha mo pi waṃ sngo/ / dri yi lha mo dung chos ser/ / ro yi lha mo zhal zas ljang / / reg gi lha mo na bza' smug /re re la grangs med 'phro ba ni gsang ba ltar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /gnyis pa de tsam ma nus na bsdus pa ni/ lus kyi gzhong pa 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya bca'/ ngag tu sngags bzla/sems kyis gtor ma gzhi bdud rtsi chen po la spris ma oṃ du chags par bsgom/ gtor ma brlab pa tshar ro/ /gsum pa rak+ta rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ rak+ta phyi ltar byin gyis brlab pa dang / rak+ta nang ltar byin gyis brlab pa dang / rak+ta gsang ba ltar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ / dang po snod ni r+ghaṃ las thod pa'i gzhal yas khang rdo rje'i ra bas bskor ba stong gsum tsam mo/ / rak+ta'i steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa bsam/ de las 'od 'phros/zhing bcu'i khrag drangs te dzaḥl thim/ slar 'dus khrag la thim/ de zhu bas rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen por bsam/ rak+ta phyar bas ro che chung mang po rnal mar shad shad song bar bsam pa ni phyi ltar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ / gnyis pa nang ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yang dzaḥlas 'od 'phros zhing bcu'i rtsa khrag drangs dzaḥl thim/ de zhu ba las rtsa khrag gi rgya mtshor bsam/phyar bas rtsa rgyud thams cad rnal mar shad shad song bar bsam pa ni nang ltar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ / gsum pa gsang ba ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ de nas yum gyi pad+ma yab kyi rdo rjes bskul bas dzaḥlas 'od 'phros/ zhing bcu'i snying khrag drangs/ dzaḥl thim/ de zhu bas snying khrag gi rgya mtshor bsam/ phyar bas glo mchin dang snying dang rtsa rnams rnal mar shad shad — 137 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/song bar bsam pa ni gsang ba ltar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de tsam mi nus na/bsdus pa ni/ lus kyis pad+ma 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya bca'/ ngag tu sngags bzla/ sems kyis rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po mi ro dang rta ro chol le ba bsgom pa'o/ / rak+ta brlab pa tshar ro/ /brgyad pa sngags gsum 'dzab kyi ched du bskyal ba ni/ bdud rtsi la brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig gtor ma la bdun/ rak+ta la bcu bzhi'o/ / gnyis pa dal rnam pa gsum dngos bstan pa la gsum ste/ dang po gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam pa gsum 'phro 'du bskyed pa dang / rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang / brten pa lha bskyed pa'o/ /dang po gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam pa gsum(mdo gsum rtsa ba brgyad yan lag lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'o/ /) 'phro 'du bskyed pa la de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'o/ /de yang rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa las/ de bzhin nyid dang kun tu snang / /rgyu yi ting 'dzin bsgom byas la/ /zhes pa dang / rgyud gzhan na mang ste ma spros so/ / dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la gsum ste/ don bskor gyi dbang du byas te bshad pa dang / 'bru gnyer gyi dbang du byas te bshad pa dang / nyams su blang ba bsgom pa'i dbang du byas nas bshad pa'o/ / dang po don bskor la/ mtshan gzhi de bzhin nyid de la mtshan nyid mkhas pa'i slob dpon gyi bzhed pas chos bco brgyad dang ldan te/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin du mtshon pa'o/ / de la dang po slob dpon pad 'byung gi bzhed pas/mtshan nyid bdun te/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang gciganges tshig dang gnyis/ dbye ba dang gsum/ byed las dang bzhi/ ming gi rnam grangs dang lnga/ ma bstan pa'i skyon dang drug bstan pa'i phan yon dang bdun no/ / dang po ni/dper na 'gro ba rigs drug gi nang nas mi ngos 'dzin na mgo nag rkang leb smra bzhin ldan pa de ming ngos 'dzin/ dpe de dang 'dra bar chos thams cad kyi nang nas spros bral stong nyid de/de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin du ngos 'dzin no/ /gnyis pa nges tshig ni/ 'o na stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin byas pas chog mod/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bya ba ci dgos zer na/de ni ye gdod ma nas chos thams cad stong nyid spros bral du yod pa las/ sgrub pa po'i blo de bzhin nyid du rtogs pas na/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin zer ba yin no/ / gsum pa dbye ba ni gsum ste/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad la rang chas su gnas pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ las dang po pas bsgom pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang gsum mo/ / dang — 138 —

rgu/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagapo ni/ sangs rgyas sgam stem mdzad/ sems can sgrin te ma bcos pa'i chos nyid stong nyid de'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ sgog pa'am/ gla rtsi la dri rang chas su yod pa ltar/ sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas rang chas su yod pa'i rtags su snying ga'i co mdud la a re yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ blo spyi'i rnam pas stong pa'i don spyi la/ blos bsgom bya sgom byed du byas nas stong pa la blos bsgom pa'o/ /bzhi ba byed las ni/ stong pa des mtshan ma'i rnam par rtog pa 'joms pa'i las can no/ / lnga pa ming gi rnam grangs ni mang ste/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ stong pa nyid kyi/ mtshan ma med pa'i/ smon pa med pa'i/ spros pa med pa'i/skye med kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /drug pa ma bstan pa'i skyon ni/ chos thams cad la stong nyid kyi rtsis ma zin na/ sku mdog rang rgyud par bsgom na 'dod pa'i khams kyi lhar skye/phyag mtshan rang rgyud par bsgoms na bdud dang srin por skye/ mgo brnyan rang rgyud par bsgom na dur khrod kyi wa'am nags kyi srin bur skye/ sbyor ba rang rgyud par bsgom na mngal gyi srin bur skye/ sgrol ba rang rgyud par bsgom na sems can dmyal bar skye'o/ / bdun pa bstan pa'i phan yon ni/ dper na chan la phab thebs na klum du 'gyur la/ ma thebs na mi 'gyur ba ltar/ chos thams cad la stong nyid kyi rtsis zin na/ gdab las dang / mnan sreg 'phang gsum byas tshad ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur la/ des ma zin na mi 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis pa slob dpon bi ma la mi tra na re/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la bdun yod de/ de bzhin nyid kyi teng nge 'dzin gyi dmigs yul/ sgom thabs/ lam du gang khyer/ goms rtags/ nyon mongs gang sbyang / sa lam 'char tshul/ 'bras bu gang thob pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid stong nyid du dmigs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ci la'ang mi rtog ci la'ang mi 'dzin/ cir yang mi dmigs par bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ lam du mi dmigs pa snang ba dang stong pa zung 'jug snang stong dbyer med lam du 'khyer ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ gang la ngos bzung med par rang grol ba goms rtags so/ /lnga pa nyon mongs gang sbyang na/ nyon mongs dngos 'dzin sbyong ba yin no/ / drug pa sa lam ni/kun tu bde rgyas dang / mthar phyin pa'i lam mo/ / bdun pa ni/ chos sku thob pa'o gsungs so/ /gsum pa slob dpon bal po shī la mdzi'i zhal nas/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhi ste/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum las gang gi chos yin pa dang / sku gsum po las gang du gtogs pa dang / dpe bstan pa dang rtags bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin 'di gzhi'i chos yin no/ / gnyis pa ni chos kyi sku yin no/ /— 139 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/gsum pa de ni nam mkha' dang rdo rje yin no/ / rtags ni 'khor ba rang grol ba'o gsungs/gnyis pa 'bru gnyer gyi dbang du byas na/ slob dpon chen po pad 'byung ni/ rdo rje khros pas de bzhin nyid bstan te/ rdo rje la gsum/ skye med don gyi rdo rje/ pha lam rdzas kyi rdo rje/mtshan ma rtags kyi rdo rje gsum las/ 'di skye med don gyi rdo rje yin gsungs/ ru bi ma la'i zhal nas/ rdo rje la chos gsum yod de/ mi 'gyur ba'i phyir na rdo rje/ phar 'joms pa'i don gyis na rdo rje/ tshur cis kyang mi tshugs pa'i don gyis na rdo rje zhes pas/ de gsum skye med don gyi rdo rje la tshang gsungs so/ /ru bal po'i zhal nas/ rdo rje zhes pa ni/ stong nyid spros bral la 'jug ste/ de de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la tshang gsungs so/ / ru pad 'byung gi zhal nas/ khros pa la gsum ste/ gang khros/ gang la khros/ tshul lam thabs ji ltar khros gsum yin gsungs so/ /gang khros na skye med kyi don stong ba nyid de khros/ gang la khros na/ mtshan ma'i rtog pa la khros/ tshul lam thabs ji ltar khros na ngang ngam shugs kyis khros pa ste/ dper na nyi ma shar bas mun pa dwangs pa ltar/ stong nyid rtogs pas dngos 'dzin zhi ba'o/ / ru bi ma las/ gnod bya gnod byed de/ nyi ma shar bas ba mo ngangarnagis dwangs pa ltar/ stong nyid rtogs pas dngos 'dzin 'jig pa'o/ /ru bal po na re/ gshis ngan pa dgra la khros pa lta bu min te/ dper na tsha reg dang grang reg lta bu mngon du gyur pa yin te/ stong nyid bsgom pas dngos 'dzin 'jig pa'o/ / de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin stong pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa ting nge 'dzin nyams su blang ba'i dbang du byas na las dang bo pa/ las goms pa ba/ las smin pa ba dang gsum gyi dbang du byas te/ stong nyid la sgra spyi tsam dang / don spyi tsam dang / don rang gi mtshan nyid gsum du nyams su blang ngo / / de bzhin nyid tshar ro/ /gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin kun tu snang ba ni gsum ste/ don bskor gyi dbang du byas pa dang / 'bru gnyer gyi dbang du byas pa dang / nyams su blang ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /dang po mtshan gzhi kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin de la mtshan nyid du ru gsum gyis bzhed pa'i chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa de/ kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin du mtshon/ de yang pad 'byung gi bzhed pas/ dang po kun tu snang pa'i ting 'dzin ngos bzung ba dang gcig nges tshig dang gnyis/ dbye ba dang gsum/ byed las dang bzhi/ ming gi rnam grangs dang lnga/ma bstan pa'i skyon dang drug bstan pa'i phan yon dang bdun no/ / dang po ni/ chos thams cad kyi nang nas snying rje sgyu ma tsam kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngos 'dzin no/ /— 140 —

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagaganyis pa ni/ 'o na snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin mi zer bar/ kun tu snang zhes pa ci zer na/snying rje des gong 'og gnyis mtshams sbyar pas na kun tu snang zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa de la dbye na gsum/ bud+dhā'i kun snang ni thugs rje chen po'o/ /sems can gyi kun snang ni snying rje tsam po ste/ khra spyang la yang phyogs cha can yod pa'o/ / las dang po pa don spyi la blo spyis bsgom pa'o/ / bzhi ba ni/ bud+dhā thob par byed pa'i las can no/ / lnga pa ming ni/ snying rje chen po'i/ byams pa chen po'i/ thugs rje chen po'i/ kun tu snang gi ting nge 'dzin zer ro/ /drug pa ni/ ma bstan sangs rgyas sems can gnyis ris su yang chad pas/ 'khor ba lte chad du mar la ltung bas mtshams mi sbyor ro/ /bdun pa ni/ snying rjes gong 'og gi mtshams sbyar nas/ stong pa nyid snying rje'i ros gang bar 'gyur ba'o gsungs/ gnyis pa ru bi ma la ni bdun te/ kun tu snang ba'i dmigs yul gcig sgom thabs gnyis/ lam du gang khyer gsum/ goms rtags bzhi/ nyon mongs gang sbyong lnga/ sa lam gang bgrod tshul druga'abras bu gang thob bdun no/ / dang po ni dmigs yul ni/ khams gsum sems can la'o/ /gnyis pa snying rje phyogs med du bsgom/ gsum pa lam du byams pa snying rje khyer ro/ /bzhi pa sems can thams cad pha mar 'char ro/ /lnga pa nyon mongs zhe sdang sbyong ngo / /drug pa sbyor lam tsam/ bdun pa 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'o gsungs/ gsum pa ru bal po ni kun tu snang gi ting nge 'dzin 'di lam gyi chos yin la/ sku gsum las longs sku yin la/dpe ni bu gcig pa'i ma'o/ /rtags ni sems can la lus srog gtong ba'o gsungs/ gnyis pa 'bru gnyer ni zhe sdang gcod ces pas so/ / ru pad 'byung ni/ dper na tsha reg gang na yod pa na grang reg med/ grang reg gang na yod pa na tsha reg med/ dpe de ltar gang zag gcig gi rgyud la zhe sdang skyes tsa na snying rje med/ snying rje skyes tsa na zhe sdang med pas lhan cig mi gnas pa'i 'gal ba ste/ kun tu snang ba'i snying rjes zhe sdang bcad pa'o gsungs/ ru bi ma la/ rjes 'gro dang ldog pa ste/ byams pa bsgom pas snying rje'i rjes su 'gro zhing / zhe sdang ldog pa'o gsungs/ ru bal bo sgra rtag 'dzin sgro 'dogs dang / sgra min pa'i nges shes ltar skad cig lhan gcig mi gnas 'gal te/ snying rjes zhe sdang gcod gsungs/ gsum pa nyams su blang ba ni/ gong gi stong nyid kyi ngang las snying rje rang shugs su skye bas sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje bsgoms te/ kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin tshar ro/ /gsum pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin la gsum ste/ dang po don bskor gyi dbang du byas na mtshan gzhi rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin de la mtshan nyid bco brgyad dang ldan pas de rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin da 141 da

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/mtshon pa'o/ /de yang du pad+ma ni/ dang po chos thams cad kyi nang nas hūṃ sngon po yig 'bru'i rnam pa ste rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'o na yig 'bru'i ting nge 'dzin bya mod/rgyu zhes ci bya zer na/ de ni hūṃ rten gzhal yas khang / brten pa lha thams cad de las bskyed pa'i rgyur 'dug pas so/ / gsum pa ni gsum ste/ bud+dhā'i thugs ni hūṃ de la ye shes lnga dang ldan pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi rtsa mdud la hūṃ rang chas su gnas pa dang / las dang po pa hūṃ blos bsgom pa'o/ /bzhi pa las ni/ rten dang brten pa skyed par byed pa'i las can no/ / lnga pa ming ni/ rgyu'i sa bon gyi yig 'bru skyed byed kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /drug pa ma bstan na bskyed pa'i rim pa cho ga dang mi ldan zhing rdzogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa bstan pas cho ga rdzogs par 'gyur ba'o gsungs/ ru bi ma la ni/ dang po dmigs yul yig 'bru la dmigs/ sgom thabs 'bur du gtod pa ltar bsgom/ lam du mtshan bcas khyer/ rtags bskyed rim gsal bar 'ong / nyon mongs chad lta sbyong / sa lam tshogs lam pa'o/ / 'bras bu sprul sku thob gsungs so/ / ru bal po ni/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum las/ gnas skabs 'bras bu yin/ sku gsum las sprul sku'o/ / dpe sa bon no/ /rtags gsal snang ngo gsungs so/ /gnyis pa 'bru gnon ni/ mtshon chen sngon por 'bar ba yis/ / nam mkha'i dkyil nas thigs pa shar/ / zhes pa las/ ru pad+ma ni/mtshon chen zhes pa ni kha dog la'ang 'gro/ rtswa yi lo ma la yang 'gro/ gri mdung la'ang 'gro/pho mo'i mtshan ma la'ang 'gro mod kyi/ 'dir rten gzhal yas khang dang / brten pa lha hūṃ 'dis mtshon pa la bya gsungs/ mtshon chen ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'o/ / sngon po ni hūṃ gi kha dog go / 'bar ba ni hūṃ de las yig 'bru mang po 'phros shing 'dus pas so/ / ru bi ma la/bud+dhā'i dgongs pa sems kyi mtshon te/ mi 'gyur bas sngon po mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar bas so gsungs/ ru bal po ni/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rgyur mtshon pa'i hūṃ sngon po 'od zer 'bar ba'o/ / ru pad+ma/ nam mkha' la snang ba nam mkha'/ bu ga nam mkha'/'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha'/ chos nyid kyi nam mkha' bzhi las chos nyid kyi'o/ / dkyil mtha' dbus med pa'o/ / thigs pa la gnyis/ don 'dril ba'i phyir na thigs pa dang /don thog tu phebs pa'i phyir na thigs pa ste/ dang po ni/ hūṃ de la ye shes lnga ldan pas 'dril lo/ / gnyis pa ni/ rten dang brten pa'i thog tu phebs pa'o gsungs/ ru bi ma la/chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu las thugs rje thigs pa ltar shar ba'o/ /ru bal po ni/nam mkha' chos sku/ mtshon chen sngon po longs sku/ thigs pa sprul skur bshad do/ /gsum — 142 —

༄khya/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagapa nyams su len na/ hūṃ gser dngul la lugs su blugs pa 'dra ba zhig bsgom mo/ / rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin tshar ro/ /gnyis pa rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang / / snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ / zhes pas/ nu pad 'byung gis/ srog ni rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin hūṃ yin la/ sgor shar ba la gnyis te/ 'byung ba'i rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i sgor shar ba dang / gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa'i sgor shar ba'o gsungs/ de la dang po 'byung ba rim brtsegs la gsum ste/ phyi'i 'byung ba rim brtsegs/ nang gi 'byung ba rim brtsegs/ gsang ba'i 'byung ba rim brtsegs so/ / dang po phyi'i 'byung ba la mdo lnga/ rtsa ba drug yan lag sum cu tham pa'o/ / dang po mdo lnga 'byung ba lnga'o/ / rtsa ba drug ni phyi 'byung ba dang ji ltar sbyar/ nang phung po dang gang ltar sbyar/ gsang ba nyon mongs pa dang ji ltar sbyar/ gsal ba lha dang gang ltar sbyar/ bde ba ye shes dang ji ltar sbyar/ stong pa chos dang gang ltar sbyar/ zhes pa'o/ /de yang srog ni rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūṃ de nyid do/ /hūṃ de spa ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces phar 'phros/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ byas te tshur bsdus pas hūṃ de nus pa dang ldan par song ba ni sgo ru shar zhes pa'o/ / hūṃ de las e gcig chad/ e spa ra ṇa phaṭa/ces phar spros/ e saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ tshur bsdus pas e las nam mkha' gru gsum tshad med pa zhig bsgom/ phyi 'byung ba nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgor shar ba'o/ / nang lus kyi khong gseng / bar du nyon mongs pa gti mug lha rnam snang / yum kun tu bzang / ye shes chos dbyings/ de thams cad chos nyid stong par 'dus pa'o/ / de nas hūṃ las yo chad/sga ra ṇa phaṭa dang / saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ kun la'agre/ phar spro tshur 'dus pa las rlung rdo rje rgya gram sngo skya bsgom/ phyi 'byung ba rlung gi dal sgor shar ba'o/ / nang lus kyi skyod byed do/ / nyon mongs pa phrag dog lha don grub dang sgrol ma/ ye shes bya grub/ de thams cad chos dbyings stong par 'dus so/ /yang hūṃ las ra zhig chad/ phar spros/ tshur 'dus pas ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrug par bsgom/ 'byung ba phyi chu/ nang khrag gsang ba 'dod chags/ lha snang mtha' dang mā ma gī/ ye shes sor rtog de thams cad chos nyid stong par 'dus so/ /yang hūṃ las sum̐ gcig chad/ phar spros tshur 'dus pa las dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi sra zhing 'thas pa'i steng du/ yang hūṃ las kau gcig chad/ phar spros tshur 'dus keng dus kyi ri rab sngo mkhregs su 'dug pa/ dpag tshad brgyad khri yar thon pa'o/ /de ni 'byung ba sa'i sgor shar ba'o/ /nad rus pa nyon mongs zhe sdang / lha rdo rje sems dpa' — 143 —

sum̐r pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/dang sangs rgyas spyan/ ye shes me long ye shes/ de thams cad chos nyid stong par 'dus so/ /yang hūṃ las ram̐ gcig chad/ phar spros tshur 'dus pas/ ri rab steng du me gru gsum du 'bar bar bsam/ 'byung ba me'i sgor shar ba'o/ / nang drod/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal/lha rin 'byung dang gos dkar/ ye shes mnyam pa nyid/ de thams cad chos nyid stong par 'dus so/ / gnyis pa gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa'i sgor shar ba ni/ hūṃ las r+ghaṃ gcig chad/ phar spros tshur 'dus pa las r+ghaṃ bi shwa bi shurnye dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la ñdzu zhes pas ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi rin po che sna lnga las grub pa/ nang dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhan yas khang / de yang thod pa skam po'i 'gram sha ra ri can gyi bar/rlon pa lcang lo can kha bad du btang ba/ thod pa de rnams kyi kha nas me 'bar ba/ sna nas du ba 'thul ba/ mig nas gdung ba'i mchi ma khrag tu skyugs pa/ gnam lcags ur mos gzer btab pa/ rgyu ma'i zung gis sbrel bas brtsegs pa'o/ / 'og gi sa gzhi ni/ māṃ sa'i sa gzhi/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ keng rus kyi ri rab khrag dang rnag gi tshom bur 'khyil ba/ dri chen gyi zhal zas zhal zhal 'dra ste steng dri chu'i chag chag btab pa'o/ / steng gi phub ni lha brgyad kyi ka ba/ klu brgyad kyi gdung ma/ gza' brgyad kyi dral phyam/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi dril bu/ mi'i g.yang gzhi'i thog phub/ zhing chung gi zar tshags/ tsit+ta'i pho thogazla ba'i ka gdan/ nyi ma'i ka zhu/ zla ba'i skar khung / nyi ma'i mthong khung ngo / /phyi'i rgyan ni/ mi'u rigs bzhi srid pa spyi blugs su bshus pa'i rgyal mtshan/ nya chen kyi 'phan/ keng rus kyi gdugs/ dregs pa chen po bsgral ba'i tsit+ta'i tog de'i phyi na dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyi na dur khrod kyi chas bzhi la/ shar na bya kaṅka skad sgrog pa/lho na khyi kyi ling ngu zug pa/ nub na 'dre me 'bar ba/ byang na du ba 'thul ba'o/ / dbus kyi pho brang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dam/ rgya mdud 'degs pa gang 'os su bsgom pa'o/ /der gdan bting ba ni/ gong gi hūṃ las dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lha mo bzhi 'phros pas/ dbus kyi pho brang 'khor lo'i mthil du paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ ma las nyi ma/ ti ra baṃ zhes brjod pas ru tra pho kha sbub/ mo gan rkyal/ byin pa 'khril ba 'gyel ba/ de'i steng du mos pa'i gdan la rang gi dgra bgegs gding ngo / / gnyis pa 'khor gyi gdan ni/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ shar dang shar lho rnams su brgya byin dang me lha nas/ 'og phyogs sa bdag gi bar bkug la pho kha sbub/ mo gan rkyal du byin pa 'khril ba 'gyel bar rings so/ /sgo bzhi shar dri za/ lho gshin rje/ nub klu/ byang gnod sbyin bkug la gding ngo / /lha snam la phur srung — 144 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nag dgod de/ gdan mi dgos/ des na gsang rgyud las/ yam̐ las rlung gi da la sngo/ / ram̐ las me dkyil gru gsum dmar/ / be las chu dkyil dkar po zlum/ / sum̐ las sa gzhi gru bzhi ser/ /kau las keng rus ri rab 'bar/ /de steng ñdzu las grub pa yis/ /mdzes pa'i gzhal yas thod pa'i mkhar/ / mchog phran dral phyam nyi zla'i mig / rak+ta 'bar ba'i zham chu 'bab/ /ces bshad pa'i don yin no/ /de rnams phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa nang bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ rang gi lus la tshang ste/ gsang rgyud las/ rkang pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ /'doms mo me yi dkyil 'khor yin/ /gsus pa chu yi dkyil 'khor yin/ /pho ba sa yi dkyil 'khor yin/ / brang ni keng rus ri rab yin/ / mgo bo klad pa'i gzhal yas khang / / rtsa gnas dbus na lha tshogs bzhugs/ / zhes pas dkyil 'khor lus la tshang ste/lus 'dom gang gru bzhi ni dkyil 'khor gru bzhi'o/ / 'khor lo lnga po dbus kyi pho brang ngo / /rkang lag bzhi sgo bzhi/ tshigs bzhi rta bab bzhi/ rkang brgyad ka ba brgyad/ mthil bzhi chos 'khor gdugs/ so dang sen mo tog dang / rdo rje rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ dbang po lnga mthong skar/ yul lnga 'dod yon/ rtsa rgyus rin chen pha gu/ rus pa'i tshigs drwa ba dang drwa phyed/ sor mo rnams mda' yab/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur/ skra dang ba spu me ri'o/ /khrag 'thung rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar rtsa gnas la phur bu'i lha tshogs tshang ba 'god do/ /nang bskyed pa tshar ro/ /gsum pa gsang ba bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ rang gi sems la lha dang dkyil 'khor thams cad tshang ste/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ sems la mtha' dbus med pas nam mkha' stong pa/ sems yang zhing g.yeng bas rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sems brlan zhing mnyen pas chu'i dkyil 'khor/ sems sra zhing mi 'gyur bas sa'i dkyil 'khor/ sems rgya che dpangs mtho ste ri rab/ sems gsal zhing rno bas me'i dkyil 'khor/ sems la thams cad 'dus pas gzhal yas khang / kun gzhi'i rnam shes lte ba/ nyon yid lha snam/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes sgo bzhi/ ye shes rta babs/ rang sems rdo rje gzhon nu/ sems la sna tshogs skye pas 'khor gyi lha tshogs yin te/ lha dang dkyil 'khor tshang ngo / /gsang ba bskyed pa'i rim pa tshar ro/ /gzhal yas rnam dag ni/ gsang rgyud las/ gzhal yas rnam par dag pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du ngas bshad bya/ / rdo rje'i gur du byung ba ni/ / phyi yi bgegs kyis mi tshugs rtags/ /bka' yi 'khor los brgyan pa ni/ / nang gi bdud kyis mi tshugs rtags/ / chos bhe 145 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/'byung nang du gsal ba ni/ / chos kyi dbyings las byung ba'i rtags/ / 'byung ba bzhi yis bskyed pa ni/ /yum bzhi'i mkha' la gnas pa'i rtags/ /gzhal yas gru bzhi 'byung ba ni/ /sangs rgyas sems can mnyam pa'i rtags/ / sgo bzhi par yang byung ba ni/ / dran pa nye bar bzhi yi rtags/ /sgo ba bzhi ni stobs lnga'o/ /rta babs bzhi ru byung ba ni/ /yang dag spong pa bzhi yi rtags/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bzhi po ni/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang ba bzhi yi rtags/ /'dod yon lnga yi lha mo ni/ /dbang po lnga po gsos 'debs rtags/ /drwa ba drwa ba phyed pa ni/ /byang chub yan lag bdun du bshad/ / ka ba brgyad kyis brgyan pa ni/ / 'phags lam yan lag brgyad du bshad/ / pañtsa re khā ye shes lnga/ / gru gsum rnam thar gsum yin te/ / rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams rdzogs/ /zhes so/ /thod mkhar gyi rnam dag ni/ thod pa skam po'i 'gram chos sku/ sha ra ri can longs sku/ lcang lo can sprul sku/ kha nas me 'bar rnam rtog sreg/ sna nas du ba 'thul ba byin brlabs/ mig nas mchi ma thugs rjerīche ba/ gnam lcags ur mo'i gzer skye med ston pa/ rgyu ma'i zung thabs shes rgya ma chad pa'o/ /'og gzhi la māṃ sa'i sa gzhi gti mug dag rak+ta 'dod chags dag keng rus zhe sdang dag rnag khrag tshom bur 'khyil sprul sku/ dri chu chag chag longs sku/ dri chen chos sku'o/ /steng gi phub la lha brgyad ka ba steng lha'i lo ka dbang du sdud pa/ klu brgyad gdung ma 'og klu brgyad dbang du sdud pa/ gza' dang rgyu skar sa bla dbang du sdud pa/ mi'i g.yang gzhi'i bar mi'i lo ka dbang du sdud pa/ zhing chung 'dod yon/ tsit+ta zhen med/ nyi zla thabs shes rgyas thebs pa/phyi'i dur khrod brgyad tshogs brgya dag shar na bya skad mi rtag pa ston pa/ lho na khyi zug pas 'khor ba 'dul/ nub na me 'bar ba byin rlabs che/ byang du du ba 'thul ba 'khor ba ma spangs par sangs rgya'o/ /rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa tshar ro/ /spyi don gsum pa lhar bskyed pa la gsum ste/ chos kyi sku'i ngo bo bdag nyid co ba'i dal bskyed pa dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i ngo bo phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i dal bskyed pa dang /sprul pa'i sku'i ngo bo phur pa rdzas kyi dal bskyed pa'o/ / dang po chos kyi sku'i ngo bo bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dal bskyed pa la gnyis te/ bskyed pa dngos dang gsal gdab pa'o/ / dang po la mdo bcu/ rtsa ba bzhi bcu/ yan lag brgyad cu'o/ / dang po ni/ bdag nyid co ba'i dal bskyed pa'i rgyu sems dpa' bzhi yod na gang yin/ bskyed pa'i sku'i cha lugs bzhi bya ba yod na gang yin/ bskyed pa'i khyad par mtshan nyid bzhi po gang yin/ bskyed pa'i gnas skabs bzhi yod na gang yin/ bskyed thabs kyi cho ga bzhi yod na gang yin/ bskyed pa'i lha bzhi — 146 bhe

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagayod na gang yin/ bskyed pa'i lha yi sbyang gzhi bzhi yod na gang yin/ bskyed pa'i lha yi nges tshig bzhi yod na gang yin/ bskyed pa la rnam dbye bzhi yod na gang yin/ bskyed pa la lam khyer bzhi yod na gang yin/ ces pa dang bcu'o/ / dang po bskyed pa'i rgyu'i sems dpa' bzhi po ni/ sngon dus mtshams la 'jug tsa na/ rang yi dam lha mos pa byas pa de dam tshig gi sems dpa' yin/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gsum sgom nas cho ga gsum gyis bskyed pa ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yin/ de nas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren pa de lha ye shes sems dpa' yin/ de gnyis su med par bsres pa de gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sems dpa' yin/ bskyed rim cig mi bsgom na mi bsgom zhes bya/ bsgom phan chad/ de bzhi ma tshang pa mi srid pa yin no/ / gnyis pa bskyed pa'i cha lugs bzhi la phyogs gcig tu a thang chad pa med de/ rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas phur pa gsang rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa na/ rdo rje gzhon nu dbu stong phyag stong spyan bye ba stong mnga' bar bshad/ phur pa myang 'dus le'u bzhi par ru tra btul tsa na rdo rje gzhon nu dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad par bshad/ rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa sogs na rdo rje gzhon nu dbu gsum phyag drug par bshad/ gī la ya tan+t+ra bcu gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyud la sogs pa nas/ rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bshad pas/gang ltar bsgom kyang 'dra'o/ / gshin rje gshed la sogs thams cad na de ltar sna tshogs su bshad do/ / gsum pa bskyed pa'i khyad par mtshan nyid bzhi ni/ khro bo byas pas bdud dang srin po khros pa lta bu min te/ thugs rje chen pos gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs su bstan pa yin pas/ blo rab cig gis dag pa'i lha bsgom pa yin/ blo 'bring gis rnam pa tsam du lha bsgom pa yin/ blo tha mas lha yi nga rgyal tsam du lha bsgom pa yin/ sngags pa lha lam pa bya ba nga rgyal tsam gyis kyang 'grub pa yin no/ / bzhi ba bskyed pa'i gnas skabs bzhi la las dang po pas shes pa lhar bskyed pa yin te/ rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /zhes pa'o/ /las goms pa pas bdag nyid lhar bsgom pa yin te/ sku yi dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig / ces so/ /las smin pa pas phung po lhar bsgom pa yin te/ phung po rdo rjer gtams byas nas/ /zhes so/ /las mthar phyin pas yul thams cad lhar bsgom pa yin te/ srid pa rdo rje phur bu'i lha/ /zhes so/ / lnga ba bskyed thabs kyi cho ga bzhi la/ blo yang rab gcig gis skad cig gis skad cig dran rdzogs su bskyed do/ / rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod pas bzang ste/ ye shes kyi tshogs pa yin no/ / blo rab cig stong ba dang snying rje'i ngang nas rtsa sngags brjod pas lhar langs te/ rtog pa nyung bas bsod nams dang ye shes gnyis ka yod do/ / blo 'bring — 147 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/zhig chos gsum gyis lhar ldang ste/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ gsung hūṃ/ thugs rdo rje/ de gyur pas rdo rje gzhon nu bskyed pa'o/ /blo tha ma zhig gis bskyed rgyu'i chos gsum la/ bskyed thabs kyi chos bcu drug gis bskyed de/ de yang bskyed rgyu ni gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang dkar po gsum mo/ /chos bcu drug ni/ dang po rgyud ting nge 'dzin hūṃ mthing nag de gtso bo'i gdan thog tu babs te de las 'od zer 'phro ba/ mdzad pa bsdu ba bsdus te brtan par 'khod pa bzhi byas pas rdo rje rtse dgu par song / de las kyang 'od zer spro ba/ mdzad pa/ bsdu ba/ bsdus te brtan par 'khod pa bzhi/ rdo rje de rgyu'i rdo rje 'chang dkar por song / de las kyang 'od zer spro ba/ mdzad pa/ bsdu ba/ bsdus te brtan par 'khod pa las rtsa sngags brjod/rdo rje gzhon nu sku che la yan lag rags par bskyed/ de las kyang 'od zer spro ba/ mdzad pa/bsdu ba/ bsdus te brtan par 'khod pa bzhi ste/ bcu drug gis bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag dang ldan pa rdzogs pa yin no/ /drug pa bskyed pa'i lha bzhi ni/ gtso bo yab yum rdzogs pa dang / lha bzhi bskyed dgos te/ srog gi lha dang gcig sku gsung thugs kyi lha dang gnyis/ rgyan gyi lha dang gsum/ go cha'i lha dang bzhi'o/ / dang po srog gi lha ni/ bdag nyid kyi snying ga'i nang tsit+ta rin po che'i pho brang du ye shes sems dpa' rdzus skyes rang 'dra ba tshon gang ba bsam/ de'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma'i gwa'u tsam/ de'i steng du rdo rje nas tsam/ de'i lte ba la rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin hūṃ spus bris pa tsam/ de'i mtha' ma ni gī la ya 'bru dgus bskor bar bsgom/ de'i sgo srung du rta mgrin gsang ba'i yum bzhi dang bcas pa bsgom ste lha bdun no/ /gnyis pa sku gsung thugs kyi lha ni/ thig le re las/ spyi bor bud+dhā he nu ka yab yum dkar po bsgom/ mgrin par pad+ma he ru ka yab yum dmar po bsgom/ thugs kar badz+ra he ru ka yab yum mthing ga lte bar rat+na he du ka yab yum ser po/gsang bar karma he ru ka yab yum ljang gur bsgom mo/ / gsum pa rgyan gyi lha ni/ dbang bskur ba'i dus dbang rtags su rigs lnga cha gcig dbu la bzhugs par bsgom mo/ / des na sku gsung thugs kyi yab yum bcu/ dbu rgyan la bcu ste nyi shu/ srog gi lha bdun de nyer bdun no/ /bzhi pa go cha'i lha ni/ ba spu'i bu ga re nas rdzus skyes su khro chung re re ste khrab gyon pa ltar ro/ /grangs bye ba sa ya'o/ /bdun pa sbyang gzhi ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha sgong skyes/ye shes sems dpa' rdzus skyes/ byang sems zhu ba las byung ba dbu rgyan lha mngal skyes/ go cha'i lha drod gsher las skyes pa'o/ /dal gyi lha la sbyar na/ bdag rtsa ba rdzus skyes/ phyogs — 148 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagabacu'i khro bo mngal skyes/ mgo brnyan nyi shu sgong skyes/ dam can srung ma drod gsher las skyes te/ sbyang gzhi sems can gyi skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba'o/ / brgyad pa bskyed pa'i nges tshig bzhi ni/ chos sku'i nges tshig bdag nyid kyi nges tshig rtsa ba'i nges tshig dkyil 'khor gyi nges tshig go / dang po ni/ spros pa dang bral ba'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid bsgom pa'o/ / gsum pa ni/ 'khor kyi lha thams cad 'byung bas rtsa ba'o/ / bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dal srog gi lha/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha/ rgyan gyi lha/ go cha'i lha rnams 'khor yin pas bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dal zhes bya'o/ / dgu pa bskyed pa'i rnam dbye bzhi ni/bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dal gyi bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dal cig yod na gang yin/ de ni ye shes sems dpa'i yin no/ /bdag rtsa ba'i dal gyi phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i dal cig yod na gang yin/ de ni sku gsung thugs kyi lha'o/ / bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dal gyi phur pa rdzas kyi dal cig yod na gang yin/ de ni phyag tha ma'i phur pa rnams so/ /bdag nyid rtsa ba'i phur srung bcu gnyis yod na gang yin/ de ni ba spu'i khro chung rnams so/ /bcu ba bskyed pa'i lam khyer bzhi ni/ rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa las/ rang sems gzhi yi rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ / sa bon kun khyab til mar 'dra/ /rtogs nas sangs rgyas ngo mtshar che/ /bgrod pa lam gyi rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ / thabs shes sku gsung ye shes lnga/ /chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bya/ /rtogs pa 'bras bu'i rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /sku lnga ye shes dgu ldan te/ /ma 'khrul rtogs pa mngon 'gyur bya/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu rtogs gyur na/ /chos sku spros bral mngon du 'gyur/ /zhes pa sa gzhi lam 'bras gsum po de chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin/ de la brten nas rnam dag bstan pa ni/ yab yum gnyis su med par sbyor ba bstan pa ni dbyings dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'o/ /sku mdog mthing nag chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'o/ / dbu gsum sku gsum rnam thar gsum mo/ / phyag drug phar phyin drug go /zhabs bzhi rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi'o/ /dang po rdo rje rtse dgu theg pa dgu/ rtse lnga ye shes lnga/ me dpung nyon mongs bsregs/ kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum gcod/ ri rab phur bu gdug pa 'dul pa'o/ / dur khrod kyi chas dgu la byug pa'i rdzas gsum/ bgo ba'i gos gsum/ gdags pa'i rgyan gsum mo/ / dang po thal chen gyi tshom bu chos sku/ rak+ta'i thig le longs sku/ zhag gi zo ris sprul sku'o/ /gnyis pa glang chen ko rlon theg chen/ zhing chen mtha' gnyis spangs pa/ stag sham phrin las rdzogs pa'o/ / gsum pa sbrul chun zhe sdang 'joms/ rus rgyan phar phyin drug thod phreng sku gsum mo/ / gar gyi nyams dgu la/sku'i gar gsum/ gsung gi gar gsum/ thugs kyi gar gsum mo/ / dang po sgeg pa/— 149 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/dpa' ba/ 'jigs su rung ba gsum sku yi/ rgod pa/ gshe ba/ 'jigs pa gsum gsung gi/ snying rje/ rngams pa/ zhi ba thugs kyi gar gsum mo/ /rgyud las/ chad pa ma yin rig cing gsal/ / rtag pa ma yin ngos bzung med/ / snang stong dbyer med gtan la dbab/ / mi bskyed rdzogs pa'i tshul du bsgom/ / zhes pas na/ bskyed rdzogs dbyer med du bsgom mo/ / de ltar bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa gnyis la sbyar na yan lag brgyad cu'o/ /gnyis pa gsal gdab pa ni/ sho lo ka gcig ste/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /zhes pas/ dam tshig ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba sbyar ro/ / 'bru bshad ni/ ru pad 'byung ni/snying rjes dug gsum bsgral lo gsungs/ ru bi ma la ni/ snying rjes zhes khams gsum sems can/ bdag rdo rje gzhon nu dang gnyis su med nas bsgral ba yin no gsungs/ rgyud las/snying rje rgyud mi chad pa'i byang chub sems / / bsgral med ngang du rtogs na dam tshig yin/ /zhes pas mngon no/ / ru bal po/ snying rjes kun nas bslangs te gdug can bsgral ba dam tshig gsungs/ bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ / zhes pas ru pad+ma ni/ zhe sdang gis bsad cing phrag dog gis mnan pa ma yin te/ thugs rjes sems can 'khor ba las bsgral bar bya gsungs so/ / ru bi ma la ni/ ye shes kyi nyon mongs zil gyis mnan te/ byang sems skye shi med pa de la bya gsungs/ ru bal po ni/ sems nyid skye shi med pa de la bsad rgyu med la/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes su mnan/ mi 'gyur ba la mnan rgyu med gsungs so/ /phung po rdo rjer gtams byas nas/ /zhes pad 'byung gis gzugs phung la sogs lnga rdo rje phung po'i rigs lngar gtams pa'o/ / zhes gsungs/ ru bi ma la ni/ phung po rnam par shes pa'i phung po ste/ rdo rje gzhon nur bskyed la/ ba spu'i bu ga khro chung gis gtams pa'o gsungs/ ru bal pos/ gzas pa po gnas spor tsa na/ lha dang gnyis su med par gtams pa'o gsungs/ rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /zhes pas/ pad 'byung tshogs brgyad sems dpa' sems mar bsgom/ rdo rje gzhon nu las khro bo khro mor 'byung bas so gsungs/ rle bi ma las/ rnam par shes pas lha yi nga rgyal la bya gsungs/ ru bal po phung po lha skur bsgom pa bya'o gsungs/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya sarba bigha nān baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa la gsum ste/ ru gsum gyi dgongs pa bsdu ba dang / rgyud kyi dgongs pa gsum bshad pa dang / thams cad 'dus pa'i 'dus lugs so/ / dang po ni/ ru pad+ma'i zhal nas/ oṃ sku lnga ye shes lnga/ badz+ra dus gsum 'dus ma byas/ gī li lha dang gī la ya phur pa gso ba/sarba dgra dgegs thams cad/ bigha nān mnan pa/ baṃ hūṃ dbang du bsdu ba/ phaṭa sgrol da 150 da

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagaba'o gsungs/ ru bi ma la/ oṃ thugs ye shes lnga ldan/ badz+ra rdo rje dbyer med/ gī li phur pa/ gī la ya skye med 'gag med/ sarba nyon mongs ye shes su sgyur cig bigha nān ye shes kyis nyon mongs thams cad gzir cig baṃ dbang du byas la/ hūṃ nyon mongs choms shig phaṭa nyon mongs sregs shig pa'o/ / ru bal po/ oṃ ye shes lnga/ badz+ra gī li rdo rje phur bu/ gī la ya 'debs pa/ sarba thams cad/ bigha nān phur pa'i ri rab kyis mnan pa/ baṃ dbang du sdud pa/ hūṃ gis sku bskyed/ phaṭa spro ba'o gsungs/ gnyis pa rgyud kyi dgongs pa bshad pa la gsum ste/ lha dang sbyar te bshad pa/ chos nyid dang sbyar te bshad pa/ byang sems dgongs pa dang sbyar ba'o/ / dang po ni/ rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags hūṃ ngo / /bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya'o/ / bskul ba las kyi sngags ni/sarba bigha nān zhes pa'o/ / bzlas pa las kyi sngags ni/ baṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'o/ / gnyis pa chos nyid dang sbyar na/ 'dzab dgongs dang sbyar la/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa/ gsal la ngos gzung med pa/ sgra grags stong du bzlas pa'o/ /gsum pa/ oṃ rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku/ badz+ra dbyings gting mtha' med pa/gī li gī la ya/ phur bu las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgral/ sarba yum gyi mkha'/ bigha nān yab kyi mkha'/ baṃ mkha' dbyings sbyor ba/ hūṃ bud+dhā'i thugs ye shes lnga/ phaṭa khro bo khro mo 'phro ba'o/ / gsum pa thams cad 'dus lugs ni/ rdo rje phur pa khrag 'thung rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ oṃ ni dpal chen yab yin te/ badz+ra shes rab yum yin no/ / kyi ni ye shes khro bo la/ /li ni dbyings kyi khro mo bcu/ / gī ni thabs kyi mche ba can/ / la ni shes rab gshog pa can/ / ya ni sras mchog phur pa ste/ / hūṃ ni phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi/ / sarba thams cad 'dus pa ste/ /bigha ni dgra dang sgrib pa yin/ /nān ni dgra dang bgegs mnan no/ /baṃ ni dbang du sdud pa ste/ /hūṃ ni brlag par byed pa'o/ /phaṭa kyis sgrol ba'i phrin las rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ / bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dal tshar ro/ /gnyis pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i ngo bo phyogs bcu'i khro bo bskyed pa la gnyis te/gsol ba gdab pa dang / bskyed pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /zhes pas/ sho lo ka gcig go /gnyis pa bskyed pa dngos ni gsum ste/ mdo bcu/ rtsa ba brgya tham pa/ yan lag bzhi brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi'o/ / dang po ni/byang sems rgyu'i khro bo bcu bya ba yod na gang yin/ bskyed pa ye shes kyi khro bo bcu bya ba yod na gang yin/ gdul bya sprul pa'i khro bo bcu bya ba yod na gang ltar yin/ drag po 'dul ba — 151 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/gsung gi khro bo bcu bya ba yod na gang yin/ ye shes rtse gcig thugs kyi khro bo bcu bya ba yod na ji ltar yin/ grangs nges pa dang ma nges pa bcu bya ba yod na gang yin/ 'khor nges pa dang ma nges pa bcu zhes bya ba yod na gang la zer/ sku mdog nges pa dang ma nges pa bcu po gang la zer/ phyag 'tshan nges pa dang ma nges pa bcu po ji ltar yin/ rnam dag nges pa dang ma nges pa bcu po ci yin/ zhes pa bcu'o/ / de las dang po byang sems rgyu'i khro bo bcu zer kyang /de re re la bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi yod do/ / gang zhe na khro bo bcu/ khro mo bcu/ mgo brnyan pha bcu ma bcu ste bzhi bcu/ sgo ma bzhi stesmozhe bzhi'o/ / de ltar bcu po la so sor brtsis pas bzhi brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi yod/ de las dang po rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags/ sa bon bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi las bskyed dgos te/ de'i sngon du gtso bo yab yum la mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yab kyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la zhes pas zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ sked par āḥ bum par oṃ/ bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag go /yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las/ a smur+ya maṇ+ḍa la baṃ zhes pas nyi ma'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa ze'u 'bru la a'o/ /de nas snyoms 'jug byas te/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃḥ ra ho haṃ/ rā ga ya mi zhes pas/ sngar gyi phyogs skyong bcu byi chings su bsnol pa'i steng du/ yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas hūṃ sbrel ma bcu/ thig le dkar dmar bcu ste bzhi bcu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbazhi ste zhe bzhi de rnams rang rang gi phyogs ma nor ba spro'o/ / ngag tu'ang hūṃ hūṃ zhes brjod do/ / gnyis pa bskyed pa ye shes kyi khro bo bcu ni/bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags bcu brjod pas lha krong krong bskyed pa'o/ / de'ang tshangs pa bsnol pa'i gdan la hūṃ gnyis thig le gnyis bzhi po las/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ zhes brjod pas/hūṃ gcig las khro bo hūṃ ka ra bskyed/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi shwa ri dī pa ya ti hūṃ brjod pas hūṃ gcis las yum rdo rje sgra 'byin ma bskyed/ oṃ(oṃ badz+ra su ka ra mu kha hūṃ)badz+ra u ka mu ka ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas thig le gcig las phag gi mgo can g.yas su bskyed/ badz+ra(oṃ badz+ra i ṣā pa mu khi hūṃ)u ga si mu khi ho/ zhes brjod pas rmig pa'i mgo can g.yon du bskyed do/ /gdan thog re rer lha bzhi bzhi bskyed pa ni tshad med pa bzhi'o/ / de ni rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'o/ / man ngag gi rjes su 'brang na/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra zhes brjod pas khro rgo hūṃ ka ra bskyed/ hūṃ zhes pas yum rdo rje sgra 'byin ma bskyed/ gardza zhes pas phag mgo can dang gardza hūṃ zhes pas smig bu'i mgo can bskyed/ de ltar 'og gi stobs po che'i bar du bskyed do/ /de nas bi da ya bing bing hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa shar sgor lcags kyu ma bskyed/ de nas dril bu ma'i bar du 'gre'o/ /da 152 da

rgu/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagagasum pa gdul bya sprul pa sku'i khro bo bcu ni/ khro bo yab yum/ mgo brnyan yab yum/ de nas khro bo rnams zhal gsum phyag drug yum yab la 'khril ba/ mgo brnyan zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ bsnyen dus su sku mdog sna tshogs pa'o/ /bzhi ba drag po 'dul ba gsung gi khro bo bcu ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra zhes pa nas ma hā ba la'i bar dang / bzlas pa sngags ha na ha na'i bar dang / pa tsa pa tsa zhes pa'i bar thog 'dril ba ltar bzlas pa'o/ / lnga pa ye shes rtse gcig thugs kyi khro bo bcu ni/ khro bcu'i phur pa sor bcu gnyis pa/ mgo brnyan gyi phur pa sor brgyad pa/ sgo ma'i phur pa sor bzhi pa ste/ lha phur lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'o/ /lha dgod/ngar blud/ byug bdug byas pa'o/ /drug pa grangs nges pa ni/ 'o na khro bcu kho nar grangs nges pa ci yod/ yang na bco lnga nyi shu/ yang na lnga drug gis chog mod zer na/ de'i lan ni bcu kho nar nges te/ gdul bya phyogs skyong bcu 'dul bas so/ / mang ba dang nyung ba don med do/ / 'o na steng gi khro bo hūṃ ka ra dang / 'og gi stobs po che gnyis go sa spos na ci lto brer na/ de mi thub ste/ hūṃ ka ra ni lha dang tshangs pa'i gnyen po yin la/ stobs po che sa bdag gi gnyen po yin pas spos na gdul bya mi thul lo/ /des shar nub la sogs 'gre'o/ /bdun pa 'khor nges ma nges ni/ steng gi hūṃ ka ra'i 'khor phag rmig bu 'di 'og gi stobs po che la spos/ dred dang byi ba hūṃ ka ra la spos na 'gal lam mi 'gal zer na/ 'gal te/tshangs pa'i 'khor na zla ba phag mgo can dang / nyi ma rmig bu'i mgo can yod pas de 'dul/'og sa bdag pho nya dred dang byi bas(mgo can yod)de mi thul pa'o/ /des thams cad la 'gre/yab kyi mche ba can rnams yum la spos la/ yum gyi gshog pa can yab la spos na mi 'gal lam zhe na/ de ni 'gal te/ mche ba can dang yab rnams chos mthun/ gshog pa can dang yum rnams chos mthun pas so/ /de ji ltar mthun na phag la gtsang smre med pa dang / hūṃ ka ra la rnam rtog med pas chos mthun/ rmig bu skam la gnas pa dang / sgra 'byin thar pa la gnas pa chos mthun/ yang stag ri mo bkra ba dang / rnam rgyal chos spyan bkra ba mthun/bya rgod srog sdom pa dang yum snyems ma rnam rtog sdom pa mthun/ g.yag khro la 'gyings pa dang /dbyug sngon khro la 'gyings pa mthun/ bya rog cho gsum rig pa dang / sder mo dus gsum mkhyen pa mthun/ shwa ba rdzi rno ba dang / gshin rje shes rab rno ba mthun/ 'ug pas mun pa la mthong ba dang / dur khrod kyis gdul bya la mthong ba mthun/ gzig la thig le yod pa dang / mi g.yo ba chos thams cad thig le gcig tu sdud pa mthun/ khu ta la sgrib shing yod pa dang / yum gyi chos nyid mi mthong ba mthun/ byi la'i skad kyis byi ba brgyal ba dang / rta — 153 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/mgrin gyi skad kyis klu brgyal ba mthun/ pu shud mig rtsi yod pa dang / yum lo thugs rje yod pa mthun/ spyang ki gsod la dga' ba dang / khro bo gdug pa bsgrol ba la dga' ba mthun/khras byi chung za ba dang / yum dam nyams za ba mthun/ seng ges ri dwags zil gyis gnon pa dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil bas dam nyams zil gyis gnon pa mthun/ pha waṃ mtha' gnyis spong ba dang / yum mtha' gnyis spong ba mthun/ dom gtum pa dang / khro bo dam nyams la gtum pa mthun/ sre mong yang rtsal che ba dang / yum rtogs tshad che ba mthun/ dred bu la snying rje che ba dang / khro bo sems can la snying rje che ba mthun/ byi ba sgo mang yang phug gcig tu sdod pa dang / yum chen chos can mang yang chos nyid gcig tu sdod pa mthun pas spor mi btub bo zhes rgyud las gsungs so/ / brgyad pa sku mdog nges ma nges ni/ bsnyen dus su shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / mtshams rnams phyogs gnyis kyi 'od 'dus pa'o/ /steng nam mkha'i mdog 'og mun pa'i mdog zhal g.yas g.yon kyang mtshams ltar ro/ / zhal ltar du mgo brnyan 'gyur bar gsang rgyud nas bshad do/ / sgrub dus su thams cad mthing nag 'ba' zhig ste/ khrag 'thung rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ zhal re la ni phyag gnyis pa/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la/ /kun kyang rdo rje phur pa 'dril/ /zhes bshad do/ / skabs kha cig tu yum rang rkyang bar sher par bya'o/ / dgu pa phyag mtshan nges ma nges ni/ khro bo rnams dang po gnyis rdo rjes bhan dmar dkrugs pa/ bar pa gnyis rang rang gi gdan phyogs skyong gi phyag mtshan 'phrogs pa/ tha ma ri rab phur pa 'dril ba'o/ /mgo brnyan g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon phur bu 'dril ba'o/ / sgrub dus su lha thams cad de ltar bshad do/ /bcu pa rnam dag ni/ gsang rgyud las/ ngag 'khyal rdzun dang srog gcod log lta phra/ /ma byin len dang tshig rtsub gnod sems dang / /brnab sems 'dod log dang ni de bcu'i yul rnams ni/ /rnam par dag pa khro bo khro mor shar/ /yum rnams ye shes shes rab tshul khrims bsam gtan thabs/ /brtson 'grus sbyin smon stobs dang bzod pa'o/ /hūṃ ka ra 'dod pa'i skyon spangs shing skye ba la mnga' mdzad pa'o/ /rnam rgyal ma byin len spangs yo byad la mnga' mdzad pa'o/ / dbyug sngon can log lta spangs nas ye shes la mnga' mdzad pa'o/ /gshin rje gshed srog gcod spangs nas tshe la mnga' mdzad pa'o/ /stobs po che'i bar du shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje sgra 'byin ma ni ye shes pha rol phyin ma'o/ /rdo rje snyems ma shes rab pha rol phyin ma'o/ / rdo rje sder mo tshul khrims pha rol phyin ma'o/ / dur khrod bdag mo bsam gtan pha rol phyin ma ste/ / bskyod byed ma'i bar du shes par bya'o/ / phra men phag mgo can — 154 —

༄khya/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagaganyid dbyings su dag pa'o/ / rmig bu'i mgo can gnyid kyi mtshan nyid dbyings su dag pa'o/ /stag mgo can sems kyi dngos po dag pa'o/ / bya rgod mgo can sems kyi yul rnam par dag pa'o/ / g.yag mgo can mun pa dag pa'o/ / bya rog mgo can mun yul dag ces bya ba'i bar du sbyar ro/ /shar sgo'i pu shud mgo can byams pa'o/ /lho sgo'i skya ka'i mgo can snying rje'o/ / nub sgor srin bya'i mgo can dga' ba'o/ / byang mgor khra yi mgo can btang snyoms so/ /rgyas par gsang rgyud du blta'o/ /'bru bshad na/ ru pad+ma 'byung gnas/ oṃ ye shes lnga/ badz+ra ni rdo rje/ kro dha ni khro bo/ hūṃ ka ra ni mtshan/ hūṃ 'og ma yum rdo rje sgra 'byin/ gardza phag mgo can/ gardza 'og ma rmig bu'i mgo can/ hūṃ sdud pa/ phaṭa spro ba'o gsungs/ nu bi ma la/ rgyu'i sngags hūṃ/ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra bskyed sngags/ gardza gardza hūṃ phaṭa/ bzlas pa las kyi sngags yin gsungs/ ru bal po ni/ oṃ tshangs pa'i snying po/badz+ra kro dha rgyu'i sngags/ hūṃ ka ra bskyed sngags/ gardza gardza bskul sngags/ hūṃ phaṭa bzlas sngags/ hūṃ ka ra bskyed kyang des bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs kyang des rlob/ bskul yang des bskul gsungs/ des 'gre'o/ / ru pad 'byung hūṃ ka ra la bzhi ste/ rang skal gyi phrin las gang 'dul na spyir phyogs skyong bcu/ sgos tshangs pa 'dul/ gnyis pa rtogs pa gang dag na/ spyir mi dge ba bcu/ sgos brnab sems dag gsum pa rnam dag la spyir dbang bcu/ sgos skye ba la dbang ngo / / bzhi pa nges tshig ni/ gar dgu/ tshul dgu/ chas dgu dang ldan pas khro bo/ bud+dhā bskyed pas yum/ thugs sprul bas sprul pa/ mgo lus mi gcig pas phra men no gsungs/ du bi ma la/ 'byung khungs las dang yon tan 'bras bzhir 'dod/ hūṃ ka ra rol ba'i stobs las byung / las tshangs pa tshar gcod / yon tan brnab sems spang / 'bras bu mos pa la dbang ngo / / yum la'ang bzhi las/ 'byung khungs par bcu las ye shes so/ /las tshangs pa'i chung ma 'dul/ yon tan ma rig pa sel/'bras bu ye shes thob/ sprul pa'i phra men la gang gis sprul/ gang las sprul/ sprul pa rang gi ngo bo/ sprul nas ci mdzad dang bzhi'o/ /dang po spyir khro bcu yab yum las/ khyad par hūṃ ka ra yab yum las/ gnyis pa smon lam ye shes las so/ /ngo bo phag rmig bu'o/ /mdzad pa phyogs skyong bcu'i ba dang ba mo 'dul/ phra men ma la gsum/ dpe'i phra men gser lag la bye dpo ra zir zer zisna byer chag lag theg char thegadangul bsras pa phra man yal ga zar/ dan dbyangs ya shas 'dras pa la phra man zar/rtags mgo lus mi gcig pas so/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /zhes pas du pad+ma ni/ thugs ye shes kyi rdo rje gzhon nu la gnyis/ don gyi gzhon nu la 'a༈ //gyur med/

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/rtags kyi gzhon nu mtshan dpe can no gsungs/ ru bi ma la/ rdo rje yang dag pa'i ye shes de rtogs na bgres rgud med pas gzhon nu/ ru bal po/ rdo rje stong ba de mi 'gyur bas gzhon nu/ rdo rje'i rigs rdo rje'i rigs kyis 'dzin/ rat+na'i rigs rat+nas 'dzin/ pad+ma'i sogs 'gre'o/ / spyir rig(rigs lnga'i ngo bo mthong ba la rig 'dzin pa zer/ mchan)'dzin la bzhi/ rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin no/ / rgyud las/ rnam par smin dang tshe la dbang / / phyag rgya che dang lhun gyis grub/ / ces so/ / de re re la brgyad de/ dang po rgyu/dus/ cha lugs/ dgongs pa/ sa lam/ chos nyan tshul/ 'gro don no/ / dang po rnam smin gyi rgyu lha'i ting nge 'dzin gsal ba'o/ / gnyis pa dus ni bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa thob dus so/ / gsum pa grub thob kyi cha lugs so/ / bzhi pa lha'i dal la dgongs pa'o/ /lnga pa tshogs lam mo/ / drug pa mos pas spyod pa'o/ / bdun pa chos rmi lam du nyan no/ /brgyad pa 'gro don dngos su byed do/ / gnyis pa tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin gyi rgyu ni rnam smin man chad do/ / gnyis pa dus ni rnam smin mthar phyin tsa na'o/ / gsum pa sprul pa sku'i cha lugs so/ / bzhi pa stong gsum dal du dgongs pa'o/ / lnga pa sbyor lam/ drug pa lus ma dor ba la sangs rgyas sa la 'gro/ bdun pa chos sgra nyan tsam du thos/ brgyad pa 'gro don dgongs pas byed do/ / gsum pa phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin gyi rgyu ni tshe dbang man chad do/ /gnyis pa dus tshe dbang mthar phyin tsa na'o/ / gsum pa cha lugs longs sku'o/ / bzhi pa dgongs pa nam mkha' tsam/ lnga pa mthong lam/ drug pa sa brgyad man chad/ bdun pa chos longs sku la nyan no/ /brgyad pa 'gro don dgongs pas khyab tshad do/ /bzhi pa lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin gyi rgyu ni phyag rgya man chad do/ / gnyis pa dus mthar phyin tsa na'o/ /gsum pa cha lugs bud+dhā dngos/ bzhi pa chos dbyings la dgongs pa'o/ / lnga pa sgom lam/drug pa sa bcu rgyun mtha' man chad/ bdun pa chos chos sku la nyan/ brgyad pa 'gro don nam mkha' khyab tshad la'o/ / srid pa rdo rje sgrub mdzod cig / ces pas/ ru pad+ma ni/srid pa rigs drug la bya/ de sku re'i lhar 'grub par mdzod cig bar ro gsungs/ ru bi ma la/ srid pa khams gsum la khyab/ khams gsum sku re re'i sku gsung thugs su 'grub par mdzod gsungs/ nu bal po/ srid pa lha mi klu'o/ / de 'ang mi srid pa'i srid pa lha la mi mi srid/ ci'ang
