srid pa'i srid pa mi la skyid sdug srid/ srid la mi srid pa'i srid pa dmyal ba la bde ba mi srid pa'o/ /yang na srid pa 'greng bu 'phred nyal kha sbubs so/ /de gsum chos skur — 156 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagartogs par bya gsungs so/ / srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ / zhes pas/ ru pad+ma ni/ srid pa byang chub sems yin te/ / de ka rdo rje de ka phur pa'i lha/ / zhes gsungs/ ru bi ma la/srid pa ni sngar dang 'dra/ de nyid phur pa'i lhar shes dgos gsungs/ ru bal po ni/spyir srid pa gsum lha yin phan chad sku re'i lhar shes par bya gsungs/ ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ / ces pas sgrub pa zung ste/ thun mong gi sgrub pa dang / khyad par gyi'o/ / dang po la gsum phyi ltar sgrub pa/ nang ltar sgrub pa/ gsang ba ltar sgrub pa'o/ /dang po la steng sgo'i man ngag 'og sgo'i man ngag go / gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ sbyor yab yum ltar du sgrub pa/ sgrol yab yum ltar du sgrub pa/ tshe yab yum ltar du sgrub pa/ dngos grub yab yum ltar du sgrub pa'o/ / de la'ang(rtsa ba)mdo ltar(khyad par du)sgrub na(sgrub pa)/ phyi rig sngags gtsug tor ltar du sgrub pa/ nang ltar gsang sngags gos sngon ltar du sgrub pa/ gsang ba gzungs sngags rnam 'joms ltar du sgrub pa'o/ /rtsa ba ma mo ltar sgrub na/ dbyings kyi ma mo dang / las kyi ma mo'o/ / dang po la/ ma bdun/ sring bzhi/ 'bar ma brgyad/dbang phyug ma'o/ / gnyis pa ma mo ltar sgrub pa la/ sring mo ltar sgrub pa/ bdud mo ltar sgrub pa'o/ /rtsa ba 'jig rten par sgrub na/ rdo rje legs pa/ yam shud dmar po/ klu rje/rgyal po/ bdud btsan du sgrub pa'o/ / 'bru la/ ru pad+ma ni ye shes la gnyis te/ rtogs pa'i ye shes gnas lugs/ spros pa'i ye shes 'gro don te/ rdo rje gzhon nur sgrub par bya gsungs/ ru bi ma la ye shes 'dra/ khro bo la bcas bcos gnyis te/ khro bo ye shes chen po dang bcas pa dang / snying rje chen po sngon du song nas khro bor bcos pa'o/ / de ni sku zhi yang 'bar ba'i cha lugs can no/ /ru bal po ni/ ngang gis khro ba dang / shugs kyis khro ba gnyis te/ ye shes chos skur yod pa de chos skur sgrub pa'o zhes gsungs so/ / longs sku khro bcu'i dal tshar ro/ /gsum pa sprul sku'i ngo bo phur pa sras kyi dal la gnyis te/ gsal gdab pa dang /bskyed pa dngos so/ /dang po la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /zhes pa sho lo ka gcig go /gnyis pa la mdo gsum/ rtsa ba bcu/ yan lag drug cu'o/ /rtsa ba bcu la/ dang po ni/ sku gsum gyi klong nas bskyed pa la chos gsum yod na gang yin/ sku gsung thugs ye shes rtse gcig tu byin brlab pa la yig 'bru gsum dgos na gang yin/ chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas blangs pa la dgos pa gsum yod na gang yin/ rigs lnga'i dbang bskur ba la rdzas gsum yod na gang yin/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlob pa la sngags gsum dgos na gang — 157 ge

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/yin/ gu gul gyis bdug pa la nus pa gsum yod na gang yin/ yungs kar gyis brab pa la sngags rdzas ting nge 'dzin gsum dgos na gang yin/ rak+ta byugs pa la ngar gsum bskyed na gang yin/ sras mchog gi rnam dbye mu bzhi yod na gang yin/ phur pa'i rnam dbye la chos bdun yod na gang yin zhes pa dang bcu'o/ / dang po sras mchog 'di yang stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i sras mchog dang chos mthun par sbyar dgos te/ dper na stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i sras de/ pha'i rgyud nyid dag pa/ ma'i rgyud dag par skye dgos pa dang 'dra bar sras mchog 'di yang sku gsum gyi klong nas bskyed de/ de yang dang po shu n+ya tā dzñā nas stong par bsgom pa ni chos sku'o/ /de'i ngang nas yab yum mkha' gsang nas hūṃ gcig chad/ phar spros tshur 'dus/ oṃ badz+ra gī li brjod pas sku stod khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa/sku smad lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum pa dmar lhang nge ba bskyed pa ni sprul sku'o/ / gsang rgyud las/ 'dir ni dbu gsum phyag drug dang / / zhal gcig phyag kyang bzhi pa ste/ / de las mang ba ngas ma bshad/ /ces so/ /'di nyid las/ lte ba man chad sku smad ni/ /sngo sangs mi bzad 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /zhes so/ /grangs ni sras mchog rab brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'bring nyi shu rtsa gcig tha ma lnga/ yang tha badz+ra 'dus pa gcig tu 'dus pa'o/ /de ltar rgyal po de skye ba bzang yang 'khor dang longs spyod med na rgyal por mi tshud pa dang 'dra bar/ 'dir yang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur byin gyis ma brlabs na sku gsum mi tshang ste/ phur pa'i gcum gzhogs kyi dbus ldir ba der ñdzu las gzhal yas khang du bskyed la/ der gtso bo yab yum bsgom/ rtsa sngags bskyed sngags brjod/ gcum gzhogs brgyad la phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo yab yum mgo brnyan dang bcas pa bskyed/ rgya mdud gong ma'i nang du hūṃ ka ra yab yum khyung mgo ltar rong nger bskyed/ rgya mdud 'og ma'i nang du stobs po che yab yum gyad gdung 'degs tshul du bskyed/ logs bzhir sgo ma bzhi bskyed/ dbal gyi gnyar phur srung bcu gnyis bskyed/ rgya mdud gong ma'i logs 'dir rigs lnga rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbu rgyan du bskyed de/ gsang rgyud las/ sku bzhag ngang las da la thams cad rdzogs/ /logs brgyad rang bzhin khro bo brgyad/ /zur brgyad 'byung ba'i khro mo brgyad/ /steng 'og lha yi rang bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ye shes rtse gcig tu brlabs pa ni/ de ltar rgyal po 'khor longs spyod ldan yang / rgyal po sku gzi brjid chung na rgyal por mi tshud pas/ sras mchog 'di yang sku gsung thugs ye shes rtse gcig tu byin gyis brlabs te/ dbal gyi zur gsum du hūṃ gsum/logs gsum du phaṭa gsum/ rtse mo la a dkar po zhig bsam ste/ rgyud las/ logs la — 158 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagaphaṭa gsum bzhag pa yin/ / zur gsum hūṃ gsum bzhag pa yin/ / zhes so/ /gsum pa phyag rgya ni/ sa ma ya dzaḥ chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas blangs pa'i dgos pa ni/ chu srin gyis 'dzin shes gtong mi shes pa ltar/ sras mchog gis kyang gang la btab pa mi btang ba'o/ /phyag rgya ni/ rgyud las/ de dus sor mo rgyab tu bsnol/ /gung mo gnyis por rab tu bsgreng / /de yi bar du phur ba gzhug /de nas sor mo pad 'drar bya/ /kha ma phye ba'i tshul du ni/ /lag mthil bar du phur pa 'dril/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa dbang bskur ba ni/ de ltar rgyal po gzi brjid dang ldan yang / rgyal po'i spyi bor dbang ma bskur na rgyal por mi tshud pas/ 'dir yang rigs lngas dbang bskur te/ g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la ma las nyi ma'i steng du rigs lnga/ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga la a las zla ba'i dal steng du yum lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad/ byang sems sras mchog la thim pas dbang bskur ro/ / gsang rgyud las/ lag g.yas mthil du nyi dkyil la/ /kun bzang 'od dang bcas pa bskyed/ /g.yon gyi a las zla dkyil du/ /kun tu bzang mo a las bskyed/ /gung mo rnam par snang mdzad de/ /mthe bong la ni mi bskyod pa/ /mdzub mo rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /srin lag don yod grub pa ste/ /mthe'u chung snang ba mtha' yas so/ /g.yon pa lnga la yum lnga'o/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug dus/ / sor mo cung zad bsnol bar bya/ / phur pa 'dril bar bya ba yin/ / ces dbang bskur ro/ /lnga pa sku gsung thugs byin gyis(yum lnga)brlab pa ni/ de ltar rgyal po la dbang bskur kyang bsod nams tshad med pa dang mi ldan na rgyal por mi tshud pas 'dir sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sras mchog gi spyi bor 'khor lo la oṃ bsam/ de las oṃ bud+dhā gī li'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ de brjod pas bud+dhā'i sku'i dngos grub thams cad 'dus te/ skus khams gsum dus gcig tu sgrol nus par byin gyis brlabs so/ /mgrin par pad+ma 'dab brgyad la āḥbasam/ āḥpad+ma gī li gī la yas bskor/ de brjod pas bud+dhā'i gsung 'dus/ gsung gis khams gsum dus gcig tu sgrol nus par bsam/thugs kar rdo rje sngon po'i lte ba la hūṃ bsam/ de la hūṃ badz+ra gī li gī la yas bskor ba la/ de brjod pas bud+dhā'i thugs kyi dngos grub 'dus / thugs kyis khams gsum dus gcig tu sgrol nus par byin brlabs so/ / drug pa yungs kar gyis brab pa la/ sngags rdzas ting nge 'dzin gsum las/ dper na rgyal po dmag la 'gro na go cha gyon dgos pa ltar/ 'dir yang be ta la'i sngags brjod cing / yungs kar nag gis brab pas lus khrab chung gis go mtshams med par song bar bsam/ rgyud las/ khros pa'i rgyal po bskul ba'i phyir/ /— 159 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/yungs nag byin rlabs khro chung bskyed/ / ces pa'o/ / bdun pa gu gul gyis bdug pa ni/sngags rdzas ting nge 'dzin ni gsum las/ rgyal po dmag la 'gro na ko gyon kyang mi phan te/mtshon rnon po dgos pa dang 'dra bar/ 'dir yang ma gu ta la'i sngags brjod cing / gu gul gyis bdug pas gdug pa'i dbal dang ldan pas/ mi bzad pa'i ngar thogs rdugs med pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ rgyud las/ phur pa ngar rnams bskyed pa'i phyir/ / lce log nag po'i dud pas bdug /ces so/ /brgyad pa rak+tas byug pa ni/ sngags rdzas ting nge 'dzin gsum las/ rgyal po des mtshon rnon po dgra la thebs dgos pa 'dra bar/ ra tri ta'i sngags brjod cing / rak+tas byugs pas phur pa dmar nag dud kha reg pas 'joms pa zhig tu bsam/ rgyud las/ gdug pa brlag par bya ba'i phyir/ / ra khyi phag pa'i khrag gis byug /ces so/ /de nas rgyal po phas kyi g.yul las rgyal te/ dgra bo'i yul thob dgos pa dang 'dra bar/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan zhes pas/ dgra bgegs kyi snying dkar nag mtshams su bzhugs par bsam mo/ / rgyud las/ gnad chen thams cad 'dus pa yi/ / dkar nag mtshams su gdab par bya/ / zhes bshad do/ / dgu pa sras mchog gi rnam dbye ni bzhi ste/sras ma yin kyang mchog yin pa'i mu dang / sras kyang yin la mchog kyang yin pa'i mu dang /sras yin la mchog ma yin pa'i mu dang / sras ma yin la mchog ma yin pa'i mu dang bzhi'o/ /de la'ang dal bzhi ste/ phur pa rdzas kyi dal gyi bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dal cig yod na gang yin/phur pa rdzas kyi dal gyi phyogs bcu khro bo'i dal cig yod na gang yin/ phur pa rdzas kyi dal gyi phur pa rdzas kyi dal ci yod na gang yin/ phur pa rdzas kyi dal gyi srung ma dam can rnam gsum yod na gang yin/ de'i sgra don ni/ phur pa'i rgya mdud gong 'og gcum gzhogs dang bcas pa ni/ gzhal yas khang mdzod dang 'dra ba yin la/ de'i nang du lha tshogs rdzas dang 'dra bar bskyed pa'i phyir na phur pa rdzas zhes bya la/ dal gyi ni lha tshogs tshang ma bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /bcu pa phur pa'i rnam dbye ni gnyis te/ spyir gang zag rnam bzhi mthar phyin pa'i phur bu'i rgyud bzhi'i dbye ba dang / bye brag tu mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nam mkha' lta bu'i gang zag gis rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa yul chos nyid kyi dbyings la gdab pa dang / ri bo lta bu'i gang zag gis thugs rje sprul pa'i phur pa yul khams gsum sems can la gdab pa dang / bya ka lan+ta ka lta bu'i gang zag gis gsang ba byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum gyi mkha' la gdab pa dang / tsan+dan lta bu'i gang zag gis mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa yul dgra dang bgegs la gdab pa'o/ / de re re la lnga lnga ste/ phur pa'i ngo bo/— 160 —

rgu/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagagadab pa'i yul/ thebs pa'i tshad/ ma thebs pa'i skyon/ 'bras bu'o/ /de yang rtsa rgyud las/ rig pa ye shes phur pa de/ / gzung 'dzin med pa'i ngang du gdab/ / lhang gis rtogs na thebs pa'i tshad/ /'bras bu chos sku skye med thob/ /ma thebs ma rtogs 'khor bar 'khyams/ /tshad med snying rje'i phur pa de/ /'gro la byams dang snying rjes gdab/ /bdag gzhan gnyis med rtogs na thebs/ /'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs sku thob/ /ma thebs ru tra srin por gol/ / lhag pa byang sems phur pa de/ / yum gyi mkha' klong dag par gdab/ /bde ba dngos med thebs pa'i tshad/ / 'bras bu sku gsum dbyer med thob/ / ma thebs 'khor ba'i 'gram rdo byed/ / mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa de/ / zhi drag dbang rgyas phur pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis pa mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa bye brag tu bshad pa la drug ste/phur pa'i rgyu/ phur pa'i nges tshig phur pa'i tshad/ phur pa'i dbye ba/ phur pa'i rnam dag phur pa'i las dang drug go /dang po rgyu la/ gsang rgyud las/ dngul lam dkar po'i shing rnams ni/ / zhi ba chos kyi phur pa'i rgyu/ / gser ram ser po'i shing rnams ni/ /yon tan rgyas pa'i phur pa'i rgyu/ / zangs sam dmar po'i shing rnams ni/ / gsung mchog dbang gi phur pa'i rgyu/ / lcags sam nag po'i shing rnams ni/ / drag po'i las kyi phur pa'i rgyu/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa nges tshig ni/ myang 'das las/ phur ni skye ba med pa'i dbyings/ /pa ni 'gags pa med pa'i don/ /phur ni chos kyi dbyings zhes bya/ /pa ni rig pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis su med pa'i mya ngan 'das/ /sems kyi sems nyid phung pa yin/ /chos kyi chos nyid phur pa yin/ /nam mkha'i mtshan nyid phur pa yin/ /gsal bar bsgom na bskyed pa yin/ / gnyis su med pa sbyor ba yin/ / lhang gis rtogs na thebs pa yin/ /nyams 'og chud na bsgral ba yin/ / ces so/ / gsum pa tshad ni/ gsang rgyud las/sor bzhi 'byung ba bzhi yi tshad/ / sor brgyad rnam shes brgyad kyi tshad/ / bcu gnyis skye mched bcu gnyis tshad/ /bco brgyad tshad du bstan pa ni/ /khams ni bco brgyad 'joms pa'i tshad/ /nas gang tshad du bstan pa ni/ /byang sems mchog gi tshad du bstan/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa dbye ba ni/ don dam pa'i phur pa dang / kun rdzob kyi phur pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ phur pa'i don ni rig pa'i ye shes te/ /de yi yul ni chos kyi dbyings zhes bya/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lcags sna dang shing sna lnga yi phur pa'o/ /myang 'das las/sa lcags gnam lcags khro chu dang / /mi rta bsad pa'i mtshon rtse dang / /phal pa'i lcags dang lnga la bya/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa rnam dag ni/ myang 'das las/ rgya mdud gong ma chos sku ste/ /— 161 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis pa longs spyod rdzogs pa yin/ /rtse mo sprul pa'i sku yin pas/ /mgo dang rtsa ba ma nor bar/ /zur gsum pa ru rnam par gzhog /ces so/ /drug pa las ni/ gsang rgyud las/tsan+dan dkar po'i phur pa yis/ / nad rnams ma lus zhi bar byed/ / skyer pa'i phur pa zur bzhi yis/ /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas par byed/ /seng sdeng phur pa zla gam gyis/ / thams cad dbang du sdud par byed/ /bswe shing phur pa rigs rgyas byed/ /tsan+dan dmar po'i phur pa yis/ / bu mo dbang du sdud par byed/ / mdzo mos blon po dbang du sdud/ / bswe shing dmangs rigs dbang du sdud/ / zangs kyis rgyal po dbang du sdud/ /shing gis gdon rnams dbang du sdud/ /ces pas mngon no/ / 'bru bshad ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /zhes pas/ ru pad 'byung ni/ ma rig mun pa'i drwa ba sangs/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes pad+ma ltar rgyas pas rgyas/ kun ni 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum/ sku ni ye shes kyi sku'o gsungs/ru bi ma la/ sangs rgyas chos sku rten yin gsungs/ ru bal po/ nyon mongs pa lnga sangs/ye shes la gsum/ rang byung gi ye shes/ gzhan byung gi ye shes/ gnas 'gyur gyi ye shes so/ /sku yon tan gyi rten byed gsungs so/ / ngang nyid rdo rje'i chos dbyings las/ /zhes pas nu pad+ma ni/ chos sku'i ngo bo rdo rje stong nyid chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'o gsungs/ru bi ma la/ ngang chos nyid rdo rje/ de ka chos nyid yin gsungs/ ru bal po skye med kyi ngang nyid/ 'gag med rdo rje/ chos dbyings chos sku gsungs so/ / 'bar ba'i khro mo mi bzad pa/ /zhes pas/ ru pad+ma gdug pa 'dul bar 'bar ba de khro bo mi bzad pa'o/ /ru bi ma la gar gyi nyams dgu la zer/ ru bal po ma rig pa sel bas 'bar pa/ khro bo gtso bo/ mi bzad pa 'khor yin gsungs so/ / sku yi dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig / ces pas/ du pad+mas lha'i sku bskyed pa bstan/ ru bi ma las rim gyis bskyed pa'o gsungs/ ru bal po rdzogs tshul du bskyed pa'o gsungs/ phur pa rdzas kyi dal tshar ro/ /spyi don gsum pa khams gsum gyis srog la dbang bskur zhing srog gis ye shes sems dpa'i srog la dbang bskur ba ni/ gsol ba gdab pa dang / dbang bskur ba'o/ / dang po ni/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du/ / zhes pa sho lo ka gcig go / gnyis pa ni/gsol pa gdab pa dang / rigs lnga gdan tsho lnga spyi bo'i steng du spyan drangs pa dang / shar phyogs pa rnams kyis chu dbang bskur/ lho phyogs pas dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur/ nub nas rdo rje'i dbang bskur/ byang nas dril bu'i dbang bskur/ dbus nas ming gi dbang bskur bar bsam pa ni bum pa'i dbang ngo / / de nas rigs lnga yab yum rnams sbyor ba mdzad pas ge 162 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagasbyor mtshams nas byang sems byung bas bdag gi spyi bo nas mar thim pas sdig sgrib dag pa ni gsang dbang ngo / / de nas rigs lnga de rnams rang gi spyi bo nas mar thams cad 'dus te thim pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / / de'i dus su bde stong gi nyams rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o/ / de nas rigs lnga cha gcig yar log nas dbu rgyan du bsgom pa ni dbang rtags so/ / de ni dus gsum bud+dhās bdag la dbang bskur ba'o/ / dbang de spa ra ṇa phaṭa ces spros pas khams gsum sems can la phog go / de rnams zhu ste lha rnams a/ mi rnams n-i/ lha ma yin su/ dud 'gro tri/ yi dwags bre/ dmyal ba dur gyur/ de ram̐ yo khaṃ gis bsregs sbyangs pas dal gyi lhar gyur par bsam/ de nas 'od zer de tshur 'dus te saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ zhes pas snying gi nang gi rta mgrin la 'dus/ dbang bskur bas bkrag dang ldan pa ni des srog la dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas rta mgrin yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas byang sems de ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ dbang bskur/ bkrag dang ldan pas bkrag thams cad 'dus te rdo rje lte ba'i hūṃ de bkrag gzi mdangs dang ldan pa ni ye shes sems dpa'i srog la dbang bskur ba'o/ / de las lcags kyi srog rtsa byung bar bsgom/ de nas 'dod log gi rigs gtsang sel gsum gyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po re/ mgrin par āḥdamar po re/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po re bsam/ de spros bsdus pas spyi bor rnam snang dkar po re/ mgrin par snang mtha' dmar po re/ snying gar mi bskyod pa sngon po re bsam pa ni dbang rtags so/ /dbang bskur ba tshar ro/ /'bru bshad ni/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du/ / zhes pas/ ru pad 'byung gis sems can gyi don du thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'dul gsungs/ ru bi ma la/ thabs mkhas pas 'gro don bya gsungs/ ru bal po/ thabs kyi spyod pas zin par gsungs/byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ / zhes pas/ ru pad+ma ni/ bsam pa byams pa lag len snying rje yin gsungs/ ru bi ma la/ theg chen la byams pa dang snying rje dgos gsungs/ru bal po/ khyad par du gsang sngags la byams snying rje dgos gsungs/ sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad nas/ / zhes pas/ ru pad+ma sangs rgyas phrin las kyi ngo bo bskyed rdzogs/nges tshig bud+dhā'i 'phrin las gang zag gi las su byed pa/ dbye ba phrin las bzhi'o gsungs/ ru bi ma la/ ma rig pa sangs/ ye shes rgyas na phrin las rdzogs brer/ ru bal po/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gang 'dul gyis rdzogs par bya gsungs so/ /dbang bskur thams cad 'dir stsol cig / ces pas/ ru pad+ma phyi dbang snang ba lhar shes na byin rlabs 'byung gsungs/— 163 ge

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/ru bi ma la nang dbang snang srid sems su shes pa'o gsungs/ nu bal po gsang dbang snang srid stong par rtogs na byin rlabs 'byung gsungs so/ / 'bru tshar ro/ /spyi don bzhi pa ye shes kyi dal spyan drangs shing mchod cing bsnyen pas dngos grub kyi bcud blang ba la bzhi ste/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa/ de la mchod pa brgyad 'bul ba/bsnyen pa bya ba/ mchod cing dngos grub blang ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang / / zhes pa sho lo ka phyed dang gnyis so/ /gnyis pa dngos ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas rang dang 'dra ba'i dal gsum mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de la mchod pa 'bul ba la brgyad de/ dang po nam mkha' la phyag gis mchod pa/ bstim nas lha mo bzhi bsnol gyis mchod pa/ ba lī ta gtor ma'i mchod pa/ bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa/ rak+ta tshar gsum gyi mchod pa/ sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa/ 'dod don gyi gsol ba gdab pa/tshogs dang bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ / dang po nam mkha' la phyag gi mchod pa ni/ nam mkha' na bzhugs pa la/ a ti pū hoḥ/ zhes pas ye shes pa la phyag btsal/ ye shes pas pra tīts+tsha hoḥ lan dngos grub byin par bsam/ ye shes pa'i 'khor phur srung rnams kyis/sarba ta thā ga ta ba ta nan gyis bdag dam tshig pa la phyag lan btsal bar bsam mo/ / gnyis pa bstems nas lha mo bzhi bsnol gyis mchod pa la/ dzaḥs ye shes pa dgug hūṃ gis gzhugabaṃ gyis bcings/ hoḥs mi dgyes pa med par dgyes par bya'o/ / de nas bdag gi thugs ka nas phyi yi lha mo bzhi spros la/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe dhū/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pu/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke hrīḥ.oṃ badz+ra gadhe gan/ yang nang gi lha mo spros la/ oṃ badz+ra lā gye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā lce ṭ+wāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gīrti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nīrti āḥ yang 'dod yon gyi lha mo spros la/ oṃ badz+ra mo hā ra ti/rā ga ra ti/ karmā ra ti/ badz+ra ra ti/ zhes pas phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod do/ /'bru don ni/ srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang / /zhes pas/ ru pad 'byung ni srid pa sngar dang 'dra/ sgrub pa'i gnas ni/ kha ral srin po'i gnas/ shing gcig dri za'i gnas/ brag phug gnod sbyin gyi gnas/ chu mig klu'i gnas/ dur khrod ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gnas so/ /gnas der ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ gang gis drangs na dam tshig pas drangs/ gang nas drangs na 'og min nas drangs/ gang du drangs na ting nge 'dzin gyi dal du drangs/gang gi phyir drangs na phur bu sgrub pa'i phyir drangs so/ / drangs nas sgrub pa la thun mong dang khyad par ro/ / dang po la gsum/ ye shes lha'i sgrub pa/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i/ dpa' bo — 164 ge

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagaging gi'o/ / dang po la gsum/ khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi sgrub pa/ khrag 'thung lnga'i/dpa' bo gcig pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ phyi ma ltar du sgrub pa dha ti/ nang sring mo ltar sgrub pa 'dus la/ gsang ba bran mo ltar sgrub pa bsdu yig go / gsum pa ging la gsum/ ging gnyis gcig gis sgrub pa/ ging bzhi'i sgrub pa/ ma ru rtse gcig gi sgrub pa'o/ / de'ang sngags re re la mgo gnon dang rang re'i sngags/ rang re'i pho nya/ rang re'i gnas/ rang re'i dgos ched/ rang re'i bya thabs/ rang re'i ting nge 'dzin tshang dgos so gsungs so/ /ru bi ma la/ srid pa gsum sku gsung thugs su sgrub gsungs/ nu bal pos srid gsum chos skur sgrub gsungs/ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ / zhes pas/ ru pad+ma ni/dbang la rtogs pa chos nyid kyi dbang / rig pa rtsal gyi dbang / khams gsum sgrol ba'i dbang ngo / / dngos grub la gsum/ rab bud+dhā/ 'bring rig 'dzin/ tha ma mig sman no gsungs/ ru bi ma la dbang 'dra/ dngos grub sku gsung thugs kyi'o gsungs/ ru bal po dngos grub 'das pa dang lo ka'i dngos grub gsungs so/ /ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pas/ ru pad+ma ye shes ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'o/ /khro bo rngams shing brjid ba'o gsungs/ru bi ma la dbyings ye shes gdug pa 'dul du gshegs gsungs/ ru bal po ni/ ye shes yin la khro bo ma yin pa zhi ba'i rigs lnga lta bu dang / ye shes ma yin la khro bo yin pa bdud dang srin po lta bu dang / ye shes kyang ma yin la khro bo yang ma yin pa'i rigs drug sems can lta bu dang / ye shes kyang yin la khro bo yang yin pa phur bu'i lha tshogs lta bu ste/ 'dir phyi ma spyan 'dren pa'o gsungs/ khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang / / zhes pas/ ru pad+ma ni thugs rje chen pos gshegs par zhu zer/ nu bi ma la gang gang gi don du gshegs gsungs/ru bal po byed pa'i tshig bzhi dang sbyar ro/ /rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang / /zhes pas/ru pad+ma rab zhal ston/ 'bring phur bu lding / tha ma rmi ltas ston pa'o/ / ru bi ma la rtags phyir/ mtshan ma nang du 'ong gsungs/ ru bal po rtags lus yangs/ ngag btsun/sems bde ba/ mtshan ma mi rtog pa'o gsungs/ gī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ / zhes pas/ru pad+ma bud+dhā thob pa'o gsungs/ ru bi ma la khams gsum sgrol ba'i phyir gsungs/ ru bal po rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol gsungs so/ /ye shes pa spyan drangs pa tshar ro/ /gsum pa gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ dam tshig chen pos gtso bo la dbul/ sprul ba chen pos phyogs bcu'i khro bo la dbul/ phyag brnyan chen pos mgo brnyan nyi shu la dbul/da 165 da

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/shā nas shwa na bzhi la dbul/ bdag nyid chen mos re ma tī la dbul/ sa bdag gis bswe mo bzhi la/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus liṅgā dbul lo/ / lha rnams kyi ljags kyi sbu gus gsol bar bsam mo/ /'bru bshad ni/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /ces pa la/ ru pad+ma sngon du ru tra sgrol tsa na/ bud+dhā thams cad kyis sras kyi dam tshig ltar dus la bab par gyis gsungs/nu bi ma la/ dus gsum gyi bud+dhā'i thugs dam bskul ba'i dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab gsungs/ ru bal po sngon bo dhi tsit+ta'i sems bskyed rtsa ba'i dus la bab zer ro/ / sprul ba chen po'i dus la bab/ /ces pas/ ru pad+ma ru tra 'dul tsa na khro bo'i sprul ba bye ba sa ya sprul pa'i dus la bab gsungs/ ru bi ma la lha yi dbang bo brgya byin gyis khro bcu sprul te bkye bas/lha ma yin pham par byas pa'o zer ro/ / ru bal po da lta'ang rnal 'byor pasatshobaskul tsa na'ang de ltar sprul pa'o gsungs so/ /phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab/ /ces pas/ ru pad+ma ru tra 'dul tsa na byi mo slas mo rnams las phra men mgo lus mi mthun pa mang po skyes pas btul ba'i dus la bab gsungs so/ /ru bi ma la/ sngon phyag rdor gyis gnod sbyin rgod ma kha btul bas/ kho ri ma la ya la bros pas/ phra men bkye ste bkug pa'i dus la bab gsungs so/ /nu bal po nyi shu po las yang sprul sum sprul gyi dus la bab gsungs so/ / shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ces pas/ ru pad+ma sngon dpal chen ye shes kyi ma mo rnams 'phar spyang wa khyir sprul pa'i dus la bab gsungs so/ /ru bi ma la/ g.ya' ri gangs kyi brag phug tu bse'i lha mo dam la btags pa'i phyir gsungs/ ru bal po/ sngon gyi khas blangs kyi dus la bab gsungs so/ /bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ /ces pas/ ru pad+ma 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bud+dhā'i bstan pa'i bdag nyid yin pas dus la bab gsungs so/ / ru bi ma la/ skye ba lnga brgya la sprul pa lnga brgya 'byung bas/ de la sgrub thabs lnga brgya'i bdag nyid yin gsungs/ru bal po sems can gyi srog dbugs kyi bdag mo yin pas bdag nyid zer ro/ / sa bdag bse mo'i dus la bab/ /ces pas/ ru pad+ma sngon du ru tra'i byi mo slas mo yin pas dpal chen la bran du phul ba gsungs/ ru bi ma la/ chu mig byang chub ris su btul bas gsungs/ru bal po yul so so nas mthu che bas so gsungs/ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ /ces pas/ru pad+ma ging dang kau rī dbang phyug ma bdun sring bzhi la gsungs/ du bi ma la skyes bu ging 'bum phrag la gsungs/ ru bal po rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang yan chad la gsungs so/ / mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /ces pas/ ru pad+ma sngon du ru tra btul tsa na mthu rtsal dbyung bar mdzad do zhes so/ / ru bi ma la/ sprul pa yang sprul gyis gsungs/ ru bal po khams — 166 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagagasum dbang du bsdus la stong gsum zil gyis gnon gsungs so/ / gtor ma dbul ba tshar ro/ /bzhi pa sman mchod la lnga ste/ dang po sman gyi che ba brjod pa/ sman mchod dngos/bshags pa/ dngos grub blang ba/ smon lam mo/ / dang po che ba brjod pa'i dus su kha ram̐ rnam gsum gyi dgongs pa la/ kha ram̐ dang pos snang srid mchod pa rdzas sngags bsam/ kha ram̐ gnyis pas de yang bdud rtsi chen por bsam/ kha ram̐ gsum pas dal gsum gyis gsol bar bsam/ sman mchod dngos kyi dus su sman phor du dpa' bo 'bru gsum bsam/ rnam dag brer tsa na hūṃ gi 'od kyis nyes skyon dag par bsam/ bdud rtsi zer tsa na āḥzhu nas bdud rtsir song bar bsam/ dam rdzas zer tsa na oṃ zhu nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar song bar bsam/mnyes mchod 'bul zer tsa na mnyes par 'bul/ thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /zhes pas rnal 'byor pas de kha len 'dod pa'o/ /de nas bshags shing dngos grub blang ba'i skabs su/ sman gyi nang du bud+dhā thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po zhig bsam/rang gi ya rkan la'ang oṃ dkar po zhig bsam/ tshig dang sngags brjod do/ / mtheb srin gyis sman gyi oṃ de blang lce la bzhag pa/ ya rkan gyi oṃ dang 'grogs te song bas spyi bo klad pa dung khang du rnam snang dkar po zhig tu song bar bsam mo/ / de ltar bud+dhā'i gsung āḥdamar po sman phor dang ma rkan gnyis la bsgom/ sngags tshig mtheb srin gyis blang ste mid pas/mgrin par snang mtha' dmar po bsgom/ de ltar bud+dhā'i thugs hūṃ mi bskyod pa sngon po dang gong gi 'dra'o/ /de nas smon lam gdab pa'o/ /lnga pa rak+ta tshar gsum ni/ rak+ta dang phud bsres la/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /zhes pas dang po bka' nyan par byed pa'i ched du dbul/ gnyis pa bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs kyis dam can gnad la dbab pa'i phyir du dbul/ gsum pa/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa yi/ / zhes pas/mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dbrog pa'i ched du dbul/ dug lnga dug gsum gyi mchod pa'ang shugs la shes par bya'o/ / 'bru bshad ni/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ / zhes pas/ru pad+ma sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob tu ma ster bar gsungs/ ru bi ma la chos nyid thob tu ma ster bar gsungs/ du bal po sems bkol du mi btub par gsungs so/ / gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ / zhes pas/ ru pad+mas/ gdug pa bgegs/ sdang ba dgra gsungs/ ru bi ma la/ gdug pa rnal 'byor sems/ sdang ba zhe sdang brer/ ru bal po/ gdug pa nyon mongs/ sdang ba rnam smin zer/ zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par — 167 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/chings/ /zhes pa/ ru pad+ma thugs rjes zung / nyon mongs rgyob/ ngan 'gror skye ba chings zer/ ru bi ma la/ lcags kyus zung / tho bas rgyob/ zhags pas chings zer/gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ / zhes pas/ ru pad+ma chos nyid rtogs nas nyon mongs pa bral bar gyis zer/ ru bi ma la/ rgyab rten byed pa rtogs/ nu bal po lha'i grogs dang bral bar gyis zer/ rings par khug la smrar chug cig / ces pas/ ru pad+ma 'khor ba nas khug chos smrar chug zer/ ru bi ma la/ bla khug smyo bas smrar chug zer ro/ /phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ / zhes pas/ ru pad+ma ye shes phob cig nyon mongs gzir zer/ ru bi ma la/ liṅgā la phob/ sngags phyag rgyas gzir brer/ nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang / / zhes pas/ ru pad+ma sems dbang du gyur nas zer/ nu bi ma la/sngags kyi dbang du zer/ bsgo ba'i bka' rnams nyan par gyis/ / zhes pas/ ru pad+ma rtogs pa'i bka' nyon zer/ ru bi ma la/ bran ltar nyon/ sngags la bshad pa byas pas byin rlabs tshar ro/ /rak+ta'i bar pa'i 'bru don ni/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /zhes pas/ ru pad+ma sngon ru dra'i bran dang bka' nyan dpal chen la phul bas gsungs/ du mi bi ma la/bar du pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis dam la btags pas zer/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ /ces pas/ ru pad+ma sngon dpal chen gyi spyan sngar ji ltar dam bcas pa bzhin zer/ ru bi ma la/ pad 'byung spyan sngar dam bcas pa bzhin zer ro/ / mngon spyod phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/ / ces pas/ ru pad+ma mngon du thob par mdzod zer/ ru bi ma la/ drag po sgrol zer/ rak+ta tha ma'i 'bru don ni/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /zhes pas/ ru pad 'byung gdug pa nyon mongs/ sdang ba rnam smin zer/ ru bi ma la/ gdug pa bgegs/sdang ba dgra zer/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung / / zhes pas/ ru pad+ma lha dam la 'da' ba bdud yin zer/ ru bi ma la/ lha klu bdud dang dri za'ang nung zer/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ / nga la sngags kyi bka' bden pas/ / mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ /zhes pas/ ru pad+mas mthu sems bsgyur ba rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston pa'i nus pa med par gyis shig pa'o/ / rak+ta tshar ro/ /drug pa sbyor sgrol gyi pū dza ni/ sbyor ba ni khro bo yab yum sbyor/ sgrol ba ni dgra dang bgegs sgrol ba'o/ /de yang lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la yab lnga/ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga yum lngar bskyed/ yab kyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las hūṃ las rdo rje dbal dang bcas pa bskyed/— 168 bhe

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagayum gyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las/ e las lcags kyi gtun khung gru gsum par bsam/ dgra bgegs bkugs la nang du bcug rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i dbyings/ / zhes pas bskul/ lag pa rdo rje bsdams pas kha khri brjod cing dgra bgegs phye mar brdungs pas/ rgyu gti mug las 'bras bu shar smin pa ka pā la khengs pa lnga byung / gtso bo bdag rtsa ba'i dal la phul/ lhag ma dal gnyis kyis gsol bar bsam/ yang kha baṃ bdun gyis brdungs pas/rgyu 'dod chags las 'bras bu khrag tu smin pa ka pā la lnga byung / gtso bor khro bo la phul/lhag ma dkyil 'khor gnyis kyis lhag med kyis zos par bsgom/ yang kha baṃ bdun gyis brdungs pas/ rgyu zhe sdang las 'bras bu rus par smin pa ka pā la lnga byung / gtso bo phur pa rdzas la phul/ lhag ma dal thams cad kyis gsol bar bsgom/ de nas lha thams cad dgyes pas ha ha zhes gsungs so/ / de ni dug gsum gyi mchod pa dngos yin no/ / 'bru bshad ni/rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ / zhes pas/ ru pad 'byung gis mtshan ma'i tho gtun gyis 'brub khung du brdung / dbyings kyi tho gtan gyis dngos po brdung / thabs shes kyi tho gtun gyis yum gyi mkhar brdung / ru bi ma las/ phyi'i dus na rdo rje tho ba/ nang gi dus na thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes/ gsang ba'i dus na yab kyi rdo rje'o/ / bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams/ /zhes pas/ ru pad+ma bstan pa la gnod pa zer/ nu bi ma la/ ru'i sku la gnod pa zer/ nu bal po/ sngags 'chang gi sku la gnod pa zer/ rdo rje me dbal snying bsregs nas/ / zhes pas/ ru pad+ma gsang ba'i rdo rje byang sems kyi me dbal can nam/phyag mtshan gyi rdo rje la ye shes kyi me dbal can gyis gnod byed kyi snying bsregs pa'o/ / lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog / ces pas/ ru pad+ma/ zhe sdang gi lus/ 'dod chags kyi ngag ye shes kyi mes rdul du rlog zer/ khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ / zhes pas/ ru pad+mas/ khro mo kro dhī shwa dī'i mkha' dbyings la bya/ rdo rje tho bas brdung bar bya/ / zhes pa gsang ba'i rdo rje ste/ thabs ye shes la bya/ lha yang nung ste brlag par bya/ / zhes pas/lha'i bu'i bdud dam tshangs pa'am biṣā'ang gnod na brlag par bya'o/ /sbyor sgrol tshar ro/ /bdun pa 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rak+ta dang phud bsres pa dbul zhing /dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ / ces pas rgyas pa'am/ bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos/ / zhes pas 'bring ngam/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ /zhes pas bsdus pa gang rung bya'o/ / dam tshig chen po drug ni bshad zin/ 'bru la bshad na bar pa ni/ bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /zhes pa ni/ phyi rabs rten gyi gang zag go /byang chub mchog ge 169 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/tu sems bskyed cing / / zhes pas/ du pad+ma kun rdzob byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang /don dam byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'o gsungs/ ru bi ma la/ byang ba sgrib pa/ chub pa po der gnyis med du sems bskyed gsungs/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa/ /zhes pa/ ru pad 'byung / dus gsum mnyam nyid du rtogs na rgyal ba/ de'i gdung lta ba rtogs pas zin pa'o/ / ru bi ma la/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung rdo rje gzhon nus/ de'i gdung khro bo bcus/ de'i gdung phur srung yan chad kyis gsungs so/ / rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ / zhes pas/ ru pad 'byung rig 'dzin bzhi'i rigs 'og ma rnams kyis bzung / ru bi ma la rig pa rnal 'byor pas bzung ngo gsungs/ gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /zhes pas/ ru pad 'byung bstan pa la gnod pa sngags 'chang la gdug pa de dgra dang bgegs yin pas gsungs/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang / / zhes pas/ru pad 'byung mā ra ya zhes pas bdud des dge ba'i bar du gcod pa yin gsungs/ ru bi ma la/ des mtho ris thar pa la bar du gcod zer/ dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams/ /zhes pas/ ru pad+ma dngos grub sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrog pa de 'tshe ba'o/ / khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ / zhes pas/ khro bo sngar dang 'dra/ chen po ye shes dang ldan pa'o/ /byin rlabs gang 'dod pa'o/ / yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la/ / zhes pas/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam la/ mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang / / zhes pas che mthong chung mthong sgrol ba'o/ /sgrol lugs ni/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog /ces pas/ nyon mongs ye shes lngar bsgral lo/ /sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /ces pas/ bud+dhā dang sngags 'chang gi bka' las 'das pa'i chad pas khong nas me 'bar ba dang / kha nas khrag skyug pa 'ong ba chos nyid yin no/ / 'dod don tha ma ni/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ /zhes pas/ ru pad+ma rdo rje thugs skye shi med pa/ de snod min la gsang ba'o/ / sdig can gang gi 'da' byed pa/ /zhes pas/ ru pad+ma rdo rje 'chang gi bka' las 'da' ba'i dam nyams pa de'o/ /stobs chen khro bo chen po yis/ /zhes pas/ ru pad+ma ye shes kyi stobs kyis bdud 'joms pa zer/ klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos/ / zhes pas/ klad pa byang sems kyi mtsho yin pa dang / yan lag gi dang po mgo bo yin pa khos zhes pa dang / ru pad 'byung dngos 'dzin gyi mgo khos gsungs/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ /zhes pas/ru pad+ma chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon/ dam tshig ma 'da'/ zhes pas/ dam tshig srungs shig pa'o/ /de nas bstod pa gnyis gnyis bya'o/ /bsnyen pas dngos grub kyi bcud — 170 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagablang ba ni/ bsnyen 'dzab la gsum/ dang po 'dzab khang dbye ba/ bar du 'dzab bzla ba/tha ma 'dzab bstod bya ba'o/ / dang po ni/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ / zhes pas tshig bzhis dbye ba'o/ / bar du 'dzab bzlas pa la gsum/ phyi ltar bzlas pa dang / nang ltar/ gsang ba ltar ro/ /de re re la sku'i bzlas pa/ gsung ltar/ thugs ltar/ yon tan ltar/ phrin las ltar bzlas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ drag po nyi zer gyi char dbab pa yin te/ bdag gi spyi bo nas bud+dhā gī la ya'i thugs ka nas/ 'od smug nag dbyibs phur pa 'dra ba/ che ba ka gdung tsam/ chung ba yungs 'bru tsam 'phros pas gang la phog pas nyal nyal 'gro bar bsam zhing / oṃ bud+dhā gī li gī la ya bzla/ 'od brer phyir 'phros phyi ltar bzlas pa'o/ /spyi bo nas bzlas pas nang sku ltar bzlas pa'o/ /des 'gre ste/ de ltar skog ma'i pad+ma gī la yas āḥpad+ma gī li gī la ya bzla/ 'od zer dmar nag dbyibs phur pa 'dra ba che chung gong gi 'gres/ des gsung gi phyi nang 'gres/ yang thugs kyi badz+ra gī li gī la yas hūṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya bzla/ 'od zer mthing nag phur pa 'dra ba spros/ thugs kyi bzlas pa'o/ /yang lte ba nas rat+na gī li gī la yas swā rat+na gī li gī la ya bzla/ 'od zer ser nag sngar dang 'dra/yon tan gyi bzlas pa'o/ /gsang gnas nas karma gī la yas hā karmā gī li gī la ya bzla/ 'od zer ljang nag phrin las kyi bzlas pa'o/ /de nas nang gi bzlas pa 'od zer nang du 'phros pas nad gdon bsregs pa'o/ /gsang ba'i bzlas pa ni/ 'od rtsa sbubs dang snying dkar nag tu 'phros pa'o/ / bsnyen pa'o/ / dngos grub blang ba ni/ man ngag ltar bya'o/ / brgyad pa tshogs mchod ni/ dang po ga ṇa tshogs la brgyad de/ dang po tshogs la gsum/ de nas gsog pa gsum/ de nas bsang ba gsum/ de nas sbyang ba gsum/ de nas brlab pa gsum/ de nas bskyed pa gsum/ de nas yul gsum/ de nas dam tshig gsum mo/ /dang po tshogs pa gsum dga' ldan lha'i tshogs/ dgyes ldan mi'i tshogs/ 'byor ldan yo byad kyi tshogs so/ /de yang dang po lha rang yang phyi nang bsrer mi btub ste/ lha mthun pa zhig bsgom dgos so/ /gnyis pa mi rang yang mi mthun pa mi rung ste dam tshig gtsang ba zhig dgos so/ /gsum pa longs spyod kyang ngan chung bas mi thub ste/ bzang po gya nom pa rmad du byung ba dgos so/ /gnyis pa gsog pa la gsum ni/ gnas dur khrod lta bur grub pa thob pa'i bla ma gsog lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo gsog 'dod yon lnga'i longs spyod gsog pa'o/ /gsum pa bsang ba gsum ni/ dang po bdag nyid bsang / gnyis pa mched lcam bsang / gsum pa tshogs bsang ba'o/ / dang po ni/ rang la'ang ting nge 'dzin mi — 171 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/gsal ba dang / cho ga las ma tshang pa yod pas/ a mṛ ta rang la gtor bas dag par bsam/gnyis pa mched lcam la nyams grib yod pas a mṛ ta gtor bas dag par bsam/ gsum pa tshogs la'ang ma dag pa nyams pa yod pas a mṛ ta gtor bas dag par bsam mo/ / bzhi pa sbyang ba gsum ni/ snod thod pa stong gsum tsam du bsam la/ nang gi tshogs kyi dngos po'i steng du/ ram̐ las me 'bar bsregs/ yo las rlung byung gtor/ khaṃ las chu byung bkrus par bsam mo/ / lnga pa brlab pa la gsum ni/ tshogs kyi steng du hūṃ byung bas sngo ding song /āḥbyung bas dmar mer song / oṃ byung bas dkar po shel ltar dwangs par bsgom/ drug pa bskyed pa gsum ni/ dang po mchod pa'i dus su 'dod yon lngar bskyed/ bshags pa'i dus su ye shes lngar bskyed/ bstab pa'i dus su dgra bgegs kyi don snying lngar bskyed pa'o/ /'dod lha ni bdud rtsi 'khyil bas bya'o/ /de yang tshogs kyi steng du a las zla ba bsgom/ de'i steng du yab lnga'i sa bon oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā bskyed/ nyi ma'i steng du yum lnga'i s+t+waṃ lī s+t+waṃ byā tī bskyed/de las yab yum bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥ zhes brjod pas yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas thig le byang sems su zhu ste/ spris ma oṃ du chags pa la 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo 'phro bar bsam/ bdun pa yul gsum ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang rnams dang / yi dam dal lha rnams dang / ma mo mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams la 'bul lo/ /brgyad pa dam tshig la bzhi/ mi bya ba gsum/ mi smra ba gsum/ mi bsam pa gsum/ mi 'bral ba gsum mo/ / dang po ni/ sems 'khrugs pa'i rtsod pa mi bya/ gzung 'dzin skye ba'i 'khrul gtam mi bya/ theg pa 'og ma'i 'bag btsog mi bsrung ngo / / gnyis pa tshogs la gzhan gyi che ste bdag gi chung mi bya/ na ning bzang ste da lo ngan pa mi bya/ kha sang mang ste de ring nyung bar mi bya/ gsum pa ni/ tshogs mthong ba'i tshe bza' yi snyam du mi bsam/btung gi snyam du mi bsam/ zhim gyi snyam du mi bsam pa'o/ / bzhi pa mi 'bral ba gsum la/lus lha dang mi 'bral/ ngag sngags dang mi 'bral/ sems rdzogs rim dang mi 'bral ba'o/ /de nas lag len la rtsa rgyud las/ bgegs bskrad byin rlabs spyan drangs dang / /mchod dang skong ba zlog pa ni/ / stod kyi las su shes par bya/ / bstod dang 'bul dang bshags pa dang / / smon lam rgya cher btab pa ni/ / smad kyi las su shes par bya/ / zhes bshad pas na/ lag len las byang ltar du shes par bya'o/ /ga ṇa tshogs mchod tshar ro/ /de yan chad stod las bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa rdzogs so/ /'di man chad smad las dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa yin te/ rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs — 172 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagapa yin no/ /spyi don lnga pa gab pa'i sngags drug tshe lung khrus lung gis kha bskangs te gdab pa'i las bya/ zhes pa la gsum ste/ dang po gab pa'i sngags drug bstan pa dang / tshe lung khrus lung bstan pa dang / gdab las dngos bstan pa'o/ /dang po smad las 'di rnams dgra bgegs rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ni/ dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral ba'i zhing bcu la 'dus te/ bla ma'i sku dgra/sngags 'chang gi sku la bsdo ba/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa sogs zhing bcu ste/phur pa khrag 'thung rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa dang / / sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang / / dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog dang / / theg chen chos la dmod pa dang / / bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang / / rdo rje'i nang du dbyen spyod dang / / sgrub la bar chad byed pa dang / / gang zhig dam las log pa dang / / snying rje med pa'i srin po dang / /mu stegs log ltar gtong ba dang / /sgrub pa po la do bsdo ba/ /'di rnams bsgral ba'i zhing bcu'o/ / zhes pas dgra bgegs de rnams kyi rgyas bshad phur pa gsang rgyud nas bshad pas der ltos shig / de yang rgyud kyi dgongs pa gab pa'i sngags drug 'di la bzhi ste/ mngon spyod thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin pas kun gyi sna 'dren du btang ba dang / sgrub pa thams cad kyi ngo bo yin pas dkyus kyi khong khrar btang ba dang / las thams cad kyi mjug sdud yin pas smon lam gyi tshul du gdab pa dang / drag sngags yin pas ngan sngags su byas te srog la 'khor lo bskor ba'o/ /de yang rgyud las/ lha dbral gnas nas dgug pa dang / /rnam shes gzugs bstem byad du gzhug /smyor gzhug rdul du rlag pa dang / /sha khrag zhal du bstab na dgyes/ /'di drug shes na las rnams 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /'di la rgyud sde ma mthong ba kha cig lnga lnga bdun bdun du byed pa 'dug kyang / rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pas bcu bcu ste drug cu tham par bshad do/ / gang zhe na/ dang po gnyen po stobs kyi lha drugagadab pa gnad kyi phur pa drug gdab pa'i gnas drug bskul bar bya ba'i pho nya drugagadags par bya ba'i 'phyang drug bsag par bya ba'i rdzas drug bzla bar bya ba'i sngags drug bca' bar bya ba'i phyag rgya drug ting nge 'dzin drug gdab pa'i smon lam drug ste bcu'o/ /de las dang po lha dang phral ba la bcu ste/ gnyen nyo stobs kyi lha ni bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ste/ n+nid+dhā smid+dhā hūṃ phaṭa/ ces so/ /'jig rten las kyi lha ni rdo rje legs pa'o/ /gnyis pa gdab pa gnad kyi phur pa seng ldeng dmar po'o/ /gsum pa gdab pa'i gnas ni spyi gtsug — 173 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/tu gdab ste/ gnam gyi 'ju thag bcad pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa bskul ba'i pho nya ni/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ / ces pa'o/ / lnga pa gdags pa'i 'phyang ni/ gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ / zhes pa'o/ / drug pa bsags pa'i rdzas ni/ gu gul/ khyi lud/ tshil chen/ lham 'bog rta bong lud do/ /bdun pa sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥche ge mo mā ra ya ha sa ya ra hrī da ya na sarba bigha nān bad+dhā hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ / brgyad pa bca' ba'i phyag rgya ni/ dud pas bdug pa'i tshul te/ dngos su'ang bdug go / dgu pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas sprul pa yang sprul mang po gu gul gyi dud pa thogs pa mang po byung ste bdugs pas dgra bo lha dang phral te mi med ba'i grong stong pa'am/ byi('u)khyur rdo 'phangs pas gzhan 'phur te phog pa de kho na gcig pur lus pa ltar bsam mo/ /bcu pa smon lam ni/ gtso bo rdo rje gzhon nu nas phur srung yul phyogs lha klu rnams brjod la dgra bo dam nyams che ge mo 'di pho lha dang phrol zhig mo lha dang phrol zhigadagra lha dang phrol zhig zhang lha dang phrol zhig tshe lha dang phrol zhig yul lha dang phrol zhigaganyis pa gzugs la gdab pa la bcu ste/ dang po gnyen po stobs kyi lha mi g.yo mgon po ste/bad+dhā bad+dhā hūṃ phaṭa/ ces so/ / 'jig rten las kyi lha ni yam shud dmar po'o/ / gnyis pa gdab phur ni/ bya rgod kyi phur pa'o/ / gsum pa gdab gnas ni rkang pa'i mthil du gdab ste sa'i rten phur phyung ba'o/ / bzhi pa pho nya ni/ sprul ba chen po'i dus la bab/ ces pa'o/ /lnga ba 'phyang ni/ phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ / zhes pa'o/ / drug pa rdzas ni mtshe nag yungs nag yungs kar rgyal po yug sa mo'i zhabs ma'o/ / bdun pa sngags ni/a we sha ya a we sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ brgyad pa phyag rgya ni/ 'bebs tshul lo/ / dgu pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis gzas po bkug la liṅgā la bstim/ bcu ba smon lam ni/lha rnams brjod la dgra bo che ge mo khug cig phob cig bstim zhig ces pa'o/ / gsum pa byad du gzhug pa la bcu ste/ dang po gnyen po stobs kyi lha khams gsum rnam rgyal te/ bid+dhā bid+dhā hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ / 'jig rten las kyi lha ni klu'i rgyal po'o/ / gnyis pa ni mchog phur ro/ / gsum pa ni gsang gnas su gdab ste skye ba dgu brgyud bcad pa'i phyir ro/ / bzhi pa bskul ba'i pho nya ni/ phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab/ / ces so/ / lnga pa 'phyang ni/zung zhing rgyob cig rnam par chings zhes pa'o/ / drug pa rdzas ni/ bal tshon sna lnga skud pa dkar nag gsum rnams so/ / bdun pa sngags ni/ shri k+shi ā na ya'o/ / brgyad pa phyag rgya ni/ 'ching tshul lo/ /dgu pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas zhags pa thogs pa — 174 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagamang po byung ste gru gu thul du bcing par bsam/ bcu pa smon lam ni/ lha tshogs kyi rjes la lha'i byad du chug cig klu'i byad du chug cig gnod sbyin gyi byad du chug cig ma mo'i byad du chug cig ces so/ / bzhi pa smyor gzhug pa la bcu ste/ dang po gnyen po stobs kyi lha rta mgrin te/ grot+na groṇ+ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces so/ / 'jig rten las kyi lha ni rgyal po be dkar ro/ / gnyis pa ni phur pa tsan+dan no/ / gsum pa gnas ni lce'i dkyil du gdab ste ngag 'joms pa'o/ /bzhi pa bskul ba'i pho nya ni/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ /lnga pa 'phyang ni/rings par khug la smyor chug cig / ces pa'o/ / drug pa rdzas ni/ dha du ra thang lo(dug chu'o)/ bdun pa sngags ni/ dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya'o/ / brgyad pa phyag rgya ni/ bcing tshul lo/ /dgu pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ snying ga nas 'od tshwa tshwa lta bu 'phros/ myos shing brgyal/smyo zhing 'bog khong nas me 'bar/ bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag par bsgom/ bcu pa smon lam ni/ dgra bo che ge mo smyor chug 'bog tu chug myos su chug ces ba'o/ / lnga pa rdul du brlag pa la bcu ste dang po gnyen po stobs kyi lha dbyug sngon can te/ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces so/ /las kyi lha bdud kyis gdung ba'o/ /gnyis pa lcags phur ro/ /gsum pa snying dkar nag mtshams su gdab ste sems kyi dbyings phyung ba'o/ / bzhi pa pho nya/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ /lnga ba 'phyang ni/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog /ces so/ / drug pa rdzas ni/ mi'i rje ngar dang / rdo rje tho ba sogs so/ / bdun pa sngags ni/ta thā ya ta thā ya'o/ / brgyad pa phyag rgya ni/ brdung tshul lo/ / dgu pa ting nge 'dzin ni/snying ga nas tho ba thogs pa mang pos brdung bar bsam/ bcu pa smon lam ni/ dgra bo che ge mo rdul du rlog phye mar gyis/ thal bar rlog ces pa'o/ / drug pa zhal du bstab pa la bcu/ dang po gnyen po stobs kyi lha stobs po che ste/ pa ra bir+yan hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /las kyi lha btsan gyis btab pa'o/ /gnyis pa skyer phur/ gsum pa gnas ni lte ba ste bskyed pa'i sa bon gzhom pa'o/ /bzhi ba pho nya/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ /lnga pa 'phyang /bsgo ba'i bka' rnams nyan par gyis/ / zhes so/ / drug pa rdzas e gru gsum du liṅgā bskyur ba'am/ yang na zhal du bstab bam thod ngan gzhug go /bdun pa sngags ni/ bid+dhā ya bid+dhā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /brgyad pa phyag rgya ni/ stob pa'i tshul lo/ /dgu ba ting nge 'dzin ni/ hūṃ gsum gyis gtso bo'i zhal du gsol/ phaṭa gsum gyis khro bo'i zhal du gsol/ ha ha has dal gsum dgyes bar bsam/ bcu pa dgra bo che ge mo khro bo khro mo'i zhal du stob ces lha thams cad la sbyar ro/ / de nas liṅgā de'i mgo bo la mnan pa bya/ ro stod la sbyin sreg bya/— 175 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/yan lag gtun du brdung / nang khrol lha'i zhal du stob bo/ / dkyus khong khrar btang na/bzhi mgo la btang / gsum dkyus su btang / gcig mjug tu btang ngo / / sngags drug tshar ro/ /gnyis pa tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pas mthar dbyung ba la bzhi ste/ gzas pa po'i khrus lung dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag gi tshe lung ngo / / dang po kho'i khrus lung la gsum ste/gsal ba rnam pa gsum/ log rdugs 'byams gsum/ dgongs pa rnam pa gsum mo/ /dang po gsal ba gsum ni/ dang po oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la yas bdag rdo rje gzhon nur gsal/sarba bigha nān bad+dhā hūṃ phaṭa kyis phur pa sras mchog tu gsal/ yang badz+ra gī li gī la ya tshar gcig gis gzas pa po dngos su gsal bar byas te/ gī la yar dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbatags pa brjod pas/ sras mchog gi phyag tha ma na las thams cad pa'i sras mchog sku stod sol dum bcag pa 'dra ba/ sku smad phur pa dmar lhang nge ba g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon phur pa bsnams pa ste/ dpag chen gyis mda' bzhin song ste/ gzas po'i gnas su skar mda' ltung ba ltar bab ste/ de'i snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung / g.yon gyi phur bus mi zhan mi drag par phur bus 'debs kyin/ sdong gog drud pa bzhin du du ru ru yong ba liṅgā la bstim mo/ /nya bo la bstem pa gal che'o/ /de ltar gsum po mi gsal na ci nyes she na/ log rdugs 'byams gsum 'ong ste/ bdag rdo rje gzhon nur mi gsal na ldog phur pa sras mchog tu mi gsal na rdugs/ gzas pa po dngos su mi gsal na 'byams 'gro ba'o/ / de nas dgongs pa gsum la/ a dkar bya dkar gyi dgongs pa/ thugs rje 'brel thag gi dgongs ba/gdung ba lu gu rgyud kyi dgongs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ oṃ lam̐ hūṃ lam̐ sngags lan gcig brjod pas dal gsum po'i spyi bor hūṃ ka ra dkar po re bsam/ de'i spyi bor a dkar po re bsam/phur bu'i rtse mor yang a dkar po re bsam/ gzas pa po'i snying gar yang a dkar po re bsam pa ni/ a dkar bya dkar gyi dgongs pa'o/ / de nas oṃ lam̐ gyi sngags lan gcig brjod pas hūṃ ka ra yab yum dang / a zhu bas dal gsum bdag gi lus rkyal grod zhos bkang ba ltar song bas sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ de nas phur pa nas gang gis ma reg pa tsam du bsgril la/ snying gar bsgril bas phur rtse'i a las 'od 'phros/ a phra mo yungs kar tsam 'phros/ kho'i snying ga'i a las kyang 'od 'phros te/ 'od phar 'phros tshur 'phros pas/gzas pa po'i sdig pa thams cad dag par bsgom pa ni/ kho'i khrus lung yin te/ sngags bzlas shing yun bsring ngo / /de bdag dang gzas pa po phur pa gsum dgongs pa gcig gis — 176 —

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum naga'abrel/ dam tshig gcig gis 'brel/ chos nyid gcig gis 'brel bas na thugs rje'i 'brel thag gi dgongs pa zhes bya'o/ / de yang snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ / zhes pa/spyir sems can thams cad snying rjes mi gtong / bye brag tu gzas pa po snying rjes mi gtong /kho 'khor bar mi gtong bas na gdung ba lu gu rgyud kyi 'brel ba'i dgongs pa zhes bya'o/ /khrus lung tshar ro/ /tshe lung la gsum ste/ dang po byung tshor gyi sgo bkag pa/ gnyis pa sems kyi dbyings phyung ba/ gsum pa kun gzhi rtsad nas bcad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya che ge mo sarba bigha nān bad+dhā hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing phur pa nas gang ma reg tsam du mig la bsgril bas mig gzugs kyi byung tshor bkag rna ba la bsgril bas rna ba sgra yi byung tshor bkagade bzhin du/ sna dri/ lce ro/ lus reg byung tshor bkag nas sgo lnga'i rnam shes de sbra dkar chon thag gtub pa bzhin du kun gzhi la 'ub 'dus pa bzhin bsam pa'o/ / gnyis pa sems kyi dbyings phyung ba la gsum ste/ dang po phaṭa dral pa/ gnyis pa gnad sleb pa/ gsum pa tog blang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sngags bzlas shing phur pa ri rab kyis bsdigs pas kho'i sha khrag dang snying dkar nag 'bral ba ni dang po phaṭa dral ba'o/ /de nas phur bu'i 'od kyis snying dkar nag gi mtshams na khrag gi sbal ba mthe bong tsam zhig yod pa bsreg de'i nang na dwangs ma rnam pa gsum yod de/ khrag gi dwangs ma mtshal lcog la dang 'dra ba/ rtsa'i dwangs ma rgyus pa klad pa 'dra ba/ dbugs kyi dwangs ma gser sa 'og tu sbas pa'i rlangs pa tsam gsum yod de/ de gsum gyi dbus na kun gzhi'i shes pa yi ge a thung gi tshul du sems can thams cad la yod pas/ yang sngags bzlas shing phur pa bcings pas/ sems de rnams kyi dbus su phur pa sleb pa ni gnad sleb pa'o/ /de nas sngags bsdod cing phur pa bcings pas kho'i rnam shes a thung du yod pa de/ rdo khab len la lcags 'du ba'am/ bye tshan la mar 'du ba lta bur phur pa'i rtse mo la 'dus pa ni gsum pa tog blangs pa zhes bya'o/ / de nas de'i shul du phur pa gzhan zhig yod na btab la bzhag ste/ kho'i rnam shes la ldog pa med par byas pa ni gsum pa kun gzhi rtsad nas bcad pa zhes bya'o/ / de nas phur pa'i rtse mo la kho'i rnam shes a bkrag dang ldan pa rig pa tshe dang bsod nams dang bcas te tshur bdag la bstem ste/ oṃ lam̐ hūṃ lam̐ lan gsum brjod de bdag gi gnas gsum du reg pas kho'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad bdag la thim pas/ bdag bkrag dang gzi mdangs dang ldan par bsam pa ni bdag gi tshe lang ngo / /dper na me 'bar ba la shing bsnan pa dang 'dra'o/ /bdag nyid tshe raX ———— 1/rwanatan ————

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/dang bsod nams dang ldan par 'gyur ba'o/ / des ni kho'i tshe dang bsod nams thob pas bdag kyang mi pham la/ kho'ang sgrib pa dag pas mi pham ste gnyis ka 'tshengs nus pa'i mu yin no/ / de nas phur pa'i rtse mo gyen la bstan la gnas spar ba'i cho ga bya ste/ lag mthil ya gcig gis phur pa'i mgo nas gyen la gdab pa dang / bdag gi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rlung har te byung bas btegs/ a a zhes sngags bzlas pa gsum gyis kho'i rnam shes a thung de me stag yar ba ltar song ste/ rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams su song ste/rigs lnga'i sras su skye bar yang bsam/ skye'ang skye bas na rten 'brel gyi shugs yin no/ /chos nyid kyi bden pa yin no/ / de ni gnas spar ba'i cho ga bya ba gsang sngags kyi khyad chos yin no/ / phur pa de btab nas gzhan 'debs pa ni/ g.yag ro la mda' tshab byed pa 'dra'o/ / des na tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pa ma shes na ngan sngags dang khyad med/gnas spar ba'i cho ga ma shes na bshan pa dang khyad med ces slob dpon pad+mas gsungs pa'i don no/ / tshe lung khrus lung tshar ro/ /gsum pa gdab pa'i las bstan pa ni/ rgyud las/ gtso bo'i phur pa blangs nas ni/ /ye ge gsum gyis byin brlabs nas/ / bdag nyid bsrung ba'i tshe phur bya/ / zhes gsungs pas/ gtso bo'i phur pa bdag nyid kyi srog lta bu yin pas byin brlabs byas/mchod bstod byas kyin bzhugs su gsol/ rgyud las/ de ltar bdag lus tshags tshud nas/ /gzhan gyi lus sems dbral ba'i phyir/ /khro bo bcu yi phur pa yis/ /lus kyi gnas bcu dag tu gdab/ / sgo ma bzhi yi phur pa yis/ / lus kyi mtsho bzhi dag tu gdab/ / mi bzad phur pa drug po yis/ / gnas drug po la gdab par bya/ / zhes gsungs pas na spyir sgrub phur brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha phur lnga bcu co gcig gdab phur nyi shu rtsa gcig mgyogs phur brgyad cu tham pa/ phur pa sil bu la grangs med/ zlog phur bcu gnyis/ de rnams bsag par bya ba yin no/ / 'dir gdab phur nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ khro bo bcu'i phur pa bcu/sgo ma bzhi'i phur pa bzhi ste bcu bzhi/ mi bzad pa'i drug ste nyi shu tham pa/ sras mchog badz+ra 'dus pa'i phur pa dang nyi shu rtsa gcig go /dang po bskul ba'i pho nya ni/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ / ces pa nas/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ / ces pa'i bar du bskul la/ gsal ba gsum dang ldan pas/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra nan/ badz+ra gī li gī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ che ge mo mā ra ya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod la/ rnam par rgyal ba'i phur pa ste/ ma byin par len pa'i gnas yin pas mig da 178 da

༄〉/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagaganyis la gdab bo/ /spyir rdo rje phur pa la dbu gnon gsum ste/ de bzhin nyid don gyi dbu gnon/ kyi la ya sngags kyi dbu gnon/ dus la bab pa tshig gi dbu gnon yin pas gī la ya kun la 'gre'o/ / da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa/ dbyug sngon can gyi phur pa ste/ log par lta ba'i gnas yin pas sna gnyis la thob cig pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ gshin rje gshed kyi phur pa ste/srog gcod pa'i gnas yin pas rna ba gnyis la thob cig ma tha ma tha hūṃ phaṭa/ mi g.yo mgon po'i phur pa ste/ rdzun du smra ba'i gnas yin pas lce la thob cig dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra/rta mgrin gyi phur pa ste/ ngag 'khyal ba'i gnas yin pas de yang lce la thob cig su ru su ru badz+ra/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i phur pa ste/ phra ma'i gnas yin pas gsang bar thob cigamu ru mu ru badz+ra/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phur pa ste/ tshig tsub kyi gnas yin pas dpung pa g.yon la thob cig ka lta ka ye dza ye bi dza ye badz+ra/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phur pa ste/gnod sems kyi gnas yin pas dpyi g.yas g.yon la thob cig a dzi te a pa ra dzi te badz+ra/hūṃ ka ra'i phur pa ste/ log par lta ba'i gnas yin pas spyi gtsug tu thob cig ma ra ya su pra madh+wa na ye hūṃ phaṭa/ stobs po che'i phur pa ste/ brnab sems spong pa'i gnas yin pas rkang pa'i mthil du thob cig de rnams kyis ni mi dge ba bcu rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir khro bo bcu'i phur pa lus kyi gnas bcur gdab pa'o/ / de nas tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ sgo ma bzhi'i phur pa lus kyi mtsho bzhi la gdab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya kun la 'gre/ bi ta ya bing bing hūṃ phaṭa/ lcags kyu ma yi phur pa de glo snying dbugs kyi mtsho la thob cig na maḥs man+ta hring hring hūṃ phaṭa/ zhags pa ma yi phur pa de mchin pa khrag gi mtsho la thob cig su nu su ru pra su ru hūṃ phaṭa/ lcags sgrog ma yi phur pa de an stong du rus pa'i mtsho la thob cig mā ra ya mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dril bu ma'i phur pa de klad pa byang chub sems kyi mtsho la thob cig de nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ mi bzad pa'i phur pa drug gdab pa ni/ ha sa ya ra hrī da na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ khrag gi gnad gcod pa seng ldeng gi phur pa spyi gtsug tu gdab pa'o/ / a be sha ya a be sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dbugs kyi gnad gcod pa bya rgod kyi phur pa rkang mthil du thob cig shī r+ghaṃ ā na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ 'byung bzhi'i gnad gcod pa mchog gi phur pa gsang ba'i gnas su thob cig dz+wa la pā ya dz+wa la pā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rtsa bzhi'i gnad gcod pa tsan+dan gyi phur pa lce'i dkyil du thob cig ta thā ya ta thā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ tshe'i gnad gcod pa lcags kyi phur pa snying gi dkyil du thob cig bi da ya bi da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phyi 'od kyi gnad gcod pa skyer pa'i phur pa lte bar thob cig de ltar yang rtsa rgyud — 179 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/las/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu gdab pa ni/ / gnam gyi 'ju thag bcad pa yin/ / rkang pa'i mthil du gdab pa ni/ / sa yi rten phur phyung ba yin/ / lce yi dkyil du gdab pa ni/ / smra ba'i ngag rnams gzhom pa yin/ / gsang ba'i gnas su gdab pa ni/ / skye ba dgu brgyud bcad pa yin/ / lte ba'i gnas la gdab pa ni/ / bskyed pa'i sa bon gzhom pa yin/ /dkar nag snying la gdab pa ni/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes gzhom pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar phur pa nyi shu tham pa'o/ / de nas thams cad kyi mjug tu sras mchog badz+ra 'dus pa'i phur pa snying dkar nag gi mtshams su gdab pa ni/ phur pa la byug bdug byas te/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya sarba bigha nān bad+dhā hūṃ phaṭa kyis gdab pa ni/ rnam par shes pa de len par byed pa yin te/ tshe lung khrus lung ltar ro/ / des gdab phur nyi shu rtsa gcig go / de rnams ni rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin te/ yang rgyud sde kha cig nas/ sku ltar gdab pa/ gsung ltar gdab pa/thugs ltar gdab par bya ba bshad pa yin/ gzhi smug nag la yod pa'i phur pa rnams sku ltar gdab par 'gro/ gzhi dmar nag la yod pa rnams gsung / gzhi mthing nag la yod pa rnams thugs so/ / yang rgyud kha cig nas/ rdo rje'i gdab las/ rin chen gdab las/pad+ma'i gdab las/ las kyi gdab las bshad pa ni dal gyi phyogs nas bshad pa yin no/ /yang rgyud sde kha cig las/ zhi ba'i gdab las/ rgyas pa'i/ dbang gi/ drag po'i gdab las zhes bshad pa'ang phur pa phye ba yin no/ /yang rgyud sde kha cig la/ dang po phur pa gcig gis sems kyi dbyings phyung / gnyis pas kun gzhi rtsad nas bcad/ bcu bdun gyis byung tshor gyi sgo bkag nyi shu pas gnam gyi 'ju thag bcad/ rtsa gcig pas sa yi rten phur phyung bar bshad pa'ang gong ma la brtsis pas tshang ngo / / de yang spyir gdab las byas pas srog chags sems can lta bu la snying rje med pas mtshon 'debs pa lta bu ma yin te/ 'o na ci lta bu yin zhe na/ phur pa ni lhar bskyed pas thugs rje ye shes kyi ngo bo yin la/ gdab yul sems can de'i nyon mongs pa dang / ma rig pa la btab pas las kyi sgrib pa dang gnod sems dag nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sgrol bar byed pas na/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /zhes pa dang/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du/ / zhes pa ni/ gzhan don gyi ngo bo yin te/gsang sngags kyi che ba yin no/ / gdab las tshar ro/ /khog don drug pa mnan sreg 'phang gsum gyis las kyi mjug bsdu ba la gsum ste/mnan gtad dang / sbyin sreg dang / zor thun no/ / dang po mnan gtad la gsang sngags kyi gzhung re re'i rjes su 'brangs nas rang rang gi lugs mang yang / zas skal du — 180 —

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagagatad pa dang / dgra skal du gtad pa dang / grogs skal du gtad pa gsum mo/ /de re re la gsum gsum ste/ brkus te gtad pa/ bris te gtad pa/ gzir te gtad pa gsum gsum mo/ / de re re la'ang gsum gsum ste/ 'jam gtad dang / tsub gtad dang /nor bu lugs su gtad pa gsum gsum mo/ / spyir gtad la mi btang ba gsum yod de/grib ma mi btang / dri ma mi btang / kha rlangs mi btang / gtad la phung ba rnam pa gsum yod de/ man ngag dang ldan na dgra phung / srung ba med na rang phung / dus tshod ma shes na rdzas phung ba'o/ / gdams pa la gsum/ gtad lam bstan pa/ gtad dmag drang ba/gtad lam gtod pa gsum mo/ /gegs gsum la/ sgrib shing sgro'i gegs/ byugs pa rdzas kyi gegs/ bzlas pa'i gegs gsum mo/ /gtad la gzhug pa rnam pa gsum ste/ mtsho dang chu mig skam sa gsum mo/ / mtsho la gsum ste/ (mtsho gting ring ba)lkug pa kha med gnam gyi mtsho(la gtad)/ long ba mig med(mtsho de can la gtad)sa yi mtsho/ smyon pa rwa sped shing gi mtsho gsum(kha shing rtsis bskor ba)la gtad/ chu mig la gsum/ nag po ral gcig nags kyi chu(la gtad)/ dmar po rting khrol brag gi chu(la gtad)/ 'brong bu rwa sngon dar gyi chu(mgo gnyis rkang gcig tu song ba)/ skam sa la gsum/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la gtad pa/'brong gi rwa dbrag tu gtad pa/ stag gi 'dzum la gtad pa'o/ /rgyal mtshan rtse la gsum ste/mchod rten la gtad pa/ lha khang la gtad pa/ mgon lcam la gtad pa'o/ / de yang gsang rgyud las/ mchod rten dag la gtad pa dang / /gtsug lag khang la gtad pa dang / /mgon po lcam dral dag la yang / /dam las 'das pa gtad par bya/ /zhes so/ /de rnams gang la gtad kyang gces pa gsum ste/ dang po spyan drangs pa gces/ bar du shags gdab pa gces/ tha ma mna' bsgag pa gces so/ /de yang dang po liṅgā tshad ldan bri/ ming dang rus rnams rdzogs par bri/ de yi mtha' mar drag sngags bri'o/ / de la dgug gzhug yang yang bya'o/ /las sngags drug tshar ba dang dril la/ yang na(snod gsum la)thod ngan/ yang na glang ru/ yang na rdza'i sbal bar gzhug re bas dril/ shi sku'i skud pa kham nag gis dkris pa'o/ /mchod rten lha khang la gtod na/ gsang rgyud las/ spos gtams rat+na spyan drangs la/ / mchod pa phul la phrin las bcol/ / dam las 'das pa 'di gtod kyis/ /bskal pa'i mthar yang ma btang zhig /de skad brjod la mchod rten sba/ /zhes so/ /yang gong ltar bya ste/ sre mo'i thod par bcug la lha'i gdan 'og tu sba'o/ / spos gtams pa la sogs pa 'gre'o/ /yang sgye'u'i nang du bcug ste mgon lcam 'og tu mnan no/ /yang sngags — 181 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/pa rang gi mal 'og tu bcug ste/ yi dam bzlas bsgom byas na brlag par 'gyur te/ rgyud las/ rnal 'byor gnas pa'i 'og bcug na/ / sangs rgyas nyid kyang brlag 'gyur na/ /khams gsum sems can smos ci dgos/ / zhes bshad do/ / gnyis pa 'brong gi rwa bar du gtad pa ni/ ma mo dang gshin rje la gtad pa yin te/ ro ras sam shun chen liṅgā bris la de mon pa'i thod par bcug ste/ sa phug gam khang stong du mnan no/ / rgyud las/ ma mo gtad pa'i rim pa ni/ / dur khrod gnas sam brag phug gam/ / grog po mgo zlum dag tu mnan/ / zhes so/ / gshin rje la gtad pa ni/ ro ras la liṅgā bri/ dur khrod du gzhugasteng du me btang / rgyud las/ de ni 'chor bar yang mi 'gyur/ / gshin rjer gtad pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes so/ /bdud la gtad pa ni/ shing shun la liṅgā bri/ glen pa'i thod par bcug la shwa 'ud kyi mdor mnan/ btsan la gtad pa ni/ liṅgā ming dang bcas pa tshos kyis bri/ spre'u'i thod par bcug la grong gsum du mnan/ gnod sbyin la gtad pa ni/liṅgā ming rus dang bcas pa de/ kho rang gi pha myes kyi thod par bcug dme khrag gsum gyis byugs la/ sa phyogs dred mo ral pa bsigs pa 'dra ba'am/ nal ma bu ro sbed pa 'dra ba'am/ wa skya thur la rgyugs pa 'dra bar mnan no/ / rgyud las/ nal ma bu ro sbed 'dra dang / /srin mo'i 'dom 'drar mnan par bya/ /'di yang gnod sbyin gtad pa'o/ /zhes so/ /klu la gtad pa ni/ chu mig la lus tshad gzhal la chu mig brtag pa la/ tsag tsag tsig tsig mig gi chu/ / drag po'i skad 'don kha yi chu/ / lkug pa sgra med rna ba'i chu/ / gsal la dwangs pa snying gi chu/ / res 'ong res mi 'ong ba gsang ba'i chu/ / lus tshad la rgyal rigs 'dom bdun/ bram ze khru bdun/ rje'u bskum khru bdun/ dmangs mda' bdun/gdol pa mtho bdun/ lus drang drod yod/ phyogs brtag pa/ shar bltas rgyal rigs/lho bltas bram ze/ nub bltas rje'u/ dmangs byang / mtshams gdol pa/ kha dog brtag pa/ sa dkar rgyal rigs/ sa ser bram ze/ sa dmar rje'u/ sa nag dmangs/sa khra gdol pa'o/ / lo zla'i sgo nas gtad pa/ ston zla gsum la rgyal rigs la gtad/dgun zla gsum la rje'u/ dbyar zla gsum bram ze/ dpyid zla gsum dmangs/ tha chung bzhi gdol pa la gtad do/ /dus sa sros la rgyal rigs/ srod la rje'u/ nam phyed bram ze/tho rangs dmangs/ nyin mo la rgyal rigs/ nyi dros rje'u/ nyin phyed bram ze/ dgong kha dmangs/ sa tshab tshub la gdol pa la gtad/ khams la skeg shing khams rgyal rigs/ 'u chu bram ze/ shang lcags rje'u/ ji me dmangs/ kung sa gdol pa la gtad/ lo'i gtad — 182 —

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagal/ stag yos rgyal rigs la gtad/ rta sbrul bram ze la/ bya sprel rje'u la/ khyi phag gdol pa la/ glang lug khyi 'brug dmangs la gtad/ spyir klu'i phyogs(pho brang zer ba'ang 'dug mchan)thams cad rgya mtsho yin/ chu mig klu yi srang sgo yin/ /pho brang srang sgo bya ra'i sa/ /lkugs pa dang ni 'dun pa las/ /gang du gtad kyang 'gal ba med/ /me long dbyar sa dgun sa'o/ / lus tshad gzhal la/ za ba'i kha la gtad/ rdung ba'i rwa la gtad/bsnyab pa'i lag pa la gtad/ gzhan gsang bar mi gtad/ gtad na dgra srid 'phel lo/ /mkhal khung du mi gtad/ gtad na dgra bo nor 'phel lo/ / de yang rgyud las/ sha rus bkol la klu sman gtor/ / 'o mas brid la bden pa bdar/ / klu la gtad pa'i rim pa ste/ / zhes bshad pas phyi mig mi blta/ stong nyid bsgom/ tsha tsha lnga'am bdun bzhagabaskor ba phyin ci log bya'o/ / de yang rgyal rigs spyang ki'i thod par mnan/ mnan pa chu bo'i zam sngas yin/ btsun pa rje'u rigs gla ba'i thod par mnan/ mnan pa lam rgya gram yin/ sngags pa rabs chad thod par mnan/ mnan sa dam sri yod pa'i dben sa rnying par mnan/ bu chung dang byis pa zer(ser)mo'i thod par mnan/ mnan sa shing rkang gcig pa'i drung du mnan(dong gru gsum pa las rgya mtsho bsam/ der chu srin gyis kha gdangs par bsam/ligi btsud pas chu srin gyis mid par bsam)/ dus tshod ni/ rgyal po dang gtso bo nam smad la mnan/ bram ze btsun pa rje'u rnams nam phyed la mnan/ sngags nag nyi ma dmar thag chod khar mnan/ byis pa bud med bu chung nyi ma'i dgung la mnan/ yang na btsad po seng ge'i(dkyil 'khor gyi 'og tu) kheg par mnan/ slob ma dam nyams stag gi 'dzum(lu mig) la mnan/ dam tshig gcig pa'i mched grogs gzig gi thig ler mnan(lu ma brag chu shor ro)/sngags nag mun pa'i gling la mnan(ro shud la)/ bon po mu stegs srin mo'i sgrom(brag chun ra res)du mnan/ skyes dar ma 'brong gi rwa bar(rirab)du mnan/ oṃ lam̐ hūṃ lam̐ mang du bzla/sku gsung thugs kyi ri rab dgu yis mnan/ ro g.yam nag po la rdo rje rgya gram bris pas mnan/de'i steng du bros sbyang ngo / / mnan pa tshar ro/ /gnyis pa rdo rje phur pa'i sbyin sreg la bzhi ste/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rgyas pa'i/ dbang gi/ drag po'i sbyin sreg go / de ltar yang gsang rgyud las/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad na/ /rmug pa'i sems can 'gro gang la/ /zhi ba'i las/ kru sbyar ngar bya/ /zhes sa/su/ngas pas/ (dkyil 'khor 'dom gang gru bzhi byang dbus su)zhi ba'i thab khung de nyid smu/ / khru sa/nga zlum po bdud rtsis byug / de thā rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor/ / zhes so/ / rigs lnga'i pyag mtshan dartso/da pa spyi dang mthun/ shing dang hom gyi tshad ni/ de nyid las/ bud 'i/nga dkar ba'i — 183 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/rim pa la/ / sboms su phyag gang(zer kyang de bas che ba bya)tshad yin te/ / mdzub gang chu ru yod pa'o/ / zhes so/ /yang rgyas pa'i hom ni/ gsang rgyud las/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ /'phongs par gyur pa'i 'gro gang la/ / dkyil 'khor rgyu ru khru gang la/ /so so'i rdzas kyis byug par bya/ / bud shing ser po gang dang gang / /sboms su phyag gang chur khru gang / / zhes pas de ltar bya'o/ / dbang gi hom ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ /chags par gyur pa'i 'gro gang na/ / dbang gi las la sbyar bar bya/ /zla gam dmar po'i dal bri la/ /rgya la sor ni nyi shu la/ /kha la sor bcu bri bar bya/ /phyi rol lcags kyu zhags pas brgyan/ /sboms su phyag gang chu sor lnga/ /zhes pas/ de ltar bya'o/ / yang drag po'i hom ni/ gsang rgyud las/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ /log par lta ba'i gdug pa can/ / mngon spyod hom ni sbar bar bya/ /nag po'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa/ /ngos re sor na nyi shu bya/ /sboms su phyag tshad sor bzhi chu/ /mi rus dur khrod sol bas byugs/ /bud shing tsher ma can gyis bya/ /zhes pas de ltar bya'o/ /dus ni zhi ba la ni snga dro/ rgyas pa nyin phyed/ dbang la phyi dro/ drag po la dgong kha'o/ / yang zhi ba nam langs/ dbang srod/ drag po nam phyed/ rgyas pa tho rangs so/ / yang zhi ba dbyar/ rgyas ston/ dbang dpyid/ drag po dgun no/ / kha blta phyogs zhi ba shar/rgyas lho/ dbang nub/ drag po byang ngo / /yang na gling gzhan du blta'o/ /shing ni/ zhi ba la/ 'o ma can gyi shing / rgyas pa la dri bzang po/ dbang la mar khu can/ drag po la tsher ma can no/ /me'i rim pa ni/ zhi ba la bram ze'i me blang / rgyas la rje'u'i/ dbang la smad 'tshong ma'i/ drag po la yugs sa mo'i blang ngo / / yang zhi ba la me shel gyi mes/ rgyas pa tsub pa las/ dbang shing drud pa las/ drag po lcags mgar las so/ / yang zhi ba la shar nas gzhug rgyas lho nas/ dbang nub nas/ drag po byang nas so/ /bsreg rdzas la/zhi ba la til/ rgyas pa la zho/ dbang la ut+pal/ drag po la dug sna/ gzhan tshogs tshad do/ /'dug stangs la/ zhi ba la skyil krung / dbang la pad+ma'i/ rgyas pa la g.yas brkyang /drag po la g.yon brkyang ngo / /bsreg rdzas kyi dang po mar gyi dgang blugs gsum dbul/ de nas me pra brtag pa ni/ me rdo rje'am/ dung ngam/ bkra shis pa'i rtags 'dra na bzang /me chad 'gro na ngan/ mdog ni gser ram/ nyi ma 'dra na bzang / ljang sngo nag ngan/sgra la 'brug dang pi waṃ 'dra na bzang / sim sim tseg tseg ngan/ du ba rtsa ba phra la mgo bo che na bzang / du ba che chung byed na bgegs yod/ du ba med na ngan/ me dri zhim na bzang /— 184 — mi

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagashing shar du 'gyel na bzang / lhor 'gyel na ngan/ nub ngan/ byang bzang mtshams 'bring / thal ba nag na mi gtsang ba yod/ dmar na nad rims 'ong / smug na nor phyuganyung la dkar na bzang / de ltar bzang ba dang / ram̐ las lha spyi ltar bskyed/ de la bsreg rdzas dbul/ bstod pa byas la/ de'i thugs kar dal gsum bskyed/ yang bsreg rdzas dbul/ bstod pa bya/ rang nyid chas ji ltar bya na/ gsang rgyud las/ lus nag khros pas lho phyogs blta/ /skra yang spyi bor bcings nas su/ /lus la thal ba chen pos byugs/ /khros pa'i sems kyis liṅgā bsreg /sangs rgyas nyid kyang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pas/de nyid las/ liṅgā gang la bri ba ni/ / sdong po me reg shing shun la/ / gzugs brnyan byas la dgug gzhug bya/ /tha ma dug gi me la bsreg /tshangs pa'i tshe dang ldan pa yang / /skad cig gis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / de nyid las/ nag po'i shing gi shun pa la/ /mtshan ma ming dang bcas pa bri/ / me de la ni bsreg par bya/ / lha yang rung ste brlag par 'gyur/ / zhes pa mdor na dgra bgegs kyi liṅgā la las drug tshang par byas la byang bu dang /bsreg rdzas rnams dus gcig tu bsreg par bya ba gdams pa yin te/ rgyud ltar du bshad pa'o/ /drag po'i bsad thabs dgu ste/ yang shing shun la liṅgā bri/ bswe shing la me sbar te bsreg na dgra bo de lo dus la 'chi'o/ / yang zhing gi pags pa la dug khrag gis liṅgā bris te bsreg na thang cig gis brlag par bshad do/ /yang shing lo grog ma'i sa bong bu'i chus sbrus te liṅgā byas nas bsreg na sangs rgyas kyang 'chi'o/ / zhes bshad do/ / gang byed kyang bzlas tshad ni/ rgyud las/ pho la brgya rtsa brgyad du bshad/ /mo la nyi shu co gcig bya/ /nam gyi gung dang nyin gung la/ / dus tshod ma nor bsreg par bya/ / zhes pas/ yang rta khrag dang dug bsres pas shing shun la ligi bris te spru shing la me sbar te bsres na lha'ang 'gas te 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ / yang dur khrod ras la khrag gis liṅgā bris te/ seng ldeng gi me la bsreg na skad cig gis 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dgra'i dri ma drug la liṅgā bya/ dur khrod ras la ming ris bri/ /snying gar bcas pa'i sbyin sreg bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas gdan la 'dren/ /zhes so/ / yang shing shun nag po la liṅgā bris te/ dur khrod shing bu la me sbar te sngags bzlas na/thang cig yud cig gis 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ / yang gsang rgyud las/ mtshan ma dum bar dum bur gtub/ / de yi dum bu re re dang / / go ro tsa na tsit+tar bcas/ /mi dbang gris bsad sha khrag dang / / de steng ro shing me btang nas/ / dug gi shing bu yam shing dang / /bdud rtsi sbyar la sreg gyur na/ / lha yang brlag 'gyur the tshom med/ / ces bshad pas/— 185 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/rgyud nas gsungs pa la/ pad+ma rgyal pos gdams pa bstan pa yin no/ /sbyin sreg tshar ro/ /rdo rje phur pa'i zor thun 'di la bdun te/ gsang rgyud las/ phur thun mda' thun dug thun dang / /khrag thun yungs thun mtshe thun dang / / rdo thun rnam pa bdun zhes bya/ /bsad pa'i las rnams kun la shis/ / zhes gsungs pa/ de yang dal khru gang gru bzhi la/dkyil du gru gsum nag po sor nyi shu/ dpangs dang zheng la sor gsum bya/ zur la rdo rje rgya gram bri/ ro sol dang bdud rtsis byugs la/ kha khyer la lcags kyu bri/ phyir tsakra rtsibs brgyad 'od dang bcas pa bri/ de la rdzas dgod pa ni/ lho rtsibs la mda' 'ug pa ma la dug khrag byugs la/ gshin rje de la bskyed la gzug shar rtsibs la khra'i mda' la gu gul byugs la/ rnam par rgyal ba bskyed la gzug byang rtsibs la srin bya'i sgro can tshil chen byugs la/bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed la gzug nub rtsibs la bya rog sgro can tshil chen byugs/ rta mgrin du bskyed la gzug de rnams la mde'u dug shing la bya'o/ / de rnams la dbang byin rlabs bya'o/ / phur thun dang sbrags na mde'u rnams phur pa mtshon dngos legs par dod pa byed la/ sras mchog tu bskyed la dbang byin brlab bya/ ngar blud do/ / thod ngan nang du thun rdzas bdun po thams cad bsag sprul pa'i tshogs su bsgom/ phur pa rnal 'byor pa'i mdun du bya'o/ /tshogs dang gtor ma bsham la bsgrub par bya'o/ /rtags byung ba dang zor thun rdeg pa ni gsang rgyud las/ gser skyems legs par btang bar bya/ / ma nyes dpang gzug las rnams bsgom/ / rdo rje'i glu ni drag tu blang / / lho phyogs kha bltas ha has gdab/ /rkang pa g.yas pa bag tsam bskum/ /g.yon pa rab tu bgrad la 'phang / /zhes so/ /de yang thag nye na mkhar khyim mam dur la 'phang / thag ring na byang ri'am mthon po'i brag khar 'dzegs la zor lam bsal la 'phang ngo / / thun dang yungs kar thams cad mda' yi steng du blugs la 'phangs/ khrag gi mda' thun byed na/ khrag sna mda'i nang du blugs la/spra tshil gyis kha bcad la khrag gi bud med du bsam la 'phang ngo / / yang dug gi mda' thun ni/dug shing la zhing lpags kyi sgro bskyon pa'am/ dug sna thams cad mda' la thang chus bkus la/sngags drug bzlas la rtags byung ba dang 'phangs te thams cad 'joms par byed do/ / yang sngags kyi dug mda'i thun byed na/ rang rang gi sngags mang du bzla/ yungs kar la bsngags la mde'u'i nang du blugs la 'phang ngo / / gong ltar bden pa bdar ba kun la gces so/ /dgra brlag par the tshom med do/ / yang dug thun ni rgyud las/ thod pa gling drug nag po'i phyogs/ / gdong cig thod cig de la byug / bong nga lcags tsher re lcags pa/ / spyang dug — 186 —

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagathar nu ske tshe dang / / glang chen(ribong)snying dang chu srin(sram)snying / /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams bkug la bstem/ /ha la'i dug chen 'bar bar bsam/ /zhes pa de la bzlas pa mang po rdzogs pa dang / zor du brdeg ste/ rgyud las/ grong dang grong khyer chen po'am/ /yul phyogs dur dang lha rten la/ /de la 'phangs par bya ba yin/ /de yis brlag par the tshom med/ /ces so/ /yang rabs chad nag po'i thod par dme khrag gi gzhi blangs la/ khrag sna brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bkang ba dal gyi dbus su bzhag bsnyen sgrub tshang pa dang / seng ldeng gi 'khar ba thogs la/ ras chen gyis g.yab cing / ma mo rbad pa'i snying po bzlas la zor du brdeg ste brlag par the tshom med do/ / yang gtor zor byed na/ khrag gi gtor ma byas la/sngags mang du bzlas te khrag thun gyi las ltar byas na/ rgyud las/ grong la gtor na mi nad dang / /phyugs nad sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dur la gtor na nad 'khrugs dang / /tha ma rabs su chad par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / yang yungs thun la/ dang po yungs kar yungs nag byin gyis brlabs la/ thod ba'i nang du dur khrod kyi sa blug sdong po rkang gcig pa bton pa'i shul du bcug bdud rtsi lngas bran/ rnga mo'i brun/ phag brun/ khyi spyang gi brun las bskyed/ de smin pa dang thod par blug bdud rtsi lnga dang dug khrag gis bran/ de nas bsngags la 'phangs te/ gsang rgyud las/ gang dmigs pa de brlag 'gyur/ /dur la brgyab na khrag 'khrugs 'byung / / klu la brgyab na mdze nad 'byung / /mkhar la brgyab na grong brdal 'jig /mi nad rta nad glang chen 'chi/ /yungs thun zhes ni de la bya/ /zhes so/ / de yang mtshe zor dang rdo zor ni las thams cad la 'jug pa yin pas/ rgyud las/mtshe dang rdo thun gdug pa la/ /rab tu bsngags la de nyid brdeg /de yis thal bar brlag par 'gyur/ /de ltar gcig la kun tshang dang / /so sor byas kyang 'dra bar te/ /de ltar thun ni bdun po kun/ / gcig la gcig brten rab gsal bas/ / mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par gyis/ /zhes so/ /yang bdag nyid chen mo'i zor bdun ni/ thod zor ni rabs chad nag po'i thod pa bla 'og ma bral bar/ mi khyi ra'i khrag thar nu spyang dug btsan dug bsngags la 'phangs/ khrag zor ni/ thod ngan nam/ dgo nu g.yas pa'am/ yang na sna ma phug pa gnya' ma skyes pa'i g.yas par khrag gsum bsngags la 'phang ngo / / mda' zor ni/smyug tshigs bdun la ltas ngan sgro bskyon la 'phang / mtshe zor ni/ brag nag las skyes pa'i mtshe la yungs kar gyi rkang bshad bal tshon gyis dkris la 'phang ngo / /rdo zor ni/ rdo nag po dgu blangs la bsngags la 'phang / yungs kar rkang bshad bal tshon gyis dkris te 'phang ba — 187 da

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/ni yungs zor/ sbang zor ni/ sbang ma la bal tshon gyis bkab la 'phang ngo / / spyir zor gang byed kyang bshan pa ni/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du gzas pa po la ga nya dang bse khrag gis bya/ ru'am thod pa'i khrag la bsngags la 'phangs te thod pa'am ru'i kha rtse gnyis g.yas su khrag dar phyar ba 'dra ba'i rlangs pa 'dra ba byung na dgra ma lus 'chi bas dus gdab pa'o/ /ru rtse g.yon du dgra sar song / khrag tshur byung na dgra'i pho rab gsum la 'ong / ru rtse khrag gsum g.yas su yo na mthu bzlog pa la 'byung ngo / / ru rtse gnyis g.yas su song nas khrag 'thung na dgra bo'i nor la god 'ong ngo / / ru g.yon du kha rtse khrag gsum dgra sar song na mo rab gcig la 'ong ngo / / rus g.yon du kha rtse song nas khrag 'thung na dgra'i 'og rta dang bran la 'ong ngo / / bzlog pa brtsi ba ni du kha rtse khrag gsum rang sar tshur log na sgrub pa bskyar dgos/ tshe chog bya/ ru kha rtse rang sar byung khrag phar song na gsum bskyar na thub 'ong /ru kha rtse rang sar g.yon du log khrag 'thung na nor god yong / nu kha rtse khrag gsum g.yon du log na spun nam nye drung la 'ong / ru g.yon du kha rtse khrig gsum rang sar byung na rang gi mo rab gsum mam gcig la 'ong ngo / / 'phang ba zor gyi gnad tshar ro/ /mnan bsreg 'phang gsum gyis las kyi mjug bsdu ba ste/ khog don drug pa tshar ro/ /e ma ho/ bla med rgyud kyi man ngag rtsa thur 'di/ / mi 'gyur rtogs pa'i rgyal po'i rgya yis btab/ /mgo mjug med par man ngag gsu/ma gyis khyab/ /skabs kyi 'grel ba don gyi khog tu bsgril/ / man ngag gzer gyis stod smad gnyis su phye/ / don gyi khongs nas bkral nas gdams pa bsdebs/ / rtsa ba gcig tu dril nas gnad kyi gzer gegs bkrol/ / lnga bcu rtsa gcig spro bsdu'i yi ge hūṃ/ / theg dgu rnam dag yi ge a yig dgu / spros dang brlag par byed pa'i sum cu rtsa bzhi phaṭa/ /ye shes lnga ldan yig 'bru bcu gnyis oṃ/ /stod las smad las phrin las so sor gdags/ / dkyus kyis gcod pa dkyus drug bkrol ba yin/ / khog don drug pa rdzogs so/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ rgyud kyi them sbyor bcu las/ gleng gzhi rnam pa gsum ni gong du bshad zin to/ /mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum gyis don gyi shan dbye/ /zhes pa las/ kha cig las mtshan nyid rnam pa bzhi zhes bshad kyang / mtshan nyid gsum las med do/ / phur pa'i mtshan nyid ni phur pa'i rgyu bzhi dang bzlos pa'i phyir/ yang yang bshad pa mi rigs pa'i phyir/de'ang gsum po gang zhe na/ dal gyi mtshan nyid/ sngags kyi mtshan nyid/ rdzas kyi mtshan nyid do/ /— 188 —
