phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/lung zin/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du/ / zhes pas mtha' spyod pa'i lung zin/ zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings/ /zhes pas gdab pa phrin las kyi lung zin/ rdo rje'i tho bas bsgral bar bya/ /zhes pas sbyor ba thabs kyi lung zin/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /zhes pas bdun tshigs zin/ rdo rje me dbal snying bsreg cing / / zhes pas nang sbyin sreg zin/ ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ / ces pas rab gnas zin/ de la sogs lung drug cu rtsa gcig dngos por tshang yod/ tshang lugs bla mas ngo sprod do/ / gdams pa brgya rtsa brgyad pa'o/ / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas nas da lta'i bla ma yan chad kyis dmigs su myong ba brgya rtsa brgyad ngo sprad par bya'o/ / dang po sems bskyed pa'i lung ni spyir theg pa chen po la sems bskyed dgos/ khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa pa sems bskyed dgos pas/sems bskyed byed pa po ni rnam par smin pa'am nges pa'i rig 'dzin yin te/ dus gsum bud+dhā'i gdung bzung snyam pa'o/ / blang ba'i yul ni tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa thob pa'o/ /sems bskyed kyi ngo bo ni/ sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin la 'god snyam pa'o/ / 'bras bu ni bdag gzhan gnyis ka lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin thob pa ste/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa bcu gsum pa thob pa'o/ /lag len ni/ slob mas/rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa po/ / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / / dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob lags/ / zhes zhus/ dus lan du/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i /sems bskyed dam tshig thub par srungs/ / zhes dang / dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub kyi bar du dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i rjes su slob bo/ / rjes su sgrub bo/ / rjes su bgyid do/ /thabs yin no/ / legs so lan gsum bya'o/ / dam tshig ni sems can thams cad lha dang lha mor shes par byas la/ dngos su phan par bya/ nyams na 'gyod pa drag pos gso/yang na bskyar la blang ngo / / sems bskyed pa'i lung rdzogs so/ /shrī ku mā ra na mo/ dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig / dbang bskur ba bshad de/ de la gdams pa dang / lag len gnyis so/ /dang po la/ spyir dbang la mu bzhi ste/dbang ma bskur kyang thob pa'i dbang ni/ rab lta ba rtogs pas sems la dbang thob pa'o /bskur te ma thob pa ni/ ru gdams pa dang mi ldan la slob ma dam tshig dang mi ldan pa'o/ /dbang bskur kyang bskur thob kyang thob pa ni/ ru gdams pa dang ldan/ bu dam tshig dang ldan pa'o/ /bskur kyang ma bskur thob kyang ma thob pa ni mi nag phal ba lta bu'o/ /de yang rdo — 220 —

༄7/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagarje phur pa'i dbang bka' 'di la nub dang po la sa chog gnyis pa la sta gon/ gsum pa la dbang bskur ba thob pa'o/ /sa chog ni rgyud sde spyi ltar ro/ /sta gon gyi skabs su gzhan 'dra ba las/ khyad par thig gi skabs su/ hūṃ/ sa gzhi ye nas lhun grub dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje'i skud pa sra zhing mnyen pa ba su tas/ /dkyil 'khor thig ni gsal la dod par btab/ /thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces brjod/ de nas bum pa'i sta gon gyi skabs su gsungs pa/ dbus su badz+ra 'dus pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i bum pa sngon po bca'/ shar du bud+dhā 'dus pa'i sras mchog bum pa dkar po bca'/ lho ru rat+na 'dus pa'i bum pa ser po bca'/ nub tu pad+ma 'dus pa'i bum pa dmar po bca'/ byang du karma 'dus pa'i bum pa ljang gu bca'/ bum rdzas mgul chings kha rgyan tshang bar bya'o/ /de nas tshon gyi skabs su/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ye shes che/ / ye shes lhun grub rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /spros med bsdu med khyab gdal chen po'i ngang / /dbang chen dkyil 'khor bdag gis bri bar bya/ / zhes brjod la/ dbus su gru gsum mthing nag zla gam dmar po gsum/ 'khor lo zla gam dmar po brgyad/ mu khyud thod pa dkar po/ gru chad ljang / lha snam phyogs dang mthun/ phur pa rnams 'god/ byang shar du gtor ma/lho shar du sman/ lho nub tu tshogs/ nub byang du tshe mchog shar du bum dbang gi rdzas/lhor gsang dbang gi rdzas/ nub tu shes rab ye shes kyi rig ma/ byang du dbang bzhi pa'i rdzas dgod/ de nas nub gsum pa la dbang bskur ba la bcu ste/ sras mchog lngas bum pa'i dbang bskur/ dal bsgom par/ dal bri bar/ rgyud nyan par/ rgyud bshad par/sngags bzlas par dbang bskur ro/ / lhor gsang bdag la bcu ste/ bla ma yab yum gyi thig le lce la bzhag dbu rgyan do shal gnyis/ rdo rje dril bu gnyis/ thod rnga gling bu/ mi bzad pa'i phur pa drug sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la rol pa'o/ / nub tu sher dbang la gsum ste/mtshan ldan rig ma dang shes rab chos dbyings dang / rang rig ye shes la brten pa'o/ /byang du tshig dbang la gsum/ rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' ches dbang bskur pa/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dgongs pas bskur ba/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis bskur pa'o/ /gnyis pa lag len la/ slob ma sta gon gyi skabs su/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed phog khrus bya/ gdong g.yogs/ me tog thogs/ phrin las tshogs yan chad brin pa dang / slob mas 'di skad zhu/ hūṃ/ bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin/ /srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin bdag / dbang bzhi rdzogs par ma thob pas/ / rgyud drug 'khor — 221 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i 'dam du zin/ /ma rig mun pa'i klong du 'khyams/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal che mthong bas/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin/ /gtso bo mgon la skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab sgron ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /ma rig mun pa bsal bar zhu/ /thugs rje thabs kyi zhags pa yis/ /'khor ba'i 'dam las drang bar zhu/ /zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /ru yis lan 'di sbyin no/ /hūṃ/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin khyod/ /gsang sngags thabs chen sgrub pa la/ /zab mo'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dgos/ /lhag pa'i dbang la dam tshig gces/ /dbang thob dam tshig ma ldan na/ / rang srog rang gis gcod pa yin/ / bskal pa 'bum du mnar med ltung / /de phyir dam tshig bsrung nus sam/ / zhes dri/ yang bus khas 'di blang ngo / hūṃ/ bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin/ / sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ / srog gi phyir yang mi gtong na/ /bdag gis dam tshig nges par bsrung / /zhes bya'o/ /de nas rus/ hūṃ/ nyon cig shes ldan rigs kyi bu/ / gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor khyod la bstan/ / dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /mos dang gus pa bskyed par gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ces gdong g.yogs bkrol lo/ / de nas dkyil 'khor blta'o/ /de nas bus/ thar pa chen po'i grong mchog 'dir/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad nas/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig / ces zhus pa dang / rus bud+dhā 'dus pa'i bum pa spyi bor/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya ma hā ma dha la a bhi dzñā na a bhi tsar+ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ/ ma hā ma dha la a bhi dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes tshang bar bya'o/ /de nas bum pa gzhan yang spyi bor bzhag par bya'o/ /rus 'di skad brjod/ hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor chen po khyod sgoms shig /dkyil 'khor chen po khyod bris shig /zas dang nor gyi phyir ma byed/ /byang chub rtsi yis zin par byos/ /brjod pa dang / bum pa'i lha thams cad 'od du zhu/ chu dang gnyis su med pa de slob ma la blud do/ /de nas rgyud nyan bshad byed pa'i dbang bskur ba/ hūṃ/ legs so shes ldan rigs kyi bu/ /bka' brgyud dri ma med pa la/ /thos pa bsam pa sgom pa gsum/ /tshul chen bu yis yang dag gyis/ /zhes dang / rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud klog sngags zlos pa ni/ hūṃ/ lha nyid sngags la sngags nyid lha/ /sngags dang lha ru gnyis su med/ /ye shes lha yi thugs dkyil na/ /rang rang thugs kyi snying po gnas/ / de phyir khyod kyang de nyid zlos/ / zhes pa dang / sngags thams cad dpog go / de nas dam tshig khas blang bar bya'o/ / bum dbang rdzogs so/ /de nas gsang dbang bskur ba ni/ dal gyi lhor phyar pa'i yol bar bla ma yab yum lus — 222 —

༄khya/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagal lha bkod de/ sbyor ba mdzad pa la zhu ba/ hūṃ/ srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ / sku gsung dbyer med sgrub pa yi/ /de phyir gsang ba'i dbang bskur 'di/ /yongs su rdzogs pa bskur bar zhu/ /zhes zhus pas/ ru'i lus kyi lha 'dod chags chen po'i mes 'od du zhu ba'i thig le bu'i lce thog tu bzhag go /de mi nus na lha yab yum gyi thig le lce la bzhag go /de nas rus pa'i dbu rgyan dang do shal sbyin/ rdo rje dang dril bu/ thod rnga gling bu/ mi bzad pa'i phur pa drug sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga byin la 'di skad do/ / hūṃ/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /dbu rgyan do shal rigs lnga ste/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya 'di/ /slob dpon rtag tu bzung bar bya/ /thod pa'i rnga brdung mi rkang gling / /mi bzad drug gi phur bus gdab/ /rtog med chen po'i rang bzhin gyis/ / sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la rol/ / a la la ho dgyes chen po/ /rang bzhin rnam dag nges par rol/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin khyod/ /lha yi bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu/ /nyon mongs thams cad sel ba'i chu/ /khyod la dbang bzhi rdzogs bskur gyi/ /gsang spyod tshul dang ldan par gyis/ /zhes brjod la phur pa drug po'i sngags brjod de gsang dbang ngo / / dkyil 'khor nub tu shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ rig ma mtshan ldan sngags kyis bkug la/ dri zhim po'i khrus bya/ 'khor lo rgyas 'debs su byas la mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab/ yab kyi'ang brlabs te/ de nas zhu ba ni/ hūṃ/ srid pa rdo rje phur ba'i lha/ / sku gsum dbyer med sgrub pa yi/ / de phyir shes rab ye shes kyi/ /dbang 'di rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ / zhes brjod pa dang / rig mas sa ma ya hoḥzhes brjod la gsang mchod 'bul/ yab kyis sa ma ya s+t+waṃ gyis gsang mchod bzhes/ oṃ badz+ra kyi li gī la ya dīsnya tsakra ra ho haṃ/ rā ga ya mi/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa dang rig mas pad+ma bskyod pa'i tshul bya/ yab kyis rdo rje bsnun pa'i tshul bya/ des rdo rje sems dpa' dbab pa'i dus su/ bde ba nyams su myong ba/rtog pa med pa'i bde ba la smrar med pa/ gsal la mi rtog pa/ rig mas bu ram gyi ro myong ba lta bu/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa nyon mongs pa rang sar grol ba zhig 'byung ba de ngos bzung la nyams su blang ngo / / de nas thig le rlung dang 'khrul 'khor gyis yar drangs la/lus la dgram pa ni sngags spyi dang 'dra'o/ / thig le lus la rgyas na yon tan brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /'od kyi rig ma la brten pa'i dbang yang shes par bya'o/ /dal gyi byang du dbang bzhi pa bskur ba ni/ hūṃ/ srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ / thams cad sems su 'dus pa la/ /sems la rang dbang ma thob na/ / 'bras bu smin par ga la 'gyur/ / chos sku ngo sprod — 223 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/dbang bskur zhu/ / zhes zhus pa dang / rus/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'di lta ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' bzhin/ /ngang nyid rdo rje'i chos dbyings la/ / rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgoms/ / zhes brjod la me long g.ya' dag pa'i ngos la gzugs brnyan bstan la/ gsal la ngos bzung med pa la ngo sprod/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dgongs pa de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin stong zhing bdag med pa la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes tshig gis mtshon du med pa brdas mtshon la bstan to/ /de ni tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa zhes bya ba yin te/ dbang bzhi ma nor ma bcos pa yin no/ / rdo rje phur pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs dbang bka' dang bcas pa 'di pad+ma rgyal po'i lag len rdzogs so/ /gu ru shrī ku mā ra na mo/ sku bskyed pa sngags dang phyag rgya'i lung ni/ 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ / sku yi dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig / ces pas sku ste de la gsum/ bdag thog mar dam tshig gi sems dpar bskyed/ de nas ting nge 'dzin sems dpar bskyed/ de la ye shes sems dpa' bcug ste gnyis su med pa'i sems dpa' bskyed pa'o/ / de yang dang po byams dang snying rjes kun nas bslangs te/ skad cig la chos thams cad stong ba nyid du bsgom pa'i ngang las/ rdo rje gzhon nur skad cig dran rdzogs su bskyed/ de nas 'khor rnams kyang bskyed nas srung ba'i 'khor lo bskyed/ mtshams dang bshags pa dang tshogs bsag pa byed pa'o/ /de dam tshig sems dpa' yin no/ /de nas ye shes kyi tshogs stong nyid bsgom pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom/ dal rnam gsum gyi sems dpa' bskyed pa la gsum/ gang zag dbang po rab skad cig dran rdzogs su bskyed pa dang / dbang po 'bring cho ga gsum nas bskyed pa dang / dbang po tha ma skye gnas bzhi nas bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byams dang snying rje'i ngang nas dal gsum rdzus skyes su bkra lam gyis bskyed pa dang / de la rnam par rtog pa gang gis kyang bar ma chod pas na ye shes kyi tshogs 'ba' zhig yin pas bzang ngo / /gnyis pa cho ga gsum gyis bskyed pa ni/ dang po gsung yig 'bru'i cho ga thugs phyag mtshan gyi cho ga sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i cho ga dang gsum/ dang po rang rang gi gdan thog tu yi ge hūṃ lta bu re gsal bar bsgom/ de nas 'od zer 'phros/'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yig 'bru la thim pas thugs phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse dgu par song / de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pas sku yongs su rdzogs pa rdo rje gzhon nur gyur pa de/ sku mdog phyag mtshan gsal bar bsgom pa'o/ / de khro bcu nas sgo ma'i bar 'gre'o/ / bskyed rim thams cad la des cho ga — 224 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagardzogs pa yin no/ / gsum pa ni sems can thams cad sbyang gzhi skye gnas bzhi las skye bas de'i sbyong byed dal gyi lha'ang skye gnas bzhi nas bskyed de/ de'ang bdag nyid rtsa ba rdzus skyes kyi tshul du bskyed/ yab yum mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab/ rjes chags byas pa'i mkha' nas hūṃ sbrel ma bcu spros/ de las khro bcur gyur pa ni mngal skyes yin no/ / thig le dkar dmar nyi shu las mgo brnyan nyi shu byung ba ni sgong skyes yin no/ / phur srung bcu gnyis po 'di las bskyed bya ba med do/ / lus grub na grib ma grub pa'i tshul du 'byung bas drod gsher las bskyed pa yin no/ / de ltar bskyed pa'i lha tshogs de rnams rang rgyud par mi bsgom mo/ / 'o na ji ltar bsgom na/ snang la rang bzhin med pa bar snang gi 'ja' tshon lta bur bsgom mo/ /gsal la rtog pa med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgom mo/ / sku bskyed pa phyag rgya'i lung rdzogs so/ /gu ru shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ phung po rdo rjer gtams byas nas/ / rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ / zhes pas bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi lung zin te/ de la gsum/ thabs bskyed rim bsgom pa dang / shes rab rdzogs rim bsgom pa dang / gnyis med zung 'jug bsgom pa'o/ / dang po bskyed rim rkyang par song na gol sa che ste/ ru tra'am 'dod lhar skye bas na/ de la rdzogs rim gyi theb pa gal che/ de la bzhi ste/ spros te thim pa/ bsdus te zhu ba/ de kho na nyid du blo bzhag pa/ dub par blta ba'o/ /dang po ni/ srog gam ye shes sems dpa'i hūṃ las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros te/ rdo rjer gsal/ de las phyir 'phros ye shes sems dpar gsal/ de las 'phros bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dal gsal/ de las phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dal gsal/ de las phyir 'phros/ gzhal yas khang gsal/ de las phyir 'phros khams gsum sems can gsal/ sgrib pa sbyangs/ bud+dhā la pū dza phul/ gdug pa can tshar bcad pa de ni spros te thim pa'o/ / de nas 'od zer gī la ya'i sgra dang bcas te/ tshur 'dus pas gzhal yas khang la phog 'od du zhu/ de khro bo bcu la phog 'od du zhu/ de bdag rtsa ba dang / ye shes sems dpa' dang / thugs ka'i rdo rje dang / hūṃ gi zhabs kyu la 'dus te/ thig le la 'dus pa ni bsdus te zhu ba'o/ / de nas thig le de yang je phra la stong bar thim pa ni de kho na nyid la blo gnas pa'o/ / de nas skad cig ma la dal gsum gzhal yas khang dang bcas par ldang ba ni dub par blta ba'o/ /de nas rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam rnam bzhi bya'o/ /gsum pa dbyer med zung 'jug tu bsgom pa ni/ dbyer med gsum gyi rgyas btab ste/ gang zhe na/ sku gsal stong dbyer — 225 ge

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/med 'od kyi sku snang la rang bzhin med pa ni sprul sku'i rgyas gdab bo/ / gsung grags stong dbyer med zhi ba chos kyi sgra ni longs sku'i rgyas gdab bo/ /thugs rig stong dbyer med bde ba chen po ni chos sku'i rgyas gdab bo/ / de la dang po rab lhar dag pa bsgom/ 'bring rnam pa bsgom/ dbang po tha ma nga rgyal bsgom pa yin te/ sngags pa lha lam pa zhes bya'o/ /sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi lung rdzogs so/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang / /zhes pas/ sgrub pa dngos grub kyi lung yin te/ de la phun sum tshogs pa brgyad/ gang zag phun sum tshogs pa/grogs phun sum tshogs pa/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ rdzas phun sum tshogs pa/ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa/ sgrub pa'i cho ga phun sum tshogs pa/byin rlabs dang dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa'o/ / dang po rten gyi gang zag ni/ rnam par nges pa'i rig 'dzin bla ma dang yi dam nges par bzung ba des sgrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa grogs ni/phyi nang brda sbyor dang / rdul phyags skyes bu dang / mchod pa stob pa dang / gzungs ma mtshan ldan dang bzhi'o/ / gsum pa gnas ni/ dur khrod dam/ shing gcig gam/gnam gri 'dra ba/ sa gru gsum sogs tsher ma skyes pa'o/ /bzhi ba dus ni/ 'bring po bzhi sgrub pa'i dus yin pas 'bring po bzhi la bya'o/ / lnga ba dang drug pa rdzas dang yo byad ni lnga ste/'tsho ba zas kyi/ rkyen bzlog sman gyi/ thugs dam bskang ba'i/ sgrub pa rdzas kyi/ dgra bgegs bsad pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams gzhung du bshad pa ltar ro/ / bdun pa bsgrub bya'i chos la lnga ste/ dang po phyi bshags phyi skong sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas phyi mtshams bcad pa dang /dam sri mnan cing sgo byang gdags pa dang / stegs bu brtsigs shing sa gzhi bzung ba dang /dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing rdzas dang yo byad dgram pa dang / sgrub pa bya zhing dngos grub blang pa'o/ /dang po la mdo bzhi sgrogs te/ shar du tshogs bsag pa'i phyir shes rab sdud pa/lhor bdud 'dul ba'i phyir tog nub tu srin po 'dul ba'i phyir laṅkar gshegs pa/ byang du sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir dpang skong bsgrag go / phyi skong de'i nub mo zhi ba'i phrin las gzhung bsrang thun mong gi las bdun nam dgu bya'o/ / bskos gdab bo/ / phyi mtshams la gnyis/snang ba mi'i/ mi snang ba bgegs kyi mtshams bcad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ yul dpon la/nga yi sgrub pa ma thon par 'tshe ba mi btang bar gnyer mdzod ces bya'o/ /bgegs kyi mtshams la gnyis/ rgyal chen bzhi bya ra'i tshul du gtad pa/ khro bo bcu jag pa'i tshul du gtad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub khang gi phyi phyogs bzhir tho bzhi brtsig shing rigs bzhi la rgyal — 226 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagachen bzhi'i gzugs bzhi btags la dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ gser skyems dang g.yu sngon gyis mchod la/ phrin las bcol la bzhag go / gnyis pa khro bcu ni/ sgrub khang gi phyogs bcur dong bcu brus la/ der phyogs skyong bcu bkug la/ phur pa bcu khro bcur bskyed/ ye shes pa bcug mchod bstod byas la phrin las bcol ba gdab bo/ /steng du tho re brtsig go / de nas dam sri'i liṅgā bris/ dgug gzhug bya/ khyi thod du bcugare bas dril/ them pa'i 'og tu mnan la rgyas 'debs chen po'i bros sbyang ngo / /de nas shing gi byang bu la gshin rje gshed bris la dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa bcug la mchod cing bstod la phyi sgo la btags te phrin las bcol lo/ / de nas yang shing gi byang bu la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bri/ ye shes pa bcug mchod cing bstod la nang sgo la gdags so/ / de nas stegs bu brtsig pa ni/ sa chog ltar brtags la stegs bu bya/ me long gi ngos ltar bcags la nub mo me tog bkod par lha sta gon bya/ nangs par snga dro ba su tas thig gdab/ grogs 'khor lo rgyas 'debs su bsam/ nyi ma phyed nas tshon bri/ mi rus la dkar po/ dur khrod so phag la dmar po/ ro sol la nag po/ ro khung du sngo skyes pa la ljang gu'o/ / de'i steng du rdzas dang lha phur bkod/ rgyan dang bla bre dgram/ phrin las gzhung bsrang / dal sgrub/ 'dzab dang phur bskor bya/ snang tshad dpal gyi skur bsam/ grags tshad gī la yi sgra/dran rigs thams cad thugs chos nyid du lhan ni lhang nger gsal ba'i sgo nas lo zla'i bar du sgrub bo/ / gab pa'i sngags drug dkyus khong khrar btang / brgyad pa ni/ de ltar bsgrubs pas rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po byung ba dang / dngos grub blang bar bya ste/ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams nye bar bzhag pa la/ sngags dang dbyangs dang bcas pas dngos grub blang ngo / /de nas tshe chog rgyas par bya/ lhag chad kha bskang / bkra shis gsol lo/ / sgrub pa'i lung rdzogs so/ /shrī ku mā ra na mo/ de yang grub rtags ni ya nga ba dang / skyi zing ba dang / byin chung ba dang skyo ba byung na bdud kyi rtags yin pas tshar bcad par bya'o/ / ye shes lha yi rtags ni/nyams dga' ba dang / byin che ba/ zhe dro zhing ting nge 'dzin skye ba 'byung bas de'i dus su ka pā lar bcud rnam pa sna tshogs bsags la/ dal gyi dbus su bzhag oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya/ma hā sirnyi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyi spro bsdus bstim la 'di skad do/ / hūṃ/srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ gī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes brjod la/ oṃ ni bsnyen pa'i dbu btsugs nas/ do nub phan chad zhag grangs thems/ /dang po'i — 227 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/zhag grangs dus kyang do nub lags/ /rdo rje bsnyen pa'i grangs kyang do nub tshang / /rdo rje sgrub pa'i nam yang do nub langs/ /bzlas brjod bsgoms pa'i grangs kyang tshang lags pas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ā be sha ya a ā/ zhes pas dngos grub bstim mo/ /hūṃ/ dpal chen khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ / bzlas brjod sgrub pa'i grangs kyang tshad lags pas/ / dngos grub chen po stsol ba'i dus la bab/ / hūṃ/ dbus kyi gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i da la nas/ / rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /yab yum gnyis su med pa'i bha ga nas/ /gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dngos grub stsol/ /hūṃ/ shar phyogs brgya byin bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ /rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje snyems ma dang / / sprul ba'i phra men stag dang bya rgod bcas/ / shar gyi phyogs la mnga' mdzad pas/ / brgya byin 'khor bcas 'dul ba dang / / sems la dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol/ / de thams cad la 'gres su shes par bya/ hūṃ/ lho phyogs gshin rje bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ / gshin rje sogs tshigs gsum 'gre/ gshin rje'i 'khor bcas 'dul ba dang / /tshe la dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /hūṃ/ nub phyogs chu lha bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ / rta mgrin rgyal po sogs/ klu yi 'khor rnams 'dul ba dang / /chos la dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol/ / hūṃ/ byang phyogs bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ /bdud rtsi sogs/ gnod sbyin 'khor rnams 'dul ba dang / /las la dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /hūṃ/ shar lhor bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ /dbyug sngon sogs/ me lha'i 'khor rnams 'dul ba dang / / ye shes dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol/ / hūṃ/ lho nub bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ / mi g.yo sogs/ bden bral 'khor rnams 'dul ba dang / / skye la dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol/ / hūṃ/ nub byang bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ / gzhan gyis sogs/ rlung lha'i 'khor rnams 'dul ba dang / / yo byad dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /hūṃ/ byang shar bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal sogs/ dbang ldan 'khor rnams 'dul ba dang / /smon lam dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /hūṃ/ steng phyogs bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ /hūṃ kar sogs/ tshangs pa'i 'khor rnams 'dul ba dang / /mos la dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol/ / hūṃ/ 'og phyogs bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ /stobs chen sogs/ sa bdag 'khor rnams 'dul ba dang / / rdzu 'phrul dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol/ / hūṃ/ gser gyi phur pa zur bzhi yi/ / logs la rgyas pa'i lha bkod de/ /bsgom zhing bsgrub pa'i don lags kyi/ / khro rgyal sku yi dngos grub stsol/ / des 'gre/ hūṃ/— 228 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagazangs kyi phur pa zla gam gyi/ / ngos la dbang gi lha bkod de/ / bsgom zhing bsgrub pa'i don lags kyi/ /khro rgyal gsung gi dngos grub stsol/ /hūṃ/ dngul gyi phur pa zlum po la/ /ngos la zhi ba'i lha bkod de/ / bsgom zhing bsgrub pa'i don lags kyi/ / khro rgyal thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /hūṃ/ lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum gyi/ /ngo la drag po'i lha bkod de/ /bsgom zhing bsgrub pa'i don lags kyi/ / khro rgyal phrin las dngos grub stsol/ / ces pa dang / hūṃ/khro bos khro ba zhi mdzad pa/ /zhes pas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub zhu'o/ /de yang dang po bla ma la mchod/ de nas rim gyis za'o/ / dngos grub blang ba'i lung rdzogs so/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang / / zhes pa phra thig don gyi rnal 'byor bsgom na rtags dang mtshan ma myur du 'byung ba yin no/ / rgyud las/ dbang chen 'byung ba'i rim brtsegs ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lus la rdzogs/ /phung po lnga ni sras lnga'i dngos/ /sku lnga ye shes dgu dang ldan/ /rang sems nor bu rin po che/ /zhes gsungs pas/'di la gsum ste/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bskyed rim mo/ / dang po ni/ gong du rgyas par bstan no/ / nang ni phra mo'i rtsa la bsgom pa yin te/ de yang 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni rnal 'byor pa yi lus la rdzogs par gsang rgyud nas bshad pa/ spyi gtsug bde chen gyi dal na rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis 'dus pa'i dbus na/ bud+dhā 'dus pa'i sras mchog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon dung chen bhan dmar khro bo'i chas kyis brgyan pa brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa/ khro bcu'i 'khor dkar po can/ ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i tshul du bskyed do/ / mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo na rtsa 'dab bcu drug la pad+ma 'dus pa'i sras mchog dmar po/ pad+ma ze'u rgyas pa'i myu gu bsnams pa/ g.yon dung chen dmar gyis gang ba/ g.yon brkyang khro bcu dmar pos bskor ba/ ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i tshul du bsgom/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus na/ badz+ra 'dus pa'i sras mchog mthing ga rdo rje dung chen bsnams pa/ thugs kyi khro bcus bskor ba/ ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i tshul du bsgom/ lte ba sprul ba'i 'khor lo tso 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbus na rat+na 'dus pa'i sras mchog ser po/ rat+na zur brgyad pa bsnams pa/ g.yon dung khrag khro bcu ser pos bskor ba/ ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i tshul du bsgom/ gsang ba bde skyong tsakra rtsa 'dab brgya nyi shu'i dbus na/ karma 'dus pa'i sras mchog ljang gu/ rdo rje sna tshogs pa dang dung khrag khro bcu ljang gus bskor ba/ ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i tshul du bsgom/ de yang rgyud las/ chad pa ma yin rig cing gsal/ /rtag pa ma yin ngos bzung bral/ /snang stong dbyer med gdan la dbab/ /mtshon bya mtshon — 229 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/byed rang la rdzogs/ /ma btsal mi 'bral tshul du gnas/ /zhes bshad do/ / phra mo'i rnal 'byor rdzogs so/ /gu ru shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ gsang ba'i bskyed rim ni thig le'i rnal 'byor te/ rim brtsegs ga'al yas khang / lha thams cad rang gi sems la tshang bar gsang rgyud las/gsang ba'i gzha/la yas bstan pa ni/ / ye nas rang byung dam pa ste/ / sangs rgyas rol mo du mas 'khrigs/ /rgyan dang bla bre rang bzhin grub/ /sangs rgyas gzhal yas dam pa yin/ /de yi dbus na bzhugs pa'i lha/ /phra la dod pa brtag par bya/ /de la yang dang yang du ni/ /phra ba'i sems kyis bzung gyur na/ / mjug tu dmigs pa med pararna'agyur/ / zhes bshad pas na/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dbus kyi pho brang / sgo bzhi'i rnam shes sgo bzhi/ gtso bo yid shes dbus kyi gtso bo/ sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig 'khor/ ye shes lnga rtsig pa/'dod yon lnga 'dod snam/ mos gus rin chen pha gu/ snang ba sna tshogs drwa ba drwa phyed/tshad med bzhi rta babs bzhi/ ting nge 'dzin mu med pa mu khyud mu med pa de ltar shes pa'i ngang la ma bcos par bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dgongs pa'o/ / thig le'i rnal 'byor rdzogs so/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ rtogs pa lta ba'i lung rgyud las/ lta ba rtog bral ma 'khrul ba/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i dgongs pa yin/ / zhes pas/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i rgyud las/sku lnga ye shes dgu dang ldan/ /ces bshad pas rdo rje gzhon nu la gsum ste/ dang po gnas pa gzhi'i rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ rang gi sems yin te/ sems de rgyus ma bskyed pa/ rkyen gyis mi 'jig pa/ sangs rgyas sgam ste ma mdzad/ sems can sgrin te ma bcos/ rang byung gi ye shes chen po/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin no/ / bgrod pa lam gyi rdo rje gzhon nu ni/gong ltar ma go ba'i sems can snying re rje snyam du stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ thabs shes gnyis med lam du khyer ba kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ / grub pa 'bras bu'i rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ gong ltar rtogs pas glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba/ spros bral dag pa gnyis ldan chos sku de nyid do/ / de la sku lnga lhun gyis grub ste/ sems nyid spros bral de chos sku yin la/ de'i rgyan nam rol pa de longs sku dang / sprul sku gzhan snang du 'byung ba'o/ / de la sdug bsngal med pa de bde ba chen po'i sku/ de rnams dbyer ma rnyed pa de ngo bo nyid sku'o/ /de ltar sku lnga la ye shes dgu ldan te/ sems gsal la rtog pa med pas me long lta bu'i ye shes/sems so sor gsal bas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ sems mnyam par shes pas mnyam pa — 230 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum naganyid/ de'i don chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ / de yang lhun grub tu 'dus pas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /de ltar snang tshad ye shes su 'dug pas gdal ba rang byung gi ye shes/ rang gis rig cing rtogs pas rang byung gi ye shes/ cir snang ye shes su rgyas thebs pas sna tshogs gnyis med rgyas 'debs kyi ye shes/ de thams cad don la tha snyad dang bral bas spros bral bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes zhes bya ste/ de ltar sku lnga ye shes dgu po rang la tshang bas grub pa 'bras bu'i rdo rje gzhon nu zhes bya'o/ / des na rdo rje phur bu'i lta ba stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can bya ba yin no/ /rtsa rgyud las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /da lta'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /ma 'ongs bud+dhā'ang de 'dra'o/ /rtogs pa lta bu'i lung rdzogs so/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du/ / zhes pas don mtha' spyod pa'i lung ste/ spyod pa la gsum ste/ rgya chung ba sman pa'i spyod pa/ rgya che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod pa/ khyad 'phags rmad du byung ba'i spyod pa'o/ / dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bodhi sa twa'i spyod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni gsang sngags kyi spyod pa ste/ de la gsum/ gnyis med lta ba'i/ rlabs chen thabs kyi/ gdug pa 'dul ba'i spyod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ myang 'das las/ gnyis med lta ba gdeng du gyur/ / spyod pa rlabs chen thabs su spyod/ /phrin las thogs med snying rjes spyod/ /dam tshig nyon mongs dug lnga sgrol/ /skrub pa gnyis med rgyal po sgrub/ / shes rab rnam gsum rjes su bsgrub/ / phyi nang bka' brgyud don la mkhas/ / theg pa rim pa dgu la byang / / g.yeng ba med pa'i sgom pa la/ /dam tshig 'jig pa'i mkhar bzhin bsrung / / rdzas dang sngags rgya rtag tu 'chang / / phung po lnga yi dkyil 'khor du/ / sgyu ma 'dra ba'i tshul du bsgom/ / sems ni chos nyid ngang la gnas/ /'dzab dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcod/ / phrin las bye ba rnam par 'byed/ / gang la dmigs pa sgrub ces bshad/ / yid la bsam pa ci yang 'grub/ / ces pa de rnams gnyis med lta ba'i spyod pa yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ dug lnga po de rdo rje gzhon nu'i spyod pa yin te/thabs rig pa ye shes kyis 'dod chags la 'dod chags lam du khyer ba'i yab yum zhal sbyor du bstan pa ni lhan skyes ye shes su mtshon pa'o/ / zhe sdang can la zhe sdang lam khyer gyi spyod pa/khro gtum 'jigs pa'i sku dang ldan par ston pa ni gsal cha bstan pa'o/ / gti mug can la gti mug lam khyer glang po che'i ko bas brgyan pa ni mi rtog mtshon pa'o/ / nga rgyal can la nga rgyal lam du khyer ba'i spyod pa/ stag gi sham thabs bstan pas rtog bral chen po'i ston pa'o/ /— 231 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/phrag dog can la phrag dog lam khyer gyi spyod pa/ mi'i g.yang gzhi ya bskor gyon pa ni mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa'o/ / gsum pa gdug pa 'dul ba ni/ dpa' gtum 'jigs par ston pa'o/ /don mtha' spyod pa'i lung rdzogs so/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ /ces pas mi 'da' ba dam tshig gi lung zin te/ de la ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ bsrung thabs/ nyams na gso ba'o/ / dang po ni/ ngo bo sems rang gi dbang po rang gis thub pa'o/ / gsang rgyud las/stong ba chen po'i sems gsal ba/ /'di ni dam tshig gi ngo bo/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa nges tshig ni/ gsang rgyud las/ nges par bsrung ba dam pa la/ / 'das na tshig pas dam tshig go /zhes so/ /dbye ba bzhi ste/ thun mong spyi'i/ sgrub pa khyad par gyi/ spyod pa rgyud kyi/lta ba gal mdo'i dam tshig go /dang po la/ rtsa ba gsum dang / yan lag nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /dang po sku'i dam tshig bla ma yi dam la 'byor tshad 'bul/ gsung gi dam tshig tu des phog pa'i gsang sngags bzla/ thugs kyi dam tshig gsang ba gzhan du mi spel/ gsang ba'i dam rdzas gzer sba'o/ /yan lag nyi shu rtsa lnga spyi dang mthun/ myang 'das las/ sa gzhi chen po 'dra ste kun gyi brten/ / yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ste 'dod pa bskang / / gcan gzan seṅge 'dra ste zil gnon pas/ / spyi yi dam tshig de dag bsrung bar bya/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa khyad par gyi dam tshig nyi shu la/ gcan gzan(ru'i bka' zur tsam yang mi bcag cing gdan sa mi rlom)rgyal po seṅge bsad mi bya/ /za ma tog du ngan pa'i(bsam ngan spang)dug mi spyod/ /rin po che yi(sems bskyed pa mi spang)lcug ma bcad mi bya/ / gangs kyi zhun chu khol(gsang dbang gi yum mi spyad)ma yongs mi btung / / pad+ma rgyal po'i ze'u kha mi(mched mo mi spyad)'byed/ / bug rdol(ma smin pa'i) can gyi snod du bcud mi(phyag rgya mi bya)blug / ma brtags pa yi(byin gyis ma brlabs par mi za) zas dang nor mi bsrel/ / shel sgong dkar(dam tshig bsrung)po rdzab tu bsnub mi bya/ / snod ngan(snod min la gdams pa mi sbyin)dag tu seṅge'i zho mi bzho/ / yid bzhin(snod ldan la sbyin)nor bu thab tu yongs su mi sreg / bya yi rgyal po khyung gi gshog(thabs shes 'bral du mi bcug)mi bcag / gnam lcags ur mo sa la(gar thod thod du 'thab mi rung)gdab mi bya/ / stag gzig rol ba'i zas(tshogs kyi phud ma nyams par bya)kyi lhag mi za/ / rdo rjes gtams(dam bca' mi gtang)pa'i brag rnams yongs mi bshig / rdo rje ra bas(mtshams dam du bya)bskor ba'i tho mi dbral/ /mun pa gsal ba'i(ting nge 'dzin mi nyams par bya)sgron me yongs mi bsad/ /rdo rje chu yi(snying po mi bcad)'ol ka bcad mi bya/ /rgyal po'i(snod min la dbang mi bskur)rtags kyi phyag rgya yongs mi sbyin/ / rdo rje mkhar(dam tshig gtso bor bsrung)rdzong — 232 —

sgo/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagagatams pa rmang mi rlog /rgyal mtshan rtse yi(ruspyi bor bsgom)nor bu mi 'gog go /zhes myang 'das las bshad do/ / spyod pa rgyun gyi dam tshig la bzhi ste/ gnyid kyi dgra gzhom/ myos 'gyur chang bsdom/ le lo'i dgra spang / gsang ba'i brda bsrung ba'o/ /gal mdo la gsum/ma khrel ba la bzhi/ sgrub pa lhas ma khrel ba/ sri zhu bla mas ma khrel ba/ gdung sems mched kyis ma khrel ba/ g.yo sgyu rang gi sems kyis ma khrel ba'o/ /nyams pa bzhi ni/ rtsa ba nyams na sa bon rul ba dang 'dra/ yan lag nyams na ljon shing mes tshig pa dang 'dra/ dngos su nyams na sgo nga rul ba dang 'dra/ zur gyis nyams na 'bras bu mi 'byung ngo / / mthar phyin pa'i rtags bzhi la/ dam can 'du zhing mthu rtsal che ba dang / /gzi brjid che la ting 'dzin brtan pa dang / / yid du 'ong zhing 'dod pa 'grub pa dang / / mang pos bkur zhing grags pa thob pa 'byung / / zhes rgyud las bshad do/ / nyams pa'i rgyu bzhi la/ gdug pa dus su mi sgrol ba/ / 'di yang dam tshig nyams pa yin/ / ma mo mkha' 'gror gtor ma gcog /'di yang dam tshig nyams pa yin/ / bshad pa'i dam rdzas mi tshang ba/ / 'di yang dam tshig nyams pa yin/ /sems can don rnams mi byed pa/ /'di yang dam tshig nyams pa yin/ /ces gsang rgyud las bshad do/ / nyams pa gang gis bskang na de nyid las/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam nyams na/ /rang lha bla ma dam pa la/ /dbang rnams tshang bar nod byas te/ /'byor ba ci dang ci yod pa/ /bla ma la phul bskang bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / phyis mi byed par dam bca'o/ / dam tshig gi lung rdzogs so/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa/ / zhes pas gdab pa phrin las kyi lung bstan to/ / gdab las byas pa'i sems can gyi lus la snying rje med pas mtshon 'debs pa lta bu ma yin te/ 'o na ci lta bu zhe na/ phur pa ni lha dang ye shes su byin gyis rlobs pa yin pas/ de btab pas las dang nyon mongs pa zad nas ngan song du mi skye la/byang chub thob par byed pa yin no/ / des na sngags thabs che ba yin no/ / 'o na gang gis gang la 'debs na/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa de ma rig pa la 'debs/ ma rig pa ye shes su song tsa na thebs pa'i tshad/ thugs rje sprul ba'i phur pa khams gsum sems can la 'debs/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas na thebs pa'i tshad/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum gyi mkha' la 'debs/ thabs shes gnyis med du song tsa na thebs pa'i tshad/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa dgra bgegs la 'debs/ dgra bgegs rang sar zhi tsa na thebs pa'i tshad/ de yang myang 'das las/ byang chub sems kyi phur pa de/ / rnam rtog — 233 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/gzung 'dzin ngos la gdab/ /dngos po kun bral phur pa de/ /gdab dang mi gdab gnyis las 'das/ /skye med gdal ba'i phur pa de/ /dbyings la gdab na rig pa shar/ /ye shes la gdab na don dam rtogs/ / khyab gdal rang bzhin phur pa de/ / snang srid kun la khyab par gdab/ /de ltar rtogs na thebs pa yin/ /mngon du gyur na rtogs pa yin/ /tshig las 'das na sangs rgyas yin/ /grangs las 'das na brjod du med/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar rtogs pas nyon mongs zhi bas zhi ba'i phur pa'o/ /bud+dhā'i yon tan rgyas par byed pas rgyas pa'i phur pa/ rang sems dbang du 'dus pas dbang gi phur pa/ de 'khor ba las sgrol bar byed pas drag po'i phur pa yang de nyid do/ /des na myang 'das las/ chos kyi chos nyid phur pa yin/ / sems kyi sems nyid phur pa yin/ / nam mkha'i mtshan nyid phur pa yin/ /zhes pas mngon no/ / gdab pa phrin las kyi lung rdzogs so/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra la na mo/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /zhes pas/ 'di nas pha rol tu bsgral ba dang / pha rol bar do nas bde ba chen por bsgral ba'o/ /de nas rtogs pas bdag sgrol/ thugs rjes gzhan sgrol ba'o/ / des na rdo rje phur pa'i bdun tshigs kyi lung du 'brel ba la gsum ste/ shi ba po de gar skye nges pa med pas snying rje'i gnas su 'brel ba dang / bar du slob ma yin pas dam tshig 'brel ba dang / de rang yang yi dam lha dang 'brel ba zhig dgos so/ / de la chos brgyad de/ dang po rten bca' ba/ de nas bgegs dang dbral ba/ de nas ngan song nas drang pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbog pa/ ye shes kyi khrus bya ba/ chos bshad dbang rim bya ba/ lam bstan lha dang sprad/ las sbyor lha la bstim pa'o/ / dang po rten ni mtshan byang dri ma gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ spyi bor a bri/mgrin par tri/ snying gar dṛ/ lte bar su/ gsang bar pre/ rkang mthil du duḥre re bri'o/ /gnyis pa bgegs dang dbral ba ni/ hūṃ/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ /zhes pa nas/ klad pa khos brjod la sngags brjod/ gsum pa ngan song nas drang ba ni/ phrin las gzhung bsrang la/ gshin po dang pū dza'i lha mo rnams mgrin gcig tu mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ me tog gsal bkra ma yi mchod bkram zhing / / rnal 'byor rab tu gsang ba ma yi glu blangs nas/ / me tog gsal bkra ma yi mchod bshams pa/ / rnal 'byor rab tu gsal ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/ tshig de thams cad 'gres su shes par bya'o/ /hūṃ/ spos kyi sprin mdangs ma yi mchod bshams shing / /de man chad 'gres/ hūṃ/ gsal ba'i sgron me ma yi mchod bshams shing / 'gre/ hūṃ/ bdud — 234 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagartsi bshos mchod ma yi mchod bshams shing / /'gre/ nang gi lha mo la/ rdo rje 'gying chen ma yi mchod bshams shing / / oṃ badz+ra la s+thā hūṃ/ 'gre/ hūṃ/ rin chen dpal phreng ma yi mchod bshams shing / / 'gre/ hūṃ/ pad+ma dbyangs mkhan ma yi mchod bshams shing / /'gre/ hūṃ/ las kyi gar mkhan ma yi mchod bshams shing / /'gre/ de nas gsang mtshan nas 'bod cing dug sbyang ba/ hūṃ/ nyon cig tshe 'das sngags 'chang khyod/ / nga ni snying rje kun gyi mgon/ / nga ni byams pa kun gyi skyabs/ / khyod kyi slob dpon nga yin gyi/ / dang po skyes pa las las skyes/ / bar du rten yang las la brten/ / tha ma 'chi yang las kyis 'chi/ /khyod la mgon skyabs su yang med/ /khyod kyi slob dpon nga yin gyi/ /bden pa'i tshig la tshe 'das nyon/ / zhe sdang rab tu 'bar ba yis/ / dmyal ba'i gnas su khrid pa'i tshe/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba skyob mdzad pa/ /khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che/ /tshe 'das de la skyabs su song / / chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / / rdo rje gzhon nu'i gsang sngags dang / /stobs chen rgyal po'i thugs rje yis/ /tshe 'das dmyal ba'i gnas nas thar par shog /oṃ badz+ra krodha ma hā ba la a a/ che ge mo'i dug sarba pā paṃ shīn+ti ku ru swāhā/ dug chu la song zhigadug sa la song zhig dug me la song zhig dug rlung la song zhig dug nam mkha' la song zhig des 'gre'o/ /ser sna rab tu chags pa yis/ /yi dwags gnas su khrid pa'i tshe/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba skyob mdzad pa/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dpal/ /tshe 'das de la skyabs su song / / de man chad 'gre/ byol song la rnam rgyal/ mi la gshin rje/ lha ma yin la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ lha la hūṃ kā ra ste/ gnyen po'i lha la zhu'o/ / de nas rigs drug gi gtor ma btang / de nas tshe 'das la skyabs 'gro dbog de nas sems bskyed dbogade nas khrus gdon/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ / zhes pa gsum ka la bya/ hūṃ/bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i char phob la/ /dug lnga'i me chen zhi bar mdzod/ / ma rig bag chags 'khrud par shog / sngags bzla zhing bkru'o/ / hūṃ/ khrus mchog 'di nyid dpal dang ldan/ /nyon mongs dug lnga rnam sbyong ba'i/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags 'gre/ de nas chos bshad pa ni gshin dang gshed gnyis ka la rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad do/ /de nas dbang bskur ba ni bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ hūṃ/ bla ma yi dam bum pa 'di/ / bden pa'i stobs las byung ba yin/ / rig pa rtsal gyi dbang bskur ro/ /sems la dbang bskur thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya kā ya wā ka tsit+ta abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ de nas lam bstan pa ni/ hūṃ/ sngags 'chang tshe 'das skyes bu khyod/ / khyod ni rnam da 235 da

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/par nges pa'i rig 'dzin yin/ /sku gsum rnam par nges par bzung / /khyod ni tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin yin/ / phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs kyis/ / ye shes bla mar lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / de nyid lam mchog bstan pa ni/ hūṃ/ gti mug rtogs na thar ba'i rgyu/ /'bras bu chos dbyings ye shes thob/ /rig 'dzin gzugs kyi phung po 'di/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ / sku yi dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig / hūṃ/ 'dod chags rtogs na thar ba'i rgyu/ /'bras bu sor rtog ye shes te/ /rig 'dzin 'du shes phung po 'di/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ / gsung gi dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig / hūṃ/ zhe sdang rtogs na thar ba'i rgyu/ /'bras bu me long ye shes te/ /rig 'dzin rnam shes phung po 'di/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ / thugs kyi dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig / hūṃ/ nga rgyal rtogs na thar ba'i rgyu/ /'bras bu mnyam nyid ye shes te/ /rig 'dzin tshor ba'i phung po 'di/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /yon tan dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig /hūṃ/ phrag dog rtogs na thar ba'i rgyu/ /'bras bu bya grub ye shes te/ /rig 'dzin 'du byed phung po 'di/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /phrin las dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig /de nas bden pa'i stobs kyi smon lam gdab bo/ / de nas dal bris la gshed dang phral ba nas dbang gi bar du byas la/nye drung 'bral ba'i zas gtad/ chos dang longs spyod gtad par bya'o/ /hūṃ/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ /gsang sngags mthu las byung ba yi/ /yul zhing bud med la sogs pa/ /zas dang gos dang nor dbyig dang / /'phags pa'i nor dang gter chen 'dis/ /dbul ba'i nyon mongs sel bar shog /ces de ltar kun gyis smon lam gdab bo/ /de nas byang bu bcags la sbyin sreg bya/ sa dang chu la sāts+tsha gdab/ bdun tshigs kyi lung rdzogs so/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ rdo rje me dbal snying bsreg cing / / zhes pas ro sreg gi lung zin te/ dang po thab khung ni gru bzhi zlum po zla gam gsum du byas la mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas ni/ dkar gsum mngar gsum til rtsi mar gyi dgang blugs/ til nag dang yungs nag gi dgang blugs/ hom gzar dang dgang gzar sogs/ ro khrus nas bton la/ hūṃ/'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma dag mdzad cing / /sbyin pa yongs su rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phar phyin drug po 'gre/ de nas ro la dris byug la bsrung ba bya'o/ /de nas me lha'i cho ga bya ste/ thab bsang la ram̐ las me lha ji lta ba bskyed/ de la ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong che/ /bsreg blugs zhal — 236 —

sgo/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagazas bzhes slad du/ /dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /lhag pa'i phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir/ / 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ / oṃ de wa shrī an+ni ye sa mā dzaḥ de la phyi mchod dbul lo/ / bsreg rdzas rnams dbul/ hom gzar dgang gzar gyis dgang gyin dkar gsum mngar gsum mar brgya rtsa brgyad dbul/ de nas sarba bi shwa dha shīn+ti ku ru swāhā/ des dbul lo/ / de nas bstod pa bya ste/ hūṃ/ dam tshig dbang gis skur sprul ba/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ / me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog / 'byung po yongs su bskyab slad du/ / thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul ba'i/ / drang srong rig 'dzin grub pa'i tshul/ / nyon mongs sreg mdzad shes rab 'od/ / bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan/ / thabs kyi theg pa'i ra la chibs me dpung bgrang phreng rig sngags zlos/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghurnye bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la sim/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /zhi bar snyems pa thugs rje che/ /tshangs sras mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ de wa shrī asno ye sa ma yi dz+wa la ram̐ hūṃ ram̐ phaṭa ram̐ lan bdun brjod la dug lnga bsregs pa'i me 'bar zhing 'khrugs par bsam mo/ / de nas lhag pa'i lha yi bsreg las ni/ me'i nang du dal gsum gyi lha rdzogs par bskyed pa la ye shes pa bcug tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib ki nag por gyur/ de bsreg rdzas la thim pa'i mar nag dang til nag hom gzar dang dgang gzar gyis blug oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya sdig sgrib badz+ra yak+ka krodha khā hi/ asno ye ram̐ shīn+ti ku ru swāhā/ brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul lo/ / de nas bstod par bya'o/ /de nas tshe 'das kyi phung po lnga sras mchog lnga la dbul te/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ / badz+ra 'dus pa'i sras mchog gī la ya/ / zhe sdang 'joms pa'i rdo rje me dbal na/ / tshe 'das rnam shes phung po 'di bsreg pas/ /zhe sdang nyon mongs dag gyur nas/ /me long ye shes rtogs par shog /ces pa kun la sbyar/ de nas tshe 'das kyi 'byung ba yum lnga la dbul te/ hūṃ/ sems ni nam mkha'i rang bzhin te/ / rdo rje dbyings phyug ma dang gnyis su med/ / yum gyi thugs dang gnyis su med/ / bden pa'i stobs kyis 'grub par shog /hūṃ/ lus 'di sa yi rang bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas spyan dang gnyis su med/ /yum gyi sku dang gnyis su med/ /'gre/ drod khrag dbugs la sbyar/ de nas tshe 'das kyi rnam shes tshogs brgyad dal la dbul ba/ hūṃ/ tshe 'das mig gi rnam shes 'di/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /chos nyid bden pa'i don rtogs shog /des 'gre/ mig rna ba 'gre'o/ / rna ba'i mchod pa/ chos nyid sgra chen thos par shog /— 237 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/des 'gre/ tshe 'das lus ngag yid gsum 'di/ / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dbul/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub par shog / smon lam gzhan yang gdab par bya'o/ / tshe 'das kyang dal gsum gyi lhar khrong gis song bar bsgom mo/ / de nas rtogs pa'i rgyas gdab bo/ / ro sreg gi lung rdzogs so/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ rdo rje phur pa'i sā ts+tsha'i lung / dang po sa yi cho ga bya/ phur bus gdab/ de nas sa de la gī la ya bzlas pa'i 'od kyi gong bur bsam/ 'bi 'bi thabs rdo rjer bsgom/ brkos phor shes rab bha gar bsgom/ 'bi 'bi brkos phor bcug pa yab yum sbyor bar bsgom/ oṃ dīp+ta tsakra s+t+waṃ e lī māṃ pya two e he ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas 'gro ba'i don du longs skur byon par bsgom/ kyi la ya bzlas pas khro bo khro mor bsgom/ mchod rten yin na gzhal yas khang du bsam/ nang la dal gsum tshang bar bsgom/ de yang rgyas pa'i sāts+tsha 'debs na/ gī la ya kun la 'gre/ na maḥs man+ta trī trī phaṭa bzla/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par gyur/ dbang gis 'debs na su ru su ru pra su ru bzla/ zhi ba byed na bi ta ya bing bing bzla/ drag por 'debs na mā ra ya mā ra ya bzla/ gshin po'i don du 'debs na/ rus pa la dug sbyangs la/ de nas brdung la/ 'jim pa dang bsres la gdab/gshin bsngo bya'o/ / sāts+tsha'i lung i tha/ na mo gu nu shrī badz+ra ku mā ra ya/ rdo rje phur pa'i rab gnas la/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/las sbyor dang / sa chog sngon du 'gro bas stegs bu gru bzhi bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i rdzas bsags la bsnyen pa bya'o/ /bgegs bskrad pa la nan tan cher bya'o/ /ma dag sbyang ba'i shu n+ya tā dzñā nas stong bar bsgom/ mchod rten yin na rat+na pañtsa e gru gsum gyi gzhal med khang du bsgom/nang du dal gsum bskyed par bya'o/ / sku gzugs de nyid gsung yin na ā li kā lir bskyed/de la ye shes pa spyan drangs la gzhug bsnyen dus kyi sngags la ye dharmā btags la 'bru la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te gtor/ oṃ dharma dhā tu dz+wa la gaste lha da ya sarba ta thā ga to sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha s+t+waṃ/ye shes pa dngos su bsam/ sku gzugs yin na spyan dbye zhal bsro/ mchod rten yin na gdugs rgyal mtshan dbul/ gsung la zhabs bro/ ngo bsro/ mnga' dbul lo/ / spyan dbye ba/ hūṃ/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / ye shes thugs rje'i spyan mdangs kyis/ /'gro ba'i sems can gzigs slad du/ /ye shes spyan 'di dbye bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭapa ta hūṃ/ gser thur gyis bya'o/ / hūṃ/ nyon mongs rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir/ /ye shes spu gri thabs mchog dang / /shes rab ral gri so mang gis/ /— 238 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagadug lnga'i lo ma 'breg par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 'gre/ n+nid+dhā ke sha phaṭa/ hūṃ/ rgyan dang mdzes pa'i na bza' 'di/ / gu ling pañtsa li ka dang / / tshul khrims gtsang ma'i na bza' 'di/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ sarba 'gre/ pra tī sarba mu kha hūṃ/ de nas rin chen sna bdun dbul lo/ /mchod rten la gdugs dbul ba/ hūṃ/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad la/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor slad du/ / gser gyi gdugs mdzes yu bar ldan/ /chos kyi sil ma thob phyir dbul/ /oṃ sarba ts+tsha tram̐ shrī ka pa mu tra hūṃ/ rgyal mtshan dbul ba/ hūṃ/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /bar chad bdud las rgyal ba'i phyir/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan nyi zlar bcas/ /bstan pa mi nub bya phyir dbul/ /oṃ sarba ha tsa ra tsa tri ka hūṃ/ ba dan dbul ba/ hūṃ/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad la/ / mdzes pa'i ba dan 'bar ba ni/ /'phur zhing rlobs la bskyod pa 'di/ /bskul ma gdab phyir dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā lam̐ tri sha ka sa mu dra hūṃ/ de nas rin chen sna bdun dbul/ de nas bkra shis mnga' gsol/ mchod par bya/ gtor ma byas la chos skyong dpal mgon lcam sring la gtad do/ / bskal ba du mar sems can gyi don du bzhugs su gsol/ rab gnas kyi lung rdzogs so/ /shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo/ bsnyen pa bskyal ba'i gdams pa'i lung la gnyis te/ thun mong gi bzlas pa dang / khyad par gyi bzlas pa'o/ / dang po la bzhi ste/ bsnyen pa/ nye bar bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po'o/ /ye shes lha nye bar bsnyen pa ni/ rgyud las/sbam phur dag la bsnyen te bsgrub/ / 'bru dgu dag gi don shes bya/ / lta ba de nyid dmigs dang bral/ / zhes pas 'bru dgu ni/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya hūṃ/ zhes pa ste/ de yang mtshams dam du bcad/ thod par nas nag po blug phur pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa rnams la dar gyi cod pan re btags/ tshon skud kyis bcings/ gzungs thag nas bzung la bzlas te/ tshogs dus gnyis su bya'o/ / phrin las kyi gzhung la 'dzab khang dbye ba'i bar du bya/ de nas e ram̐ gyis gzhal yas khang gnyis su bya/ dz+wa la ram̐ gyis thod pa gnyis su bya/dkyil 'khor gcig mdun du bsam/ de nas sngags bzla ba ni/ de nas bdag gi thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ/ hūṃ la gī la yas bskor ba la sems gtad nas bzla/ de yang sngags de rdo rje'i rtse mo nas yar thon/ ye shes sems dpa'i mgrin pa nas zhugs/ yar zhal du thon/ bdag gi mgrin pa nas yar brgyud/ sna bug g.yas nas thon/ ye shes kyi rdo rje gzhon nu'i sna bug g.yon du zhugs/ thugs kar thim/ge 239 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ ci 'dod kyi dngos grub blang bar bsgom/ yang khong gi shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ bdag gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ snying gar thim par bsam/ de ni gser gyi ba thag gzings pa'i tshul du bzla ba'o/ / thun mtshams su bzlas pa sras mchog la bcol/ de nas yang thun gnyis pa la yang des 'gre'o/ / de ltar dus dang grangs dang mtshan ma'i bar du ste/ rgyud las/ dus ni tha ma lo gcig ste/ /grangs ni bye ba bskyal bar bya/ / rtags ni zhal mthong lung bstan pa'o/ / zhes pa'o/ /mjug tu sarba bigha nān btags pa'ang shas cig bzla'o/ / gnyis pa dam can nye bar bsnyen pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi zur bzhir srung ma'i stegs bu dma' ba de dag la/ dbus mthing nag zla gam dmar po/ gru chad ljang gu/ snam bu dang sgo phyogs dang bstun par bya/rang gi dam rdzas gzhung ltar dgod pa la/ tshogs dus bzhir byas te/ gzhung bsrang la 'dzab khang dbye ba'i bar du bya/ dang po gī la yas sna drangs la gzhi snying gcig tu dril ba ka haṃ ka ye bzla/ nyin mtshan dril la bzla/ rtags byung na gang nye ba la mthil gtad/ spyi rtags srog chags bsad pa dang / glang khrid pa 'ong / sgos rtags gcan gzan rmis na shā na ma nye/ bud med nya sbrul byung na bse mo nye/ bud med nag mo bya nag byung na bdag nyid chen mo nye/ mi reng dkar dmar rta ba byung na ging nye/ de la mthil gtad/ gzhan bag re bzla'o/ /de ni dam can snying nye bya ba yin no/ /gsum pa ngan sngags nye bar bsnyen pa ni/zhag drug bya ste/ tshogs dus drug tu btang ngo / / ngan sngags rgyal po drug ni/ re re la khri tsho re bzla/ kha bsgyur la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bya/ gzhung bsrang la 'dzab kyi skabs su 'dzab khang dbye la/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī la ya/ ha sa ya ra da ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di nyid rkyang du bzla/ nub gnyis pa la a be sha bzla/ nub gsum pa la/ shī sgro ā na ya bzla/ bzhi ba la dza ye bi dza ye bzla/ lnga ba la ta thā ya bzla/ drug pa la bi da ya bzla/ 'dzab bstod bya/nub bdun pa la/ ngan sngags rgyal po drug po sngon du 'gro bas dma' dbab par bya ste/ lha dang phral ba'i bskul dang / 'phyang dang / rdzas dang / ting nge 'dzin smon lam la sogs lag len rdzogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la dbab par bya/ gsum pa byad du gzhug bzhi ba smyor gzhug lnga pa rdul du brlag drug pa zhal du bstab par bya/ de nas tshe lung khrus lung bya'o/ / gsal ba gsum dang ldan pas a a kho'i tshe bdag la bstim/ de nas dang po phaṭa dral/ gnyis pa gnad sleb/ gsum pa tog blang / de nas gnas spar bar bya'o/ / de nas sgo ma bzhi'i phur pa lus kyi mtsho bzhi la gdab ste/ de nas gtun du brdung / rdungs — 240 —

༄/ /phur 'grel 'bum nagashig rdo rje 'bar ba nas/ kha baṃ yan chad brjod do/ /de nas mtshon gyis gtub/ de nas zhal du bstab par bya'o/ /de ltar nub tha ma la/ sur phug tu gdab las yan chad rgyas par bya'o/ / ngan sngags nye bsnyen no/ / de rnams kyis thun mong gi bzlas pa tshar ro/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi bzlas pa la gnyis te/ lha 'dzab la brten te bla na med pa'i byang chub skrub pa dang / dgra 'dzab la brten te dgra bgegs tshar bcad pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ gī la chos nyid dang sbyar te bzlas pa dang / gī la ya lha dang sbyar te bzlas pa'o/ /dang po 'dzab khang dbye/ bar du 'dzab bzla/ tha ma 'dzab bstod bya'o/ / dang po zin pa dang / bar du 'dzab la e ram̐ gyis gzhal yas khang phye/ dz+wa la ram̐ gyis lha gnyis su phye/ de nas bdag gi thugs ka'i sems dpa' sum brtsegs khro chung dang bcas pa bzlas pas/ ye shes sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa yang bzla/ rdo rje gzhon nu 'bum phrag dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas di ri ri bzlas par bsam pa ni/ bung ba tshang zhig pa'i tshul du zlos pa'o/ / kun rdzob de ltar zlos kyang don dam par chos nyid kyi rang bzhin sgra skye med du lteng lteng bsam mo/ /de ni shun tu zab cing sgrub thag nye ba yin ces pad+ma rgyal pos gsungs so/ /gnyis pa lha dang sbyar te bzlas pa ni/ 'dzab khang dbye ba sogs sngar dang 'dra/ bdag gis bzlas pas rdo rje'i rwa phrag nas mar byung / ye shes sems dpa'i zhal nas thon/ rta mgrin yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas yar drangs/ lce steng gi snang ba mtha' yas la bskor phyir thon/ sna bug g.yas nas drangs/ spyi bo'i rnam snang la bskor/ slar log lce steng nas phar 'phros/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar thim/ mchod pas mnyes par bsgom/ tshur log lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ dngos grub byin par bsam/de nas sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can dkyil 'khor gsum du gyur/phrin las bzhi yis 'gro don byed par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa dgra 'dzab ni/ dgra bo glo bur du byung na bya ste/ sbam phur la brten nas thun mong gi bzlas pa skyel ma khoms na/ dang po bsnyen pa rang nas brub khung bca'/ srung ma'i dkyil 'khor byas la/ de nas gzhung bsrang /'dzab khang dbye ba yan chad byas la 'dzab bzlas pa la dam can bzhi'i snying po nyin mtshan gnyis ka dril la bzla/ ting nge 'dzin mtshon cha'i char 'bebs par bsam/ de nas spyi rtags dang sgos rtags la sogs sngar dang 'dra/ rtags phebs na ngan sngags nye bsnyen zhag drug bya/ de nas nub gcig la mā ra ya bsad pa'i dkyil 'khor bya ba 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar gru gsum byas pa der/ gdab las rgyas par bya'o/ / des dgra la rtags 'ong — 241 —

phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/ngo / /dgra 'dzab rdzogs so/ /de nas gso ba gsum gal che ste/ dang po bdag gso ba ni/ gī la ya nyer gcig bzlas la/ khams gsum thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i lhar bskyed/ de las 'od 'phros bud+dhā'i thugs bskul/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ bdag gi'ang rtog sgrib sbyangs/bdag gsal la 'tsher bar bsam mo/ / gnyis pa ni gī la ya bco brgyad bzlas pas khams gsum thams cad phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du song / klad la bskor zhing bzlas pas 'od 'phros/ bud+dhā'i thugs bskul/ 'gro drug gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ phur pa gsal 'tsher du bsgom/ gsum pa dgra la rtags byung ba dang / kho'i rnam shes hūṃ du gyur/ yi las rlung gis bteg ste lha yab yum mtshams sbyor su phaṭa kyis 'phang ngo / / sku gsum thob par bsam mo/ /bsnyen pa'i lung rdzogs so/ /rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho las/ / mkhas pa gsum gyis legs bkral de nyid bcud/ / (mngon)phyung nyung ngur bsdus te(gnad)dril(ba)/ / bstan la phan phyir yi ger bkod pa'o/ / 'bum nag rdzogs so/ / sa'i steng du nyi zla ltar gyur cig / shu s+t+waṃ/

༄khya //dpal rdo rje phur pa'i chos 'byung dang rgyud 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/sgribangapo/ hūm̐chen/ dnganyi zla/ da wa dpe sgrum ma khan/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang /'grems spel mkham/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi bod yi ga rtso ma sgrig bang /banas yu' pe cin co phing li byang 'a ma ang 14pa/sbras sring a nga grangs/ 100013kha par ang grangs/ 010 —6427531 1nga ra 'debs mkhan/ petshocin ti 'in par 'debs bzo grwa/brgyud 'tshong mkhan/ rgyal yongs sa sanas so so 'i zhin hwa dpe chong lang /deb tshod/ 7877kro྾ 10927tsā 1 ( ’ 6par shago 15 6 25par gzhi'i sgrig thengs 2006'o 'i zla 6par par ga'i dang po bsgrigs/nga ra thengs/ 2006lo'i zla 6nga ra nge cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/spraradri/ngar+sā/ lta01 — 15()0rin gang sgar 18 ()0
